summary: Agrievolution Group is a comprehensive provider of products and services catering to agriculture, gardening, pet care, hardware, and outdoor needs. They offer a wide range of items and also provide specialized services such as soil restoration, grain processing, excavator rental, agricultural consulting, and garden maintenance. Their mission is to be a one-stop shop for all customer needs, simplifying activities and offering innovative, reliable solutions.

name: Vegesul
summary: Vegesul is an agricultural supplier based in the Serra Gaúcha region of Brazil, offering a comprehensive range of products and technologies to boost agricultural production. They provide seeds, fertilizers, residue-free technology, drones, and tools for fruit growers, vegetable producers, nursery operators, and home gardeners. Vegesul aims to support farmers with technology, information, and quality products to enhance their daily operations and overall productivity.

name: SmartGrow
summary: SmartGrow provides a precision information system to support farmers in making optimal decisions for crop cultivation. Their offerings include the SmartGrow system, focusing on hemp cultivation and irrigation systems, along with consulting services. The company aims to enhance crop yields through data-driven insights.

name: HuizingHarvest
summary: HuizingHarvest is a global technical support provider for the agricultural sector, offering services such as machine validation, assembly, rework, maintenance, and training to manufacturers, dealers, and agricultural businesses. They also operate a jobs department connecting qualified candidates with agricultural opportunities worldwide and invest in developing young talent. Their mission is to provide tailored technical expertise and practical, innovative solutions to the agricultural industry.

name: My Softivert
summary: Softivert is a company specializing in precision agriculture products and solutions, developing and selling kits and equipment for optimized farming. Founded in 2003, they aim to provide time, energy, and cost savings to their clients across France and Europe through simple, scalable systems. They offer a wide range of products including dosing systems, motors, pumps, and accessories, supported by expert advice and worldwide delivery.

name: 天津高福农牧设备有限公司 (Tianjin Gofu Farming Equipment Co., Ltd.)

They offer automated feeding, drinking, environmental control, and ventilation systems, as well as laying nests and flooring. The company also acts as a regional agent for imported products and collaborates with international companies to develop advanced equipment for poultry farming and animal husbandry facilities.

name: Belhomme
summary: Belhomme is a French company established in 1956, specializing in agricultural machinery. Their flagship product line, Reflex, has continuously evolved with technological advancements, including the latest Reflex 3000 with Tactelec young plant detection, offering environmentally friendly solutions for crop cultivation.

name: Agritap
summary: Agritap is a company that provides products and services tailored for the agricultural sector, indicated by the slogan "O melhor para o Homem do Campo" (The best for the Man of the Field). The website offers contact information including a physical address, phone number, and email, suggesting it serves as a point of contact for agricultural professionals.

name: REICHERT SPEZIALAUFBAUTEN

They offer integrated solutions for dosing, transferring, and distributing agricultural materials, along with accessories and custom-built options. The company provides comprehensive service, including consultation, custom fabrication, maintenance, repair, and spare parts procurement, aiming to optimize agricultural workflows for their clients.

summary: Sami Máquinas is an authorized dealer specializing in agricultural machinery, including tractors, harvesters, and implements. name: Maquinas Donni
summary: Maquinas Donni is a company specializing in agricultural equipment, offering sales, purchases, and specialized technical assistance for agricultural implements. The company emphasizes customer trust, quality, and commitment, offering a wide variety of implements for different crops and competitive purchasing conditions.

With a commitment to enhancing crop productivity and quality, Inootec provides sales, support, and equipment designed for operational efficiency in the field.

Led by its Founder & CEO, Disha Kedia, the company offers services focused on social media strategy and execution. They aim to build strong online identities for their clients, as evidenced by their portfolio and client testimonials.

name: FORMEDIA CZ s.r.o.
summary: FORMEDIA CZ s.r.o. is a marketing agency based in Hradec Králové, Czech Republic, specializing in online marketing services. They offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including website creation, e-commerce development, PPC advertising, social media management, graphic design, and SEO optimization. Their mission is to help businesses enhance their online presence, attract new clients, and outperform competitors through professional digital marketing strategies.

name: Bonn.digital
summary: Bonn.digital is an agency specializing in digital communication, focusing on helping companies and institutions effectively utilize social media. They offer services such as social media strategy, community management, content creation, and media production. Additionally, they organize and consult on digital and hybrid events, aiming to connect communities through digital platforms and engaging events.

name: Agência Club
summary: Agência Club is a digital marketing agency offering services such as social media management, website development, e-commerce store creation, and traffic management. They aim to help businesses improve their online presence and achieve better results through tailored strategies. The agency also provides free website evaluations to identify areas for improvement.

name: ARCOsports
summary: ARCOsports is an SEO marketing agency that specializes in enhancing online presence through search engine optimization, social media management, and targeted email marketing services. They aim to increase client visibility, drive engagement, and deliver personalized content to target audiences. The company also offers advertisement services for other businesses on the internet.

name: hersocial.com.au
summary: Hersocial.com.au is a social media and creative agency specializing in organic social media growth and brand visibility for lifestyle brands. They offer services including social media management, branding and design, content creation, and various design services like shopfront signage and stationery. The agency aims to enhance brand presence and engagement for its clients.

name: Délit d'influence
summary: Délit d'influence is a marketing agency that positions itself as a partner committed to client business development, not just a service provider. They offer a range of expertise including consulting, web development, studio services, event management, social media strategy, and training. Their approach emphasizes understanding client needs and objectives before implementing creative and technical solutions to achieve performance.

name: UpHigh LLC
summary: UpHigh LLC is a digital marketing agency specializing in services for comedic entertainers and businesses. They offer a comprehensive suite of marketing solutions including social media management, content creation, website design, SEO, SEM, and paid media strategy. Their mission is to help clients achieve new heights in their professional careers through tailored digital strategies and authentic content.

name: WSI
summary: WSI is a global digital marketing agency network that helps businesses solve their digital marketing challenges. They offer a comprehensive suite of services including lead generation, online reputation management, brand awareness, and website design. With over two decades of experience and a network of consultants worldwide, WSI focuses on delivering tailored strategies to achieve remarkable results for their clients.

name: ZWOLSBLOND
summary: ZWOLSBLOND is a creative agency specializing in social media management and graphic design for businesses. Founded by Myrthe, who discovered her passion for online business presentation through her own successful coffee bar, the company aims to make businesses visible online. They offer services to manage and enhance social media presence, providing creativity and time-saving solutions for clients.

name: cf-grafix
summary: cf-grafix is a creative agency specializing in tailored marketing solutions and innovative advertising strategies. They offer services including brand development, social media marketing, web design, and search engine optimization to help businesses succeed in the digital age. The company aims to bring brands to life through impressive campaigns and customized solutions aligned with client goals.

name: FORTIN
summary: FORTIN is a digital communication agency that specializes in reinventing brand image, online presence, and communication strategies for clients. They focus on connecting key elements in online promotion to achieve brand consolidation, notoriety, and sales objectives. The agency offers services including copywriting, branding, web design, SEO, paid advertising, social media promotion, and photo/video production.

name: Affari Audiovisual (Reboost)
summary: Affari Audiovisual, operating under the brand Reboost, is a creative agency specializing in social media management and digital marketing. They offer services such as content creation, influencer collaborations, paid advertising, brand strategy, and website optimization to help businesses and brands grow their online presence. Their mission is to act as the right partner for brands, ensuring their content reaches the target audience and drives measurable results.

name: Meraviglia Siena
summary: Meraviglia Siena is a marketing agency that focuses on transforming digital efforts into tangible business results such as leads, sales, and revenue. They offer a range of services including SEO, social media management, online advertising, content marketing, and branding. The agency aims to help businesses enhance their online presence and achieve concrete objectives through innovative strategies and advanced technology.

name: UDIGIT SRL
summary: UDIGIT is a creative agency specializing in digital solutions and corporate communication. They offer services such as website development, social media marketing, online advertising, direct marketing, lead generation, and influencer marketing. The agency focuses on helping clients build brand awareness, create engaging content, foster community interaction, and achieve measurable business objectives through an omnichannel approach.

name: Violetto Communication
summary: Violetto Communication is a communication agency based in Cittadella, Italy, specializing in strategic, modern, and effective marketing solutions. They offer services including website and e-commerce creation/restyling, corporate identity design, product graphics, advertising, social media strategy and management, and community building. The agency aims to help businesses grow by providing professional, dedicated, and personalized consulting rooted in the local territory.

name: Republika
summary: Republika is a strategically driven digital creative agency that focuses on building lasting relationships between brands and customers. They leverage digital marketing tactics like social media, search, and email marketing, combined with creative risk-taking and solid strategy, to deliver high-quality work that generates results for their clients. The agency positions itself as having a 'digital DNA' and aims to be a communication agency.

name: Plot Comunicación
summary: Plot Comunicación is a digital marketing agency based in Madrid that specializes in creating compelling online strategies for businesses. They offer a range of services including social media management (community management), content marketing (blog marketing), search engine optimization (SEO/SEM), press relations, and web design. Their mission is to help businesses establish a strong online presence and communicate their value effectively in the digital space.

name: La Quincaillerie
summary: La Quincaillerie is a digital communication agency based in Lille and Paris, France. They offer a comprehensive suite of services including brand strategy, visual identity creation, communication material design, website development (WordPress, WooCommerce, PrestaShop), and client acquisition strategies such as SEO, SEA, and social media advertising. Their mission is to transform ambitions into concrete achievements by combining strategic solutions with effective tools.

name: The Grid Agency
summary: The Grid Agency, founded in 2013, is a digital media and marketing firm specializing in social media management, digital media services, media planning, and event planning. They focus on providing comprehensive solutions and measurable results for small to mid-sized businesses in the United States. Their services include social media consulting and advertising, email marketing, media relations and buying, and event planning and management.

name: Chimpion Media
summary: Chimpion Media is a dynamic media agency specializing in social media. They offer comprehensive services including the development, execution, and analysis of tailored social media campaigns. Their offerings also encompass content management, video production for social media, and professional photography to enhance client visibility.

name: División Creativa
summary: División Creativa is a digital creative media agency that specializes in developing technological and advertising strategies to generate valuable experiences for brands. They offer a comprehensive range of services including identity and design, web design, integral marketing, app development, social media management, and production/photography. Their mission is to help businesses connect with their audience, attract new clients, and achieve significant results through innovative digital solutions.

name: KROS Digital
summary: KROS Digital is a digital marketing agency specializing in social media management, content creation, and targeted advertising. They offer services such as custom graphic design, audience segmentation, and performance reporting to help businesses enhance their online presence and sales. The company aims to manage all aspects of a company's social media strategy.

name: Rejunta Comunicações
summary: Rejunta is a digital communication and marketing agency that focuses on creating innovative solutions to connect brands with people. They specialize in lead generation, driving traffic, and increasing sales and customer engagement through services like graphic design, photography, video production, website development, branding, and social media management. Their mission is to be a partner for businesses seeking creative and effective marketing strategies.

name: The Social Dingo
summary: The Social Dingo is a digital communications agency that combines social media strategy with high-quality visual content and communications expertise. They offer services including social media strategy, advertising, content creation, community management, and live streaming. Their mission is to act as a "digital communications team" for their clients, helping them tell their social stories effectively.

name: Moosh Media
summary: Moosh Media is a creative agency specializing in social media, graphic design, video production, and animation. They position themselves as a partner to businesses, aiming to elevate their online presence through enthusiastic and collaborative efforts. Their services include concept creation, video production for marketing and social media, graphic design for branding and web, and multimedia content strategy to ensure effective distribution to target audiences.

name: FDCT: Agenzia di comunicazione Varese e Milano
summary: FDCT (fd communication team) is a communication agency based in Milan, specializing in helping micro and small businesses, professional studios, and individual professionals communicate effectively to achieve their desired results. They offer a comprehensive range of services including website development, graphic design, marketing strategy and planning, and social media marketing. Their mission is to support clients in growing their business through tailored communication and marketing solutions.

name: NAJWIDOCZNIEJ
summary: NAJWIDOCZNIEJ is an advertising and marketing agency based in Silesia, Poland, operating since 2016. They specialize in social media management for platforms like Facebook and Instagram, graphic design services including business cards, flyers, posters, and social media graphics, as well as promotional merchandise and corporate apparel. The company emphasizes a diligent, reliable, and customer-centric approach, aiming to provide unconventional advertising campaign ideas at competitive prices.

name: The Really Cool Group
summary: The Really Cool Group is a boutique investment firm founded in 1998, based in Jersey, UK. It actively invests in a diverse portfolio including property, technology, life sciences, consumer goods & services, and art. Unlike passive investors, the firm takes an active role in supporting management with strategy and operations, focusing primarily on startups and early-stage ventures but also considering mature businesses. Their investment approach aims to generate strong financial returns while fostering the growth and success of portfolio companies.

name: Tomas Schwarz Capital
summary: Tomas Schwarz Capital (TSC) is an investment firm founded in 2017 that scouts and invests in companies offering solutions to pressing global problems. They focus on early-stage companies with sustainable solutions, providing clients with early entry opportunities for potentially high returns. TSC emphasizes reliability, innovation, security, quality, and environmental awareness in its investment criteria, aligning with the values of the companies they support.

name: Welfare Tech Invest
summary: Welfare Tech Invest is an investment firm that provides capital and resources to accelerate the growth of early-stage, spin-off, and growth companies. They focus on businesses within medtech, welfare technology, and welfare services, aiming to help them realize their full business potential through tailored development programs. The firm supports companies with strong teams, commercial strategies, and innovative products or services.

name: Apogae
summary: Apogae is a firm that supports founders and companies in building enduring businesses with significant returns. They offer resources such as an entrepreneurial community and industry knowledge to their partners. The company focuses on private investment and aims to foster legendary companies.

name: Redpill
summary: Redpill is an investment firm that partners with visionary companies to accelerate their growth, focusing on sectors like Impact, Healthcare, and Cleantech. They combine investment with active support to maximize value for founders. Their portfolio includes companies in music licensing, sustainable materials, luxury essentials, urban mobility, biotechnology, financial services, real estate optimization, and cybersecurity.

name: Smartfin
summary: Smartfin is a European investment firm focused on funding and supporting exceptional B2B technology companies. They provide financial backing, strategic guidance, and mentorship to entrepreneurs, aiming to foster growth and innovation in the technology sector. With over €600 million in assets under management, they invest up to €50 million in growing B2B tech companies headquartered in Europe.

name: Rimal Capital
summary: Rimal Capital is a Jordanian private investment firm established in late 2018, focused on investing in innovative technologies and scalable business models. They aim to reshape how people live and work by supporting ventures that offer innovative solutions and sustainable growth. The firm engages in angel investments, direct investments, and also invests in mobile apps, software, real estate, public equities, and private equities.

name: Emergent Growth Fund
summary: Emergent Growth Fund is a member-managed angel investment fund focused on early-stage companies developing unique, leading-edge products or proprietary technologies with high growth potential. The fund leverages the experience of its successful business people and investor members for due diligence. The premier fund, Emergent Growth Fund, LLC, is fully invested, and Emergent Growth Fund II, LLC was established to continue this investment strategy.

name: Band of Angels
summary: Band of Angels is the first high-tech angel investment group in the USA, founded in 1994. It comprises over 150 angel investors, primarily former and current high-tech executives, who invest in and mentor seed-stage startups. The group focuses on high-technology and life science companies with strong teams, proprietary technology, and large market potential, having funded over 400 companies with numerous profitable exits.

name: FiTalent
summary: FiTalent is the corporate venture capital fund of NTT DATA group, dedicated to supporting entrepreneurs and transforming their ventures into profitable, leading companies. It operates with three strategic lines: venture capital, corporate venturing, and company builder, investing in innovative technologies and committed teams. FiTalent's portfolio includes startups in diverse sectors such as logistics, advertising, and biopharmaceuticals, reflecting its broad investment scope.

name: Silversmith Capital Partners
summary: Silversmith Capital Partners is a growth equity firm that invests in technology and healthcare companies. They focus on providing capital and strategic partnerships to entrepreneurs, aiming to help them achieve greater success than they could alone. The firm emphasizes collaborative, long-term relationships built on values of integrity, teamwork, humility, and conviction.

name: Tar Heel Capital Pathfinder VC Sp. z o.o.
summary: Tar Heel Capital Pathfinder is an experienced venture capital fund that invests up to 1 million EUR in technology projects from the idea stage to the seed round. They provide financing and practical support in strategy, technology, product, business development, and team building. The fund focuses on early-stage technology companies, helping to transform innovative ideas into market-changing businesses and supporting startups in achieving scalable growth and market leadership.

name: Ahlborg Acquisitions LLC
summary: Ahlborg Acquisitions is an investment firm founded by entrepreneurs, dedicated to helping promising young companies secure capital. They aim to simplify the funding process and support business growth through their specialized investment criteria and focused approach. The company works with a limited number of businesses to ensure dedicated support.

name: K7 Investments
summary: K7 Investments is a seasoned private equity firm specializing in growth investments, having raised over $18 billion in capital. They focus on investing in growing private companies across various industries, with the capacity to invest up to $500 million in individual companies. Their mission is to support management teams in building their businesses into significant enterprises and creating long-term value.

name: Nicklaus Brown & Co, LLC
summary: Nicklaus Brown & Co. is a family office that partners with entrepreneurial leaders to build innovative businesses. They focus on investments and development within the Design, Financial Services, and Technology sectors. The firm is managed by partners Gary Nicklaus, Rory Brown, Gabriel Apodaca, and Jack Purcell.

name: Audrey Capital
summary: Audrey Capital is an angel investment and research company founded by Matt Mullenweg, aimed at fostering the growth of innovative ideas. The firm invests in a diverse range of companies across various sectors, including technology, biotechnology, consumer goods, and AI. Its portfolio showcases a broad spectrum of early-stage and growth-stage ventures, reflecting a strategy of identifying and supporting disruptive technologies and promising business models.

name: Forestay
summary: Forestay is an investment firm that partners with technology leaders, focusing on enterprise AI and SaaS companies. They provide growth capital to category-defining businesses from their early revenue stages through to market leadership. Forestay acts as entrepreneurial partners, leveraging their expertise to help scale global companies.

name: Secways
summary: Secways is a family office that invests in early-stage software-based solutions, focusing on startups and search funds. They leverage their entrepreneurial experience to guide founders, offering capital and mentorship to help build global businesses. With €30 million in funds to invest, they aim to support resilient founders building category-leading products.

name: Kaas
summary: Kaas is a consumer-focused venture firm that invests in and supports exceptional founders building companies that aim to significantly improve people's lives. They focus on sectors like shopping, eating, working, playing, living, and learning, backing tech-enabled startups with global potential. Kaas provides capital, strategic guidance, and network access to help founders scale their businesses from early stages through to exit.

name: KESA Partners
summary: KESA Partners is a family office that provides seed capital and strategic financial advice to life science entrepreneurs. They offer business savvy, network access, and exit strategy planning to accelerate the growth of life science ventures. Their mission is to support innovation in the life sciences sector.

name: O'Reilly AlphaTech Ventures
summary: O'Reilly AlphaTech Ventures (OATV) is an early-stage investment firm founded by Mark Jacobsen, Tim O’Reilly, and Bryce Roberts. They pioneered institutional seed investing in 2005 and later developed the Indie.vc investment category in 2015, focusing on founders prioritizing customers, revenue, and profitability. OATV operates within the venture capital and investment sector.

name: Sopris Capital, LLC
summary: Sopris Capital, LLC is an investment firm that operates with a single source of long-term capital. This structure allows them the agility and flexibility to leverage their knowledge, expertise, and networks to foster growth and create value for their investments. They are positioned as a strategic partner focused on developing and enhancing businesses.

name: Kjøller
summary: Kjøller is a privately held investment company that invests in and supports both startups and mature companies. They provide capital and expertise to help businesses reach their full potential, focusing on venture, real estate, and financing opportunities. The company aims to foster growth and success for its portfolio companies.

name: High Park Angels Fund
summary: High Park Angels Fund is an investment fund that focuses on early-stage companies. Although Fund I is fully invested and no longer accepting new pitches, its portfolio includes companies in advanced battery energy storage systems, robotic delivery, real estate fractional ownership, AI-driven car automation, decentralized web technologies, and wearable bio-sensing devices. The fund aims to support innovative ventures and has had successful exits in some of its investments.

name: PlumTree Partners, LLC
summary: PlumTree Partners is a private family office that invests in technology-enabled businesses, focusing on growth opportunities in cloud computing, automation, and mobile technologies. The firm's approach involves identifying and supporting companies that have successfully navigated early-stage challenges and are poised for scaling. Through operational expertise and strategic investment, PlumTree Partners aims to unlock value and drive future growth in its portfolio companies.

name: Taylor Ventures
summary: Taylor Ventures is a venture capital firm that invests in early-stage technology companies. They focus on providing capital and strategic guidance to help startups scale and achieve market leadership. Their investment thesis centers on disruptive technologies and innovative business models across various sectors.

name: First Trust Capital Partners, LLC
summary: First Trust Capital Partners, LLC (FTCP) is an investment firm that focuses on early and growth stage companies, particularly within the financial services and healthcare technology sectors. With over 15 years of experience and more than 100 private investments, FTCP utilizes its balance sheet capital to support business growth through long-term capital appreciation and meaningful portfolio engagement. The firm has offices in Wheaton, Illinois, and Franklin, Tennessee, and is affiliated with First Trust Portfolios L.P. and First Trust Advisors L.P.

name: Richland, Gordon & Company
summary: Richland, Gordon & Company is an investment firm with a legacy of backing growing companies founded by entrepreneurs, families, and founders. The company focuses on investment opportunities and has a stated mission of supporting business growth through its investment criteria. It operates within the financial services sector, specifically in private equity or venture capital.

name: Humbition
summary: Humbition is an early-stage investment fund that focuses on backing founder-led technology companies. They invest in innovative ideas and founders who demonstrate both humility and ambition. The fund aims to support companies that are shaping the future of technology.

name: CW Technologies
summary: CW Technologies (CWT) is an angel investment advisor that supports early-stage, high-tech companies with disruptive technologies. They provide due diligence, research, development planning, and strategic risk management services, often working with incubators, angel investment groups, and venture capital firms. CWT also facilitates strategic alliances and connects companies with marketing, CPA, and law firms, and is a member of MERLIN MENTORS offering free services to entrepreneurs.

name: Metrica S.r.l.
summary: Metrica is an investment company founded by Alfredo Scotti, focused on facilitating the economic, cultural, and organizational growth of startups and small to medium-sized companies. It invests in minority stakes with an active management approach, prioritizing sustainability and innovation. Metrica has shown significant growth in its net worth, increasing by nearly 60% in four years.

name: Evidity Health Capital
summary: Evidity Health Capital, formerly Canepa Healthcare, is a late-stage venture capital and growth equity firm focused on the healthcare industry. They invest in leading, innovative, and transformative healthcare companies, aiming to build businesses through a value-focused and evidence-based approach. The firm manages assets and has a portfolio of exited companies.

name: Alta Park Capital
summary: Alta Park Capital is an investment firm specializing in public and private companies within the global technology, media, and telecommunications sectors. The firm focuses on identifying emerging technological innovations and understanding their impact across various companies. They manage both public equity strategies since 2013 and growth equity investments in private companies since 2015, with a particular interest in software and fintech.

name: Innovation in Motion (iiM)
summary: Innovation in Motion (iiM) is an early-stage investment firm that identifies, funds, and supports companies focused on solving global problems through innovation. They specifically partner with businesses making advancements in agriculture, animal health, and human health sectors. iiM aims to make a significant positive impact on the world by investing in ambitious entrepreneurs.

name: NEXYR AG
summary: NEXYR AG is an investment firm focused on supporting innovative founders and bringing great ideas to life. They invest in companies with bold ambitions and effective execution, having backed over 150 businesses. The company's mission is to empower passionate entrepreneurs and help them achieve success.

name: ājīva ventures
summary: ājīva ventures is a privately held company focused on investment and support for innovators in the social impact, technology, and entertainment sectors. The company has a history of involvement in various consulting projects and entrepreneurial ventures, including a social networking startup and a document due diligence service that evolved into KYCnet BV. Currently, ājīva invests in and supports innovators in fintech, blockchain, life sciences, marketing, and entertainment, with a growing emphasis on sustainability and social impact.

name: ZIG Capital
summary: ZIG Capital is a youth-owned investment firm focused on backing ambitious ventures. They aim to cultivate partnerships by adding substantial value to supported businesses through a dynamic approach and deep industry understanding. The firm emphasizes long-term investment and fueling innovation-driven growth, positioning itself as a partner for lasting success.

name: JSJ Investments
summary: JSJ Investments is a Texas-based family office with a 20-year history of investing in small- to mid-cap companies poised for significant growth. They provide strategic capital, including seed money, bridge financing, and growth injections, to companies with strong management and clear action plans. JSJ Investments focuses on building robust relationships and investing in forward-thinking, innovative businesses across North America, Europe, and globally, including public and imminently public companies.

name: Doma Vida Capital
summary: Doma Vida Capital is a private capital firm focused on identifying and nurturing investment opportunities across various industries. The firm emphasizes integrity, dependability, optimism, and adventure in its operations. It aims to invest in future opportunities by supporting and growing businesses, as indicated by its portfolio of companies.

name: Oaktree
summary: Oaktree is an investment firm that partners with investors and business owners to identify and capitalize on opportunities across real estate, private equity, and venture capital. The firm focuses on investing in undervalued assets, identifying operational improvements and growth potential, and supporting early-stage companies with new technologies. Their purpose is to create financial well-being while aiming for a positive impact in the communities where they invest.

name: Lionhead Capital
summary: Lionhead Capital is a private investment firm that leverages expertise, networks, and capital to identify and capitalize on underappreciated opportunities. Drawing on family office roots and an entrepreneurial heritage, they invest flexible capital across private equity, real assets, and special situations. Their strategies focus on sectors like critical minerals for the new economy, opportunistic real estate, and founder-led businesses in high-growth markets.

name: TiE Angels
summary: TiE Angels is a prominent angel investment group based in Silicon Valley, operating as part of TiE Silicon Valley. It connects early-stage companies with experienced entrepreneurs and professional investors, facilitating funding and growth. With over 150 members and leveraging TiE's global network, TiE Angels has a strong track record of successful exits and follow-on funding, having been recognized as a top angel group nationally.

name: Aplomado Investments Ltd
summary: Aplomado Investments Ltd is a private investment firm focused on identifying and investing in cutting-edge technologies and innovative projects. The firm develops and invests in sectors including hospitality, fintech, entertainment, equipment leasing, development, and renewables. They emphasize risk mitigation and aim to create value through strategic investments in growth-oriented industries.

name: Apeiron Investment Group
summary: Apeiron Investment Group is a discretionary investment firm managing approximately $7 billion, founded and owned by Christian Angermayer. The firm invests directly in innovative companies across their lifecycle and also makes anchor LP investments with GP stakes in emerging asset managers. Driven by optimism for technology's role in improving lives, Apeiron focuses on biotech, fintech & crypto, deep tech, experiences, hospitality & sports, real estate, and natural resources, with a notable achievement in advancing psychedelics for mental health.

name: Xandex Ventures
summary: Xandex Ventures is the investment arm of Xandex Inc., established in 2005 and operating as Xandex Investments LLC. It functions as a venture capital investor, focusing on early-stage funding for startups in emerging fields such as digital health care, medical devices, healthy lifestyles, and eco-friendly products. The firm actively participates in investment groups and business incubators in the San Francisco Bay Area to identify and support promising ventures.

name: Glean Management LP
summary: Glean is a private equity firm that focuses on investing in established technology companies at attractive valuations. The firm has deployed over $250 million across multiple funds and co-investment vehicles since its inception. Glean's operations suggest a focus on financial investment and management within the technology sector.

name: Aldgate Ventures Ltd
summary: Aldgate Ventures is an early-stage investment firm focused on technology companies that aim to create significant change. They support ambitious startups tackling fundamental issues in identity, security, and data, relating these to everyday interactions and transactions. The firm's mission is to help build and scale companies that leverage technology to solve real-world problems.

name: Designer Fund
summary: Designer Fund is an early-stage venture capital firm that invests in technology companies using design to improve health, sustainability, and prosperity. They empower founders with design expertise and resources to build impactful businesses. The firm also provides resources and guides for founders on topics like fundraising, hiring designers, and company building.

name: Northwest Technology Ventures
summary: Northwest Technology Ventures (NTV) is a formation-stage venture fund based in Portland, Oregon, specializing in seed and early-stage investments. NTV focuses on opportunities emerging from Oregon's public and private universities, research institutions, and corporate labs, particularly in technology and life sciences. The fund is currently fully committed and actively manages its portfolio companies, which have collectively raised over $225 million in outside investment.

name: Pezos BV
summary: Pezos is a private equity investment firm focused on technology and educational companies. They aim to accelerate growth by investing in businesses with strong potential and partnering with talented management teams. Pezos also offers expertise in M&A strategy and exit planning to maximize business value.

name: ITI Growth Opportunities Fund
summary: ITI Growth Opportunities Fund is an investment firm focused on empowering early-stage entrepreneurs and disruptive ideas. They provide operational expertise, network access, and thesis-oriented investment strategies to fuel the success of ambitious founders. The fund invests in a diverse portfolio of companies across various sectors, including consumer wellness, aerospace logistics, and electric vehicles.

name: Sesa Capital
summary: Sesa Capital is an investment firm that focuses on providing capital and strategic support to companies. They aim to foster growth and create value through their investment activities. The firm operates within the financial services sector, targeting various industries for investment opportunities.

name: Acorn Innovestments
summary: Acorn Innovestments is a fund management company that partners with and invests in early-stage ventures, referred to as 'acorn-stage'. They aim to foster growth into mature companies by providing corporate partnerships and rigorous investment strategies. The company emphasizes collaboration, likening their approach to a forest where established companies ('mighty oaks') support emerging ventures ('little acorns').

name: FirstMark
summary: FirstMark is an early-stage venture capital firm based in New York City that invests in exceptional founders. They provide a platform to accelerate portfolio companies through access to networks, customers, and talent, offering expert communities, customer access, exclusive summits, full lifecycle recruiting, and private networks. FirstMark focuses on founders with grit, excellence, curiosity, and a strong sense of community.

name: Candy Ventures
summary: Candy Ventures is an investment firm founded by British entrepreneur Nick Candy, focused on funding global companies with visionary founders and ambitious global goals. The firm leverages its network to accelerate business growth and ideas. It operates as a portfolio of companies, providing investment and strategic support.

name: Mavcap Technology Sdn Bhd
summary: Mavcap Technology Sdn Bhd is an investment firm that provides capital for businesses through its managed fund and a network of venture capital partners. They offer seasoned investment banking services, including IPO advisory, private placement, fund raising, and mergers & acquisitions. Additionally, they operate a hands-on accelerator program for seed and early-stage companies, offering strategic advice, funding, infrastructure, and access to mentors to prepare them for venture capital funding.

name: e-navik
summary: e-navik is a holding firm with an investment portfolio focused on practical, understandable assets for stable and sustainable long-term growth. They actively invest in early-stage companies across various technology sectors including SaaS, IoT, AI, Data, B2B, Blockchain, e-commerce, healthcare, 5G, VR/AR, gamification, fintech, healthtech, ed-tech, and Media. The firm aims to balance risks across different industries and geographic regions.

name: Red Six
summary: Red Six is an investment firm that backs companies focused on creating joy and positive global impact. Since 2006, they have supported businesses across diverse sectors including gaming, fintech, AI, equine tech, and adventure travel, helping them grow into influential global brands. Their approach emphasizes meaningful innovation, true partnership, long-term commitment, and success beyond financial profit, focusing on environmental impact, employee wellbeing, and customer satisfaction.

name: Haas Portman
summary: Haas Portman is an investment firm that focuses on providing value to earlier-stage technology companies. They leverage internal assets and strong relationships to identify and invest in promising ventures. The firm aims to decrease investment risk and maximize the probability of success for their investment team.

name: Moirex ApS
summary: Moirex ApS is a privately owned investment company that partners in various projects and assists startups in finding investors. They offer fundraising, partnership, consulting, and project development services, aiming to foster diversity by collaborating with innovative new businesses. The company is led by CEO and owner Kaare Korsbek, who leverages his extensive experience in management and project development.

name: Soul Capital
summary: Soul Capital is a single family office that invests in innovative and emerging technology companies. They focus on providing capital to companies ranging from early-stage ventures with high potential to later-stage market leaders. The firm's activities suggest a focus on financial investment and strategic support for technology businesses.

name: Eothen
summary: Eothen is a family investment firm that provides permanent capital to support businesses through various growth stages. They offer a blend of business and cultural resources, seeking to partner with entrepreneurs who share long-term objectives in both public and private markets. The firm invests across sectors including consumer, technology, hospitality, industrials, healthcare, and commercial real estate.

name: Nea Taxidi
summary: Nea Taxidi, meaning 'The New Way', is an investment firm that participates in startups and growth-stage companies. They act as active shareholders, providing capital, entrepreneurial experience, and coaching to help businesses grow. Their approach is constructive, long-term, and hands-on, focusing on sectors where they and their partners have extensive experience. The goal is to increase company value and provide strong returns for all stakeholders.

name: Solare Capital

name: Solstra Capital Partners LLP
summary: Solstra Capital Partners is an independent private equity advisory firm specializing in equity investments in small and mid-cap companies, value-added real estate investments with long-term asset management, and active management of debt portfolios and leverage finance. name: Resurgens Technology Partners
summary: Resurgens Technology Partners is a high-energy, software-focused private equity firm that invests in application and IT infrastructure software businesses. The firm leverages its experienced team to actively support portfolio companies in building market leaders.

name: Cimbria Capital
summary: Cimbria Capital is a private equity investment firm founded in 2015, with offices in the United States and Denmark. The firm focuses on growth and expansion capital investments specifically within the Water Economy across North America and the Nordics. They leverage a team of experts and an internal ESG framework to identify and manage investments, aiming for superior returns for investors and societal benefit.

name: Yellowstone Capital Partners, LLC
summary: Yellowstone Capital Partners is a private equity firm founded in 1993, with offices in Houston and New York. The firm specializes in management buyouts, special situations, and mezzanine finance for small to medium-sized businesses, often acquiring majority stakes. They focus on sponsoring entrepreneurial management teams and providing capital for growth, operating with flexibility and speed. Yellowstone targets established companies with revenues between $10-50 million, positive cash flows, and competitive advantages.

name: Zetland Capital Partners LLP
summary: Zetland Capital Partners LLP is a private equity firm specializing in mid-market, deep-value investment opportunities across Europe. They provide flexible capital solutions for complex situations, integrating closely with management teams to drive growth and value. The firm focuses on special situations across various industries and asset classes, aiming for better outcomes for businesses and stakeholders.

name: Trajectory Capital
summary: Trajectory Capital is an investment firm that focuses on acquiring and managing a portfolio of businesses. They aim to partner with founders and management teams to drive growth and create long-term value. The firm's investment strategy typically involves acquiring established businesses with strong market positions and potential for operational improvement.

name: DynEvolve Capital
summary: DynEvolve Capital is a private equity firm specializing in multifamily real estate investments. They focus on acquiring and managing apartment properties, aiming to generate returns for their investors through strategic real estate operations. The company operates as an investment manager within the real estate sector.

summary: High Bluff Capital Partners is a private investment firm based in San Diego, California, specializing in control-oriented equity investments in consumer-facing companies. They focus on the restaurant, entertainment, and food & beverage industries, partnering with management to drive growth through strategic initiatives, operational expertise, and back-office platform development. The firm aims to reinvigorate consumer brands by executing transformational agendas and supporting future growth with capital and acquisitions.

name: KRC Capital
summary: KRC Capital is a private equity firm and investment company focused on lifestyle businesses with creative, unique brand experiences. They invest in hospitality, leisure, fashion, technology, and real estate markets, targeting companies with turnovers between €25 million and €250 million. With a long-term investment horizon and a hands-on management style, KRC Capital leverages its entrepreneurial expertise and global network to maximize opportunities and ensure sustainable profit for its partners.

summary: Millennium Bridge Capital is a private equity investment firm specializing in a multi-manager co-investment strategy within the middle market. With founders active in this market since 1980, the firm leverages its extensive experience and relationships to provide a competitive advantage for its investors. They focus on middle market private equity and co-investment opportunities.

name: Altris Partners GmbH
summary: Altris Partners is a German investment firm focused on providing active capital and long-term partnership to medium-sized companies with innovative business models and strong organizations. They specialize in supporting companies with revenues between 10 and 150 million EUR, particularly in succession, spin-off, or turnaround situations. Altris Partners aims to contribute substantially to the long-term success of its portfolio companies by focusing on growth, differentiation, and innovation, rather than solely on cost reduction.

name: Navis Capital Partners
summary: Navis Capital Partners is a leading fund manager in Southeast Asia, specializing in private equity and private credit. Founded in 1998, the firm focuses on transforming mid-market companies with strong competitive advantages into regional and global powerhouses. They achieve this by partnering with companies, providing strategic guidance, and leveraging deep industry knowledge to accelerate growth.

name: Jones Capital
summary: Jones Capital is a growth-oriented capital partner that invests in middle-market businesses with a focus on long-term, sustainable growth. They aim to support entrepreneurs by providing a flexible, value-added approach to investing, working collaboratively with management teams to achieve success. The firm emphasizes shared values, community benefit, and stakeholder well-being in its investment strategy.

name: InfraVia Capital Partners
summary: InfraVia Capital Partners is a leading independent European private equity firm specializing in real assets, including infrastructure, critical metals, and real estate, as well as technology investments. They focus on resilient businesses, partnering with management teams to drive long-term value creation through active asset management. The firm aims to connect long-term capital with investments supporting digital transformation, energy transition, urbanization, and demographic shifts.

name: Oosenbrugh Group GmbH
summary: Oosenbrugh Group GmbH is a family-run private equity firm and single-family office that invests long-term in growth-oriented companies. summary: Ascentro Capital Partners is an investment firm focused on helping build and grow companies. Their mission is to identify and support businesses with the potential for significant growth, acting as a dedicated partner throughout the process.

summary: GVIM is a private equity co-investment platform and investment advisory firm that provides cost-effective access to direct investments alongside private equity sponsors. summary: Twin Lakes Capital is a private equity firm specializing in growth capital and control investments. summary: Kingfish Capital operates as a strategic advisor and investment partner in the private equity sector. summary: Wincove Private Holdings is an investment firm founded in 2008, specializing in providing evergreen funding and creating lasting value for its portfolio companies. The firm partners with management teams to build lasting value by focusing on dedication to solving customer problems rather than relying on superficial strategies.

The firm focuses on partnering with proven management teams across various sectors, particularly primary industries, industrials, healthcare, and FMCG/retail, aiming to support businesses with strong cash generation and growth potential.

name: Fox Meadow Capital Partners, LLC
summary: Fox Meadow Capital Partners is a private equity and infrastructure investment and advisory firm based in New York.
