summary: Onda Gráfica is a Brazilian company established in 2009, specializing in the manufacturing of packaging solutions. Initially focused on simple-faced micro-corrugated sheets for gift boxes, they expanded in 2012 to include flexographic printing for colored corrugated materials used in cosmetic protection and wrapping. Since 2017, Onda Gráfica has also entered the premium rigid box market, offering high-quality finishes for special projects, promotional kits, and custom packaging.

name: SAVAKO
summary: SAVAKO is a Czech company specializing in innovative and custom packaging solutions, founded in 2008. They offer a wide range of materials, including reusable packaging, and cater to diverse clients from the automotive industry to e-shops. Their core values emphasize innovation, sustainability, quality, and partnership, aiming to optimize packaging processes, reduce costs, and improve environmental impact for their clients.

name: Sigma Supply Chain Solutions Ltd
summary: Sigma Supply Chain Solutions Ltd provides reusable and one-trip packaging solutions designed to improve supply chain efficiency. They offer bespoke design services, pooling and rental options for equipment, and a free packaging review to identify cost savings and operational improvements. Their services cater to industrial, automotive, and retail sectors, aiming to minimize handling, increase vehicle fill, and enhance health and safety.

name: 山成産業 (Yamanari Sangyo)
summary: Yamanari Sangyo specializes in providing high-quality packaging solutions that enhance product value and branding. They offer a wide range of packaging materials, including specialized options for fruits and vegetables, as well as custom-made products. The company focuses on quality over low prices and provides personalized consultations to meet diverse customer needs, serving individual farmers, schools, and retail stores in the Okayama prefecture.

name: Opakowania Legeń Sp. z o.o.
summary: Opakowania Legeń Sp. z o.o. is a family-owned company established in 1990, specializing in the design and production of high-quality cardboard and paper packaging. They offer a range of products including industrial packaging, e-commerce packaging, retail packaging, and advertising materials like POS displays. The company also operates its own printing house, providing printing and finishing services, and emphasizes customer support, timely delivery, and flexible production.

name: Grafitusa
summary: Grafitusa is a large and modern graphic park specializing in intelligent packaging solutions. With over 100 years of experience, they offer innovative and customized packaging for various industries, including cosmetics, food, and electronics. Their services focus on enhancing customer experience, improving point-of-sale presence, and promoting sustainability through efficient production, prototyping, and logistics.

name: Coffee Service Sp. z o.o.
summary: Coffee Service Sp. z o.o. is a manufacturer and supplier of various packaging solutions, including doy packs, stand-up pouches, flat-bottom bags, sachets, and cardboard cups. They offer both standard and custom-printed packaging, with a focus on biodegradable and recyclable options. The company also provides related services such as graphic design and labeling, catering to diverse product needs.

name: Southwest Poly Bag
summary: Southwest Poly Bag is an e-commerce affiliate of AA Poly Bag Company, specializing in industrial, food, retail, and healthcare packaging solutions. They offer a wide range of products including various types of poly bags, vacuum bags, and custom packaging, alongside sealing equipment. The company emphasizes high-quality, domestic manufacturing, competitive pricing, and excellent customer service, serving diverse industries across the United States.

name: LPI
summary: LPI is a company specializing in custom finishing and specialty packaging solutions, transforming traditional ink and paper projects into engaging brand experiences. They offer a comprehensive range of services including design, printing, die cutting, digital enhancement, and fulfillment for various industries. Founded in 1984, LPI partners with brands of all sizes to enhance their product's shelf appeal and customer engagement through innovative packaging.

name: Cartotecnica Olimpia S.p.A.
summary: Cartotecnica Olimpia S.p.A. is an Italian company with over 60 years of experience in the cartographic industry, specializing in the design and production of custom packaging solutions. They offer a wide range of products including rigid and coupled cardboard boxes, displays, and specialized packaging for various sectors such as food, beverage, industrial, and personal care. The company emphasizes quality, custom design, and sustainable practices in its manufacturing process.

name: Carpepack
summary: Carpepack is a company specializing in the design and production of high-quality, custom packaging and display solutions. They offer consulting, design, prototyping, and production services, focusing on functionality, attractive design, and supply chain efficiency. Carpepack emphasizes sustainability by using recycled materials like cardboard and paper in their manufacturing processes.

name: Opus Packaging
summary: Opus Packaging is a full-service packaging provider offering a comprehensive range of solutions from consultation and design to production and distribution. They specialize in custom packaging, graphic packaging, shipping containers, interior dunnage, and returnable systems. Their mission is to provide customized, high-quality packaging and distribution solutions to meet specific customer needs, aiming to be a world-class provider and enhance customer performance.

name: Opus Packaging
summary: Opus Packaging is a full-service packaging provider offering a comprehensive range of solutions from consultation and design to production and distribution. They specialize in custom packaging, graphic packaging, shipping containers, interior dunnage, and returnable systems. Their mission is to provide customized, high-quality packaging and distribution solutions to meet specific customer needs, aiming to be a world-class provider and enhance customer performance.

name: Groupe Astic
summary: Groupe Astic provides customized, reliable, and responsible packaging solutions tailored to various business needs, including moving, wine production, e-commerce, and automotive recycling. They offer a comprehensive range of packaging materials, custom design services, stock management, and eco-responsible options. The company emphasizes personalized support, quality commitment (ISO 9001 certified), and efficient logistics with multiple depots across France.

name: TUBA.ru
summary: TUBA.ru is an industry information portal focused on tube packaging and related sectors. It provides a catalog of packaging organizations, news and articles about the packaging world, and a marketplace for buyers and sellers of equipment and services. The portal aims to connect businesses within the packaging industry and facilitate transactions.

name: Cartonnerie Oudin
summary: Cartonnerie Oudin is a company specializing in the design and production of packaging solutions. They cater to various markets including luxury, industrial, food, and merchandising, offering graphic design and sustainable development options. Their services focus on creating custom packaging projects to meet client needs.

name: Компания Эней
summary: Компания Эней is a Russian company specializing in the production of innovative cardboard packaging solutions, particularly dividers (dividers) for various industries including medical, food, alcohol, and perfumery. They offer custom packaging design, manufacturing of full-color and complex-design boxes, and related services such as production audits and logistics optimization. The company emphasizes economic benefits for clients through reduced costs and improved product protection.

name: Bertschlaska
summary: Bertschlaska is a company specializing in providing comprehensive solutions for the meat processing industry. They offer a range of services from supplying individual machines to planning, delivering, installing, and commissioning complete production plants. Their expertise covers slaughtering, cutting, production, packaging, and logistics, aiming to deliver customized solutions for their clients.

name: VICTUS International GmbH
summary: VICTUS is an independent, family-owned company based in Vienna, Austria, specializing in providing top European food processing and packaging equipment and technology to the Hungarian market. They offer complete line solutions, from concept to implementation and training, focusing on processing, filling, portioning, maturing, drying, slicing, and packaging. The company prides itself on building long-term relationships based on trust and expertise, offering consulting services in meat processing and packaging, particularly with sausage casings and barrier packaging materials.

name: ООО ПКФ «ШеЛен»
summary: ООО ПКФ «ШеЛен» is a Russian company founded in 1995, specializing in the manufacturing of non-standard equipment for the food and livestock industries. They also offer services such as laser metal cutting, installation, repair, and maintenance of equipment, including conveyors, manure removal systems, and stall equipment. The company also distributes food additives and ingredients through its associated entity, ООО "АРОМАОМ".

name: TILS Das Kalbfleisch. GmbH
summary: TILS Das Kalbfleisch. GmbH is a leading German company specializing in the cutting and processing of veal, operating since 1967. They offer a wide range of veal products, from whole cuts to portioned items, catering to individual customer needs and private labels. The company emphasizes consistent quality, product innovation, and competitive pricing, with a focus on customer satisfaction and a traceable supply chain.

name: 株式会社サンフェクト
summary: San Fect Co., Ltd. is a specialized contract packer for food packaging. They offer integrated services from individual product packaging to inner and outer packaging. The company handles everything from raw materials (tablets, capsules, granules) to final product packaging, including manufacturing from raw materials, shipping, and inventory management based on customer requests. They aim to meet customer needs with quality, delivery times, and pricing unique to a contract packer.

name: Schröder (JBT Schröder)
summary: Schröder, now part of JBT Corporation, is a globally recognized manufacturer specializing in technologically advanced injection and marinating solutions for the food processing industry. They offer a diverse range of machinery designed to meet the specific needs of businesses processing meat, poultry, and fish. Their expertise lies in brine preparation, injection, massaging, and mechanical tenderization, aiming to enhance food product quality and processing efficiency.

name: MASTER MACHINES® (VR&A Systems Ltda)
summary: MASTER MACHINES®, a brand of VR&A Systems Ltda, provides innovative technological solutions for the food industry, specializing in processing and packaging equipment. Their offerings include vacuum sealers, thermoformers, automatic slicers, metal detectors, and coders, designed to optimize production for various food sectors. With over 15 years of experience, they focus on high-quality, affordable, and efficient equipment, coupled with comprehensive support and a commitment to sustainability through their ECOMASTER line.

name: Technopack
summary: Technopack is a French company specializing in the custom blending and packaging of powders and dry food products since 1996. Operating from a 5000 m2 facility, they serve both human and animal food sectors. As a subcontracting provider, Technopack prioritizes client satisfaction through expertise, flexibility, and traceability.

name: КОМПО
summary: КОМПО is a manufacturing company specializing in complex solutions for the production of sausage products and processed cheese. They offer a range of equipment including vacuum fillers, clippers, and auxiliary machinery, as well as consumables like clips and casings. The company emphasizes its long history, commitment to quality, and global service network, providing comprehensive support and maintenance for its products.

name: LUMIX PROCUT
summary: LUMIX PROCUT supplies machinery, professional cutting tools, and sharpening services to the industrial food and meat industry. They offer machinery breakdown and electrical services, along with a wide range of spare parts including blades, knives, and plates. The company also distributes various brands of food processing equipment and aims to help food manufacturers improve productivity and profitability.

name: FESSMANN GmbH und Co KG
summary: FESSMANN is a family-owned company with over 100 years of experience specializing in thermal food processing equipment. They design and manufacture advanced systems for smoking, drying, cooking, baking, and cooling food products, serving clients from craft businesses to large industrial operations. Their mission is to enhance the quality, durability, taste, and color of food through innovative technology and sustainable production methods.

name: 株式会社 明石鉄工所 (Akashi Tekkosho Co., Ltd.)
summary: Akashi Tekkosho Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of high-speed strainers and stirring/grinding machines, primarily for the food processing industry. Their products aim to reduce foreign object contamination and improve efficiency in food production lines, catering to seafood, agricultural, and livestock product processing. The company emphasizes custom production using CAD and offers sample videos to showcase their equipment.

name: Nutrigold
summary: Nutrigold, founded in 1996, is a company specializing in innovative food ingredients sourced from 14 countries. They collaborate with clients in the food industry, including wheat milling, baking, dairy, and processed meats, to design and develop products. Nutrigold provides essential ingredients, technical support, and customized solutions to enhance product quality and innovation.

name: Fruchtverarbeitung und Obsthandel Quast GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Fruchtverarbeitung und Obsthandel Quast is a family-run business established in 1962 that processes and trades fresh, high-quality fruit from controlled cultivation. They process approximately 8000 tons of fruit annually, offering customized products like peeled apples, pitted plums, and cut strawberries to bakeries, cooperatives, and wholesalers nationwide. The company emphasizes passion, quality, and customer-specific processing using modern technology.

name: Collags
summary: Collags is a partner to the food industry, specializing in the manufacturing and trading of semi-finished products and offering contract manufacturing services. They also engage in the trade and service of used machinery. Their product offerings include functional ingredients and dietary supplements under the Collags® brand.

name: Kanizsahus 2000 Kft.
summary: Kanizsahus 2000 Kft. is a Hungarian meat processing and trading company established in 2000. It specializes in the wholesale and retail of meat products, with a focus on pork processing, deboning, and packaging. The company serves institutional catering, hotels, and aims to expand its market reach into neighboring EU countries and Croatia, emphasizing quality and customer satisfaction.

name: DES (Drishya Engineering Solutions)
summary: DES, also known as Drishya Engineering Solutions, specializes in providing perfect engineering solutions, particularly in the food processing industry. They offer design, installation, commissioning, automation, upgradation, and maintenance services for process plants and machinery. Additionally, they provide consultancy services in areas like refrigeration, energy, water, and automation, along with manufacturing products such as IQF lines and cooking/chilling lines.

name: (주)정푸드코리아
summary: Jung Food Korea is an agricultural corporation specializing in the manufacturing and processing of canned goods, retort pouches, and pet food. They also engage in the import and distribution of agricultural and aquatic products. With over 30 years of experience, the company emphasizes using the best raw materials to produce high-quality products and holds ISO and HACCP certifications.

name: Marillen Gyümölcsfeldolgozó Kft.
summary: Marillen Gyümölcsfeldolgozó Kft. is a 100% Hungarian-owned food processing company with over 30 years of market experience. They specialize in producing premium quality fruit purees and frozen fruit products, with a significant portion of their raw materials sourced from their own 60-hectare orchard. The company also offers contract manufacturing for fruit and vegetable purees, toll freezing, and cold storage services, adhering to strict food safety standards like FSSC 22000 and BIOKONTROLL for organic products.

name: ООО “ТЕХНО ГРУПП”
summary: ООО “ТЕХНО ГРУПП” is a company specializing in the supply of European food processing equipment, spare parts, and consumables. They act as an official dealer for leading European brands, offering a wide range of equipment for meat, fish, and dairy processing, as well as sanitary and hygiene equipment. The company also provides comprehensive technical support, including installation, commissioning, repair, and modernization services, catering to both small workshops and large industrial complexes.

name: (주)정푸드코리아
summary: Jung Food Korea is an agricultural corporation specializing in the manufacturing and processing of canned goods, retort pouches, and pet food. They also engage in the import and distribution of agricultural and aquatic products. With over 30 years of experience, the company emphasizes using the best raw materials to produce high-quality products and holds ISO and HACCP certifications.

name: Dakota Ingredients
summary: Dakota Ingredients is an American-owned business that processes high-quality crops into premium ingredient inputs for food and pet food manufacturers. They specialize in non-GMO pea products, including yellow split peas, whole yellow peas, pea fiber, pea flour, pea protein, pea starch, and processed peas. The company emphasizes craftsmanship, strong relationships, competitive pricing, and prompt grower payments, positioning itself as a flexible and trusted partner for ingredient solutions.

name: SEPAmatic GmbH
summary: SEPAmatic GmbH specializes in developing and manufacturing machinery and equipment for the food processing industry, particularly for meat, fish, vegetable, and fruit processing. Their core product is the SEPAmatic, a gentle and energy-efficient separation system that uses a soft endless belt to press softer parts of a product against a perforated drum, separating soft and firm components. The company offers various models of this 'Mincer' or 'Soft Separator' technology, including the latest SEPAmatic 6000.

name: Delpack
summary: Delpack is a company specializing in the elaboration and packaging of food products, including powders, dehydrated items, liquids, and pasty substances. They offer services such as co-packing, co-manufacturing, maquila (contract manufacturing), and re-packaging, operating a certified organic and gluten-free facility. Delpack focuses on quality, safety, and customer satisfaction, serving various clients with private label and contract manufacturing solutions.

name: Larco Foods B.V.
summary: Larco Foods B.V. is a modern food production company established in 1937, specializing in the artisanal preparation and sterilization of food products. They offer a diverse range of products including broths, stocks, soups, sauces, ragouts, and meat products, available in various packaging formats like glass, cans, and pouches. Larco also operates as a private label partner, catering to specific dietary needs such as organic, 'Beter Leven', gluten-free, lactose-free, vegetarian, and Halal.

name: Hollymatic Corporation
summary: Hollymatic Corporation is a manufacturer of food processing equipment, specializing in mixers, grinders, patty machines, and vacuum packaging systems. Their products are designed for high-volume production in various food service and industrial settings, including butcher shops, wholesalers, and meat plants. The company emphasizes reliability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness in its equipment offerings.

name: Lincoln Transload and Processing, LLC
summary: Lincoln Transload and Processing, LLC is a specialized full-service feed ingredient toll processor. They offer services such as homogenizing, blending, grinding, pelleting, and packaging of feed ingredients into bags, totes, or bulk. The company also provides dry packaged and bulk storage, with extensive receiving and outbound logistics capabilities, including rail access. Their mission is to add value to feed ingredient mixes and support their clients' businesses through reliable processing and traceability.

name: Shandong Fruit King Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Fruit King Co., Ltd. is a company specializing in the processing and distribution of fruits, offering a range of industrial and retail products including fresh fruit solutions, frozen roasted vegetables, dried fruits, fruit purees, fruit bars, and infused fruits. They emphasize sustainability, food safety, and aim to be a trusted partner for their clients, leveraging decades of experience in the industry. The company also offers private label services for dehydrated fruits.

name: TianBa Process Equipment
summary: TianBa Process Equipment is a global provider of thermal treatment processing solutions for the food and beverage industry. They specialize in manufacturing and delivering equipment for pasteurization, sterilization, and aseptic processing, including UHT, HHST, and DS-UHT systems. The company also offers automation solutions like TianBa ProcessEasy™ and comprehensive customer service and engineering support, aiming to deliver customized, innovative, and environmentally sustainable solutions.

name: METGIS
summary: METGIS is a Polish company established in 1993, specializing in the manufacturing of machinery and specialized cutting parts for the food processing industry. Their core products are based on 'kutry przelotowe' (conveyor cutters), which they equip with patented cutting and grinding systems tailored to specific production needs. The company also offers repair and modernization services for these machines, as well as custom-made cutting components for various types of mills.

name: Zasada Fabryka Maszyn Sp. z o.o.
summary: Zasada Fabryka Maszyn Sp. z o.o. designs and manufactures specialized machinery for various food processing applications, including smoking, cooking, and frying. They offer comprehensive solutions from design to implementation, focusing on advanced technology and customized equipment. The company also provides a premium service package including 24/7 support, tailored machine adjustments, extended documentation, and enhanced warranty.

name: PIMENT NV
summary: PIMENT NV is the official BeNeLux distributor of LIMA food processing equipment, specializing in meat-bone separators, deboners, and desinewers. They cater to a wide range of food processing industries, including slaughterhouses, meatpackers, and convenience food manufacturers. With a strong export focus, PIMENT NV distributes LIMA products worldwide, positioning them as a leader in their niche.

name: LA GOLDONI
summary: LA GOLDONI, also known as Goldoni International srl, specializes in the design and construction of machinery and complete plants for the food and beverage industry. With over 40 years of experience, the company offers customized solutions, focusing on innovation, technical development, and high-quality, reliable machinery. They cater to a range of clients, from small artisanal workshops to large companies, providing both complete turnkey projects and individual machines.

name: HaMix GmbH
summary: HaMix GmbH is a full-service food manufacturer based in Hameln, Germany, specializing in dry-based food products. They offer comprehensive services including product development, raw material and packaging procurement, production (mixing, pelletizing, instantizing, agglomerating), filling, and logistics. The company operates as a contract manufacturer and private label provider, catering to diverse food industry needs from desserts and soups to sports nutrition and meat alternatives.

name: Rubin Mühle GmbH
summary: Rubin Mühle GmbH is a company with over 300 years of experience in processing grains. They specialize in producing a variety of milled products, including flakes, special milled products, extrudates, flakes, extruded flours and granulates, and proteins. The company focuses on modern extrusion technologies for plant-based meat alternatives and offers products for breakfast. They also emphasize quality, product development, ecological practices, and provide information on their history, jobs, and training opportunities.

name: Bettcher do Brasil Comércio de Maquinas Ltda
summary: Bettcher Industries, Inc., operating in Brazil as Bettcher do Brasil Comércio de Maquinas Ltda, specializes in the design and innovation of food processing equipment and hand tools. Founded in 1944, the company offers over 60 years of experience with global sales and service. Their mission is to provide technically superior products that enhance worker productivity and product yield while reducing risks associated with repetitive strain injuries.

name: CeSoT - Shop
summary: CeSoT - Shop is an online retailer specializing in equipment for food processing, particularly for hunters and chefs. Their product range includes vacuum sealers, meat processing tools, professional knives, saws, shears, sharpening tools, pans, and baking accessories. The company emphasizes its expertise in these areas, aiming to provide high-quality tools for various culinary and food preparation needs.

name: Cor Voet B.V. Wild & Gevogelte
summary: Cor Voet B.V. is a family-owned wholesale and processing company specializing in chicken, game, and poultry products. They offer customized products with short lead times, focusing on customer needs for specific product, packaging, and labeling requirements. The company emphasizes sustainability, animal welfare, and quality, sourcing chicken from the Netherlands and Belgium and processing game directly from the hunt.

name: Morski Brands, Inc.
summary: Morski Brands, Inc. is a family-owned and operated company specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of packaged food and ingredient products. With over 60 years of experience, they offer a full range of services including packaging, commissary ingredients, and ready-to-eat product lines. They focus on quality, innovation, and customer partnerships, serving customers nationwide.

name: ООО ЕФТ
summary: ООО ЕФТ is a Russian company with over 15 years of experience specializing in the supply and integration of technological equipment for the food processing industry. They offer full-cycle cooperation, from design to equipment delivery and launch, focusing on sectors like poultry, meat, fish, and vegetable processing, as well as semi-finished and ready-to-eat product manufacturing. The company emphasizes providing turnkey production lines, leveraging its own engineering center and a network of European and American brand partners.

name: bwin必赢 (LONGDA MEISHI CO.,LTD)
summary: bwin必赢, established in 1996 and listed as 002726.SZ, is a Chinese company focused on the food industry. Its strategy involves food as the core, supported by slaughtering and farming operations, aiming to be a premium raw material supplier and processed food producer, as well as a comprehensive food consumption scenario solution provider. The company collaborates with over 1000 well-known enterprises and exports to more than 20 countries.

name: Shama Gewürze e.K.
summary: Shama Gewürze e.K. is a company specializing in providing high-quality food processing equipment and expert consultation services to food processors worldwide. They offer a range of machines from bandsaws and mixer grinders to vacuum fillers and smoking chambers, catering to hypermarkets, hotels, catering businesses, and large industrial processors. The company also supplies consumables and packaging materials, alongside after-sales services and spare parts.

name: GOREMI Co., Ltd.
summary: GOREMI Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive food company specializing in high-quality processed seafood, established in 2012 with proprietary domestic technology. The company focuses on developing new and unique flavors to provide delicious and enjoyable dining experiences for everyone. They emphasize systematic hygiene management, strict quality control, and reasonable pricing through direct manufacturing and online sales.

name: КОМПО Технолоджис
summary: КОМПО Технолоджис is the official representative of KOMPO in the Russian Federation, specializing in the sale and service of food processing equipment. They offer a wide range of products including vacuum fillers, clippers, and auxiliary equipment, along with consumables and spare parts. The company provides comprehensive services such as installation, technical support, repair, and training, catering to the meat, dairy, and other food production industries.

name: ABL Cavezzo
summary: ABL Cavezzo is a company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of fruit processing machinery. With over 40 years of experience, they focus on improving performance, efficiency, and fruit quality through innovative engineering and automation. They offer a range of solutions for various fruits and processing functions, supported by comprehensive service, spare parts, and training.

name: Euronuts
summary: Euronuts is a specialist in nut processing and refinement, importing high-quality nuts and seeds globally. They prepare these products for further manufacturing, primarily supplying large industrial bakeries. The company distinguishes itself by offering customized solutions and also provides contract processing services, utilizing advanced cleaning lines and laser scanners to remove foreign materials.

name: Carsoe Seafood ApS
summary: Carsoe is a global expert in seafood processing systems, offering solutions for both onboard vessels and land-based facilities. They provide a range of equipment including plate freezers, palletizing systems, and processing lines, alongside services like maintenance, upgrades, and spare parts. The company aims to be a trusted partner, delivering reliable processing equipment and expertise tailored to the harsh conditions of the seafood industry.

name: Lameri S.p.A.
summary: Lameri S.p.A. is an Italian company founded in 1968, specializing in the transformation and commercialization of food products. They offer a range of products including private label options, retail brands, and semi-finished goods like extruded cereals, flours, and grains for bakeries. The company also emphasizes organic product lines and sustainable development, participating in international trade fairs to showcase their offerings.

name: Prila Sp. z o.o.
summary: Prila Sp. z o.o. is a company specializing in the production and private labeling of food products, particularly jams and baked goods, for the bakery, hotel, and catering industries. They offer custom branding solutions, allowing businesses to feature their own logos on products like mini jams and pastries. The company aims to help clients build brand strength through personalized food offerings.

name: Fischer Planning
summary: Fischer Planning provides expert consulting, design, and turnkey systems for aseptic and ultra-clean processing in the food, beverage, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries. They specialize in liquid-based production systems and offer solutions for new line construction and retrofitting existing systems. Their premier product, SteriVent, is a sterile air filtration system designed to protect products from airborne contaminants, extending shelf life and improving efficiency.

name: МИЛАМ
summary: МИЛАМ specializes in the design, manufacturing, and installation of modular mini-factories and food processing equipment. They offer complete solutions for meat, dairy, and fish processing, including slaughter modules, processing lines, and specialized equipment. The company provides a full cycle of services from design and documentation to installation, commissioning, and after-sales support.

name: Rex-Pol Sp. z o.o.
summary: Rex-Pol Sp. z o.o. is a Polish company established in 1991, specializing in the design and production of environmentally friendly equipment for the food processing industry, including meat, fish, poultry, dairy, and baking sectors, as well as catering businesses. They offer a range of products such as smoke houses, ovens, curing chambers, and smoke generators, alongside services like laser cutting and welding. The company emphasizes quality, safety, and competence, operating on global markets and providing comprehensive advice for plant modernization.

name: Equichem International, Inc.
summary: Equichem International, Inc. specializes in developing and manufacturing custom vitamin/mineral premixes and specialty enzyme-based ingredient blends for the food processing industry. They offer services from benchtop formulation to final custom manufacturing, serving clients across North America, Central America, and South America. Their expertise supports product development in the flour, baking, and beverage sectors.

name: 中利缶詰株式会社 (Nakari Co., Ltd.)
summary: Nakari Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company established in 1961, specializing in the manufacturing and sale of canned goods and pastes. Their product range includes candied chestnuts, chestnut paste, burdock root paste, various bean products, and other fruit and vegetable pastes. They also offer commercial canned goods like zenzai and black beans, as well as chilled desserts such as kuzu-kiri, warabi mochi, and jellies, catering to diverse customer needs from product development to production.

name: 银河集团官网 (LONGDA MEISHI CO.,LTD)

They emphasize technological strength, global resources, and quality control, with products sold domestically and in over 20 countries.

name: Garozzo Ingredienti & Co. S.r.l.
summary: Garozzo Ingredienti & Co. is an innovative company specializing in the supply of food ingredients and raw materials for food processing. Leveraging extensive experience in the natural casings industry, the company offers a wide range of products including traditional, organic, and allergen-free ingredients, as well as technological aids, packaging, machinery, and accessories. They also provide specialized consulting and professional training to support clients in food production.

name: Lavorcarni Srl
summary: Lavorcarni Srl is an Italian company specializing in the processing and commercialization of meat and fish products. Established in 1973, the company offers a wide selection of high-quality food products, including fresh and packaged meats, seafood, crustaceans, mollusks, and prepared items. They emphasize hand-crafted preparation and quality control, holding various hygiene certifications. Lavorcarni aims to meet diverse customer needs through continuous research and evolution in the food sector.

name: Zakład Przetwórstwa Owocowo-Warzywnego ROLFROZ Sp. z o.o.
summary: ROLFROZ Sp. z o.o. is a leading Polish producer specializing in fruit and vegetable processing for over 30 years. Their product range includes tomato concentrates and purees, sterilized and salad vegetables, pickled vegetables, and fruit/vegetable purees. They also offer packaging and private label services, focusing on delivering high-quality ingredients for the food industry.

name: REISCHL LEBENSMITTELTECHNIK
summary: Reischl Lebensmitteltechnik (RLMT) specializes in the professional production of ham, offering both individual machines and complete production lines. For over 30 years, they have provided maintenance, spare parts, and consulting services. They also offer an "Upcycling" service to extend the lifespan of existing machinery.

name: MAKOFROST JAROSŁAW MAKOŚ
summary: MAKOFROST is a family-owned company established in 2008, specializing in the purchase and processing of fruits and vegetables. They source fresh produce directly from growers, process them into pulp or frozen whole fruits using advanced technologies and HACCP quality control, and also offer wholesale of fresh produce. Additionally, the company provides frozen goods storage services with significant capacity and offers forwarding and refrigerated transport services.

name: Sprematec Sondermaschinenbau GmbH
summary: Sprematec Sondermaschinenbau GmbH specializes in the planning, development, and construction of custom machinery for the food processing industry, with a particular focus on baking and confectionery applications. They offer a comprehensive range of products including baking plants, dough preparation equipment, chocolate coating machines, and conveying technology. Beyond manufacturing, Sprematec provides extensive services such as consultation, maintenance, spare parts, and contract manufacturing, aiming to be a full-service partner for their clients' success.

name: Hubka-Petrášek a vnuci s.r.o.
summary: Hubka-Petrášek a vnuci s.r.o. specializes in developing custom food products and ingredients for various sectors of the food industry. They offer a range of solutions including spices, marinades, preservatives, starter cultures, and packaging for the meat industry, as well as ingredients for dairy, confectionery, and vegetarian/vegan products. The company also provides custom blend mixing services, aiming to optimize food production processes for their clients.

name: Fratelli Pagani S.p.A.
summary: Fratelli Pagani is an Italian family company with over 110 years of experience in producing and commercializing exclusive aromas and ingredients for the food industry. They specialize in solutions for meat, fish, pasta, and savory products, as well as offering organic and vegan options. The company emphasizes innovation, quality, and customized service through its proprietary 'Metodo Skybridge' process, serving clients globally.

name: PROBA-LUXE LLC
summary: PROBA-LUXE LLC is a direct importer and supplier of a wide range of food ingredients, casings, and professional cleaning agents for the food industry. Established in 2005, the company specializes in complex functional blends, spices, and various types of casings, sourcing directly from China, India, and Uzbekistan. They serve meat, fish, and dairy processing industries, offering both standard products and custom formulation services.

name: AURELI MARIO Società Agricola
summary: Aureli Mario Società Agricola, established in 1968, is a leading company in the cultivation and processing of vegetables into natural ingredients for the food industry. They offer a wide range of products including NFC juice, puree, concentrated products, spray-dried ingredients, flour, pellets, and natural aromas. The company serves various sectors such as industry, retail, fresh produce, and food service, with a strong focus on sustainability and research & development.

name: ООО «ТопФуд»
summary: ООО «ТопФуд» is a modern processing and production company specializing in dried vegetables, herbs, mushrooms, spices, grains, and other plant-based ingredients for the food industry. They offer services such as raw material cleaning, grinding, calibration, blending, and steam sterilization. The company emphasizes reliability, innovation, and health and safety in its operations, aiming to make food products natural and safe.

name: MGT Foods
summary: MGT Foods is a food technology and manufacturing company with over 50 years of experience in co-packing and distributing CPG, food service, and pet food brands. They specialize in scaling recipes for various distribution channels, offering services in R&D, manufacturing, and distribution for frozen foods, ice cream, and plant-based products. Their capabilities include producing bulk ice cream, pints, frozen yogurt, sorbet, gelato, mochi ice cream, and various cookie products.

name: Ceralia
summary: Ceralia is a company specializing in the production and packaging of organic and natural food products. They offer a wide range of products including pure grain products, gluten-free options, cereals, legumes, and baking ingredients. Additionally, Ceralia provides custom packaging solutions like pillow bags, gusset bags, and folding boxes, along with services such as contract mixing, co-packing, and private label manufacturing. Their focus is on utilizing high-tech processes and quality assurance to transform client ideas into market-ready products.

name: ПРО-ИНЖИНИРИНГ
summary: ПРО-ИНЖИНИРИНГ is an engineering company specializing in the supply of components, equipment, and technological solutions for the food and pharmaceutical industries. They offer services such as production automation, equipment selection, assembly of technological modules, and comprehensive project development. Their mission is to implement advanced technological solutions to enhance energy efficiency, automation, and product quality in food production.

name: LUMIX PROCUT
summary: LUMIX PROCUT supplies machinery, professional cutting tools, and sharpening services to the industrial food and meat industry. They offer machinery breakdown and electrical services, along with a wide range of spare parts including blades, knives, and plates. The company also distributes various brands of food processing equipment and aims to help food manufacturers improve productivity and profitability.

name: Fibrisol Service Australia
summary: Fibrisol Service Australia is a leading food blending specialist and an industry leader in providing innovative ingredient solutions for the food industry. They offer contract blending services for functional blends used in meat products, processed cheese, and noodles, utilizing state-of-the-art blending and R&D facilities. As part of a global organization owned by BK Giulini GmbH, they leverage international expertise and technology to serve customers in Australia, New Zealand, the Pacific, and Southeast Asia.

name: Gigema BV
summary: Gigema BV is a family-owned company established in 2000, specializing in the sorting and packaging of fruits, primarily apples and pears. They offer services such as tray packaging, manual bag filling, flow packing, and net packing, with a daily sorting capacity of 25,000 kg and packaging capacity of 20,000 kg. The company also operates ULO storage facilities, with significant expansion planned for 2025 to increase storage capacity and improve logistics.

name: Charlottetown Metal Products (CMP)
summary: Charlottetown Metal Products (CMP) is a Canadian company specializing in innovative, hygienic food processing solutions. As part of the FPS Food Process Solutions global family, CMP designs and manufactures equipment such as hygienic conveyors, tote handling systems, sanitary spirals, and thermal solutions. They offer end-to-end process line solutions, leveraging their engineering expertise and a dedicated innovation center to serve global customers in various food sectors.

name: VITULIA, S.A.
summary: VITULIA, S.A. is a family-owned company founded in 1985, dedicated to producing high-quality prepared, cooked, and marinated food products at competitive prices. The company emphasizes quality, safety, and innovation (R&D+i) to meet market demands and consumer needs. They strive for continuous improvement and adhere to strict national and international certifications for quality and hygiene.

name: PROEXA S.A.
summary: PROEXA S.A. is a company specializing in healthy food production and maquila (contract manufacturing) services. They offer a range of food products including rice pasta, pre-baked pizza and bread, instant soups, vegan yogurt, and rice semolina. Their services encompass grinding, mixing, extrusion, spray drying, hydrolysis, and packaging, catering to both their own brands and private label development.

name: Regio Frucht GmbH
summary: Regio Frucht GmbH specializes in the ultra-fresh processing of fruits and vegetables, offering ready-cut products of the highest quality. They provide customized fresh-cut items, including organic options, packaged to customer specifications and delivered directly. Founded in 2000, the company leverages its family heritage in agriculture to process regional and imported produce.

name: Miray İthalat İhracat
summary: Miray İthalat İhracat is a Turkish company specializing in the import and export of a wide range of products. Their offerings include food and filling facilities, filling machines and tanks, stainless steel spare parts and pumps, cooling systems, food packaging, raw food materials, promotional items, hygiene products, home textiles, and mining facilities. They serve various industries with a broad product portfolio and have completed projects in Armenia.

name: Le Specialità Italiane S.r.l.
summary: Le Specialità Italiane is an Italian food processing company specializing in the production of tomato pulp, ready-made sauces, and rehydrated legumes. Operating from a large industrial site with a history linked to the Cirio brand, the company serves both Italian and international clients. They focus on modernizing traditional food preservation techniques to meet evolving market demands.

name: GOMAR Sp. z o.o.
summary: GOMAR Sp. z o.o. is a Polish family company established in 1992, specializing in the processing of fruits and vegetables. They produce a wide range of products including concentrates, purees, aromas, frozen fruits and vegetables, and ready-made preserves, all made without preservatives from natural Polish ingredients. The company operates four production facilities and exports its products globally, serving both small businesses and international corporations.

name: CI+DEA, S.L. (CIDEA)
summary: CI+DEA (CIDEA) is a consultancy firm established in 1998, specializing in research and development for the food industry. They offer advisory, consulting, and representation services, focusing on new product development, process improvement, and machinery selection. The company leverages expertise in product components, production processes, and international supplier relationships to help clients optimize investments, reduce waste, and minimize costs.

name: Engmir
summary: Engmir is a Ukrainian manufacturing company established in 2005, specializing in the production, repair, and setup of equipment for the food, processing, and pharmaceutical industries. They design and manufacture a wide range of products including conveyors, mixers, metal structures, automation systems, tanks, production tables, refrigeration tunnels, and industrial grease traps. The company emphasizes using high-quality materials and components from leading global brands to meet diverse customer requirements.

name: PAPRIFOOD, S.L.
summary: PAPRIFOOD, S.L. is a Spanish company with 60 years of experience specializing in the development of functional blends and custom solutions for the food industry. They offer a wide range of products including meat developments, pre-cooked items, functional bases, sauces, marinades, and veggie options, catering to the meat industry, industrial kitchens, and the HORECA sector. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer-tailored advice to create unique flavors.

name: Ruiten Foodpack
summary: Ruiten Foodpack is a Dutch company specializing in customized food production and packaging services. They offer private label solutions, co-packing, and handle various product types and packaging materials. With over 135 years of experience and state-of-the-art machinery, they focus on flexibility, reliability, and quality, holding certifications like BRC and FSSC 22000.

name: 浙江味海食品配料有限公司
summary: Zhejiang Weihai Food Ingredients Co., Ltd. is a food processing company specializing in a wide range of products including frozen foods, family seasonings, prepared sauces, and snack items. The company emphasizes quality, efficiency, integrity, and win-win cooperation, striving for innovation and customer satisfaction. It has received recognition as a provincial-level agricultural technology enterprise and a national high-tech enterprise, with its 'Weizi Hai' trademark being a well-known brand in Wenzhou.

name: 株式会社ハシモト
summary: 株式会社ハシモト (Hashimoto Co., Ltd.) is a specialized company focused on filling and packaging services for food products, including confectionery, snacks, and health foods. Leveraging extensive experience, they aim to provide safe, secure, and cost-effective solutions for their clients' valuable products. The company offers a comprehensive range of services from filling and packaging to shrink wrapping, supported by diverse equipment and skilled manual labor to meet various customer needs.

name: Kim Hing Food Industries Pte Ltd.
summary: Kim Hing Food Industries specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of premium bottled and retort-packed food products. They offer services including R&D for items like birds' nest and abalone, bottling, retort pouch packing, and design & packaging for OEM customers. The company focuses on producing high-quality, preservative-free food with an extended shelf life through advanced sterilization and vacuum sealing processes.

name: MUSASHI-SHOKAI Co.,Ltd.
summary: MUSASHI-SHOKAI Co.,Ltd. is a company specializing in the manufacturing and sales of various food machinery, as well as plant and layout design. They offer solutions for projects, focusing on their strengths in these areas. The company provides product information and rental services, aiming to support their clients' operational needs.

name: REISCHL LEBENSMITTELTECHNIK
summary: Reischl Lebensmitteltechnik (RLMT) specializes in the professional production of ham, offering both individual machines and complete production lines. For over 30 years, they have provided maintenance, spare parts, and consulting services. They also offer an "Upcycling" service to extend the lifespan of existing machinery.

name: RIVALIS
summary: RIVALIS is a private company with over 20 years of experience in the food industry, specializing in the supply, consulting, and production of sausages and meat products. They offer a wide range of products including casings, spices, machinery, and tools for meat processing. The company aims to help clients achieve European standards in their operations and serves as a wholesale and retail supplier for the meat processing industry, fish industry, dairies, and poultry farms.

name: МолТехноПроект
summary: MolTechnoProject is a Russian company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of technological equipment for the dairy and other food industries. They offer a range of services including equipment production, reconstruction, automation, and installation. The company serves major Russian enterprises and has experience working on complex projects.

name: El Campo Game Processing, Inc.
summary: El Campo Game Processing, Inc. is a family-owned business in Kingsville, Texas, specializing in wild game processing. They offer services for various wild game animals (excluding fowl) and ensure that customers receive the exact meat they bring in, vacuum-packaged for extended freshness. The company emphasizes customer service and aims to provide a savory experience from hunt to table.

name: Glasbest B.V.
summary: Glasbest B.V. is a food production and packaging facility located in Udenhout, specializing in developing and manufacturing food products for both its own brands and third-party clients. Leveraging extensive experience, culinary expertise, and private label development knowledge, they serve as a flexible partner for a diverse clientele, from chefs to large food producers. The company offers services ranging from bespoke product development to the creation of more standard or cost-efficient food items, focusing on quality, taste, and efficiency.

name: Halsan Kjøtt
summary: Halsan Kjøtt is a meat processing company located in Levanger, Norway, specializing in slaughter cutting and the production of meat products. They offer services such as portioning, vacuum packing, smoking, and sausage making, and also provide contract manufacturing for small-scale producers. The company supplies local food products to restaurants and has its own retail outlet, emphasizing quality control and export potential.

name: Opnios
summary: Opnios is a company specializing in the processing and distribution of industrial raw materials and finished products, primarily in the poultry sector. They offer a comprehensive range of raw materials such as chicken, turkey, duck, and goose, available frozen or fresh. Additionally, Opnios provides elaborated products under their own brand, neutral options, or private labels for clients, catering to various market needs.

name: Janbak (Aust.) Pty Ltd
summary: Janbak is a certified food manufacturing specialist with over 60 years of experience, focusing on blending and packing services. They are recognized for their meticulous allergen control and high-value processing, catering to sensitive markets. The company emphasizes sustainability through waste reduction and holds prestigious certifications like SQF, ACO, Halal, and Kosher Australia, positioning itself as an innovator in food processing.

name: ALLTEX - ЮГ - СЕРВИС
summary: ALLTEX - ЮГ - СЕРВИС is a trading and engineering company with 20 years of experience in the meat, poultry, and fish processing industries. They specialize in supplying equipment from major Western European manufacturers, offering a full range of services including installation, maintenance, spare parts, and technological support. Their mission is to assist Russian producers in creating high-quality domestic products that meet international standards.

name: Dunninghams Ltd
summary: Dunninghams Ltd is a supplier of ingredients, casings, packaging, ancillary equipment, PPE, and machinery primarily for the food processing industry, with a focus on meat processing. They offer a wide range of products including seasonings, marinades, glazes, coatings, and various types of casings and packaging solutions. The company also provides machinery and equipment for food production and emphasizes environmental responsibility and sustainability in its operations.

name: Lameri S.p.A.
summary: Lameri S.p.A. is an Italian company founded in 1968, specializing in the transformation and commercialization of food products. They offer a range of products including private label options, retail brands, and semi-finished goods like extruded cereals, flours, and grains for bakeries. The company also emphasizes organic product lines and sustainable development, participating in international trade fairs to showcase their offerings.

name: CeSoT - Shop
summary: CeSoT - Shop is an online retailer specializing in equipment for food processing, particularly for hunters and chefs. Their product range includes vacuum sealers, meat processing tools, professional knives, saws, shears, sharpening tools, pans, and baking accessories. The company emphasizes its expertise in these areas, aiming to provide high-quality tools for various culinary and food preparation needs.

name: Compass
summary: Compass provides comprehensive engineering services, machinery supply, and maintenance solutions specifically for the food industry. Established in 1993, they offer 24/7 engineering support, planned and preventive maintenance, new and remanufactured machinery, and consumables. They aim to build long-term business relationships based on trust and commitment, positioning themselves as an expert partner in the food processing and packaging sectors.

name: KORKUS – Zakład Przetwórstwa Warzyw i Owoców z Pajęczna
summary: KORKUS is a fruit and vegetable processing plant established in 1991, specializing in the production of fruit and vegetable preserves, and notably, fruit and vegetable juices. The company has invested in modern facilities and focuses on high product quality, offering a wide range of juice flavors and the ability to create custom blends for clients. KORKUS also produces fruit and vegetable purees used as semi-finished products in the food industry and exports its products to various international markets.

name: ООО Алекс-Пак
summary: ООО Алекс-Пак is a professional supplier of technological and packaging equipment and materials for the food and processing industries. They offer a comprehensive range of services, from raw material processing to finished product packaging, catering to businesses of all sizes. The company emphasizes quality products at accessible prices, reliable supply, and a flexible pricing system, aiming for mutually beneficial long-term partnerships.

name: Paseo Alimentos
summary: Paseo Alimentos is a Brazilian food processing company founded in 2010, specializing in the production and distribution of preserved food products. Initially focusing on cucumbers, the company expanded its offerings to include garlic, onions, pickles, carrots, and other items, serving both private label and institutional markets. Paseo Alimentos emphasizes quality, fair pricing, and excellent service, with a commitment to innovation and customer respect.

name: Doering Systems, Inc.
summary: Doering Systems, Inc. is a family-run manufacturer of industrial food processing machinery, specializing in pumping systems, extruders, conveyors, and sheeting equipment. They focus on processing high-viscosity products while maintaining integrity, offering custom-engineered, reliable, and sanitary machinery. The company has a long tradition of quality, dating back to 1884, and provides one-stop solutions for various food processing needs.

name: Morski Brands, Inc.
summary: Morski Brands, Inc. is a family-owned and operated company specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of packaged food and ingredient products. With over 60 years of experience, they offer a full range of services including packaging, commissary ingredients, and ready-to-eat product lines. They focus on quality, innovation, and customer partnerships, serving customers nationwide.

name: Fratelli Indelicato S.r.l.
summary: Fratelli Indelicato designs and manufactures complete turnkey plants for the citrus and tropical fruit processing industry, specializing in high-performance machinery for juice and essential oil extraction. Since 1946, the company has focused on delivering reliable solutions to produce high-quality juices and oils. They offer integrated systems for both citrus and tropical fruits, along with services like feasibility studies, project design, and spare parts supply.

name: Australian Freeze Dry
summary: Australian Freeze Dry is a leading contract freeze-drying business specializing in the processing, freeze-drying, and packaging of food products for clients across Australia. They offer services including slicing, dicing, mincing, cooking, powdering, and various packaging solutions. The company is HACCP accredited, Organic certified, and has over 10 years of experience, handling volumes from 1kg to multiple tonnes. They are wholly owned by Forager Foods Pty Ltd.

name: Milk-Szolg Kft.
summary: Milk-Szolg Kft. has over 25 years of experience providing comprehensive solutions for the food manufacturing and processing industry, as well as the chemical industry. They specialize in aseptic beverage technology and dairy industry services, offering everything from spare parts supply and maintenance to service, development, and complete production line implementation. Their services include technical solutions, installation, commissioning, and competitive pricing for OEM and general spare parts.

name: Arne B. Corneliussen AS
summary: Arne B. Corneliussen AS is a full-range supplier to the meat, fish, and food industries, specializing in natural and artificial casings, processing aids, ingredients, packaging, and flavorings. The company emphasizes quality and food safety, aiming to deliver secure products to its customers. They operate as a key supplier within the food processing sector.

name: ABL Cavezzo
summary: ABL Cavezzo is a company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of fruit processing machinery. With over 40 years of experience, they focus on improving performance, efficiency, and fruit quality through innovative engineering and automation. They offer a range of solutions for various fruits and processing functions, supported by comprehensive service, spare parts, and training.

name: Jiaxing Jian'an Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiaxing Jian'an Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive enterprise established in 2008, specializing in the research, development, production, and OEM/ODM processing of food and cosmetic products. Their offerings include probiotics, essences, hair growth solutions, creams, lotions, protein powders, and meal replacement powders, alongside cosmetic products like creams, lotions, masks, and essences. The company boasts advanced production and quality inspection equipment, with significant annual production capacities for various dosage forms and cosmetic products, aiming to be a trusted partner for market success.

name: Comercial ADIM De Maquinaria S.L.
summary: Comercial ADIM De Maquinaria S.L. is a company specializing in the sale and service of machinery for the food industry, including meat, fish, and dairy processing, as well as the hospitality sector. They offer a comprehensive service that includes advice, installation, and after-sales support, leveraging over 30 years of experience. The company also provides consumables, spare parts, and refurbished machinery, aiming to optimize client productivity with the latest technology.

name: 360 Group
summary: 360 Group is a holding company that integrates two businesses: 360 Consultoria & Gerenciamento de Projetos and 360 Representações Comerciais. They specialize in providing knowledge, innovation, and technology solutions for the food processing industry. The company develops integrated solutions, including project layouts and necessary equipment, representing global brands to offer advanced processes and technologies for various production volumes.

name: AUPRO
summary: AUPRO is a company established in 2012 that provides engineering, design, supervision, and project execution services for the food and beverage, dairy, and pharmaceutical industries. They specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of processing systems within these sectors, aiming to deliver quality products and services to their clients.

name: Торговый Дом Арта
summary: Торговый Дом Арта is a leading supplier of food ingredients and packaging materials for the meat and fish processing industries. They represent STABИ Germany and RUTA Russia, offering a wide range of products including textured soy protein, complex additives, dried vegetables, animal proteins, and packaging solutions. The company focuses on enhancing the economic efficiency, quality, and shelf-life of processed food products.

name: Mezuli
summary: Mezuli provides equipment and consulting services for product packaging, filling, drying, freezing, grilling, and general production. They offer solutions for various sectors, including fruit and vegetable processing, with specialized equipment for drying, freezing, grilling, and producing soups, juices, purees, and compotes. The company also advises on the latest methods and trends in product packaging and beverage filling.

name: Exim
summary: Exim is a South African company that supplies a wide range of products and equipment for the food processing and butchery industries. They offer spices, natural herbs, custom blends, casings, sauces, marinades, machinery, and packaging. Exim also operates several factory shops across South Africa and promotes various brands including Exim Products, Nyama Choma, and Grill Club.

name: Doray Foods GmbH Warenhandel
summary: Doray Foods is a German-based company with over 40 years of experience in the meat processing and services industry. They specialize in custom meat preparation, including slicing (carpaccio), portioning, aging, vacuum sealing, sawing, packaging, and labeling. The company serves major clients across Germany, France, Holland, Denmark, and England, focusing on high-quality, efficient, and sustainable meat solutions for the food industry.

name: IFT S.r.l.
summary: IFT S.r.l. is an Italian company specializing in the production and sale of plastic equipment for the food industry. They offer a range of robust and hygienic solutions, including crates, pallets, racks, tables, and trays, designed to meet strict national and international regulations. Their products cater to various sectors such as dairy, meat processing, pasta, baking, confectionery, fruits, vegetables, and fish, aiming to improve production processes and ensure compliance.

name: Arne B. Corneliussen AS
summary: Arne B. Corneliussen AS is a full-range supplier to the meat, fish, and food industries, specializing in natural and artificial casings, processing aids, ingredients, packaging, and flavorings. The company emphasizes quality and food safety, aiming to deliver secure products to its customers. They operate as a key supplier within the food processing sector.

name: Βουτσινάς Χρήστος I.K.E.
summary: Βουτσινάς Χρήστος I.K.E. has been providing modern production, packaging, and bottling systems for over 40 years to Greek manufacturers in the food and beverage industry, as well as other sectors. They offer a wide range of machinery for products like jams, preserves, honey, appetizers, ready meals, olives, oils, water, wine, seafood, and vacuum-packed goods. In addition to equipment supply and installation, the company provides technical support, study and design services, custom machine manufacturing, and collaborates with international manufacturers. They have been ISO 9001 certified since 2016 for the construction, trade, and technical support of food processing and packaging machinery.

name: Частное предприятие "ПримУпак"
summary: Частное предприятие "ПримУпак" is a company operating for over 10 years, specializing in equipment and technologies for fruit and vegetable processing, including complete lines with supply and service. They also provide packaging materials and equipment, modern cargo securing technologies, and distribute direct-pressed juice in bag-in-box packaging. The company emphasizes quality products, competitive pricing, and good service.

name: Marel
summary: Marel is a global leader in providing advanced processing systems, software, and services for the food industry. They specialize in solutions for poultry, meat, fish, and prepared food processing, leveraging digitalization, automation, and robotics. Their mission is to innovate food processing to meet the growing global demand for high-quality protein, with a strong focus on sustainability and operational efficiency for their clients.

name: Cimbria
summary: Cimbria is a leading global company specializing in the industrial processing, handling, and storage of bulk products such as grain, seed, animal feed, and foodstuffs. They offer a comprehensive range of solutions, including conveying, drying, processing, and optical sorting equipment, alongside complete turnkey plant solutions. Cimbria focuses on enhancing quality, efficiency, and sustainability for its customers across various industries, including agriculture, food, and recycling.

name: MCM Matériel Charles Mecal
summary: MCM Matériel Charles Mecal specializes in designing and manufacturing equipment for the agri-food industry, particularly for slaughterhouses, salting operations, and food processing. They offer solutions for various sectors including beef, sheep, pig processing, and food product manufacturing like yogurts and chocolate. The company also provides water treatment and blood treatment systems, indicating a comprehensive approach to industrial process equipment.

name: Pohjolan Luonto ja Kala Oy
summary: Pohjolan Luonto ja Kala Oy is a Finnish company that imports and sells equipment for processing and preserving game, fish, and natural products. Their product range includes specialized items like Dry Ager cabinets, vacuum packaging machines, sous vide equipment, and various tools for meat and fish preparation. The company operates an e-commerce platform, vakuumikauppa.fi, serving customers interested in food preservation and preparation.

name: Török és Társai Bt. / SHT Service Kft.
summary: Török és Társai Bt., operating as SHT Service Kft., is a Hungarian company specializing in the maintenance, repair, and refurbishment of food processing machinery, particularly for the dairy industry. They service separators, heat exchangers, pasteurizers, and homogenizers from various manufacturers, and also offer custom-built equipment and complete processing lines. The company extends its services to the beverage, brewing, chemical, and building services sectors, with international clients in Serbia, Croatia, and Romania.

name: 江西鑫万来食品有限公司
summary: Jiangxi Xin Wan Lai Food Co., Ltd., established in 2012, is a food processing enterprise based in Jiujiang, China, specializing in baking and catering services. The company integrates research and development, production, and sales, offering a wide range of products including frozen dough, handmade tart shells, puff pastries, cakes, and Western-style cold desserts. With a large, modern production facility and a dedicated cold chain logistics system, Xin Wan Lai serves major supermarket chains and renowned bakeries, also providing OEM services.

name: MARELEC Food Technologies
summary: MARELEC Food Technologies designs and manufactures high-tech portioning, weighing, grading, and control systems for the fishing and food industry. They offer solutions to optimize manufacturing processes, including software like MATRIX PRO for monitoring and control, and provide lifecycle services to ensure operational efficiency. As part of the Duravant family, they serve the food processing, packaging, and material handling segments.

name: BDG (Baez Design Group)
summary: BDG is a leading design service provider for the food processing industry, offering expertise in industrial processes, processing, and agribusiness. They focus on creating long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with clients by providing experienced engineering services. BDG also offers geotechnical services through an affiliate, Baez Geotechnical Group, ensuring practical recommendations and construction monitoring.

name: Domenico De Lucia SPA
summary: Domenico De Lucia SPA is a family-owned company founded in 1929, initially focused on exporting local agricultural products and later expanding into food processing in the 1950s. The company specializes in ready-to-eat steamed products (V Gamma) and dried fruits, adhering to strict HACCP and BRC quality standards. They export their products to France, Germany, England, Canada, and the United States, serving both the agro-industry and flexographic printing sectors.

name: NATURA PRODUCTION
summary: NATURA PRODUCTION is a French food industry company specializing in product development, formulation, manufacturing, and packaging. They offer services ranging from R&D and consulting to full-scale production, with a focus on gluten-free and organic products. Their facility is notably 100% gluten-free and manages strict allergen controls, including dedicated milk-free production lines.

name: Ruiten Foodpack
summary: Ruiten Foodpack is a Dutch company specializing in customized food production and packaging services. They offer private label solutions, co-packing, and handle various product types and packaging materials. With over 135 years of experience and state-of-the-art machinery, they focus on flexibility, reliability, and quality, holding certifications like BRC and FSSC 22000.

name: Diviande
summary: Diviande is a food sector company with over 30 years of experience, specializing in the development and production of meat and meat alternative products. They focus on innovation, quality, and sustainability, offering customized solutions for the industry, foodservice, Cash & Carry, and retail sectors. Diviande provides both private label options and products under their own brands, aiming to be a total solutions provider in the protein transition.

name: Grupo El’Golli
summary: Grupo El’Golli is a Brazilian agro-industrial group founded in 1986, specializing in the meat processing industry. It comprises three main units: Frigorífico El’Golli, focused on beef processing and distribution; H10 Foods, offering a variety of frozen meat products including poultry, beef, and pork, as well as processed foods; and El’Nutri, which produces tallow and flours. The group emphasizes quality, innovation, and socio-environmental commitment in its operations, serving both retail and wholesale markets.

name: APITAL d.o.o.
summary: APITAL d.o.o. is a Croatian company specializing in the manufacturing of stainless steel equipment and black iron constructions.
