Leveraging approximately 40 years of experience in element installation, the company serves various sectors including food retail, bakeries, slaughterhouses, and restaurants. They offer custom-built solutions and ready-to-use containers, emphasizing quality and tailored specifications for diverse client needs.

name: Grupo Químico Industrial
summary: Grupo Químico Industrial specializes in providing innovative cold chain solutions and services for the transportation of temperature-sensitive and perishable products. They offer a range of products including refrigerant gel packs (Frigogel), passive thermal systems (Coldboxx), thermal pallets, and data loggers. The company also provides services such as cold chain infrastructure qualification, temperature monitoring equipment calibration, and point-to-point cold chain validation.

name: Холод Юга
summary: Холод Юга is a company specializing in commercial real estate rental and storage services, established in 1967. For the past 5 years, they have focused on providing dry, low-temperature, and medium-temperature cold storage facilities. They also offer administrative spaces for employees and ensure a secure, well-maintained site with ample parking and power supply for refrigerated transport.

name: Frigo-Profil Hűtéstechnikai Kft.
summary: Frigo-Profil Hűtéstechnikai Kft. specializes in the design, installation, repair, and maintenance of refrigeration solutions, including cold rooms, freezing chambers, and rapid coolers. They cater to various industries requiring temperature-sensitive storage for food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, and other products. The company emphasizes customized solutions that meet Hungarian and EU standards, focusing on energy efficiency and durability.

name: Mech-Air
summary: Mech-Air is a leading Indian company specializing in end-to-end cold chain management and turnkey food processing solutions. With over 25 years of experience, they offer advanced refrigeration systems, industrial refrigeration, and food processing projects, from farm to fork. Their services encompass food refrigeration, comprehensive food processing, and specialized cryogenic and freeze-drying solutions, aiming to reduce costs and ensure product integrity throughout the supply chain.

name: 聯倡股份有限公司 (Lian Chang Co., Ltd.)
summary: 聯倡股份有限公司, also known as "美國冷王牌運輸冷凍設備" (US Cold King Transport Refrigeration Equipment), specializes in cold chain logistics equipment and services. They offer a range of products including refrigeration units for trucks and trailers, cold storage solutions, freezing equipment, and related accessories. The company also provides services such as refrigeration unit leasing, used equipment sales, and educational training on refrigeration unit usage, catering to the transportation of perishable goods like fresh produce, pharmaceuticals, and food products.

name: Tyrol Ice
summary: Tyrol Ice is a leading supplier of dry ice products and related services in Italy and Austria, specializing in various forms of dry ice like nuggets, pellets, and gourmet ice cubes. They offer solutions for cryogenic cooling, pharmaceutical transport, food logistics, and industrial cleaning, emphasizing their unique Südtirol-wide delivery service for even small orders. The company also provides accessories like gel pads and rents out ultra-low freezers, positioning itself as a comprehensive provider for temperature-sensitive logistics and industrial applications.

name: ALMAFRIGO SpA
summary: ALMAFRIGO SpA provides specialized cold storage and logistics services, offering refrigerated and frozen storage solutions for various products like fish, seafood, meats, vegetables, cheeses, honey, fruits, and vegetables. They operate temperature-controlled chambers at -18°C for frozen goods and 3°C for fresh items. Additionally, they provide a web platform for inventory control, weight tracking, valuation, and managing outgoing orders, aiming to be a key logistics partner in Santiago.

name: Gastrochlad Papán s.r.o.
summary: Gastrochlad Papán s.r.o. specializes in the installation, sale, and service of refrigeration and air conditioning systems. Their offerings include industrial cooling and freezing solutions, custom-built cold and freezer rooms for various commercial and industrial applications, and repair services for domestic and industrial refrigeration units. They also provide sales and service for air conditioning systems, including automotive air conditioning, and supply related components and refrigerants.

name: EASYFROID
summary: Easy Froid specializes in the rental and sale of mobile cold rooms and refrigerated containers. They offer solutions for various sectors including agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and events, emphasizing the importance of maintaining the cold chain. The company provides responsive 24/7 after-sales service across France and adheres to European quality standards for its equipment.

name: Frio Servicio de Monterrey, S. A. de C. V.
summary: Friser, also known as Frio Servicio de Monterrey, S. A. de C. V., specializes in providing refrigeration solutions for transportation, primarily focusing on Carrier Transicold equipment. They offer a range of cooling systems for trucks, trailers, and delivery vehicles, designed for fresh and frozen product transport. Beyond equipment sales, Friser provides comprehensive services including personalized attention, extended warranties, asset tracking, 24/7 support, technical training, and cold chain consulting to ensure efficient and reliable refrigerated logistics.

name: De Poel Koel- & Vrieshuis
summary: De Poel Koel- & Vrieshuis is a Dutch company specializing in conditioned storage and handling of chilled and frozen products. With over 40 years of experience, they offer comprehensive logistics services including warehousing, value-added services, and customs handling. Their facilities are centrally located in the North of the Netherlands, providing efficient loading and unloading times for up to 28,000 pallets.

name: GLOBAL CONTAINER Soluciones de Refrigeración S.A de C.V
summary: Global Container Soluciones de Refrigeración S.A de C.V is a company specializing in the rental of refrigerated containers and portable cold rooms, offering solutions for refrigeration and freezing. They also provide rental of diesel generators, air conditioning services, and container handling services. The company serves the Bajío and Manzanillo regions, catering to events, food businesses, restaurants, and logistics operations.

name: Controlled Environments Construction (CEC) Inc.
summary: Controlled Environments Construction (CEC) Inc. specializes in the design and construction of cold storage, food processing, and pharmaceutical facilities. Since 1992, they have offered turn-key solutions including environmental cleanup, site remediation, project management, and industrial racking layouts. CEC is also a proponent of low-charge ammonia refrigeration and industrial roof-raising services to maximize property use.

name: Kryeros, Inc.
summary: Kryeros is a full-service cryogenic resource company specializing in equipment distribution, cold-chain consulting, and system design for cryogenic storage. With 47 years of experience, they offer solutions for animal husbandry, IVF, and general cryogenic applications, acting as an authorized distributor for IC Biomedical and MVE Biological Solutions. They also provide cryogenic compliance training to help clients navigate cGMP environments.

name: Morozim
summary: Morozim is a specialized enterprise in Russia focused on the manufacturing and sale of refrigeration equipment. They offer a comprehensive range of products including refrigeration units, industrial chillers, cold rooms, shock freezing systems, and control panels, utilizing components from leading international brands. The company provides full-cycle services from design and supply to installation, commissioning, and after-sales service for clients in the food, processing, retail, and logistics sectors.

name: FRESCO
summary: FRESCO specializes in cold chain and integrated logistics solutions for perishable products. They offer services including cold storage with controlled temperatures, refrigerated delivery and logistics across Mexico, and cold processing services like labeling and repacking. Their strategic location in Tepotzotlán, State of Mexico, and advanced technology ensure product continuity and safety.

name: Guangdong Bingchuan Refrigeration Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Bingchuan Refrigeration Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, development, manufacturing, and installation of refrigeration equipment and cold storage projects. They offer a range of products including integrated units, various compressor units, and cold room panels, serving industries that require precise temperature control for storage and processing. The company emphasizes technological innovation, environmental protection, and energy efficiency in its operations, aiming to provide high-quality solutions and comprehensive after-sales service.

name: Karal Industrial Cooling Systems
summary: Karal Industrial Cooling Systems, established in 1974, specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for the cooling sector. They offer a range of products including cold storage facilities, cold room doors and panels, refrigeration appliances, and PVC curtains. The company also provides technical service, repair, and maintenance for cooling systems, focusing on quality and customer satisfaction.

name: Frigoríficos Santander
summary: Frigoríficos Santander offers specialized services in the storage, logistics, and distribution of food and products requiring controlled temperatures. They provide comprehensive logistics and food safety solutions, catering to industries such as ice cream, concentrates, meat, pharmaceutical, restaurant, and bakery. Their mission is to care for client products as if they were their own, ensuring quality and integrity throughout the supply chain.

name: ProRef AS
summary: ProRef AS is a total supplier of refrigeration, freezing, and climate solutions, specializing in custom installations and comprehensive service. They offer a wide range of products including cold and freezer rooms, compact units, industrial cooling systems (CO2), automation, monitoring, dry coolers, and heat recovery. The company provides project consultation, installation, and 24-hour emergency service for various industrial and commercial clients.

name: Arctic Koel & Vries logistiek
summary: Arctic Koel & Vries logistiek specializes in the storage, packaging, and freezing of meat and frozen products. They offer over 60,000 m3 of storage capacity, utilize modern mobile racking systems for efficient pallet management, and are AEO certified with a customs permit. The company operates an environmentally friendly cooling and freezing system using ammonia-CO2.

name: Öz Soğutma
summary: Öz Soğutma specializes in designing, engineering, and implementing turnkey cold room and climate control solutions for the food, health, logistics, and manufacturing industries. With over 10 years of experience, they offer energy-efficient, durable industrial refrigeration systems and provide comprehensive services from initial consultation to installation and after-sales support. Their mission is to deliver reliable, long-lasting cooling solutions tailored to client needs.

name: Petit Forestier
summary: Petit Forestier is a European leader in refrigerated rental solutions, offering a wide range of refrigerated vehicles, cold rooms, and refrigerated display units. They cater to both professional clients for business needs and private individuals for events, providing flexible rental terms and comprehensive services. The company emphasizes its extensive network for rapid response and support, alongside a commitment to sustainable practices.

name: Adour Chambres Froides
summary: Adour Chambres Froides specializes in refrigerated storage solutions, offering rental and sales of mobile cold rooms, refrigerated trailers, and display units. Established in 2014 and expanding to the Midi-Pyrénées region in 2018, the company also provides ice delivery services for events. They cater to both individuals and professionals for various needs, from private parties to large festivals.

name: Iceline, INC.
summary: Iceline, INC. is a company with a long history, originating from the sale of natural ice and evolving to include mechanical ice production, refrigerated warehousing, and the sale of dry ice and frozen foods. They have also developed innovative products like 'Ice Cafe' for making iced coffee and supply ice for convenience store coffee. The company emphasizes contributing to society through its business, focusing on customer satisfaction and employee well-being.

name: 德扑之星 (Zhejiang Depuzhixing Integrated Co., Ltd.)
summary: 德扑之星 (Depuzhixing) is a company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and sales of refrigeration and cold chain equipment. Their product range includes commercial and household freezers, commercial kitchen and supermarket cold chain solutions, smart cold chain devices, cold storage units, and medical cold chain equipment. They serve various markets such as professional markets, hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, convenience stores, and healthcare facilities, offering customized solutions and cold chain transportation services.

name: Sumundi Inc.
summary: Sumundi Inc. is an enterprise software solutions provider that has been operating for six years. They specialize in developing cutting-edge software to increase business productivity and scalability, aiming to lead digital transformation. Their offerings include POS software (Sumundi Keepsales), hardware solutions for enterprises, and on-demand software development services through Sumundi Devshop.

summary: SAV Srl, operating under the brand Dicashnet, specializes in providing integrated technological solutions for the retail and franchising sectors. Their offerings include telematic cash registers, electronic scales, automatic cash drawers, and management software designed to streamline sales operations and enhance business efficiency. The company focuses on delivering customized systems and automation for points of sale, aiming to support the success of their clients in the dynamic retail market.

name: ООО «24ТТЛ»
summary: ООО «24ТТЛ» provides retail services and technological solutions for brands and retailers, aiming to automate routine tasks and enhance customer experience. Their offerings include automated rich content syndication, retail monitoring tools, AR-powered engagement, and shop-in-shop creation to boost sales and brand visibility. The company focuses on leveraging AI and advanced technologies to improve online merchandising and customer interaction across various e-commerce platforms.

name: ООО "КиК-софт"
summary: КиК-софт is a company specializing in the automation of retail trade and service industries, operating since 1998. Their mission is to provide effective solutions for businesses in various retail sectors, having served over 500 clients.

summary: Neto Baltic is a company specializing in digital retail transformation, offering services in retail security, checkout transformation, omnichannel enablement, and store digitization. The company serves leading retail chains, pharmacies, and logistics companies across the Baltic states.

Their platform automates manual tasks in inventory planning, buying, allocation, and replenishment by ingesting system data and enhancing it with external datasets. The goal is to help brands and retailers reduce overstocks, maximize margins, and meet demand with greater precision.

name: Mark Bric Sizers
summary: Mark Bric Sizers is a company that specializes in manufacturing and supplying high-quality clothing size identification markers, labels, and retail organization solutions. Their product range includes size marker solutions, size label stickers, garment rack dividers, and various accessories designed to enhance product visibility and streamline retail operations. The company aims to help brands, clothing stores, and retailers improve organization, save time, and ultimately increase sales.

name: iXtenso
summary: iXtenso is an online magazine focused on the retail industry, providing practical advice and innovative solutions for current and future challenges. It serves as an independent platform connecting technology, marketing, design, and logistics providers with users, while also emphasizing sustainability. The magazine aims to inspire retailers with expert opinions, success stories, and accessible knowledge on digital trends and everyday tips.

name: Nubistar B.V.
summary: Nubistar B.V. is a software development company specializing in quality software for the Retail, Cash and Carry, and Hospitality industries. They offer end-to-end project management, from design to implementation, for global clients. Their expertise includes payment integrations for point-of-sale systems and handheld scanner solutions for inventory and logistics, often in collaboration with partners like Retailstars B.V. and MCL-Technologies.

name: Pricefy by Selbetti
summary: Pricefy by Selbetti offers comprehensive omni-media price communication solutions for the physical retail sector. Their services include creating and printing promotional posters, automated price tags (printed and electronic), and managing promotional offers to enhance the in-store customer experience. They aim to revolutionize retail by improving operational efficiency, standardizing brand communication, increasing sales through attractive offers, and reducing price discrepancies.

name: refive
summary: refive provides a platform for brick-and-mortar retailers to capture in-store customer data through digital receipts and other smart touchpoints. It enables hyper-personalization, customer engagement, and retention by connecting online and offline customer identities. The company aims to help retailers increase purchase frequency and basket sizes by understanding customer behavior and delivering personalized interactions.

name: Vertiseit AB
summary: Vertiseit AB is a company specializing in digital in-store experience management, aiming to connect the retail world. They offer an intuitive platform and consulting expertise, partnering with companies like Dise, Grassfish, and Visual Art to shape world-leading digital in-store solutions. Vertiseit positions itself as the leading digital in-store platform company in Europe.

name: KY·开元(888中国)集团
summary: KY·开元(888中国)集团 is a technology company specializing in RFID and EAS solutions. They offer intelligent solutions for smart retail, smart loss prevention, RFID fixed asset management, and RFID automotive logistics. Their offerings include software and hardware systems designed to enhance operational efficiency, data visualization, and asset tracking for various industries.

name: NutriTap Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
summary: NutriTap is a technology-driven retail solutions company that operates India's largest network of unmanned smart retail kiosks. They provide automated inventory management, cashless payment systems, and a variety of vending solutions for corporate offices, transit zones, educational institutions, and residential societies. Their mission is to offer convenient access to everyday essentials through innovative IoT-enabled kiosks, aiming to save time and remove hassles for modern consumers and businesses.

name: Vendobots
summary: Vendobots reimagines the vending machine service for the 21st century, integrating modern technology with traditional vending. They offer dynamic vending experiences with real-time sales tracking and remote customer support. Their machines are designed to offer a diverse range of products relevant to their location, moving beyond typical snacks and drinks, and are strategically placed in high-traffic areas like shopping malls.

name: 合肥联拓富数字科技有限公司 (Hefei Liantuofu Digital Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Liantuofu Digital Technology provides digital solutions to connect private traffic with offline businesses, focusing on retail, catering, gas stations, beauty, and commercial areas. Their offerings include payment products, private domain membership tools, and a business middle platform for chain enterprises. They aim to help businesses better manage their stores and customers through digital technology, serving a large user base and numerous merchants and stores across China.

name: Marketplace Performance Cloud
summary: Marketplace Performance Cloud (MPC) provides digital technology, data, and e-commerce solutions for shopping centers and brands worldwide. They focus on evolving shopping experiences beyond just foot traffic by integrating digital technology, AI, and engagement strategies. MPC aims to increase sales and drive revenue for retail real estate by connecting physical and online shopping, enhancing tenant partnerships, and creating tailored shopper experiences.

name: Inwave
summary: Inwave develops connected solutions for analytical and efficient retail management, focusing on research and development of new technologies. Their offerings include platforms for process monitoring, anti-theft systems, video surveillance, RFID, and video analytics, aimed at reducing losses, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing the customer shopping experience. The company positions itself as a technological leader in providing intelligence for the retail sector.

name: yayloh
summary: Yayloh is a technology company that provides an automated returns management platform specifically designed for fashion brands. Their solution aims to improve customer experience, reduce manual workload for customer service teams, and increase revenue by optimizing the returns process. The platform offers features like automated workflows, exchanges, store credits, and analytics to help brands manage returns efficiently and gain insights into customer behavior.

name: InVue Security Products
summary: InVue Security Products provides innovative solutions for retail asset protection, access control, and point-of-sale systems. Their product portfolio includes merchandise display security, smart locks, and POS peripherals designed to reduce theft, increase sales, and enhance customer experiences. They serve a wide range of industries, including retail, mobile carriers, and banking, with a focus on creating secure yet frictionless in-store environments.

name: EasyFill AB
summary: EasyFill AB is a Swedish company specializing in innovative retail shelving solutions, including TurnLoader™ and RotoShelf®. Their systems are designed to optimize store efficiency by ensuring first-in, first-out product rotation, reducing waste, and improving product visibility to boost sales. The company focuses on providing sustainable and cost-efficient solutions for retailers, aiming for a fast return on investment.

name: Darsh InfoTech
summary: Darsh InfoTech is a consulting and IT services organization with over 40 years of experience specializing in the retail sector. They provide technology solutions, including POS, ERP, and CRM systems, to help businesses improve efficiency and profitability. The company focuses on custom software development, implementation, and support, aiming to be a strategic partner for both enterprise customers and SMBs.

name: SmarTI Inovações Tecnológicas
summary: SmarTI Inovações Tecnológicas is a technology company specializing in management software for service and retail businesses. They offer practical, secure, and essential management tools, including solutions for fiscal compliance like NF-e, SAT Fiscal, NFC-e, and MFE. Their mission is to provide entrepreneurs and accountants with a comprehensive set of resources aligned with government regulations, enhancing business efficiency and competitiveness.

name: ООО "Ретвик"
summary: ООО "Ретвик" is a company specializing in the supply and repair of retail equipment and automation solutions in Voskresensk and the Moscow region. They offer sales of cash registers, warranty and post-warranty repair, registration services, and staff consultations. As an official partner of 1C, ATOL, and SHTRIKH-M, they provide software automation for retail, cafes, restaurants, and pharmacies, including integration with 1C and EGAIS.

name: Vertiseit AB

Vertiseit positions itself as the leading digital in-store platform company in Europe.

They offer a comprehensive "visualization + refined management" platform connecting e-commerce, retail stores, cloud storage, and ERP systems. Their services include remote video store inspection, video traceability, customer traffic analysis, dress recognition, advertisement distribution, and smart security, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience for retail chains.

name: ARMA IT-Consult GmbH & Co. KG
summary: ARMA IT-Consult GmbH & Co. KG operates an online shop selling IT hardware and software, including point-of-sale systems, cash register software, and signature pads. The company also provides IT consulting services, as indicated by its name and the nature of its product offerings. It appears to cater to businesses looking for integrated solutions for sales and customer interaction.

name: RIOT Insight, Inc.
summary: RIOT Insight provides RFID software solutions specifically for fashion retailers, aiming to transform in-store inventory management. Their platform offers real-time inventory control and visibility, enabling retailers to track sales and reduce manual labor. The company emphasizes radical value, tailored solutions, and deep expertise, positioning itself as a disruptive force in the fashion retail RFID market.

name: 北京星创云科技有限公司 (Beijing Xingchuangyun Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Beijing Xingchuangyun Technology Co., Ltd., operating as 百胜软件 (Baisheng Software), is a service provider specializing in digital retail solutions. They offer comprehensive software products and implementation services, including omnichannel platforms, ERP management, CRM, warehousing, BI analytics, and online ordering systems. Their mission is to empower businesses with IT core competitiveness through professional consulting and innovative solutions, aiming for mutual development with clients.

name: Status Plan
summary: Status Plan is a technology company specializing in custom software solutions for the retail and real estate industries. They offer web-based applications designed to streamline leasing, tenant delivery, and property management processes. Their products, such as Status Plan, DDCM, and spark MIS, aim to improve collaboration, accuracy, and efficiency from initial concept to grand opening.

name: QVS Software
summary: QVS Software provides technology solutions and software development services, specializing in retail technology such as self-checkout, mobile POS, and smart carts. They also offer solutions for other industries including operating systems, databases, and wireless technology. With 30 years of experience, QVS aims to solve complex technical challenges that others cannot.

name: Торговый Дом

They also provide maintenance for cash registers and are involved in system integration for product traceability, such as with 'Chestny ZNAK'. The company focuses on providing comprehensive solutions for trade automation.

name: MEEC Società Cooperativa
summary: MEEC Società Cooperativa specializes in providing specific software solutions for retail stores, including computer systems and cash registers. As a work cooperative, they focus on delivering high-quality, reliable technology solutions to their clients without prioritizing profit maximization.

summary: Sumber In Store Sales provides solutions to increase conversion and turnover in physical stores. Their systems are designed to optimize store efficiency by ensuring first-in, first-out product rotation, reducing waste, and improving product visibility to boost sales. name: Smart Supply
summary: Smart Supply is a Norwegian company that provides comprehensive solutions for retail and warehouse operations. Their services encompass needs analysis, concept development, design, and total delivery, aiming to optimize customer flow and operational efficiency for businesses.

name: 潍坊知码网络科技有限公司
summary: 潍坊知码网络科技有限公司 specializes in developing and operating new retail mini-programs and e-commerce solutions. summary: Hunan Simpro Information Technology Co., LTD., operating as EVO视讯EVO, is a high-tech company specializing in the development and integration of commercial management application software. summary: ООО "Аспект АТ" specializes in the comprehensive automation of retail businesses, offering a range of equipment and software solutions. summary: Retevo is a company that specializes in retail merchandising execution, combining technology with expert services to optimize retail operations and maximize ROI for CPG suppliers. summary: Nexgen AG is a Swiss company specializing in IT retail solutions and services, offering a comprehensive range of products and support for the trade sector. Their mission is to equip shops with ideal IT solutions and offer extensive support, aiming for customer satisfaction and continuous value generation.
