summary: AgroVision develops and provides next-generation agricultural software solutions designed to enhance efficiency and responsibility in farming. Their product suite includes specialized software for pigs, cows, crops, finance, and feed formulation, aiming to empower farmers and agribusinesses with data-driven insights for smarter decision-making. The company emphasizes innovation, customer focus, and future-proofing agricultural practices.

name: Food Home Direct
summary: Food Home Direct is a company that is temporarily pausing operations to focus on building local agriculture partnerships. Their goal is to create more affordable local food options and improve their operational efficiency to enhance customer experience. The company aims to streamline its processes and strengthen its supply chain by working closely with local farmers.

name: New Life Farm
summary: New Life Farm is a regenerative farm located in Sapphire Beach, Australia, that grows 100% organically grown, chemical-free produce. They operate on permaculture principles and holistic management practices, incorporating elements of biological farming and Korean Natural Farming. The farm sells its fresh seasonal produce directly to consumers through an online store and also offers consultancy and training services. Their mission is to work with nature to create sustainable food systems and inspire a connection between people, food, and the environment.

name: Lantmännen
summary: Lantmännen is a Northern European agricultural cooperative and a leading player in agriculture, machinery, bioenergy, and food. The company offers a wide range of products and services for competitive farming, including machinery import and sales, bioenergy production, and the development and marketing of food products. They operate from farm to table, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and supporting a vital agricultural sector.

name: Corvus Group GmbH
summary: Corvus Group GmbH operates under brands like Schloss Beuchow, Landware, and Neue Gärtnerei, focusing on sustainable agriculture and innovative cultivation methods. They aim to create a foundation for a sustainable future by promoting conscious living, eating, and shopping through their offerings. The company emphasizes preserving old values while developing new, eco-friendly farming techniques.

name: Grupo Adubos Real
summary: Grupo Adubos Real is a Brazilian company dedicated to enhancing agricultural productivity through a wide range of products and services. They offer fertilizers, special fertilizers, essential fertilizers, fertigation solutions, adjuvants, bioactivators, seeds, and crop protection products. With a mission to contribute to the sustainable development of agribusiness and client success, they operate 90 stores and 5 industrial units across Brazil, serving over 50,000 clients annually.

name: DE SANGOSSE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD
summary: DE SANGOSSE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD is a company specializing in sustainable agricultural innovations, offering a range of plant nutrition products, biofertilizers, rodent control solutions, and organic certified products. They focus on developing solutions for the agriculture of tomorrow, including precision technologies and seed treatments. The company also participates in recycling programs like drumMUSTER, demonstrating a commitment to environmental responsibility.

name: JB APec
summary: JB APec is an agricultural and livestock company primarily engaged in the production of grains, soybeans, and corn, as well as raising beef cattle. They focus on sustainable practices, including integrated crop-livestock systems and direct planting for agriculture, and creep feeding for cattle. The company is committed to environmental respect and operates in Rio Brilhante, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil.

name: Alqudsi Agri Group
summary: Alqudsi Agri Group is an agricultural company established in 2014, specializing in high-quality halal red meat products. They focus on sustainably sourced and environmentally friendly solutions, from paddock to plate. The company works with livestock producers to improve yields and promote sustainable agriculture, aiming to contribute to global food security while maintaining product integrity and animal welfare.

name: ACE Ohlsson Pty Ltd
summary: Ace Ohlsson is a dedicated agricultural supplier providing a comprehensive range of products and services to support agribusiness from seed to market. They offer seed supplies, rural supplies, horticulture support, animal health products, and fertilizer solutions. With a team of experienced agronomists, they aim to help growers achieve efficient and sustainable production.

name: NuWay-K&H Cooperative
summary: NuWay-K&H Cooperative is a diversified agricultural cooperative operating in Minnesota and Iowa, providing a range of products and services including seed, fuel, precision agriculture technology, and agronomy services. Their mission is to deliver exceptional value through knowledge and innovation, acting as a trusted advisor to help farmers improve efficiency, manage risks, and increase profitability. They emphasize a cooperative model where mutual success is prioritized.

name: Hof Schürmann
summary: Hof Schürmann is a family-run agricultural farm located in Hamm, Germany, that has transitioned from traditional to modern farming practices. The farm cultivates approximately 155 hectares, focusing on producing high-quality meat (pork) and field crops. They also engage in renewable energy production through photovoltaics and aim to promote public understanding of agriculture. The farm has a long history, dating back to 1780, and is committed to regional and sustainable production.

name: AGROCONSULTE
summary: AGROCONSULTE is a company specializing in the commercialization of agricultural products, offering a comprehensive portfolio including pesticides, fertilizers, seeds, irrigation systems, and tools. Their mission is to provide complete solutions for agricultural products and services, contributing to the development of both rural and urban areas. They aim to be a recognized reference in agricultural products, emphasizing trust, innovation, and customer commitment.

name: Dawson Farms
summary: Dawson Farms is an agricultural business focused on providing high-quality and sustainable products. They emphasize ethical and responsible farming practices that benefit the environment and community. The company is involved in farming operations, including harvest, and also mentions land and cattle operations.

name: Pinehold Gardens
summary: Pinehold Gardens is a farm that previously operated under a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) model and sold produce directly to consumers and restaurants. After 27 years, they have transitioned to focusing on land stewardship, planting cover crops, trees, and beneficial habitats for wildlife. They continue to sell to a few long-time restaurant accounts and are expanding their insect habitat through a contract with US Fish and Wildlife.

name: Carpus Cultura Agriculture
summary: Carpus Cultura Agriculture, established in November 2018, provides high-value products and services to agricultural producers in Greece. The company offers integrated solutions for modern production processes, from soil analysis to harvest and sales, focusing on contract farming for hazelnuts. They aim to build mutually beneficial relationships with producers, ensuring market access and stable pricing.

name: Zarpellon Agricoltura s.r.l.
summary: Zarpellon Agricoltura s.r.l. is an Italian company established in 2005 that provides specialized solutions and services for agriculture, particularly focusing on viticulture. They offer a range of products including fertilizers, foliar nutrients, and phytostimulants, alongside services such as business consulting, organic farming support, and training for agricultural certifications. Their mission is to support farmers in cultivating the future through passion and expertise.

name: Agrargenossenschaft Grünlichtenberg e.G.
summary: Agrargenossenschaft Grünlichtenberg e.G. is an agricultural cooperative located in the Zschopautal valley in Saxony, Germany. Founded in 1990, it operates on 3,297 hectares, focusing on crop farming (grains, rapeseed, potatoes) and dairy production with its own young cattle breeding. The cooperative also offers contract farming services from sowing to harvest and emphasizes sustainable land and resource management. It employs 65 staff and apprentices and has expanded into energy production through subsidiaries.

name: Agromoliceiro
summary: Agromoliceiro is a leading company in Portugal, established in 1995, specializing in the distribution of agricultural products and providing technical support. They offer a wide range of products including phytopharmaceutical products, fertilizers, seeds, and plants, with a strong commitment to sustainable agriculture, integrated production, and organic farming. The company emphasizes professionalism, customer support, and environmental responsibility, including safe recycling of packaging.

name: PANNON Ipari-Mezőgazdasági Szolgáltató és Kereskedelmi Kft
summary: PANNON Ipari-Mezőgazdasági Szolgáltató és Kereskedelmi Kft is a family-owned company established in 1991, operating in the agricultural sector. The company specializes in arable farming, animal husbandry (specifically cattle), and provides related services and trade. They emphasize modern, sustainable, and environmentally friendly technologies, including precision farming, and hold an ISCC certification, positioning them in the international market.

name: Quaker Lane Enterprises
summary: Quaker Lane Enterprises (QLE) is a seed and technology company operating in North Central and Central Illinois. They specialize in providing seeds and production agriculture expertise, with representatives who are also farmers. QLE aims to offer solutions that are best suited for individual farms, leveraging their deep experience in both the seed business and farming.

name: Khubaa Group
summary: Khubaa Group is a diversified family business with a long history, originally founded as a trading house. It has expanded into manufacturing catalysts, mineral-based agricultural products, and water-saving solutions. The group also has significant real estate development interests and a commitment to philanthropy and community service, aiming to build a sustainable future through innovative and eco-friendly practices.

name: Società Agricola Lanzi s.s.
summary: Società Agricola Lanzi is a certified organic farm specializing in the sustainable breeding of Limousine cattle. They raise their cattle on mountain pastures, using forage and organic cereals grown on their own land. The company offers family-sized meat packages and breeding cattle, emphasizing their commitment to quality and sustainable agricultural practices.

name: 义田农场 (Yitian Farm)
summary: Yitian Farm operates as a wholesale membership procurement and trading service platform for organic and ecological farms. It aims to connect consumers and suppliers through its Yitian Community platform, fostering a symbiotic and sustainable ecosystem. The company also offers internet supply chain center services through Yitian Supply Chain, enhancing operational efficiency and reducing costs for merchants by integrating online and offline professional markets.

name: Agroinsider
summary: Agroinsider is a company focused on environmental and agricultural sustainability, specializing in the carbon market. They leverage satellite data to monitor forests and crops, helping companies improve efficiency and reduce their environmental footprint. Their services include quantifying carbon emissions on farms, providing consulting on best practices for carbon sequestration, and facilitating the buying and selling of carbon credits.

name: Ormiston Farms
summary: Ormiston Farms is a fourth-generation, family-operated farm established in 1906 in Kismet, Kansas. Spanning thousands of acres, the farm cultivates alfalfa, corn, soybeans, and wheat, and also raises cattle. They utilize advanced machinery and precision agriculture technology to maximize efficiency and minimize environmental impact, focusing on sustainable practices to preserve land and water resources for future generations.

name: Armston Farm (J.L Ashby & Co.)
summary: Armston Farm, operated by J.L Ashby & Co. Ltd and R. J. Ashby & Partners, is a family-run agricultural business established in 1910. They specialize in sustainable farming practices, producing crops and livestock including asparagus and deer. The farm also participates in agricultural research through NIAB trials and adheres to environmental standards like the LEAF Marque Scheme.

name: Euro Greens
summary: Euro Greens is an organization focused on promoting sustainable agriculture and food systems. They recently acquired Efoodprint.com to enhance their expertise in environmental impact assessment and optimizing food production processes. Their mission is to support sustainable practices within the agricultural sector.

name: 친환경 서부농약사
summary: Seobu Nongyaksa is an online retailer specializing in eco-friendly agricultural supplies, including pesticides, fertilizers, seeds, and other farming materials. They offer a wide range of products categorized by crop type and function, catering to both individual farmers and larger institutions like schools and corporations. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly solutions for pest control, soil improvement, and plant nutrition.

name: KR Agrícola e Pecuária
summary: KR Agrícola e Pecuária, founded in 2010, offers a new concept in service for farmers and ranchers by providing high-quality agricultural products and logistical support. They focus on delivering positive results without environmental degradation, offering a range of fertilizers, soil conditioners, and seeds. The company also emphasizes efficient transportation and logistics to ensure customer satisfaction.

name: Brett Brothers Ltd.
summary: Brett Brothers Ltd. is a family-owned company established in 1940, dedicated to supplying essential agricultural inputs to farmers. They offer a range of products including animal feeds, fertilizers, seeds, crop protection chemicals, and hardware goods, alongside agronomy and animal nutrition services. The company emphasizes innovation, quality assurance, and sustainable farming practices to enhance livestock performance and farm profitability.

name: Vel Organics / Vela Biotech
summary: Vel Organics, marketed by Vela Biotech, is dedicated to reviving traditional agriculture through modern science by providing NABL-tested organic fertilizers and farmer-centric solutions. Their mission is to restore soil fertility, reduce chemical dependency, and empower farmers with sustainable practices and AI-powered advisory tools. They offer products like Fermented Organic Manure (FOM) and Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) to improve crop yield and soil health.

name: Free Mulch Inc.
summary: Free Mulch Inc. is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability and supporting local farmers. They provide micro grants for educational experiences, community outreach, farm tours, and incubator projects. The organization also welcomes volunteers and donations to further its mission of sustainable land management and local food systems.

name: Caloona
summary: Caloona presents itself as a provider of "Farming Solutions for Tomorrow." The website offers a contact form for inquiries and a signup for updates, indicating a focus on agricultural technology or services. Its primary goal appears to be engaging potential clients and partners interested in modern farming approaches.

name: 上籾みろく農場協議会 (Kamimomi Miroku Farm Council)
summary: The Kamimomi Miroku Farm Council is a community-driven organization focused on sustainable agriculture, particularly the restoration of the Kamimomi rice terraces. They promote natural farming methods, offer experiential programs in farming and wellness (like meditation and yoga), and develop local specialty products. The council also engages in educational activities, including human resource training and workshops, aiming to revitalize the local community and promote environmental conservation.

name: TEZA
summary: TEZA provides sustainable, efficient, and effective solutions for agricultural production, backed by over 20 years of experience. They offer a range of products including fertilizers, geomembranes, irrigation systems, and bio-technological inputs, alongside specialized technical advisory services and greenhouse construction. Their mission is to empower producers to grow cleanly and healthily while caring for the environment.

name: Southern Valley
summary: Southern Valley is a family-owned and operated company that has been in the farming industry for 37 years. They specialize in growing, packing, and shipping a variety of produce year-round from their farms in Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, and Yucatan. The company emphasizes sustainable farming practices, food safety, and high-quality produce, serving customers across the United States and Canada.

name: Riddhi Soilcare
summary: Riddhi Soilcare is a Gujarat, India-based company established in 2019 that manufactures and supplies a wide range of organic agriculture inputs nationwide. Their mission is to promote a new way of farming for chemical-free organic food production and sustainable farming models. They aim to consistently produce effective, high-quality, and environmentally friendly organic inputs while raising awareness about their usage for soil improvement and natural farming.

name: Consorzio Agrario delle province del Nord Ovest soc.coop.
summary: Consorzio Agrario delle province del Nord Ovest (CAP Nord Ovest) is a cooperative agricultural consortium that serves as a reference point for the agricultural sector in Northern Italy. They offer a wide range of products and services, including agricultural supplies, seeds, fertilizers, animal feed, machinery, and precision farming solutions. Their mission is to drive innovation and progress in agricultural production while safeguarding the environment and supporting entrepreneurial spirit.

name: Natuurlijk Klein Dongen
summary: Natuurlijk Klein Dongen is a family-run business that combines organic farming with retail, event hosting, and educational activities. They cultivate tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers in greenhouses, alongside a vegetable garden and a food forest, selling their produce in their own organic shop. The company also offers workshops and tours to share their knowledge of sustainable agriculture and provides spaces for events and team building.

name: Heart2Heart Farms
summary: Heart2Heart Farms promotes a natural, heritage, and sustainable lifestyle, aiming to provide access to pure, nutritious food for everyone, regardless of income. They offer a variety of farm products including meat, vegetables, eggs, dairy, and livestock, alongside services like consultations, classes, and livestock hauling. The farm also emphasizes upcycling, sustainability, and community involvement through volunteer programs and educational initiatives.

name: Famsun Co., Ltd.
summary: Famsun Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of solutions for the agriculture and animal husbandry industries, aiming to create a better life through its offerings. The company provides integrated solutions, products, and services, supported by a global marketing network. With a mission focused on sustainability and creating a habitable planet for all species, Famsun leverages its extensive global resources to serve customers worldwide.

name: Häcklehagens Gård
summary: Häcklehagens Gård is an organic farm operating in its 8th generation, specializing in livestock and crop production. They raise cattle and sheep, with a focus on lamb meat boxes sold directly to consumers. The farm also cultivates grains and manages forest land, emphasizing sustainable and ecological farming practices.

name: La Ferme des Petits Pas
summary: La Ferme des Petits Pas is a farm focused on organic agriculture and donkey farming, as indicated by 'Agriculture pays'âne et biologique'. It offers products and services through an AMAP (Association for the Maintenance of Organic Agriculture) and shares farm news and cultural practices on its blog. The farm emphasizes natural expression of plant species and aims to connect with its community.

name: Trindade Fertilizantes
summary: Trindade Fertilizantes is a company focused on the agricultural sector, providing solutions for rural producers. They specialize in the trade of agricultural pesticides, fertilizers, and seeds, alongside offering technical assistance, application quality assessment, and development support for large plantations. Their mission is to enhance productivity and sustainability in agribusiness by generating value for the agricultural community.

name: Jasanka s.r.o.
summary: Jasanka s.r.o. is a family-owned company with over 30 years of experience in agriculture, specializing in crop and livestock production. They offer seasonal agricultural products like potatoes and corn, operate a biopower plant utilizing biological waste for sustainable energy, and manage livestock including dairy cows, heifers, bulls, and calves. Additionally, the company provides hospitality services, hosting events and offering rental spaces and accommodation.

name: The Edible Group
summary: The Edible Group is a Houston-based collective of small businesses focused on developing and nourishing healthy communities. Through its subsidiaries, Agmenity and Meristem, it offers agricultural amenities, consulting, design, installation, and management services, alongside holistic land planning and people-centered community development that integrates with natural environments. The group aims to explore and implement sustainable practices for community well-being.

name: Envitecpolis Oy
summary: Envitecpolis Oy provides sustainability management and consulting services, focusing on the food chain. They offer expertise in biogas and solar energy solutions for farms, environmental accounting, and corporate responsibility reporting. Additionally, they develop and market the EnvitecVisio software platform for environmental and financial calculations, aiming to help businesses improve their sustainability performance.

name: Multifarm Kereskedelmi és Szolgáltató Kft.
summary: Multifarm Kereskedelmi és Szolgáltató Kft. is a Hungarian company focused on providing services and products for the agricultural sector. Their motto, 'Idea. Plan. Profit.', highlights their approach of developing ideas into thorough plans to ensure profitability, emphasizing the value of time and money in agriculture. They offer solutions such as PRRS filtering, automated bedding robots, and odor control systems, alongside solar energy options.

name: Olitys
summary: Olitys is a company specializing in natural solutions for sustainable livestock farming. They offer comprehensive diagnostics, personalized support, and tailor-made natural products to optimize animal health, soil quality, and ecosystem vitality. Their mission is to help farmers achieve profitable, long-term, and serene agricultural activities by promoting a global, innovative approach to livestock management.

name: Riverdale Grain Farms
summary: Riverdale Grain Farms is a privately held, family-owned seed and grain company established in 1988. They specialize in producing nutritionally superior crops using biologically based farming practices, minimizing harsh pesticides and ensuring glyphosate-free products. The company operates through distinct sectors including family farming, seed/grain production, and a drying/shipping/storage facility, with a mission to provide sustainable, high-quality grains and oilseeds.

name: Power Z Agriculture Solutions
summary: Power Z Agriculture Solutions, a division of Genesis Water Technologies, Inc., specializes in developing and supplying sustainable, bio-organic soil conditioning media and liquid spray growth enhancement solutions. Their products, Power-Z Soil Conditioner and Power-Z Grow Spray, aim to conserve water, increase plant yields, and reduce soil nutrient eutrophication for conventional and organic farmers, growers, and landscapers globally. The company focuses on innovative and environmentally friendly agricultural inputs.

name: 株式会社 海水化学研究所
summary: 海水化学研究所 (Sea Water Chemical Institute) is a company that develops and sells organic enzyme activators for agriculture, primarily their product 'CORE'. This product enhances crop yield, taste, and nutritional value while reducing fertilizer needs and nitrates. Their mission is to contribute to society by developing safe, functional, and environmentally friendly products using advanced technology.

name: Agmenity
summary: Agmenity specializes in making agricultural amenities accessible and manageable for various clients, including developers, HOAs, and private owners. They offer comprehensive services ranging from initial consulting and feasibility studies to design, installation, and ongoing farm management. Their mission is to integrate functional and community-building agricultural elements into residential and commercial developments, enhancing well-being through education and access to fresh food.

name: Novag SAS
summary: Novag SAS is a company focused on developing and supplying sustainable hybrid chemical solutions for modern agriculture. They offer a range of products including bioherbicides, bactericides, fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, and agricultural regulators. The company aims to help the agricultural sector meet new regulatory challenges, such as Maximum Residue Limits and the European Green Deal, by promoting sustainable and regenerative farming practices.

name: Agrobarcellos
summary: Agrobarcellos is a family-owned company operating in the agricultural sector, with diversified activities including beef cattle farming (full cycle), dairy farming, and the production of soybeans and corn. The company emphasizes sustainable practices, technological integration, and a commitment to leaving a positive environmental and social legacy. Their operations are based in Sidrolândia and the Pantanal region of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil.

name: Зеленые инсайты
summary: Зеленые инсайты (Green Insights) is an information resource focused on advanced technologies and sustainable practices in agriculture and construction. The website publishes articles on topics such as metal roofing benefits, herbicide resistance in weeds, drone technology for herbicide application, and the impact of herbicides on soil microflora. It aims to provide insights into sustainable agro-technical solutions and construction materials.

name: ACE Ohlsson Pty Ltd
summary: ACE Ohlsson is a trusted agricultural supplier providing a comprehensive range of products and services to support agribusiness from seed to market. They offer animal health products, rural supplies, fertilizers, seeds, and horticultural support, backed by a dedicated team of sale agronomists. Located within Sydney Markets and with local branches, they aim to help growers of all sizes succeed through efficient and sustainable production.

name: Fattoria Le Prata Società Agricola s.r.l.
summary: Fattoria Le Prata is an agricultural company focused on producing fresh, organic, and local produce. They emphasize a 'farm to fork' philosophy, promoting short supply chains and sustainability. The company also operates a bottega (shop) and a ristoro (eatery) in Pisa, offering their own products and a convivial dining experience.

name: 南京蒲公英农业科技有限公司
summary: Nanjing Dandelion Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. is an agricultural solutions provider offering integrated services across the entire industry chain. They focus on advancing smart, refined, and branded agriculture, aiming to enhance the professional skills and knowledge of agricultural practitioners and benefit farmers. The company provides services in smart agriculture, leisure agriculture, brand agriculture, and shared agriculture, leveraging an experienced technical and customer service team.

name: Agroavicola Italia
summary: Agroavicola Italia is an agricultural company focused on producing food alternatives for the livestock and agricultural sectors. They aim to offer products meeting global quality standards, catering to client, market, community, and environmental needs with a motivated and qualified team. Their vision is to be recognized nationally and internationally for leadership in production, quality, research, and development of new technologies, ensuring customer and collaborator satisfaction while preserving the environment.

name: Nufarm Polska
summary: Nufarm Polska is the Polish branch of Nufarm, a global agricultural company specializing in crop protection and seed technologies. They offer a wide range of products including fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, growth regulators, seed treatments, biological products, and foliar fertilizers. The company aims to support farmers in achieving efficient and sustainable agriculture, providing solutions tailored to specific crop needs and challenges.

name: Agroineco
summary: Agroineco is a dynamic company specializing in the marketing and distribution of agricultural products and sustainable solutions. They offer a range of products and systems, including those for water treatment, with a focus on natural active ingredients and zero-residue practices. The company aims to improve the profitability of its clients through sustainable agriculture, personalized treatments, and technical advice, serving various crop types and green spaces.

name: Emmett Ridge Farm
summary: Emmett Ridge Farm is a family-run farm dedicated to creating a sustainable local food system by directly connecting consumers with their food. They offer subscription-based meat packages, emphasizing farm-to-table quality and transparency in food production. Their mission is to change how food is produced, purchased, and valued within their community.

name: Landhandel Perseis
summary: Landhandel Perseis is a retail business offering a wide range of agricultural supplies, animal feed, food products, and workwear. They specialize in products for sustainable farming and provide a delivery service with their own fleet. The company serves farmers, authorities, and private individuals, emphasizing quality products and customer service.

name: Daniaud LCS
summary: Daniaud LCS is an expert partner in agricultural trade, offering a range of carefully selected products designed for maximum performance while preserving land quality. They focus on providing advanced technological solutions to meet new quality, economic, and ecological demands. The company also offers flexible payment options and personalized terms for professional clients.

name: REAVIA, a.s. and ROKOVIA, s.r.o.
summary: REAVIA and ROKOVIA specialize in advanced solutions for organic agriculture and renewable energy, leveraging over two decades of expertise in producing organic fertilizers from natural by-products. Their proprietary technologies, protected by international patents, are marketed under brands like ROKOHUMIN. The companies focus on global expansion, developing new eco-friendly agricultural technologies, and establishing joint ventures worldwide to promote sustainable food production and economic growth.

name: Strobl Landwirtschaft
summary: Strobl Landwirtschaft is a family-run agricultural operation based in Cadolzburg, Middle Franconia. They practice sustainable farming on approximately 100 hectares, cultivating crops such as sugar beets, soy, wheat, and corn. The farm also includes free-range pig farming, a small herd of Pinzgau cows, and sustainable forestry with direct sales of firewood. Additionally, they offer services like contract sowing and trailer rental.

name: NEA biotek
summary: NEA biotek is a company that imports and distributes Acela Biotek's microbial product, LALITHA 21®, in Europe. This product is an organic soil amendment designed to create a superior soil environment using a proprietary mixture of naturally occurring microorganisms. Its goal is to promote sustainable agriculture by increasing crop yields, reducing water and chemical fertilizer usage, and revitalizing soil health without negative environmental impacts.

name: SC Soufflet Agro Romania SRL
summary: Soufflet Agro Romania is a company specializing in agricultural products and services. They offer certified seeds, crop protection solutions, agromonic advising, silo services, and grain trading. The company aims to support farmers through innovation and sustainable agriculture practices, as evidenced by their SOILTEQ project.

name: Edd Colbert Agroforestry
summary: Edd Colbert's website focuses on promoting agroforestry, a system that integrates trees with crops and/or livestock. The site offers information on what agroforestry is, showcases a design portfolio, provides training services, and features 'The Agroforestry Show' and a blog. The core message emphasizes the immediate need and benefits of adopting agroforestry practices.

name: AGRIRED SOCIETÀ AGRICOLA INNOVATIVA SRL
summary: AGRIRED Società Agricola Innovativa SRL is an innovative agricultural company based in Tarquinia, Italy. The company focuses on agricultural activities, likely leveraging innovative practices or technologies within the sector. Its core business revolves around farming and related agricultural services.

name: Valett Grow Agro
summary: Valett Grow Agro is an agricultural solutions company with over 10 years of experience, specializing in high-quality fertilizers and crop enhancement products. They offer a range of microgranulated and liquid specialty products designed to boost crop productivity, improve soil structure, and enhance fruit quality. The company is committed to making a difference in Brazilian agribusiness through innovative solutions and expert technical support.

name: Familie Müller-Zumbühl (Kernmatt)
summary: Familie Müller-Zumbühl operates the Kernmatt farm in Kägiswil, Switzerland, focusing on sustainable agriculture and direct-to-consumer sales. They produce and market Natura-Beef, free-range eggs, laying hens, and cut flowers, alongside operating a farm shop and offering educational programs. The farm emphasizes environmental protection through investments in solar energy, efficient heating, and reduced plastic waste, aiming for resource conservation and reduced fossil fuel dependency.

name: AJ Products
summary: AJ Products is an Australian company that provides organic farming solutions for both plants and animals, aiming to improve profitability and sustainability for farmers. They offer a range of products including natural weed killers, seaweed and fish fertilizers, soil inoculants, and animal supplements, all designed to work with nature rather than against it. The company emphasizes the effectiveness of its organic solutions through testimonials and data, highlighting their role in addressing challenges like pest resistance, soil degradation, and chemical exposure.

name: SFA (Sustainable Farming Association)
summary: SFA is an organization dedicated to transforming agriculture through soil health. They provide consulting, technical assistance, and educational/networking opportunities to farmers and landowners in areas like grazing, dairy, cropping, silvopasture, and fruit/vegetable production. Their mission is to promote agricultural community and prosperity by focusing on soil health principles such as keeping soil covered, limiting disturbance, building diversity, maintaining living roots, and integrating livestock.

name: Magasin du Cultivateur
summary: Magasin du Cultivateur is a company with over 40 years of experience providing agricultural supplies including fertilizers, seeds, grains, animal feed, and supplements. They serve farmers and rural families with a focus on quality, sustainability, and personalized service. The company also offers delivery services and caters to animal nutrition, large crop solutions, and urban agriculture needs.

name: Gooch Family Farm
summary: Gooch Family Farm is a family-run agricultural business with a heritage in sustainable farming practices. They operate a farmers market store on their farm, offering livestock farm sales and other farm products. The farm emphasizes building relationships and preserving its legacy while innovating for the future.

name: International Biological & Ecological Solutions (IBES)
summary: International Biological & Ecological Solutions (IBES) is committed to modern and responsible agriculture, offering a range of biological and ecological products. Their offerings include biostimulants, nutrition products, fortifiers, correctors, and organic amendments designed to enhance crop health and yield. IBES also provides related services and actively engages in industry events to promote innovative agricultural solutions.

name: El Puma Agrosoluciones-Pharmacia agrícola
summary: El Puma Agrosoluciones-Pharmacia agrícola is an agricultural solutions provider with over 30 years of experience in Mexico. They focus on producing quality food by recommending chemical, organic, and biological products to enhance crop health and yield. Their services include crop protection, nutrition, pest and disease management, seed supply, equipment, and logistics, aiming for prosperity in the agricultural sector.

name: Promar
summary: Promar is a leading provider of consulting and data solutions for the agri-food supply chain, offering services in farm business, sustainability, and data analysis. They assist farmers and food businesses in maximizing profits, achieving net-zero targets, and improving operational efficiency. With over 60 years of experience and operations in the UK and Germany, Promar partners with over 3,000 farm and food businesses annually to foster growth and sustainability.

name: AdonaiAgro (formerly Adonai Fertilizantes)
summary: AdonaiAgro is a global agricultural company with 12 years of experience, operating in all Brazilian states and internationally in the US, Bolivia, Paraguay, Argentina, and Canada. They specialize in developing innovative, high-quality agricultural solutions and products tailored to individual producer needs, aiming to maximize productivity and promote sustainable growth in the agribusiness sector. The company focuses on commitment, quality, and technology to drive success in agriculture.

name: Biolandhof Mammoißel
summary: Biolandhof Mammoißel is a farm that has been cultivating vegetables according to Bioland guidelines for over 30 years. They focus on sustainable practices, preserving biodiversity, and avoiding artificial fertilizers and pesticides. In addition to vegetable farming, they raise dairy sheep, bake whole grain bread in a wood-fired oven, and produce juices from their own apple orchards, offering harvest shares to the local community.

name: Lakey Farm
summary: Lakey Farm is a regenerative farm located in Sunbury, Victoria, that focuses on producing high-quality meat, wine, and tallow products. They implement sustainable farming practices such as rotational mixed grazing, cover cropping, and native tree revegetation to improve soil carbon and biodiversity. The farm offers its products through farmers' markets, CSA hubs, and an online store, emphasizing a 'put back more than we take' philosophy.

name: Copercana
summary: Copercana is a large cooperative in Brazil's agribusiness sector, offering a wide range of services to its members. These include agricultural inputs, precision farming, soil analysis, fuel distribution, insurance, automotive services, and retail (supermarkets and stores). The cooperative also engages in grain storage and operates a media outlet (Rádio Copercana, Revista Canavieiros), demonstrating a commitment to supporting its members' operations and community.

name: BIOXPLOSION SRLs
summary: BIOXPLOSION SRLs offers a patented, sustainable, and non-polluting system called Bioxplosion System® for managing organic waste, particularly animal manure. This system transforms organic matter into a natural fertilizer, approved for organic agriculture, by utilizing earthworms. The company provides the technology and know-how to help agricultural businesses resolve waste management issues economically and legally, promoting a chemical-free approach to cultivation.

name: DynAgro s.r.o.
summary: DynAgro is a premium quality cereal producer focused on ecological farming practices and environmental sustainability. The company aims to bridge financial gaps in ecological farming by acquiring fertile land and using digital tools to share profits from cereal production and land appreciation with investors. They also offer farm products like oats, barley, and wheat for sale.

name: Backbone Food Farm
summary: Backbone Food Farm is a diversified family farm located in Garrett County, Maryland, specializing in sustainably raised produce, meats, and mushrooms. They offer a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) program, farm camp for children, and sell products through farmers markets and an online pre-order platform. The farm also has a dedicated Mycology Division focused on mushroom cultivation and foraging.

name: Coppess Family Farms & Lincolnway Ag Services
summary: Coppess Family Farms & Lincolnway Ag Services provides modern row-crop farming services, including planting, chemical and fungicide application, harvesting, and grain hauling. They focus on building partnerships with clients through sustainable management, crop technology, and tailored rental agreements. The company aims to grow agriculture one field at a time with integrity and professionalism.

name: Fitogar, S.L.U.
summary: Fitogar is a company specializing in agricultural solutions, offering foliar and root products certified for organic farming. They focus on innovation in "the new agriculture," aiming to optimize water and fertilizer use, reduce environmental impact, and promote smart farming systems. Their offerings include products for citrus cultivation and digital solutions for real-time field monitoring, contributing to sustainable and efficient agricultural practices.

name: Skrivargården Lantbruks AB
summary: Skrivargården is a family-run farm, now in its sixth generation, located along Svartån. While historically involved in livestock, it now focuses on hay production for horse feed, sheep and lamb farming, and selling mushroom cultivation boxes through svampladan.se. The farm also hosts a solar park and offers consulting services in project management, development, environment, sustainable development, green industries, and social entrepreneurship.

name: The FruitGuys Community Fund
summary: The FruitGuys Community Fund provides annual grant awards to small farms and agricultural nonprofits supporting sustainable agriculture projects. Their mission is to foster environmental stewardship, equitable food systems, and farm diversity. Since 2012, they have awarded over $665,000 in grants to small-scale farmers across 42 states and territories.

name: FertGaia
summary: FertGaia offers high-performance, custom-made agricultural solutions, including specialized products for crops and livestock. Their offerings aim to enhance every stage of production, from cultivation to animal husbandry, ensuring quality output. The company also maintains a blog to keep clients informed about market trends, new technologies, and industry news.

name: Società Agricola Emon Agri S.r.l.
summary: Società Agricola Emon Agri S.r.l. was an organic agricultural company focused on cultivating and selling healthy and tasty produce directly from the field to the table. They operated greenhouses and offered seasonal products, including recipes. The company announced its closure after 11 years of operation, ceasing its direct sales point.

name: C. Agrario Srl
summary: C. Agrario Srl is an Italian company providing services and products for the agricultural and zootechnical sectors. With over 15 years of experience, they offer technical consultancy, business management, and veterinary advice to farms. They also operate a retail shop selling animal feed, forage, gardening supplies, pet products, and irrigation systems, serving both businesses and private customers.

name: Landmark Advisory Ltd
summary: Landmark Advisory Ltd is a farm compliance business that offers environmental consulting services to farmers. They specialize in nutrient management, greenhouse gas and carbon analysis, and holistic farm systems analysis to help agricultural businesses improve profitability while meeting regulatory obligations. Their services include farm environment plans, nutrient budgeting, and due diligence for farm sales.

name: Albion Hills Community Farm
summary: Albion Hills Community Farm is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting local food understanding and sustainable agriculture through farming, education, conservation, and community partnerships. They offer educational programs, community garden plots, a CSA service, and sell produce at their farm market. The farm aims to connect people with local food production and foster community engagement.

name: Grundo Switzerland GmbH
summary: Grundo provides advisory, consulting, and technology solutions focused on sustainability challenges in agriculture, environmental protection, and calamity prevention. They leverage scientific research, remote sensing, and AI to offer customized solutions for governments, NGOs, and private sector clients. Their mission is to enhance food security and sustainability through scalable data systems.

name: Feistmann GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Feistmann GmbH & Co. KG is a family-run agricultural contracting company established in 1970, based in Rheine, Germany. They offer comprehensive services to farmers, including nutrient management, transportation of manure and bulk goods, and a full range of agricultural tasks from sowing to harvesting. The company also provides a rental service for agricultural machinery and is a certified provider of sustainable nutrient supply.

name: Schulz Pastoral
summary: Schulz Pastoral is an organization focused on sustainable farming practices for future generations. The website provides contact information and a sign-up for email updates, indicating a business involved in agricultural operations. Its mission centers on environmentally conscious and long-term viable farming.

name: Consorzio Agrario delle province del Nord Ovest soc.coop.
summary: The Consorzio Agrario delle province del Nord Ovest is a cooperative agricultural consortium that provides a wide range of products and services to farmers and the agricultural sector. Their offerings include agricultural products like seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides, as well as machinery, fuels, and animal feed. They also offer specialized services such as precision farming, agronomic and zootechnical assistance, and financial and insurance support, aiming to enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability.

name: Lila BV
summary: Lila BV is a young, internationally operating trading company based in Groningen, Netherlands. The company aims to contribute positively and sustainably to the production of sufficient and safe food worldwide by leveraging its knowledge and network. They offer innovative, effective, sustainable, environmentally friendly, and safe solutions for agriculture, focusing on plant and soil nutrition to reduce reliance on conventional chemicals.

name: Rio Bonito Agro
summary: Rio Bonito Agro is an agricultural company focused on sustainable production and natural resource preservation. They offer services in silviculture (cultivating pine and eucalyptus), grain storage and standardization (corn, soy, wheat), and agricultural production and commercialization of corn, soy, wheat, and beans. As part of the Plenaventura Group, they integrate technology with responsible practices for sector development.

name: DB AG
summary: DB AG, operating under the DB Group, is a significant player in the agriculture sector, offering a comprehensive range of services including livestock management, cropping, farm management, and contract farming. Through its business units Griffith Feed & Grain and GFG Rural Supplies, it provides animal feeds, warehousing, and rural supplies. The group emphasizes sustainable and logical agriculture for investors, operators, and partners, leveraging over 80 years of experience.

name: Gut Illmau
summary: Gut Illmau is a bio-agricultural enterprise focused on harmonizing nature and economy through sustainable farming practices. They produce high-quality organic products, including grains, Angus beef, and potatoes, emphasizing environmental protection and closed nutrient cycles. With operations spanning Austria and the Czech Republic, Gut Illmau aims to deliver premium, flavorful food while respecting the natural environment.

name: Agrarbetriebe Schliebener Land
summary: Agrarbetriebe Schliebener Land is an agricultural enterprise focused on sustainable farming with closed-loop systems, primarily producing milk. They manage 1,250 hectares of arable land and 900 hectares of grassland for their dairy cows and young stock. The organization enhances value through biogas plants integrated with cattle farming operations and the production and marketing of specialty milk. It operates as a cooperative including Milchgut Kolochau GmbH, WENAU Agrar GmbH, Agrar GmbH Schlieben, and Bioenergie Schlieben GmbH, emphasizing responsibility towards people, animals, and nature, high animal welfare standards, and regionality.

name: Twiddle Dee Farm
summary: Twiddle Dee Farm is a pastured-based small farm specializing in regenerative and sustainable agriculture. They offer horse boarding services, and sell produce such as fruits, nuts, flowers, and vegetables directly to the public. The farm also engages in small livestock sales and focuses on alternative farming practices.

name: ACE Ohlsson Pty Ltd
summary: Ace Ohlsson is a trusted agricultural supplier that provides a comprehensive range of products and services to support agribusinesses from seed to market. They offer expertise in animal health, horticulture, seed supplies, fertilizers, and rural supplies, with a dedicated team of agronomists providing specialist advice. Located within Sydney Markets and supported by local branches, they aim to help growers of all sizes succeed.

name: Biolandhof Bodemer
summary: Biolandhof Bodemer is a diverse organic farm operating under strict Bioland association guidelines. The farm engages in cattle fattening (Angus beef), crop cultivation (grains, potatoes, clover-grass), pumpkin farming, and maintains extensive orchards. They also offer firewood sales, operate a contract business for services like mowing and winter maintenance, and have a photovoltaic system. The farm emphasizes a closed-loop, sustainable agricultural system, avoiding mineral fertilizers and promoting biodiversity.

name: 2B Farming Inc.
summary: 2B Farming Inc. is a full-service agricultural company offering comprehensive farm management, custom cultivation, spraying, pest control, administration, and harvesting services. They specialize in pistachios, almonds, citrus, and wine grapes, operating across Kern County, Kings County, Tulare County, and Kingman, Arizona. The company focuses on modern, precise farming techniques, leveraging technology and research to increase crop productivity and farm viability for owners and corporate farmers.

name: TRAITAGRI CENTRE
summary: TRAITAGRI CENTRE specializes in providing alternative agricultural products and services for market gardening and horticulture. They offer solutions focused on environmental respect, aiming to maintain yields and quality through biological and physical rebalancing of water, soil, and plants. Their offerings include disinfection services, pest control, greenhouse cleaning, and sales of greenhouse films, positioning them as an alternative to conventional fertilizers and synthetic treatments.

name: Fattoria Le Prata Società Agricola s.r.l.
summary: Fattoria Le Prata is an agricultural company focused on producing fresh, organic, and local produce. They emphasize a 'farm to fork' philosophy, promoting short supply chains and sustainability. The company also operates a bottega (shop) and a ristoro (eatery) in Pisa, offering their own products and a convivial dining experience.

name: Itaka srl
summary: Itaka offers natural solutions for agriculture, focusing on soil vitality, plant health, and seed coating. Their products aim to regenerate damaged soils, boost plant resistance, and improve crop resilience. The company emphasizes a scientific and personalized approach, supported by a research and development center, and serves various crops including cereals, vegetables, and fruits.

name: Tenderground
summary: Tenderground supports farmers in developing productive and profitable agroecosystems through coaching and educational workshops. Led by Courtney Young, an agroecologist with expertise in soil and plant health analysis, farm business strategy, and marketing, the organization focuses on landscape regeneration and farmer education. They offer consulting and coaching services grounded in action learning and peer-to-peer knowledge sharing to enhance landscape literacy and decision-making skills.

name: Fundación Agroecosistema
summary: Fundación Agroecosistema is dedicated to promoting sustainable agriculture and livestock farming in Spain. They offer training, consulting, and business management tools to farmers and producers, aiming to improve profitability and environmental practices. The foundation organizes key industry events like the Encuentro Agroecológico and Foro del Vino, and undertakes projects focused on ecological transition and ecosystem renaturalization.

name: Agrar-Service Meyer GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Agrar-Service Meyer is a company offering comprehensive agricultural services in the Oldenburg and Wesermarsch regions. They provide a wide range of services including soil cultivation, fertilization, crop protection, and transportation of agricultural products. Additionally, they offer 'Strohfix', an innovative, dust-free straw bedding for animal husbandry, and operate their own sustainable agricultural farm.

name: Jura Légumes
summary: Jura Légumes is a farm based in Courgenay, Switzerland, specializing in sustainable agriculture and the production of high-quality, seasonal vegetables and fruits. Established in 2007, the company offers a variety of fresh produce through direct sales, home delivery of curated baskets, and wholesale to restaurants and stores. They also produce processed goods like jams and dried vegetables, emphasizing ecological commitment and freshness.

name: Bioagroinsumos SAS
summary: Bioagroinsumos SAS is a company specializing in organic agricultural inputs, offering products like Avisana (solid organic-mineral fertilizer) and Bioxinis (liquid organic-mineral fertilizer). They aim to protect the environment and consumer health by promoting sustainable farming practices. The company also offers livestock sales, including Simmental purebred cattle, embryos, and semen, and operates internationally.

name: Atypical Roots LLC
summary: Atypical Roots LLC is a company focused on providing sustainable and healthy food options, including farm-fresh meats, produce, and freeze-dried items. They operate from a dedicated gluten-free commercial facility and aim to give back to their community. Their product range includes familiar favorites and treats, emphasizing a unique approach to food production and distribution.

name: Grupo Adubos Real
summary: Grupo Adubos Real is a Brazilian company dedicated to enhancing agricultural productivity through a wide range of products and services. They offer fertilizers, special fertilizers, essential fertilizers, fertigation solutions, adjuvants, bioactivators, seeds, and crop protection products. With a mission to contribute to the sustainable development of agribusiness and client success, they operate 90 stores and 5 industrial units across Brazil, serving over 50,000 clients annually.

name: Fa. ERNST HASLHOFER EHA
summary: Fa. ERNST HASLHOFER EHA is a company that offers a range of products for sustainable agriculture, home improvement, heating systems, cleaning, milking hygiene, and construction machinery. They emphasize providing optimal solutions with quality products, attractive pricing, and reliable personal service. The company acts as a distributor or representative for various brands in these sectors.

name: Agroprodukt, s.r.o.
summary: Agroprodukt, s.r.o. and its affiliated companies operate as a holding system managing approximately 2,300 hectares of agricultural land. Their core activities include crop production, animal husbandry, and the manufacturing and direct sale of food products, with a focus on ecological farming. The group also engages in waste management, construction, and transportation services.

name: Taurus Environmental Consulting LLC
summary: Taurus Environmental Consulting LLC is an Abu Dhabi-based Agrotech and environmental consultancy that specializes in making sustainable agriculture and water systems viable in arid environments. They combine science, technology, and local expertise to help farmers, investors, and governments optimize resource use, focusing on measurable sustainability through clear KPIs for productivity, water efficiency, and carbon reduction. Their work includes developing solutions for controlled environment agriculture, atmospheric water generation, smart integrated systems, and bio-solutions, aiming to turn arid regions into productive and resilient ecosystems.

name: Agrarservice Heller GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Agrarservice Heller GmbH & Co. KG is an established company providing agricultural contract and services, including manure and digestate application, spreading of solid manure, lime, and compost, baling of hay, silage, and straw, grass and corn harvesting, and sugar beet harvesting. They also offer transport services, including chicken dry manure, and trade in hay and straw, as well as selling compost and substrates. The company aims to maximize customer yields while promoting sustainable practices.

name: The Green Edge International Pty Ltd.
summary: The Green Edge is an Australian company focused on enhancing organic food grain productivity through advanced agricultural solutions. They offer plant nutrients, soil conditioners, robotic farming and testing equipment, vertical gardening, digital irrigation systems, and industrial lab facilities. Their product line includes humate-based soil reclamations and water-soluble fertilizers designed to reduce chemical reliance, regenerate soil, and improve plant vitality.

name: ACTIVEWATER TECHNOLOGY Limited
summary: ACTIVEWATER TECHNOLOGY Limited provides revolutionary eco-friendly water technology and agri-sensors to farmers, enabling them to increase crop yield, improve water usage efficiency, and enhance soil health. Their sustainable, solar-powered solutions aim to reduce carbon footprints and promote Net Zero farming. The company targets farmers, distributors, and governments with its chemical-free, affordable technology.

name: Bradner Farms
summary: Bradner Farms is a fourth-generation family farm specializing in regenerative organic food production. They are pioneers in organic farming in Western Canada, offering organic beef, poultry, dairy products, and operating their own organic feedmill. Their commitment to compassionate animal care and sustainable land practices ensures high-quality, certified organic products.

name: CRE S.r.l.
summary: CRE S.r.l. is an Italian company specializing in sustainable agricultural solutions. They transform biological wastewater treatment sludge into certified, nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their mission is to close the waste cycle by returning valuable resources to the soil, promoting healthier and more environmentally friendly agriculture through advanced technology and expertise.

name: Ortoingiro Società agricola Orto in giro s.s.
summary: Ortoingiro is an agricultural company focused on sustainable farming practices, utilizing animal traction with horses instead of fossil fuels. They cultivate 6 hectares of land in rotation, producing seasonal vegetables, legumes, ancient grains, honey, pollen, propolis, and eggs. The company emphasizes artisanal production, same-day harvesting and delivery, and offers opportunities for community engagement and farm visits.

name: Boa Fang
summary: Boa Fang is a manufacturer specializing in eco-friendly, biodegradable, and compostable single-use systems for agricultural needs. Their product range includes tree guards, ties, stakes, and weed barriers designed to enhance production and labor efficiency in farms, fields, nurseries, greenhouses, and gardens. The company emphasizes renewable and globally eco-friendly solutions for modern agriculture.

name: Solawi Hofkollektiv eG / LwB Kremershof
summary: Kremershof is an agricultural operation transitioning from dairy farming to diverse organic production, operating as a non-profit cooperative (Solawi Hofkollektiv eG). They offer organic products like eggs, beef, and hay, and engage in landscape maintenance and educational programs. The initiative emphasizes community involvement through 'Mitmachtage' (participation days) and an 'Ernteabo' (harvest subscription) for members, aiming for sustainable agriculture that benefits everyone.

name: Tronchin Srl
summary: Tronchin Srl promotes sustainable practices for natural resource conservation by transforming waste into usable resources, thereby reducing environmental impact. They specialize in composting garden waste into valuable soil amendments, offer agricultural services from land preparation to harvesting, and create sustainable soil mixes for responsible cultivation. Additionally, they operate a garden outlet selling pet supplies and gardening equipment.

name: Jacoma Estate Limited
summary: Jacoma Estate Limited is a UK-based investment company that manages agricultural land in Malawi through its subsidiary, Tropha Estates Limited. The company focuses on cultivating and producing high-quality Macadamia Nuts, Paprika, and Birds Eye Chilli, employing advanced agricultural technologies and regenerative farming practices. Jacoma Estate is committed to environmental responsibility, carbon-positive farming, and uplifting local communities through outgrower farmer support programs.

name: Organic Forestry Center
summary: The Organic Forestry Center is a nature preserve and working farm located in southern Fond du Lac County, operating with environmentally responsible, natural, and organic methods for over 30 years. They specialize in raising and selling grass-fed beef, including various breeds like Black Angus and Hereford, processed locally and USDA inspected. The center also offers trees, wood, gates, and beef hides for sale, and welcomes visitors for farm tours.

name: HDH Agri Products, LLC
summary: HDH Agri Products, LLC is a company that appears to be involved in agricultural products, as indicated by its name and the copyright notice from 2007. The provided information is limited, but it suggests a business operating within the agricultural sector. Further details about its specific products or services are not available from the given text.

name: iFarmTec
summary: iFarmTec is a company established in October 2017, focused on developing, producing, and commercializing intelligent products and services for the agricultural sector. Their mission is to create added value for clients through process optimization and cost reduction, aiming for environmental sustainability and circular economy principles. The company's vision is to be a leader in technological solutions for agriculture, offering innovative, tailor-made products and services.

name: Die Galegge
summary: Die Galegge is a biological and ecological farm located in Suhr, within the Aarau agglomeration. The farm focuses on producing quality food, maintaining a diverse recreational landscape, and promoting biodiversity and public awareness for nature-oriented agriculture. It offers various products and activities including a farm shop, goat cheese, and fish farming.

name: Full Circle Community Farm
summary: Full Circle Community Farm is a certified organic farm specializing in vegetables, pasture-raised eggs, grass-fed beef, and pastured pork. They offer a customizable Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) program through the SLO Farmers Co-op, providing home delivery in Green Bay and the Fox Valley. The farm also sells wholesale organic meat directly to consumers, allowing for custom cuts through local butchers.

name: UNICOM SERVICIOS Y GESTIÓN S.L.
summary: UNICOM SERVICIOS Y GESTIÓN S.L. is an agricultural company based in Granada, Spain, focused on providing integrated solutions for modern, sustainable agriculture. They offer a range of products and services including bio-stimulants, fertilizers, seeds, biological pest control, and soil monitoring and regeneration. The company aims to innovate and technify agricultural businesses, ensuring high-value crops while prioritizing environmental respect and consumer health.

name: Happy Cells Private Limited
summary: Happy Cells Private Limited is an exporter and supplier based in Mumbai, India, focusing on bio-diverse, organic farm produce. Their vision is to bridge the gap between rural farmers and global consumers by providing safe, healthy, and affordable food products. They offer a range of items including pulses, jaggery, turmeric, cow ghee, and copper bottles, emphasizing sustainability and farmer empowerment.

name: Kansas Rural Center (KRC)
summary: The Kansas Rural Center (KRC) is dedicated to promoting the long-term health of land and people through research, education, and advocacy. They champion an economically viable, ecologically sound, and socially just food and farming system, believing that multifaceted farming systems are key to a sustainable future. KRC offers various projects, resources, and events focused on supporting farmers, rural communities, and healthy food systems.

name: AGROPEC INGENIEROS CONSULTORES, S.L.U.
summary: Agropec Ingenieros Consultores is a firm of consulting engineers specializing in sustainable agriculture, livestock farming, and agro-industrial transformation. They offer services in farm management, ecological production, technical project development, bioconstruction, precision agriculture with drones, and agro-food industry implementation. Their mission is to promote healthy, environmentally responsible food production, leveraging over 15 years of experience and a multidisciplinary team.

name: Dagan Agricultural Automation
summary: Dagan Agricultural Automation is a company with over 40 years of experience specializing in providing comprehensive agricultural solutions. They offer turnkey projects, advanced agricultural systems like greenhouses, AgriSolar, and aquaculture, as well as services including planning, consultation, feasibility studies, and ongoing maintenance. Dagan focuses on integrating technology, innovation, and sustainability to ensure effective and profitable results for governments, research institutions, companies, and private farmers worldwide.

name: LoginEKO
summary: LoginEKO is dedicated to transforming the food system towards sustainability by integrating research, technology, and practical implementation. Operating a large farm as a living laboratory, they develop and share knowledge, software, and tools for sustainable farming, food development, and traceability. Their mission is to create solutions that work at scale for the benefit of future generations.

name: 株式会社ファームプロ
summary: 株式会社ファームプロ (Farmpro Co., Ltd.) aims to foster a society where consumers and farmers interact, by developing various services to enhance the value of agriculture. The company's website features blog posts on agricultural topics, smart agriculture initiatives, travelogues of business trips including dining experiences, and announcements related to agricultural events. They also operate an online shop and provide information through their "Saiennavi" platform.

name: Gut Illmau
summary: Gut Illmau is a bio-agricultural enterprise focused on harmonizing nature and economy through sustainable farming practices. With operations spanning Austria and the Czech Republic, Gut Illmau aims to deliver premium, flavorful food while respecting the natural environment.

name: Ziemia Polska Sp. z o.o.
summary: Ziemia Polska is a company focused on environmental action and sustainable agriculture, developing and promoting natural technologies. They specialize in probiotic microorganism-based soil conditioners and organic fertilizers, aiming to improve soil health and crop yields while being environmentally conscious. The company emphasizes research and development, with products certified by agricultural authorities and a mission to foster civilization's development in harmony with nature.

name: Pioneer Pesticides Pvt. Ltd.
summary: Pioneer Pesticides Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001 & 14001 certified company established in 1995, specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of agrochemicals. The company offers a range of products including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, bactericides, and plant growth promoters, aiming to support healthy and sustainable food production. With a strong focus on quality and farmer satisfaction, Pioneer Pesticides has become a leading agrochemical company in India.

name: Rittergut Alvesse
summary: Rittergut Alvesse is a family-run estate offering sustainable agricultural products, including firewood sourced from local forests for eco-friendly heating. As a certified training company, they emphasize quality and knowledge transfer, alongside a strong commitment to nature conservation.

summary: Ace Ohlsson is a dedicated agricultural supplier providing a comprehensive range of products and services to support agribusinesses from seed to market. With a team of experienced agronomists, they aim to help growers achieve efficient and sustainable production.

name: Acciarri Ugo & Nello Srl
summary: Acciarri Ugo & Nello Srl is an Italian company with 70 years of experience in the agricultural sector, offering a comprehensive range of products and services. They specialize in agro-supplies, including pesticides, fertilizers, and seeds, as well as managing agricultural commodity storage and providing technical and agronomic support to farmers. The company also caters to the home and garden sector, offering irrigation solutions and nursery supplies, with a mission to promote sustainable agriculture and farmer well-being.

name: AgroVision
summary: AgroVision develops and provides next-generation agricultural software solutions designed to enhance efficiency and responsibility in farming. Their product suite includes specialized software for pigs, cows, crops, finance, and feed formulation, aiming to empower farmers and agribusinesses with data-driven insights for smarter decision-making. The company emphasizes innovation, customer focus, and future-proofing agricultural practices.

name: Master Group
summary: Master Group is an agribusiness company with its headquarters in Passo Fundo and operations in 10 units across Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The company is involved in various stages of the agricultural value chain, including planting, processing, storage, and commercialization of grains. They also operate feed mills and provide agricultural inputs such as fertilizers and pesticides, aiming to support the future of agriculture through innovation and responsibility.

name: Granja Bretanhas S/A
summary: Granja Bretanhas S/A is an agricultural company primarily engaged in the production of rice, soybeans, blueberries, and beef cattle. The company operates with a focus on modern agricultural techniques, including precision farming with satellite navigation for soil leveling and advanced irrigation systems like politubos. They are committed to environmental sustainability, as evidenced by their participation in the "Selo Ambiental da Lavoura de Arroz do RS" program.

name: Wacrain Culina Terra e.U.
summary: Wacrain Culina Terra e.U. is a manufacturer and retailer specializing in sustainable regional agricultural products, including herbs, spices, and honey. They emphasize the quality derived from their bees and their commitment to bee protection, offering these products through their webshop. The company aims to provide consumers with high-quality, ethically produced regional delicacies.

name: AGRAVIS Ems-Jade GmbH
summary: AGRAVIS Ems-Jade GmbH is a regional partner for agriculture, operating as part of the larger AGRAVIS-Gruppe. They also operate Raiffeisen markets and fuel stations, serving both agricultural and retail customers.

name: DJ Serviços Rurais
summary: DJ Serviços Rurais is a company with 34 years of experience providing environmental solutions for the agricultural sector. They specialize in ecological restoration, offering services such as hydroseeding for revegetation and erosion control, biomat installation for soil stabilization, and comprehensive area management including ecological restoration. Their mission is to promote sustainable practices that cultivate the future, ensuring environmental compliance and long-lasting results for their clients.

name: Tributary Farm
summary: Tributary Farm is an organic farm located in High Falls, NY, specializing in the cultivation of vegetables, small fruits, and honey. The farm operates on principles of the triple bottom line, prioritizing soil and ecosystem health, a strong client and team base, and financial viability. Serving a 350-member summer CSA, a 200-member winter CSA, wholesale accounts, and food pantries, Tributary Farm is entering its seventh season of operation.

name: Central Hortofrutícola La Rinconada S.L.L.
summary: Central Hortofrutícola La Rinconada is an agricultural company based in Alfamén, Spain, specializing in the cultivation and commercialization of fruits. The company adheres to Integrated Production protocols and is Global GAP certified, emphasizing quality, environmental sustainability, and efficient resource management in its operations.

summary: Rede do Campo Mercado Rural is an agricultural retail company offering solutions for livestock, agriculture, and related tools. summary: Domaine La Micro Ferme is an agricultural estate focused on developing sustainable farming practices through permaculture.
