name: Azienda Agricola da Schio
summary: Azienda Agricola da Schio is a family-run farm managed by agronomists Francesco and Berardo. They practice sustainable and regenerative agriculture across their lands in Vicenza and Rovigo, producing wine from organic grapes, olive oil, honey, and cured meats. The company also offers enotourism experiences and direct sales of their products.

name: Omri Trading 121 CC
summary: Omri Trading 121 CC is a company specializing in agricultural products and equipment, including soil sampling tools, automated drill rigs, specialized fertilizers, and agronomy services. They aim to empower farmers with expertise for informed decision-making and sustainable production. The company is committed to customer-centricity, building strong partnerships, and fostering a culture of optimal service delivery with a focus on economic growth and community upliftment.

name: Linwood Ag
summary: Linwood Ag appears to be an agricultural holding company with various subsidiaries involved in farming, green energy production, management, ventures, turf cultivation, and natural upcycling. The group operates under the umbrella of Linwood Ag, suggesting a diversified approach to agricultural and related business activities.

name: Agrisystem
summary: Agrisystem is an Italian company specializing in the production and distribution of agricultural products, including fertilizers, biosolutions, agrochemicals, and complementary products. They focus on providing solutions for crop nutrition and protection, aiming to enhance plant health, soil vitality, and overall agricultural productivity. The company emphasizes research and development to offer innovative products that support sustainable farming practices.

name: SAMAGRI
summary: Samagri is an Italian company focused on enabling sustainable agriculture by reducing reliance on synthetic chemicals. They develop and provide microbial consortia, such as Ryzo Pep Up and Mambo, designed to improve crop quality, soil health, and water/nutrient absorption. Their mission is to protect the future by caring for the present, offering tailored microbial solutions and professional consulting to agricultural businesses.

name: Biolandbetrieb Eichenhof
summary: Biolandbetrieb Eichenhof is a family-run organic farm that has been operating for several generations. They specialize in raising Bioland-certified cattle and chickens, offering high-quality organic beef packages and canned sausages. The farm also functions as an educational site for children, teaching them about farm life and agriculture, and sells a variety of organic products through on-site vending machines.

name: Baxter Barn
summary: Baxter Barn is a historical farm dedicated to demonstrating sustainability and conservation, valuing both domesticated and native plants and wildlife. They offer a variety of products and services including day-old chicks, pumpkins, feed, farm supplies, and fresh eggs. The farm also provides private tours, educational programs, and hands-on experiences for visitors, emphasizing the proper care of their birds from farm to home.

name: More Than Just Feed
summary: More Than Just Feed is an organization dedicated to supporting farmers and their communities through agricultural solutions. Their mission is to help farmers feed families by fostering farm growth and sustaining communities. The website provides information about their approach, beliefs, locations, and company structure, indicating a focus on agricultural services and support.

name: HATponics
summary: HATponics is an organization focused on sustainable environmental solutions, offering products and services in education, outreach, consulting, and construction, with a special emphasis on organic healthy foods. Founded in 2013 with the mission to deliver farms instead of food, it aims to combat world hunger through innovative approaches like aquaponics. The company develops and markets new systems, driven by a team with expertise in biology, engineering, and economics.

name: Van der Woerd Bio-agro-products
summary: Van der Woerd Bio-agro-products is a Dutch company specializing in the cultivation and year-round sales of organic agricultural products, both domestically and internationally. They focus on delivering high-quality products through innovative farming practices and are certified by GLOBALGAP, SKAL, and GRASP. The company emphasizes sustainable agriculture and aims for optimal product quality and market presence.

name: Pursehouse Rural
summary: Pursehouse Rural is an Australian agricultural supplier offering a wide range of products including agricultural chemicals, animal health supplies, farm equipment, feed, produce, fencing, fertiliser, and seeds. They also provide comprehensive agronomy services, soil and nutrient management, and agricultural finance solutions. With a strong network of branches across New South Wales and Queensland, Pursehouse Rural aims to support the success and sustainability of rural communities.

name: ZUMA TRADING s.r.o.
summary: ZUMA TRADING s.r.o. is a company focused on developing organic agriculture by providing specialized consulting services, organic fertilizers, and agrocommodities. They aim to help clients improve quality, efficiency, and sustainability in farming through tailored solutions and the application of organic products. The company also facilitates trade in the agricultural sector and offers services related to waste utilization and seed multiplication.

name: Ferme de Gisy
summary: Ferme de Gisy is an agricultural farm that cultivates over 150 types of vegetables. They offer a wide range of products including vegetable spreads, ketchup, and other processed goods, available for direct purchase or through AMAP and retail points. The farm emphasizes freshness, taste, and quality, delivering produce harvested on the same day to local stores.

name: ОАО АПК Ильинка
summary: ОАО АПК Ильинка is an agricultural company celebrating 10 years of operation. They focus on modern methods, high-quality products, and 100% natural offerings in livestock and crop production. The company aims to provide wholesome agricultural goods to its customers.

name: ShireFolk Farm
summary: ShireFolk Farm is a family-owned and operated farm in Palmyra, Virginia, specializing in GMO-free, pasture-raised eggs, hogs, and poultry. They also offer pasture-raised lambs sold in whole animal units and agroforestry nursery stock. The farm is transitioning its focus, with family members engaged in off-farm work related to sustainable agriculture and agroforestry.

name: Walkmühlenhof
summary: Walkmühlenhof is a second-generation family farm operating approximately 220 hectares of agricultural land. They specialize in growing grains, rapeseed, and buckwheat, with a strong emphasis on environmental protection, insect conservation, and sustainable farming practices. The farm also raises Simmental cattle, utilizing a closed-loop system for feed and fertilizer, and offers agricultural services to others. Their products are sold regionally, contributing to the local economy.

name: Familie Dreher & Team
summary: Familie Dreher & Team operates a farm with direct sales of its products, emphasizing local sourcing. Their offerings include dairy products sold through milk vending machines and a 'Milchhäusle' (milk house), alongside animal husbandry and crop cultivation. The farm also utilizes biogas production, indicating a focus on sustainable agricultural practices and regional supply chains.

name: Lantmännen
summary: Lantmännen is a Northern European agricultural cooperative and a leading player in agriculture, machinery, bioenergy, and food. The company offers a wide range of products and services for competitive farming, including machinery import and sales, bioenergy production, and the development and marketing of food products. They operate from farm to table, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and supporting a vital agricultural sector.

name: We Grow LLC
summary: We Grow LLC is a produce farm in northern Taylor County, Wisconsin, specializing in organic, non-GMO vegetables grown using Community Supported Agricultural (CSA) principles. They also offer pasture-raised heritage breed pork and broiler chickens seasonally. The farm emphasizes sustainable growing practices, community engagement, and providing fresh, local food to its members and the wider community through various sales channels including farmers markets and an online store.

name: Dirt Capital Partners LLC
summary: Dirt Capital Partners is an investment firm that partners with regenerative farmers to invest in agricultural land. They offer flexible financial arrangements and technical support, focusing on supporting farmers and land stewardship. The company aims to facilitate positive outcomes for farmers, land, and communities through collaborative projects.

name: Plant Defender
summary: Plant Defender is a company dedicated to providing innovative and sustainable solutions for agriculture. They offer a range of products and services aimed at protecting crops and improving yields for various cultures. Their mission focuses on care, responsibility, and innovation to enhance the agricultural sector.

name: Biohospodářství Kokonín
summary: Biohospodářství Kokonín is a certified organic farm located in Kokonín, Czech Republic, focusing on growing cereals, fodder crops, vegetables, and oilseeds. They also operate an orchard and a vineyard, selling produce directly from their farm. The organization emphasizes environmental sustainability through various eco-friendly practices, including renewable energy, waste reduction, and nature conservation efforts, alongside offering environmentally conscious IT services.

name: Feiter
summary: Feiter is an agricultural enterprise seeking to expand its operations by leasing land for short-term or long-term cultivation. They offer sustainable collaboration concepts and systems. The company is also developing an innovative controlling software called 'Agro Aktiv' for organizing, planning, executing, and evaluating agricultural data, emphasizing data control, flexibility, and real-time analysis.

name: Hydroemission
summary: Hydroemission is a company focused on advancing sustainable agriculture through cutting-edge technology that optimizes input use, reduces environmental impact, and lowers labor needs. They develop tailored solutions for complex agricultural and environmental challenges, enhancing crop protection and offering eco-friendly industrial products. Their proprietary delivery technologies aim to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and address pollution, aligning with UN sustainable development goals.

name: Iroquois Valley Farmland REIT
summary: Iroquois Valley is a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) that provides capital to organic, regenerative, and transitioning farmers across America. They offer long-term leases, flexible mortgages, and post-investment support, aiming to transform the agricultural system. The company is structured as a public benefit corporation and a B Corp, focusing on impact-driven investing in farmland.

name: Agrisolv Waste SRL
summary: Agrisolv Waste SRL is a Romanian company established in 2007, specializing in agricultural solutions. They offer agricultural consulting with guaranteed efficiency improvements, provide biostimulator products derived from marine algae, fulvic and humic acids, and custom fertilizers. The company also engages in R&D for agricultural technologies, offers regulatory services for fertilizers and pesticides, and provides consulting for photovoltaic systems, energy storage, heating, and irrigation. Their services aim to optimize farm profitability and promote sustainable agricultural practices.

name: Agrinnovazione - Dott. Agronomo Davide Misturini
summary: Agrinnovazione provides agricultural consulting services focused on optimizing farm management for increased productivity and sustainability. Led by agronomist Davide Misturini, the company offers solutions in soil mapping, digital farm management, phytosanitary consulting, conservative agriculture, cover crops, drone monitoring, and precision agriculture services. Their mission is to help agricultural businesses adopt modern, efficient, and environmentally conscious practices.

name: Naturhof Waltwil4
summary: Naturhof Waltwil4 is an agricultural estate focused on a holistic approach to farming, emphasizing the well-being of humans, animals, and nature. They offer animal welfare, sustainable agriculture, and educational experiences, promoting a mindful coexistence with life. The farm also produces and sells specialty grains and offers services like horse boarding and volunteer opportunities.

name: Opus Terra
summary: Opus Terra is a group of Mexican companies focused on promoting sustainability and environmental care through organic agriculture, sustainable landscaping, pest management, and cannabis-related projects. They offer services like urban garden installation, landscape architecture, urban pest control, and education on cannabis benefits, aiming to create harmonious and sustainable spaces.

name: Coyote Run Farm
summary: Coyote Run Farm is an 110-acre family farm committed to sustainable agriculture and providing high-quality produce and heirloom plants. They focus on land stewardship and customer satisfaction, offering chemical-free products. The farm also raises mules, horses, and beef, and welcomes visitors by appointment.

name: 株式会社チクテック (Chikutech Co., Ltd.)
summary: Chikutech Co., Ltd. specializes in promoting sustainable agriculture through its "Kassei Dōsui" (activated誘導 water) and "Sukoyaka Series" products. These products leverage microbial power to create safer and more natural farming practices, aiming to revitalize local soil and improve livestock health. The company offers solutions for transforming animal waste into valuable compost and enhancing livestock drinking water to balance and activate microorganisms, thereby supporting a circular agricultural economy.

name: Familie Schrottner Winkelhof
summary: Familie Schrottner Winkelhof is a family-run farm that emphasizes sustainable agriculture to produce high-quality food products. Their offerings include processed milk, meat, apple products, and pumpkin seed oil. They also provide a seminar room and have designated sales points for their goods, indicating a focus on direct-to-consumer sales and community engagement.

name: River Valley Ag Exchange, LLC
summary: River Valley Ag Exchange (RVAE) is a full-service grain elevator founded in 2017, specializing in biological and specialty crop solutions for farmers in Central Missouri. Owned by 5th-generation farmers, RVAE offers innovative, sustainable solutions including inputs, consulting, seed production, grain marketing, and storage. Their mission is to help farmers boost profits and improve soil health through advanced products like the Trilogy™ Soil Converter Program, which restores soil biology and fertility.

name: Argo
summary: Argo is an infrastructure project developer focused on optimizing economic and environmental value within agricultural communities. They collaborate with farmers, investors, and partners to develop sustainable projects, leveraging emerging financial opportunities. Their mission is to enrich communities, engage agriculture, and optimize value through impactful infrastructure development.

name: LENATEC GmbH
summary: LENATEC GmbH is an innovative service and trading company in the agricultural sector, based in the Lower Rhine region of Germany. Since its founding in 1994, the company has focused on soil nutrition for agriculture, offering various technologies and expert services. They collaborate with industrial and agricultural partners nationwide, utilizing regional by-products for local application, emphasizing sustainability, quality, reliability, and customer-oriented solutions.

name: AlphaSEVA
summary: AlphaSEVA is a company focused on sustainable agriculture and logistics, aiming to provide global market access for growers. The company's mission is to responsibly guide products from farm to table, ensuring quality, freshness, and safety through transparent supply chains. They bridge the gap between producers and consumers, promoting access to natural and wholesome foods.

name: AGRAVIS Ems-Jade GmbH
summary: AGRAVIS Ems-Jade GmbH is a regional partner for agriculture, operating as part of the larger AGRAVIS-Gruppe. The company offers a wide range of products and services including crop production, animal nutrition, agricultural products, agricultural services, energy, and digital solutions. They also operate Raiffeisen markets and fuel stations, serving both agricultural and retail customers.

name: Kilometro Zero
summary: Kilometro Zero is an online platform connecting local agricultural producers directly with consumers, promoting sustainable and healthy eating. It facilitates the sale of fresh, locally sourced products, reducing environmental impact and supporting local economies. The platform also features a blog with news and advice on sustainable agriculture.

name: Agronorte
summary: Agronorte is a Brazilian company with 40 years of tradition in the agribusiness sector, offering a comprehensive ecosystem of multi-services. They specialize in storage, grains, livestock, logistics, and nutrition, providing complete solutions for agricultural producers. The company also operates fuel stations, agricultural stores, and restaurants, and develops apps to optimize processes, demonstrating a commitment to innovation and supporting those who produce.

name: Koina
summary: Koina is a technology-driven agricultural ecosystem in Vietnam focused on enhancing the quality and efficiency of the agricultural sector. The company connects farmers with sales channels, distributes organic and sustainably grown produce, and supports farmers with technology and knowledge to improve productivity. Koina also offers integrated services including logistics, financing, and trading to create a data-driven farm-to-table ecosystem.

name: Mad Agriculture
summary: Mad Agriculture is a non-profit organization dedicated to fostering regenerative agriculture through a multi-faceted approach. They offer financing (Mad Capital), land and business planning (Mad Lands), marketplace solutions (Mad Markets), and community building (Mad Revolution) to support farmers in transitioning to sustainable practices. Their mission is inspired by Wendell Berry's 'Mad Farmer' poems, aiming to transform agriculture with love, community, and radicalism.

name: Akola group
summary: Akola group is an investment company managing one of the largest agricultural and food production groups in the Baltic states. The group operates across the entire food product value chain, from field to table, encompassing farming, food production, and related services. They emphasize sustainable operations and foster partnerships with farmers.

name: Versagro
summary: Versagro is an agricultural company focused on transforming the agricultural sector through innovation and technology. They offer a range of solutions including agricultural pesticides, organomineral foliar fertilizers, and soil fertilizers, aiming to increase productivity and sustainability. The company emphasizes building strong partnerships with producers based on trust, proximity, innovation, and mutual growth.

name: Mattawoman Creek Farms
summary: Mattawoman Creek Farms was an organic farming operation that ran from 2005 to 2025. The farm served several thousand customers and employed over 130 individuals during its operational period. The owners express gratitude to their supporters and wish everyone a healthy future.

name: Hofgut Dettenberg
summary: Hofgut Dettenberg is a family-run agricultural business focused on sustainable farming practices. They produce high-quality food products, including eggs, pasta, meat, poultry, sunflower oil, and a liqueur, all from their own livestock and crops. The company emphasizes animal welfare, soil health, and regenerative energy production, offering a direct-to-consumer sales model through weekly markets, local stores, and on-site sales. Additionally, they provide a holiday home rental service.

name: Il Frutteto del Palù
summary: Il Frutteto del Palù is an Italian agricultural company focused on sustainable farming and the production of authentic, healthy food products. They cultivate fruits and vegetables, transforming them entirely on their farm into juices, preserves, dried fruits, extra jams, and honey. The company emphasizes natural processes and is also committed to supporting bee populations for ecosystem health.

name: Gathering Ground
summary: Gathering Ground is a non-profit organization that blends agriculture, education, and conservation on its working and teaching farms. Their mission is to foster thriving communities connected to the environment and their food through sustainable farming practices, biodiversity promotion, community composting, and educational programs. They operate farms on Washington Island, Wisconsin, serving as a living laboratory for sustainable agriculture and conservation efforts.

name: Benton Group
summary: Benton Group operates multiple dairy farms focused on sustainable practices, community engagement, and animal welfare. They emphasize regenerative agriculture, including reduce-till, cover crops, and natural fertilizers, while also contributing to the regional economy through job creation and local partnerships. Their dairies are Validus Certified and NonGMO Project verified, reflecting a commitment to high standards in milk quality and environmental stewardship.

name: Agri Bio Conseil
summary: Agri Bio Conseil is a distributor of 100% organic agricultural products, serving organic farmers for over 20 years. They offer a wide range of organic products including plants, mixtures, soil amendments, and animal feed, backed by expert advice and a commitment to quality and environmental respect. The company operates within a 150-200 km radius around Bain de Bretagne, delivering to Brittany, Pays de la Loire, and Normandy.

name: AGRYSERV
summary: AGRYSERV, founded in 2007, initially focused on manufacturing oils and derived products. Currently, the company specializes in the development and consulting of biotechnological products for modern agriculture, aiming to provide sustainable and residue-free solutions. They offer a range of bionutrients, soil and foliar biostimulants, and deficiency correctors, supported by a technical team and R&D infrastructure.

name: Logan Contracting
summary: Logan Contracting is a family-operated agricultural business with over 40 years of experience, offering a comprehensive range of farm contracting services, freight transportation, and hay sales across Australia. They specialize in services like effluent management, crop cultivation, soil rejuvenation, and transport of various goods including hay, steel, timber, pallets, and machinery. The company emphasizes family values, professionalism, and sustainable land management, aiming to provide dependable service and expertise to farmers nationwide.

name: SEAGULL ADC
summary: Seagull ADC is an agricultural company focused on applying high technology to produce organic and safe produce for consumers. They aim to establish Vietnam as a leading nation in advanced agriculture with high-quality organic products for export. The company specializes in organic melons (honeydew and cantaloupe) and vegetables, offering solutions in microbial dòng, organic biotechnology, and plant protection.

name: B&B Agro
summary: B&B Agro is a Bulgarian representative, importer, and trader of organic liquid fertilizers and soil conditioners. They focus on foliar-soil nutrition and soil improvement, partnering with Australian company Growth Agriculture to develop sustainable and environmentally friendly agricultural enhancers. Their mission is to provide responsible agricultural solutions that support profitability while promoting ecological balance and food security.

name: LA PAYANA S.A.
summary: La Payana S.A. is a family-owned company established in 1989, engaged in agricultural and livestock activities. They produce grains such as wheat, barley, soy, corn, and sunflower, and raise cattle, completing the full cycle of livestock production. Additionally, they have diversified into intensive pig farming since 2012, focusing on quality production while respecting environmental values.

name: Mega Agro Group
summary: Mega Agro Group is an agricultural distributor focused on providing products and services to farmers. They offer a range of agricultural inputs including seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and machinery, as well as processed organic and semi-organic food products. The company emphasizes sustainable practices, clean technology, and efficient support to ensure farmer success and promote healthy living and food.

name: SEGERHULTS GÅRD AB
summary: Segerhults Gård AB is a family-run farm operating as a KRAV-certified organic agricultural business. They specialize in organic egg production, organic crop cultivation (wheat and oats), forestry, and operate a sawmill and lumberyard. The farm also sells fresh eggs directly from their on-site egg stand, emphasizing local production and a sustainable future for the countryside.

name: Chicheley Farms Ltd
summary: Chicheley Farms Ltd is a family-owned arable farming business located in North Buckinghamshire, England. They grow combinable crops and produce meadow hay, while also operating an on-site sawmill. The sawmill sustainably sources timber from the estate's woodlands to produce firewood, fencing materials, and various treated and untreated sawn woods. The company is committed to environmental protection and sustainable woodland management.

name: Vrienden van Herenboeren
summary: Vrienden van Herenboeren is a foundation supporting the Herenboeren movement, which aims to establish small-scale, nature-inclusive agriculture. They advocate for a shift towards healthier, more environmentally friendly food production systems that involve engaged consumers. The organization facilitates project applications, donations, and knowledge sharing to promote sustainable farming practices and local food supply.

name: Ayres del Sur
summary: Ayres del Sur is a company providing products and services for the agricultural sector with a strong commitment to sustainability. With over 40 years of experience, they offer aerial applications (planes and drones), drone maintenance, metallurgical solutions like modular housing and collection points, and logistics services for agricultural products. Their mission is to transform agricultural production into a sustainable model while ensuring quality and personalized customer service.

name: CNC Grondstoffen B.V.
summary: CNC Grondstoffen is a leading European supplier of substrates for mushroom cultivation, specializing in compost and casing soil. They are globally recognized for their expertise in mushroom substrate production, delivering high-quality, stable, and reliable products. The company emphasizes knowledge-driven quality and sustainability, with their compost being a cradle-to-cradle certified product.

name: ACE Ohlsson Pty Ltd
summary: ACE Ohlsson is a dedicated agricultural supplier providing a comprehensive range of products and services to support agribusiness from seed to market. They offer seed supplies, horticulture support, rural supplies, animal health products, and fertilizer solutions. With a team of experienced agronomists, they aim to help growers of all sizes achieve efficient and sustainable production.

name: ProAgria
summary: ProAgria is a Finnish organization providing expert services and solutions for agriculture and rural businesses. They offer consulting in farm management, finance, crop production, animal husbandry, and sustainable development. Their mission is to support the profitability and competitiveness of farms and to promote a vibrant rural economy through knowledge sharing and practical advice.

name: Agrotama Tunas Sarana
summary: Agrotama Tunas Sarana is a company specializing in the distribution of high-quality agricultural products, including fertilizers, seeds, and spraying equipment. They emphasize environmentally friendly and sustainable products, aiming to support crop growth and yield. The company operates through a network of 12 dealers and provides services like training and trials to its customers.

name: Senkor Group, Inc.
summary: Senkor Group is a family-owned corporation specializing in innovative products for agriculture, aquaculture, and water treatment. They offer private labeling, custom formulation, research and development, and comprehensive warehousing and fulfillment services. Their mission is to support future generations by making farming and aquatic management more practical and sustainable through science-backed solutions and decades of industry experience.

name: Central Farm Service (CFS)
summary: Central Farm Service (CFS) is a cooperative that provides agricultural products and services to its member-owners. Their offerings include agronomy, grain handling, feed, and energy solutions. CFS emphasizes a cooperative model where members own and guide the company, aiming to provide value and community support.

name: Olmix Group
summary: Olmix Group is a global company specializing in the development, production, and distribution of high-value biosourced solutions for livestock and crop farming. They offer innovative products for animal care, plant care, and mycotoxin risk management, leveraging nature and science for sustainable agriculture. Operating in over 100 countries, Olmix focuses on research and development to provide effective and environmentally friendly solutions.

name: CNC Grondstoffen B.V.
summary: CNC Grondstoffen is a leading European supplier of substrates for mushroom cultivation, specializing in compost and casing soil. They are globally recognized for their expertise in mushroom substrate production, delivering high-quality, stable, and reliable products. The company emphasizes knowledge-driven quality and sustainability, with their compost being a cradle-to-cradle certified product.

name: Global Control
summary: Global Control is a company founded in 2010 that provides innovative and sustainable solutions for the agribusiness sector. They specialize in agricultural adjuvants, pest control (flies and rodents), and egg trays, aiming to promote a sustainable and productive agricultural industry. Their mission is to deliver high-quality, intelligent solutions while prioritizing environmental respect and continuous innovation.

name: Biolandgärtnerei Erdfrüchte
summary: Biolandgärtnerei Erdfrüchte is a market garden operating for 40 years under Bioland guidelines, cultivating over 30 types of vegetables on approximately 3 hectares of open land and 2000 sqm of greenhouse space. They focus on organic farming practices, including organic fertilization, green manuring, and crop rotation, to ensure healthy produce. The company sells directly from their farm shop and at a local market.

name: Agrícola Nossa Senhora do Rocio
summary: Agrícola Nossa Senhora do Rocio aims to provide effective solutions for crop cultivation, offering excellent products and employing skilled professionals. The company focuses on agricultural support and solutions for plantations.

name: Biohof Rapp
summary: Biohof Rapp is a certified organic farm located in Harthausen, Germany, specializing in high-quality organic beef and free-range eggs. They also offer agricultural products like hay and straw, and operate a composting facility providing mulch, wood chips, planting soil, and compost. The farm emphasizes natural, sustainable practices, offering its products for pre-order and direct sale.

name: Nucleus
summary: Nucleus is a knowledge organization focused on developing integrated solutions for sustainability in the agricultural and forestry sectors. They offer expertise in natural resource management, sustainability certifications, and greenhouse gas emission reduction projects. Their mission is to provide customized and effective solutions, from strategic planning to implementation, enabling organizations to achieve sustainability goals and transition to a new economy.

name: Lantmännen
summary: Lantmännen is a Northern European agricultural cooperative and a leading player in agriculture, machinery, bioenergy, and food. The company offers a wide range of products and services for competitive farming, including machinery import and sales, bioenergy production, and the development and marketing of food products. They operate from farm to table, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and supporting a vital agricultural sector.

name: Agronorte
summary: Agronorte is a Brazilian company with 40 years of tradition in the agribusiness sector, offering a comprehensive ecosystem of multi-services. They specialize in storage, grains, livestock, logistics, and nutrition, providing complete solutions for agricultural producers. The company also operates fuel stations, agricultural stores, and restaurants, and develops apps to optimize processes, demonstrating a commitment to innovation and supporting those who produce.

name: エム・ティ・エル (MTL Inc.)
summary: MTL Inc. is a company dedicated to contributing to a sustainable society by addressing challenges in livestock, agriculture, and environmental conservation. They offer products and solutions derived from natural materials like 'Humus', focusing on water purification, feed customization, and soil improvement. Their offerings are utilized across various sectors including agriculture, livestock farming, and environmental management, with a strong emphasis on eco-friendly and safe products.

name: 琳琅娱乐 (Linlang Entertainment)
summary: Linlang Entertainment is a Chinese agricultural product supplier platform focused on 'Internet+Agriculture'. It aims to be a leading industry brand by providing online trading services for agricultural specialties, seeds, fresh produce, and medicinal materials. The platform also offers franchise opportunities for offline businesses, promoting ecological farming and sustainable agriculture.

name: Grupo Adubos Real
summary: Grupo Adubos Real is a Brazilian company dedicated to enhancing agricultural productivity through a wide range of products and services. They offer fertilizers, special fertilizers, essential fertilizers, fertigation solutions, adjuvants, bioactivators, seeds, and crop protection products. With a mission to contribute to the sustainable development of agribusiness and client success, they operate 90 stores and 5 industrial units across Brazil, serving over 50,000 clients annually.

name: PourDemain
summary: PourDemain is a grocery brand committed to promoting agriculture that respects the Earth and its inhabitants. It aims to bridge the gap between urban and rural areas, enabling everyone to participate in the transition towards healthy and responsible food consumption. The company supports farmers in producing sustainably and living with dignity, while empowering citizens to be part of a virtuous consumption model. Since 2018, PourDemain has expanded to over 600 stores in France and partnered with 500 producers, offering products that support French agricultural transition and fair farmer compensation.

name: People 4 Earth Foundation
summary: People 4 Earth Foundation is a Dutch non-profit organization dedicated to fostering sustainable and profitable food supply chains. They developed the AgriPlace Platform to enable farmers to share sustainability data with supply chain partners, simplifying compliance for all stakeholders. Their mission is to accelerate sustainable development in food supply chains by increasing transparency and harmonizing data, thereby promoting profitable, sustainable businesses that benefit people and the planet.

name: Tecno Agro s.r.l.
summary: Tecno Agro s.r.l. is an Italian company founded in 2017, specializing in the supply and production of fertilizers, phytosanitary products, and other agricultural supplies for both wholesale and retail markets. The company also offers professional technical consulting services to its clients and members of a cooperative founded by its owners. It aims to promote innovation and sustainability in agriculture, leveraging over 30 years of family experience in the agri-food sector.

name: The Friends of Hilltop Hanover Farm & Environmental Center
summary: The Friends of Hilltop Hanover Farm & Environmental Center is dedicated to advancing sustainable agriculture, environmental stewardship, community education, and accessible food systems. They offer programs, events, volunteer opportunities, and operate a farm stand, emphasizing food security and native plant initiatives. The organization serves as an environmental center and community hub.

name: Matellus
summary: Matellus is a company focused on developing and providing sustainable products for the agricultural and industrial sectors. They offer micronutrients for crop nutrition to enhance yields and specialized solutions for industrial processes, including wastewater treatment and general chemicals. Their mission is to improve global sustainability by offering environmentally friendly products that also benefit their clients.

name: Asociación Juntas Arreglamos la Biosfera (aleJAB)
summary: aleJAB is a non-profit association focused on regenerative agriculture and livestock practices to combat desertification and restore soil fertility. As an ally of the Savory Institute, it promotes Holistic Management, a decision-making framework for land regeneration. The organization also participates in projects like Go GRASS, which uses innovative agro-livestock practices and technology to certify grassland restoration and environmental services.

name: Beejom Grám Sanctuary
summary: Beejom Grám Sanctuary is an animal sanctuary and sustainable agricultural farm located in Uttar Pradesh, India. It practices natural farming techniques, focusing on indigenous cattle and heirloom seeds to produce organic manure, biogas, and traditional foods like millets. The organization aims to restore food security, health, and ecological wealth by working with farmers to transition to organic, holistic farming methods and operates completely off the grid using solar power, biogas, and rainwater harvesting.

name: 陕西昶源生态农业股份有限公司
summary: 陕西昶源生态农业股份有限公司 is a comprehensive "other services" enterprise focused on providing professional, efficient, and attentive one-stop service experiences. The company emphasizes quality, customer satisfaction, and integrity, aiming to be a leader in its field. They offer customized solutions and have a strong service system built on years of practical experience in the "general" sector.

name: Agrotec
summary: Agrotec is a regional leader in the agricultural sector, specializing in the commercialization of agricultural inputs such as fertilizers, pesticides, and seeds. They also offer services including pesticide sales, training, crop monitoring, and harvest sales consulting. The company emphasizes productivity, sustainability, and building trust with rural producers, having been in operation since 2003.

name: Growers Transplanting Inc. (GTI)

summary: Llopis y Llopis is a family-owned company with over 50 years of experience in the agricultural sector. summary: Azienda Agricola Giovannini is an agricultural company focused on producing genuine, locally sourced food products. name: Les Vergers du Mékong
summary: Les Vergers du Mékong is a company dedicated to sustainable development, promoting sustainable agriculture and local ingredients. summary: Antelagro offers solutions for crops, including conventional and ecological phytosanitary products, organic and mineral fertilizers, and foliar fertilizers. summary: Charrua Agrícola is a company that has been providing technology solutions to rural producers for over 34 years. name: Enza Zaden
summary: Enza Zaden is a global seed company specializing in the breeding, production, and marketing of vegetable seeds. The company serves professional growers worldwide, providing them with high-performance seeds to optimize their cultivation and yield.

summary: Biohof Lüssi is a family-run organic farm in Turbenthal, Switzerland, offering services such as green waste disposal, a local heating network (Wärmeverbund), and direct sales of milk, compost, cattle manure, and wood chips. summary: Zoberbac Agrocompany S.L. is a company specializing in crop nutrition and protection solutions for modern agriculture. name: OpenFarm
summary: OpenFarm is a social enterprise focused on transforming agribusiness by connecting farmers with traders, experts, and students. summary: Yutakawa Inc. operates Yutakawa Farm, which cultivates pesticide and chemical fertilizer-free rice and vegetables in the Higashi-Mikawa region of Aichi Prefecture, utilizing the blessings of the Toyokawa irrigation system. name: CIGRA
summary: CIGRA is a company that provides comprehensive solutions to agricultural producers, focusing on inputs, commodity trading, and production. name: SA VERNAZOBRES FRERES
summary: SA VERNAZOBRES FRERES is a family-run company with 90 years of tradition, dedicated to supporting sustainable, profitable, and productive agriculture. name: Innova Biologica
summary: Innova Biologica is an Italian company focused on developing and promoting natural substances for organic, natural, and sustainable agriculture. summary: Hirzel Farms is a family-owned agricultural business with nearly a century of experience in organic and sustainable farming. summary: AgriGanics offers sustainable agricultural solutions for cropping, dairy, sheep and beef, and horticultural clients. summary: Conap provides knowledge and access to financial resources for agricultural producers and agro-industries. summary: AgroVision develops and provides next-generation agricultural software solutions designed to enhance efficiency and responsibility in farming. summary: The Associação de Agricultores para Produção Integrada de Frutos de Montanha (AAPIM) is an association dedicated to promoting sustainable agriculture, specifically integrated production and organic farming methods. They focus on building stable customer bases across multiple sectors and providing professional services for industry qualification applications.

name: Nexem
summary: Nexem is an agricultural technology company specializing in the design, engineering, and integration of high-tech indoor farming solutions. They offer state-of-the-art grow system design, including modular containerized facilities and a proprietary AliceOS™ SaaS platform for control and automation. Nexem serves licensed indoor producers and greenhouse cultivators in North America, aiming to optimize manufactured consistency in high-value plant cultivation.

name: La ferme des Hauts Champs
summary: La ferme des Hauts Champs is a biological market gardening farm located in the Anjou and Touraine region of France. The farm specializes in cultivating organic vegetables on approximately 0.5 hectares, utilizing a sandy soil type. They offer direct sales of their produce through farm-gate sales, weekly baskets (with or without subscription), and an AMAP-style 'Paniers de Céline' service, prioritizing heirloom varieties and growing their own seedlings. The farm is certified organic and is also involved in a project called 'Toutilo'.

name: Green Balcony
summary: Green Balcony is an e-commerce company specializing in products for urban gardening and balcony living. They offer a wide range of items including balcony greenhouses, pots, planters, furniture, indoor and vertical garden systems, birdhouses, insect hotels, and decorative items. The company emphasizes European manufacturing for its products and aims to help customers transform their living spaces into green oases.

name: TTA-ISO
summary: TTA-ISO provides high-tech automation solutions for the horticulture and food industries, focusing on empowering growers worldwide. They develop cutting-edge automation, software, and integrated systems to enhance productivity, improve yields, and drive sustainable progress. Their solutions address challenges such as labor shortages, increasing demands, and competitiveness across sectors like ornamentals, bulbs, cut flowers, food, and forestry.

name: BIO-MAYER
summary: Bio-Mayer is a family-operated organic farm and delivery service based in the Lake Constance region, Germany. They specialize in growing over 35 types of vegetables on approximately 75 hectares of open land and 2.2 hectares of greenhouse space, adhering to Bioland and Demeter guidelines. The company offers a direct-to-consumer delivery service for fresh organic produce, operates weekly markets, and sells young plants, also catering to businesses, kindergartens, and schools.

name: Aeroponics Hellas P.C.
summary: Aeroponics Hellas P.C. is an innovative Greek startup specializing in aeroponic and hydroponic cultivation systems. The company focuses on eco-green technologies, research, and development, offering expertise in designing and operating advanced agricultural units. Their mission is to promote aeroponics as a sustainable farming method, aiming for significant water savings and reduced CO2 emissions.

name: Sierra Valley Farms
summary: Sierra Valley Farms is a 65-acre certified organic farm and nursery located in the Sierra Valley, California, at an elevation of 5,000 feet. Established in 1990 as a native plant nursery and expanding to organic produce in 1999, the farm cultivates a variety of cool-season vegetables, fruits, microgreens, herbs, and hops. They also produce value-added condiments and operate an on-farm farmers market, restaurant CSAs, and host farm dining events, serving the Reno/Tahoe area.

name: SmileLeaf Spica Division, Hokuriku Kikai Co., Ltd.
summary: SmileLeaf Spica Division, part of Hokuriku Kikai Co., Ltd., operates a fully enclosed hydroponic farm producing lettuce. Their controlled indoor environment ensures pest-free, pesticide-free produce that is clean and ready to eat. They offer year-round production, stabilizing prices and providing a consistent supply of high-quality vegetables, available for purchase online.

name: Aglantis Pty Ltd
summary: Aglantis Pty Ltd specializes in precision farming and irrigation solutions, offering automated irrigation systems, farm management software, and AI-driven tools from FJ Dynamics. They aim to help farmers in Queensland increase productivity while conserving resources like water and power. The company also provides compliance and consulting services related to sustainability and record-keeping for enhanced farm profitability.

name: Hidrocultivos Australianos, S.A. de C.V.
summary: Hidrocool, also known as Hidrocultivos Australianos, is a Mexican company specializing in hydroponic cultivation of a wide variety of lettuces, vegetables, and greens. They focus on providing fresh, high-quality produce year-round using sustainable practices that minimize environmental impact, such as water conservation and avoiding pesticides. The company offers a range of products including loose leaves, lettuce mixes, salad kits, and packaged vegetables, aiming to make healthy eating convenient and accessible.

name: ООО «Аграрные Технологии Будущего»
summary: ООО «Аграрные Технологии Будущего» is a Russian company operating the first plant in Russia for growing plants using smart and convenient agriculture technology. They specialize in producing fresh greens like salads, herbs, and microgreens year-round, independent of external conditions, using hydroponics and purified water without pesticides. The company supplies its products to stores, restaurants, and individual consumers, emphasizing safety, convenience, and taste.

name: Happy Underground
summary: Happy Underground is a petite market garden focused on growing vegetables in healthy soil for hyper-local consumption. They operate on a small scale, emphasizing human-powered labor, fossil fuel-free operations, and a commitment to ecological practices. The garden provides produce for about 20 local families, selling exclusively within Yackandandah and sourcing inputs locally.

name: Agrourbis Agricoltura Urbana
summary: Agrourbis, founded by Ivan Zecchin, specializes in urban agriculture, promoting the creation of domestic, corporate, and hotel gardens. The company offers services ranging from garden design and maintenance to urban farming solutions, emphasizing sustainability, local food production, and employee well-being through ortoterapia (horticultural therapy). Their mission is to make fresh, seasonal produce accessible in urban environments, enhancing quality of life and environmental consciousness.

name: Raumgarten
summary: Raumgarten offers an indoor gardening system designed to grow fresh herbs, vegetables, and microgreens at home. Their system emphasizes ease of use, automation for watering and lighting, and aims to provide significantly more nutrients and flavor compared to supermarket produce. The company promotes a sustainable approach by reducing food miles and waste, offering a wide variety of plantable seeds.

name: Lindegaard
summary: Lindegaard is a company specializing in the cultivation and trade of organic fruits and vegetables. They offer a range of products including traditional and old Dutch varieties of apples, pears, plums, and cherries, as well as seasonal vegetables sourced from a network of local growers. Lindegaard sells directly to consumers at a weekly organic farmers' market in Amsterdam and supplies products to farm shops, market vendors, and the hospitality industry. They are SKAL certified, emphasizing their commitment to environmentally responsible agricultural practices.

name: Gully Hydroponic
summary: Gully Hydroponic is an Indonesian company founded by farmers specializing in hydroponic systems. They offer a one-stop solution for hydroponic farming, providing essential components like drain pipes, end caps, joiners, and net pots. The company operates hydroponic farms in Bogor and Bali, aiming to make a significant regional impact in the hydroponics sector.

name: Corvus Group GmbH
summary: Corvus Group GmbH operates under brands like Schloss Beuchow, Landware, and Neue Gärtnerei, focusing on sustainable agriculture and innovative cultivation methods. They aim to create a foundation for a sustainable future by promoting conscious living, eating, and shopping through their offerings. The company emphasizes preserving old values while developing new, eco-friendly farming techniques.

name: 金天雨生态科技（北京）有限公司
summary: Jintianyu Ecological Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on aquaponic ecological farms. The company integrates R&D, farm design, cultivation, and sales to deliver safe, green, and pollution-free vegetables and fish. They aim to reduce investment costs for farm investors, making urban agriculture profitable and accessible. Their mission is to be a leading provider of modern urban agriculture solutions, contributing to the development of the sector and bringing healthy, organic produce to households.

name: Emerald Agriculture Technologies Ltd.
summary: Emerald Agriculture Technologies (EAT) provides advanced agriculture solutions, primarily focused on controlled environment greenhouse frameworks to meet the growing global demand for such systems. They offer complete, innovative solutions including project management, consulting, and marketing services, extending from project inception through ongoing production management and guidance. EAT aims to exceed client expectations by leveraging their proven innovative abilities and a comprehensive view of agricultural projects.

name: Hydro Agritech
summary: Hydro Agritech specializes in the manufacturing and supply of hydroponic growing systems and polyhouses for commercial and home growers. Established in 2014, the company offers solutions for vine crops (Bucket System) and leafy greens (NFT System), alongside controlled environment polyhouses. They also provide comprehensive business solutions, services like seminars and consultations, and custom nutrient formulations to support successful hydroponic farming.

name: Wiru Vili TÜH
summary: Wiru Vili TÜH is an organic producers' cooperative focused on the core values of organic farming and high-quality services. They are involved in the purchase and sale of grain, promoting a holistic view of biointensive agriculture where the farm, animals, and humans are seen as an integrated system. The cooperative emphasizes the interconnectedness of changes within this system.

name: Numazon s.r.o.
summary: Numazon specializes in hydroponic and aquaponic cultivation systems, offering solutions for ecological and soil-less farming. They provide plant nutrients, automation systems, and complete cultivation setups, aiming to enable year-round fresh harvests with reduced water usage and environmental impact. With over a decade of experience, Numazon caters to both beginners and experienced growers seeking efficient and sustainable agricultural practices.

name: 夏县庙前镇杨村蔬菜基地
summary: 夏县庙前镇杨村蔬菜基地, designated as the Xia County Yangcun Agricultural Science and Technology Demonstration Park, is a large-scale agricultural operation established in 1999. It specializes in the cultivation of organic vegetables, including tomatoes, cucumbers, lettuce, peppers, and napa cabbage, across over 2200 mu of land, with 1300 mu dedicated to standard solar greenhouses. The base also operates a 50-mu wholesale market, facilitating sales to local and distant markets, and has invested significantly in infrastructure development. The operation follows a 'five unifications' model for planning, land allocation, standards, construction, and technical guidance, while maintaining individual investment and operational principles.

name: Gemüsehof Dietmar Meese
summary: Gemüsehof Dietmar Meese was a farm specializing in organic produce, operating weekly markets and a farm shop. The business is ceasing operations due to the owner's age, lack of successors, and the increasing economic pressures within the organic farming sector. The farm also served as an educational site for aspiring gardeners and a habitat for local wildlife.

name: Arianetech Pte Ltd
summary: Arianetech Pte Ltd specializes in advanced agri-technology, providing integrated solutions for urban and indoor vertical farming. They offer proprietary LED grow lights (EZYGRO®) and indoor vertical farming systems (SMART-AGRO®), alongside end-to-end consultancy services. Their mission is to support the development of highly efficient, energy-saving, and technically advanced urban farms to produce high-quality crops with high yields in controlled environments, aligning with Agriculture 4.0 principles.

name: ビニールハウスドットコム (Vinyl House.com)
summary: ビニールハウスドットコム specializes in custom-made agricultural vinyl greenhouses and smart farming materials like automatic irrigation systems. They offer direct import of high-quality products at competitive prices, aiming to support farmers by reducing equipment investment costs. The company provides both standard and bespoke greenhouse solutions, along with smart agriculture equipment to enhance efficiency and reduce labor.

name: Le jardin des Aspes
summary: Le jardin des Aspes is a small-scale organic farm that sells locally grown produce directly from the garden. They emphasize "bio & local" practices, with no chemical treatments used, relying on natural fertilizers and soil enrichment. The farm offers a variety of seasonal vegetables and fruits, with a focus on quality and direct customer interaction. The owner is transitioning to a reduced activity, focusing on subsistence farming while continuing to share their passion for pesticide-free cultivation.

name: Tuinderij De Volle Grond
summary: Tuinderij De Volle Grond is a social, local, and organic farm located on the historic vegetable garden of Nieuw Amelisweerd. They cultivate and sell organic vegetables, fruits, and herbs through a "groentetas" (vegetable bag) subscription service for shareholders in and around Utrecht. The farm also provides opportunities for "arbeidsmatige activering" (work-based activation), volunteers, and interns, integrating diverse people into their operations.

name: Plant form Inc.
summary: Plant form Inc. specializes in aquaponics, a sustainable farming method that integrates fish and plant cultivation. They offer a range of services including entry support, facility tours, training, operational assistance, and direct sales. The company aims to promote eco-friendly agriculture and provides solutions for businesses looking to adopt this innovative farming technique.

name: Biolandhof Adrion GbR
summary: Biolandhof Adrion is a farm that has been managed according to certified organic guidelines for over 30 years. They specialize in growing a wide variety of fruits and vegetables, including apples, pears, berries, stone fruits, and open-field vegetables. The farm operates a farm shop and sells its produce at local weekly markets, emphasizing direct sales and regional sourcing.

name: Partalan Tila
summary: Partalan Tila is a Finnish farm that offers modern organic farming and professional excavator contracting services. They specialize in growing organic gluten-free oats and provide land construction services with 15 years of experience. The farm is operated by Katariina and Veli-Matti Kalliokoski.

name: Hof Barmbach - Heun GbR
summary: Hof Barmbach is an organic farm located in Niederbrechen, Germany, that practices ecological agriculture. They raise various animals including cows, bulls, pigs, chickens, and bees, and cultivate crops like potatoes and grains. The farm directly markets its high-quality organic products through its farm shop and online store, offering a range of items from meat and dairy to produce and honey.

name: Maitri Farm
summary: Maitri Farm is a certified organic farm located in upstate New York that grows vegetables and cut flowers using holistic agricultural practices. They offer a Certified Organic Vegetable CSA, farm stand sales, and wholesale options. The farm also emphasizes education through workshops on sustainable living and has partnered with Equiti Trading to promote financial literacy and economic empowerment within the community.

name: Marstorps Mat
summary: Marstorps Mat is a Swedish vegetable farming operation that has taken a temporary pause from selling produce after nearly ten years. While they are not selling this year, they remain enthusiastic about cultivation and encourage others to grow their own or seek out similar local producers. The company previously operated on a subscription model, delivering vegetables directly to consumers and employing staff.

name: Rootster
summary: Rootster is an e-commerce platform specializing in lighting solutions and supplies for urban farming, hobby gardening, and large-scale agricultural complexes. They offer a range of specialized lamps, fertilizers, and growing media, alongside educational resources through their blog and school. The company aims to support and educate city farmers and enthusiasts in optimizing plant growth.

name: Bauernhof Martin Zschoche
summary: Bauernhof Martin Zschoche is a farm offering high-quality, sustainable food directly from the farm. They specialize in organic vegetables, berries, and nuts, and also provide consulting services related to agroforestry and farming practices. The farm emphasizes community engagement and educational events, such as their 'Lebendige Landschaften' (Living Landscapes) initiative.

name: Ciclo Tecnologias
summary: Ciclo Tecnologias offers an innovative smart planter designed to simplify plant cultivation for consumers. Their product, 'Ciclo,' automates watering and provides intelligent alerts for water and battery levels, allowing users to grow a variety of plants, from herbs and vegetables to ornamental flowers. The company emphasizes ease of use, sustainability in design, and domestic production, aiming to reconnect people with nature.

name: 义田农场 (Yitian Farm)
summary: Yitian Farm operates as a wholesale membership procurement and trading service platform for organic and ecological farms. It aims to connect consumers and suppliers through its Yitian Community platform, fostering a symbiotic and sustainable ecosystem. The company also offers internet supply chain center services through Yitian Supply Chain, enhancing operational efficiency and reducing costs for merchants by integrating online and offline professional markets.

name: MIRAI Co., Ltd.
summary: MIRAI Co., Ltd. is a company specializing in the development and operation of plant factories, producing high-quality vegetables with a focus on safety, taste, and sustainability. They offer plant factory equipment sales, business planning, and operational support, leveraging their extensive experience as a producer to help clients establish and optimize their own plant factory businesses. Their mission is to contribute to global development and prosperity by providing 'peace of mind' and 'excitement' to customers and business partners.

name: ForestBit
summary: ForestBit is an innovative company focused on sustainable urban farming solutions. They develop and implement hydroponic rooftop farms and modular indoor systems to provide fresh, local produce year-round. ForestBit also offers educational tools for environmental and science subjects, aiming to integrate technology with sustainability.

name: TheSproutHub
summary: TheSproutHub is an e-commerce company specializing in indoor hydroponic growing systems. Their flagship product, TheSproutHub, allows users to grow herbs, vegetables, and flowers year-round without soil, using nutrient-rich water and an integrated LED grow light. The company emphasizes ease of use, faster growth, eco-friendliness, and cost savings on groceries, positioning itself as a provider of convenient home gardening solutions.

name: R&D AquaFarms Inc.
summary: R&D AquaFarms Inc. is an agricultural company that has merged with Bite-Sized Botany, a creator of microgreen terrariums. Bite-Sized Botany specializes in personalizable microgreen terrariums designed for countertops and artistic display. The merger allows R&D AquaFarms to expand its offerings into the microgreen and decorative plant market.

name: Kendall Farms
summary: Kendall Farms is a self-sustaining farm focused on growing flowers for both wholesale and retail markets. They emphasize sustainable practices, utilizing reclaimed water, solar power, and on-farm compost. The company aims to exceed flower expectations through their dedication to quality and environmental responsibility.

name: Multiplicare Plantas
summary: Multiplicare Plantas specializes in plant production technology, focusing on producing healthy and vigorous seedlings for agricultural productivity. They offer services such as in vitro seedling production, development of new in vitro production protocols, biofactory consulting, and seed sowing for difficult-to-germinate or dormant seeds. Additionally, they have developed 'JardinVitro,' an urban gardening product featuring decorative flasks with small plants in a nutrient medium.

name: 惠州益植农业科技有限公司
summary: 惠州益植农业科技有限公司 (Yizhi Agricultural Technology) is a high-tech enterprise focused on the research, development, and manufacturing of digital agriculture and plant factory technologies. Leveraging nearly 20 patented technologies in plant environment control, the company integrates international hydroponic experts and domestic agricultural research teams to provide advanced solutions for controlled environment agriculture. Their offerings include solar-powered facilities, plant factories, and related agricultural technologies, aiming to innovate and transform modern farming practices.

name: Anything Grows
summary: Anything Grows is a certified organic, no-till market garden and plant nursery based in Salisbury, Massachusetts. They offer a variety of products including certified organic dahlia tubers, a Winter Tulip CSA, and gift certificates. The company also provides opportunities for employment and volunteering within their farming operations.

name: La Ferme Kabocha
summary: La Ferme Kabocha is a farm dedicated to producing organic vegetables, emphasizing environmental respect and consumer well-being. They operate on a small, human-scale model, focusing on local, short-circuit sales and offering a diverse range of about forty vegetables. The farm allows customers to purchase directly through online orders, subscription baskets, and at their farm stand or local markets.

name: Indoorvolkstuin
summary: Indoorvolkstuin offers year-round indoor gardening opportunities in professional greenhouses located in Rijnsburg. Customers can rent plots to grow organic vegetables, fruits, and flowers in an ideal climate, benefiting from expert advice and a supportive community. The facility also features a biological store selling fresh produce and organic meats, with delivery services available in the surrounding areas.

name: Dancing Gnome Farm
summary: Dancing Gnome Farm is a certified organic farm that provides fresh, high-quality vegetables to consumers. They emphasize sustainable growing practices and select varieties for superior flavor. The farm offers various ways to access their produce, including online pre-orders, a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) program, and sales at farmers' markets.

name: KG Systems
summary: KG Systems specializes in realizing innovative internal transport systems, focusing on automated and manual solutions for horticulture. They offer a comprehensive portfolio including cultivation tables, vertical farming systems, and mobile container systems designed to maximize internal transport efficiency. With a strong emphasis on personalized service, sustainable approaches, and in-house design and production, KG Systems aims to provide tailored solutions for growers worldwide.

name: M Leggate and Sons (Produce) LTD
summary: M Leggate and Sons (Produce) LTD is a long-established company with over 70 years of experience in growing and supplying brassica vegetables, including cauliflower, broccoli, cabbages, kale, and cavolo nero. They specialize in vegetable preparation and packing, operating advanced facilities in the UK to meet customer specifications. The company emphasizes sustainable farming practices, innovation, quality, and continuity of supply, serving the retail and food service sectors.

name: Gardners.cz
summary: Gardners.cz specializes in the design, implementation, and maintenance of vertical gardens, living plant walls, and moss art installations for interior spaces. They offer a range of plant-related products and services, including plant rental, interior planters, and workshops, aiming to enhance indoor environments with greenery. The company also operates a retail store and showroom, alongside an e-shop for direct sales.

name: Roof Food
summary: Roof Food is a sustainable urban farming initiative that started in 2014 as Belgium's first rooftop garden. They grow produce in the city with a social mission, supplying local restaurants, caterers, shops, and their own events. The location also serves as a venue for meetings, workshops, and dining experiences.

name: 网胜互联学院
summary: Wang Sheng Hu Lian Academy is involved in a diverse range of activities including fruit and vegetable cultivation, wholesale and retail of fresh produce, and primary agricultural product acquisition. They also engage in internet sales of non-licensed goods, packaging services, and the sale of packaging materials and equipment. Additionally, the company offers technical services, development, consulting, exchange, transfer, and promotion, indicating a broad operational scope within the agricultural and technical service sectors.

name: Oakcroft Organic Market Garden
summary: Oakcroft is a 2-acre certified organic market garden that cultivates a diverse range of vegetables. The produce is sold locally within a 20-mile radius, serving consumers, chefs, and greengrocers. The organization emphasizes organic methods and direct sales through initiatives like their 'Veg Box' scheme.

name: OGarden Smart
summary: OGarden Smart appears to be an e-commerce platform or brand specializing in indoor gardening systems and related products. They offer systems for growing food indoors, peat pellets, and seeds, aiming to help consumers cultivate over $1,000 worth of food annually. The site also features gardening tips and promotions, indicating a focus on home gardening solutions.

name: Dr Greenthumb Shop
summary: Dr Greenthumb Shop is an e-commerce platform focused on promoting sustainable and organic gardening and farming practices. They offer a range of safe and halal products, including fertilizers, pest control, plant boosters, and soil care, catering to both urban and rural needs. The company aims to foster a healthier and greener community through accessible gardening solutions.

name: Caloona
summary: Caloona presents itself as a provider of "Farming Solutions for Tomorrow." The website offers a contact form for inquiries and a signup for updates, indicating a focus on agricultural technology or services. Its primary goal appears to be engaging potential clients and partners interested in modern farming approaches.

name: サニーライン株式会社
summary: Sunnyline Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in hydroponic cultivation, delivering fresh produce grown with ample sunlight to tables. Their website highlights the benefits of their cultivation method, including consistent harvests and healthy seedlings. The company appears to be focused on agricultural innovation and direct-to-consumer sales or distribution.

name: DOANH NGHIỆP TƯ NHÂN TM DV CÔNG NGHỆ HẢI TRÂN
summary: DOANH NGHIỆP TƯ NHÂN TM DV CÔNG NGHỆ HẢI TRÂN, operating under the brand "Vườn Tại Nhà", specializes in designing, consulting, and installing automated aquaponics systems for home use. They offer integrated solutions for organic vegetable and fish farming, emphasizing minimal maintenance, no soil, no fertilizer, and no daily watering. The company also provides related supplies such as grow beds, fish tanks, and seeds, aiming to make sustainable home farming accessible.

name: CEA Advisors LLC
summary: CEA Advisors LLC provides consulting services and innovative solutions for the development of Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) indoor farming projects. They offer expertise to both commercial growers and investors, focusing on economically viable projects and appropriate technology selection. With extensive experience in horticulture since 1971 and CEA for over 15 years, they deliver a holistic, hands-on approach to CEA project development.

name: Natuurlijk Klein Dongen
summary: Natuurlijk Klein Dongen is a family-run business that combines organic farming with retail, event hosting, and educational activities. They cultivate tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers in greenhouses, alongside a vegetable garden and a food forest, selling their produce in their own organic shop. The company also offers workshops and tours to share their knowledge of sustainable agriculture and provides spaces for events and team building.

name: Magni Piante Società Semplice Agricola
summary: Magni Piante is an agricultural company with three generations of experience in the green sector, specializing in plants and greenery. They offer professional consultancy for businesses, focusing on passion, experience, and reliability. Their mission is to bring greenery worldwide, with a particular emphasis on sustainable practices like water resource management for agricultural purposes.

name: Arvensis Spółka z ograniczoną odpowiedzialnością
summary: Arvensis is a company with over 25 years of experience in the field of field vegetables, specializing in providing high-quality seeds, seedlings, and onion sets. They offer expert advice on crop management and help clients increase profits by selecting the best solutions. The company also assists clients with product sales and introduces innovative cultivation methods and technologies to the market.

name: Gärtnerhof Borby
summary: Gärtnerhof Borby is a farm specializing in organically certified cultivation, indicated by its DEÖKO022SH certification. They focus on ecological agriculture and support its adoption and maintenance. The farm offers produce through weekly markets in Eckernförde and Schleswig, as well as direct sales at their farm stand from May to October. They also provide a 'vegetable plot' service, allowing customers to have their own dedicated plot.

name: Grincell
summary: Grincell offers modular growing cells designed for modern agriculture, providing protection against weather and pests while ensuring crop yield. Their system features self-watering capabilities, modular expansion, cost-effectiveness due to no need for concrete foundations, and easy assembly/disassembly. The product aims to address challenges posed by climate change and rising vegetable prices by offering a convenient and efficient solution for gardeners and small-scale farmers.

name: Orgânicos da Fátima
summary: Orgânicos da Fátima is a family-run organic farm specializing in the production and delivery of fresh, certified organic fruits, vegetables, and herbs. They offer subscription boxes in various sizes, as well as an online market for individual purchases. The company emphasizes sustainable agriculture, supporting small producers, and providing customizable options for their customers.

name: Onna Greens AS
summary: Onna Greens AS is a Norwegian company that cultivates ready-to-eat salads using advanced vertical hydroponic farming in a high-tech, controlled environment in Moss. Their "clean room production" method ensures year-round availability of pesticide-free, naturally clean salads with extended shelf life, grown without soil and requiring no washing. The company focuses on delivering fresh, locally grown produce with reduced transportation distances.

name: Fitotech Hydroponics
summary: Fitotech Hydroponics is an innovative agricultural company based in Luxembourg that utilizes advanced hydroponic technologies to produce ultra-fresh leafy greens and microgreens. Their mission is to create ecologically clean and efficient food production systems with a minimal carbon footprint, offering affordable, healthy, and high-quality produce year-round. They focus on sustainable practices, including eco-friendly packaging and optimized cultivation methods.

name: HYDRO EARTH
summary: Hydro Earth is a company specializing in the design, consulting, and construction of cultivation facilities, particularly for the hydroponic indoor gardening sector. Founded in 2009, they offer expertise in creating efficient processes, eliminating redundancy in design, and providing nationwide construction services. They aim to help clients build the best possible cultivation facilities, leveraging established industry relationships and a professional team to resolve issues within 24 hours.

name: AgroMation
summary: AgroMation provides customized, automated, and sustainable grow systems for both commercial operations and residential homes. Their mission is to simplify the growing process by merging nature with advanced technology, offering organic, healthy, and chemical-free plant growth solutions. They focus on user-friendly interfaces and high-quality components to deliver efficient and reliable plant cultivation.

name: M式水耕研究所
summary: M式水耕研究所 specializes in developing innovative hydroponic cultivation methods that add value beyond the inherent benefits of hydroponics. They focus on creating production techniques that are less dependent on natural environmental conditions, developing labor-saving equipment, and establishing high-quality production systems and high-income production models. The company offers comprehensive hydroponic business solutions, including artificial light and solar-powered systems, and has a proven track record as a pioneer in hydroponics in Japan.

name: 株式会社ハートフルマネジメント
summary: 株式会社ハートフルマネジメント specializes in the planning, design, and sale of plant systems, particularly their proprietary "808 Plant System." This system utilizes closed-type artificial light cultivation with high-efficiency LED panels for pesticide-free hydroponic vegetable production. They also focus on supporting employment for individuals with disabilities and sell their "808 brand" vegetables produced through this system.

name: CV Hydro
summary: CV Hydro specializes in hydroponic and soilless farming solutions, offering a range of nutrient products, consulting services, and educational programs. They aim to empower communities with sustainable farming techniques to make pesticide-free food accessible. The company also acts as a certified dealer for Bluelab Corporation in India, providing advanced farming equipment.

name: Van Woerden Flevo
summary: Van Woerden Flevo is a company specializing in the organic cultivation, processing, and supply of agricultural products, primarily potatoes and carrots. They focus on sustainable farming practices, utilizing light machinery and closed-loop water systems. The company offers a range of services including washing, polishing, hydro-cooling, and sorting, delivering fresh produce directly to processors, wholesalers, and retailers with a commitment to quality and year-round supply.

name: Biohof am Hollerberg Agrar GbR
summary: Biohof am Hollerberg is an organic farm operating under the Bioland association guidelines in the Donnersbergkreis region of Germany. The farm cultivates approximately 75 hectares, focusing on crop farming with an 8-year crop rotation and also raising livestock including sheep, goats, and laying hens. They emphasize circular economy principles, landscape maintenance, biodiversity, and direct sales through an on-site farm shop.

name: Conill de les Serretes
summary: Conill de les Serretes is a family-run business with over 30 years of experience in rabbit farming. They utilize modern, adapted facilities with climate control to ensure optimal conditions for their livestock. The company offers its products for sale to shops, restaurants, and directly to consumers' homes.

name: Reppe Søndre
summary: Reppe Søndre is a family-run farm located in Trondheim, Norway, focused on engaging the local community in food production through sustainable, urban agriculture. The farm cultivates grains for flour production, offers event venue rentals, and provides mini-storage units. It also hosts various community projects including a CSA (Reppe Andelslandbruk), a school garden program, and an integration project (Dype Røtter) that operates a cafe and vegetable sales, aiming to preserve local farming knowledge and promote Norwegian agriculture.

name: Aquaponics USA
summary: Aquaponics USA is a company specializing in aquaponics systems, which combine aquaculture (raising fish) with hydroponics (growing plants without soil). They offer various "PLUG & GROW" STEM and family food growing systems, including compact and larger models, along with Hydroton growing media and STEM curriculum materials. The company aims to provide innovative food-growing technology that allows users to grow food anywhere, without land or sunlight, by creating a symbiotic relationship between fish and plants.

name: UpTerra
summary: UpTerra is a farm performance technology company that enhances agricultural water using advanced physics and bio-frequencies to mimic rainwater.
