Their TerraFlow device integrates into existing irrigation systems, aiming to significantly increase crop yields while reducing the need for water and other agricultural inputs. The company supports a wide range of crops and growers, positioning itself as an innovator in sustainable farming practices.

name: Agricola Fior di Frutta S.S.
summary: Agricola Fior di Frutta is an agricultural company focused on cultivating fruit trees for a 'self-service' harvest experience. They aim to provide consumers with direct access to orchards, ensuring absolute freshness and producer-to-consumer pricing by eliminating intermediaries. The company is committed to producing high-quality, organic fruit, promoting ethical and sustainable farming practices, fostering biodiversity, and enhancing the landscape.

name: 兰州一分田农业科技有限公司
summary: Lanzhou Yifentian Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. is a technology company specializing in the research, development, and promotion of innovative agricultural technologies. They are recognized as a leader in smart organic farming for balconies, having developed and patented an organic vegetable growing equipment after five years of research. Their products aim to enable urban dwellers to grow their own organic vegetables, offering health benefits, faster growth, space efficiency, and an enhanced living environment. The company also provides seeds, fertilizers, and technical guidance, positioning itself as a provider of smart agricultural solutions for modern living.

name: Ouroboros Farms and Education Center
summary: Ouroboros Farms and Education Center is a large commercial aquaponic farm in the U.S. that specializes in aquaponics, combining aquaculture and hydroponics. They offer farm tours, aquaponics classes for various skill levels, and sell their produce directly and to local restaurants. The center also hosts events and provides aquaponics supplies, positioning itself as an educational facility and a provider of sustainable food solutions.

name: Bioriem
summary: Bioriem is a Swiss organic farm and retailer offering a wide range of regional organic products directly from the farmer. They specialize in fresh produce, dairy, baked goods, and meats, with options for flexible subscriptions and pre-orders. The company emphasizes direct sales through their online shop, farm shop, and delivery services, promoting sustainable agriculture and local sourcing.

name: Urban Growing Institute (UGI)
summary: Urban Growing Institute (UGI) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization focused on urban agriculture, providing training, certification, and business development opportunities. They specialize in vertical farming and hydroponics, with a particular emphasis on empowering military veterans and at-risk, income-disadvantaged youth. UGI aims to foster community redevelopment, create career opportunities, and ensure urban food security through educational programs and partnerships.

name: Papes Gemüsegarten GmbH
summary: Papes Gemüsegarten is a family-run agricultural business that operates several farm shops and mobile market stands, offering a wide range of fresh, regional produce. They focus on direct sales, including a 'Gemüsekiste' (vegetable box) delivery service, and also host events. The company emphasizes local sourcing and sustainability in its operations.

name: P. van Osch Groenteproducties B.V.
summary: P. van Osch Groenteproducties is a Dutch company specializing in the cultivation, harvesting, processing, and packaging of fresh vegetables and lettuce varieties. They serve B2B clients with locally grown, day-fresh produce, exclusively sold through the ZON growers' association. The company emphasizes innovation, continuous improvement, and local production, also cultivating lily bulbs.

name: Vihannestila Känkänen Oy
summary: Vihannestila Känkänen Oy is a family-owned company founded in 2008, with roots in a farm established in 1948. The company specializes in the preparation and marketing of vegetables, as well as growing and selling vegetables, seedlings, herbs, and summer flowers in greenhouses. Customer satisfaction is their top priority as they focus on developing and expanding their business.

name: Biolandhof Scharein
summary: Biolandhof Scharein is a family-run organic farm established in 1958, located in Otersen, Germany. They specialize in growing and selling high-quality organic produce, primarily potatoes and pumpkins, directly to consumers online. The farm emphasizes sustainable farming practices, adherence to strict Bioland guidelines, and regional, pesticide-free cultivation.

name: AGRICOLA MODERNA S.p.A. società agricola
summary: Agricola Moderna is an Italian company specializing in vertical farming, producing pesticide-free, natural salads and herbs using hydroponic systems. Their innovative approach minimizes water and soil usage, offering fresh produce year-round. The company emphasizes sustainability and modern agricultural techniques.

name: Native Hill Farm
summary: Native Hill Farm is a family-run, diversified, and intensive vegetable farm operating year-round in Fort Collins, Colorado. They focus on cultivating certified organic produce using sustainable practices like season extension, cover cropping, and water conservation. The farm offers various products and services including farm shares, pre-ordered flowers, workshops, and direct sales through a farm stand and local markets.

name: Minigarden.nl
summary: Minigarden.nl is an e-commerce platform specializing in modular green wall systems for both indoor and outdoor use. They offer a range of products including vertical garden modules, irrigation systems, and accessories, catering to both DIY enthusiasts and professionals. Their mission is to promote urban greening by making vertical gardening accessible and sustainable.

name: Bioland Hof Großholz
summary: Bioland Hof Großholz is a farm that practices gardening in harmony with nature, focusing on sustainable agriculture. They offer a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) model called Solawi, operate a farm shop, and sell produce at weekly markets. The farm also emphasizes traditional farming methods, including horse-powered work, and is certified by Bioland.

name: Nebula Group
summary: Nebula Group is a vertically integrated turnkey solution provider specializing in indoor farming facilities. They offer design, engineering, automation, and equipment supply for greenhouses, poultry barns, turkey barns, and hog barns. Their vision is to enable local, affordable, and sustainable food production through automation and process controls, ensuring profitability and resource conservation.

name: Viemose DGS
summary: Viemose DGS is a Scandinavian engineering company specializing in the design and manufacturing of advanced greenhouse equipment and automated production systems for the horticultural industry. They offer a range of products including bench systems, moving gutter systems for vertical farming, and complete greenhouse solutions. The company aims to provide cost-efficient, environmentally friendly, and automated systems to growers worldwide, supporting sustainable agricultural practices.

name: Familienbetrieb Schöll
summary: Familienbetrieb Schöll is a certified organic vegetable farming operation with direct sales through its farm shop and wholesale to food retailers. The business, tracing its roots back to 1580, specializes in root vegetables and potatoes, cultivating a variety of crops across different soil types to optimize quality and storage. They emphasize personal service and high-quality regional products.

name: Hof Wurzelreich GbR
summary: Hof Wurzelreich GbR is a farm that cultivates and sells fresh, organic vegetables and other natural food products. They operate under Bioland guidelines, emphasizing field-fresh produce harvested daily and delivered to customers via a subscription box service (Biokiste) or through their farm shop. The company also supplies local retailers and the food service industry, and participates in the EU school program to provide healthy snacks to students.

name: MEOD PTE LTD
summary: MEOD PTE LTD is an agricultural company focused on sustainable farming practices, producing 100% pesticide-free vegetables through advanced technologies. They prioritize environmental responsibility by using minimal water and upcycling inputs, aiming for a sustainable future for agriculture. Their produce is available through online retailers like MeodFresh and Redmart.

name: SHERPA SPACE INC.
summary: SHERPA SPACE INC. is an innovative company focused on developing smart farm systems and advanced LED lighting solutions for sustainable agriculture. They offer integrated platform services, smart farm systems like Sherpa Farm and Sherpa Open Field Solution, and specialized lighting devices such as Sherpa Light. Their mission is to lead the next green revolution by optimizing plant growth environments and addressing global food challenges through technology.

name: Teclion(shandong)Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Teclion (Shandong) Agricultural Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and manufacturing of intelligent agricultural equipment and facilities. They focus on providing professional agricultural automation control systems, planting systems, plant factories, container planting, and water-saving irrigation equipment. The company aims to offer comprehensive solutions for agricultural planting and is committed to sustainable development through technological innovation.

name: 厦门市桐洲生态科技有限公司
summary: Xiamen Tongzhou Ecological Technology Co., Ltd. is a company established in 2003, specializing in the design, construction, and technical support of soilless cultivation facilities for commercial fruits and vegetables. They offer expertise in hydroponics, smart agriculture, greenhouse engineering, and aquaponics systems. The company aims to promote ecological health and sustainable agriculture through innovative farming solutions and educational initiatives.

name: Gren Fox Sp. z o.o.
summary: Gren Fox is a company specializing in the development and production of automated indoor plant cultivation systems, including grow boxes and advanced air filtration solutions. Their mission is to promote a return to nature and a healthy lifestyle by providing ecological plant cultivation systems for both home and industrial use. They emphasize innovation through collaboration with research institutions and offer customized products.

name: HydroHouse Farms LLC
summary: HydroHouse Farms LLC is Nashville's first hydroponic greenhouse farm, established in 2016. They specialize in growing premium leafy greens year-round using a combination of greenhouse agriculture and hydroponics. The company emphasizes quality, consistency, and local sourcing, providing traceable and healthy produce to the Nashville community.

name: Floratom Kft.
summary: Floratom Kft. is a company focused on growing and distributing fresh vegetables, particularly tomatoes, paprika, and cucumbers, from the Szeged region. They are pioneers in hydroponic cultivation, emphasizing environmentally friendly, circular economy principles with chemical-free treatments and biological pest control. The company utilizes geothermal energy for heating and solar power for electricity, operating a large greenhouse complex with a modern logistics center for automated sorting, packaging, and refrigerated storage to meet customer needs. They also sell gerbera flowers.

name: Aquaponic Design S.r.l
summary: Aquaponic Design S.r.l specializes in designing and implementing soilless cultivation systems, including aquaponics, hydroponics, and bioponics. They offer solutions for farms, private individuals, public administration, and schools, focusing on efficient water and space usage. The company also provides training, masterclasses, and sells related products and kits, aiming to promote sustainable and innovative agricultural practices.

name: Biolandhof Engemann
summary: Biolandhof Engemann is a group of agricultural and trading companies focused on organic farming and direct marketing. They operate farms, trade in fruits, vegetables, and grains, and offer a regional organic box subscription service. The company emphasizes regionality, seasonality, and biodiversity in its operations, serving customers through farm shops, weekly markets, and online channels.

name: FRM – Aero-po-nic solutions
summary: FRM designs and produces patented vertical aeroponic cultivation systems that enable waterless and soil-less farming. Their solutions aim to revolutionize agricultural production by drastically reducing water usage, maximizing space efficiency, and eliminating polluting substances. FRM's technology supports sustainable, ethical, and ecological food production, adaptable to various building structures.

name: Cooperativa agricola il frutto permesso
summary: Il Frutto Permesso is an agricultural cooperative founded in 1987 that practices organic farming. They cultivate fruits, vegetables, cereals, and raise livestock including cattle, pigs, sheep, and bees. The cooperative processes its own products into preserves, juices, jams, meats, and liquors, and also offers agriturismo services, educational farm activities, and summer stays. They sell their fresh and processed products directly at their farm, in retail stores in Turin, and through organic channels in Italy and abroad.

name: Greenloop
summary: Greenloop is a company focused on revolutionizing home food production with its innovative indoor vertical farming system, Greenloop One. This hydroponic system allows users to grow fresh herbs and salads directly in their kitchens, offering hyper-local produce with minimal environmental impact. The technology utilizes optimized LED lighting and automatic watering, promoting sustainability through reduced water usage, CO2 emissions, and elimination of transport and packaging waste.

name: AQUAGREEN.FARM
summary: AQUAGREEN.FARM is an innovative agricultural operation specializing in the cultivation of microgreens and aquaponics. They focus on sustainable practices, using significantly less water than traditional farming and avoiding all chemicals, pesticides, and GMOs. Their local production ensures maximum freshness, delivering nutrient-rich microgreens and herbs directly from their farm to consumers.

name: Pure Harvest Smart Farms
summary: Pure Harvest Smart Farms is an agricultural company focused on producing fresh, high-quality produce year-round. They specialize in growing over 30 varieties of tomatoes, greens, and berries using sustainable, pesticide-free methods in controlled environments. Their mission is to provide locally grown, exceptionally fresh, and naturally authentic food while reducing food waste and carbon footprints.

name: Daunfarm
summary: Daunfarm is a farm that emphasizes organic and sustainable practices, offering a variety of produce including vegetables, fruits, and dairy. They highlight their commitment to chemical-free products and healthy living, aiming to supply the best organic products. The farm also mentions innovative farming techniques and systems, suggesting a blend of traditional agriculture with modern technology.

name: Bejo Zaden B.V.
summary: Bejo Zaden B.V. is a global seed company focused on developing innovative vegetable varieties for growers worldwide. They emphasize research, organic cultivation, and sustainable practices to ensure healthy and flavorful produce for consumers. The company actively engages with partners in the supply chain to explore market opportunities and advance agricultural methods.

name: 高邮市孙源特种青蛙养殖厂
summary: Gaoyou City Sunyuan Special Frog Farm is located in Lixian and operates a diverse business scope including rock climbing, laboratory furniture, thermal power generation equipment, engineering contracting, and more. The company emphasizes reform, optimization of industrial structure, and resource allocation to enhance core competitiveness. It aims to adapt to market challenges and opportunities, fostering cooperation and building a stable customer base across various industries.

name: Milkweed Farm
summary: Milkweed Farm is an organic farm established in 2017, specializing in growing over 100 varieties of vegetables and flowers using no-till practices. They offer a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) program with a free-choice model and operate a farm store selling their produce and goods from local producers. Their mission is to provide delicious, high-quality food to their community.

name: Il MQ Verde by E.SI. s.r.l.
summary: Il MQ Verde offers an innovative, fully automatic indoor cultivation system within a one-square-meter footprint. This system utilizes closed-loop hydroponic subirrigation for efficient, clean, and safe cultivation. The company provides a complete greenhouse structure, aluminum frame, and lighting kits, focusing on efficiency, resource savings, and customization for indoor gardening enthusiasts.

name: YardYum
summary: YardYum is a platform that connects individuals and organizations with available land to neighbors seeking space for gardening. The service facilitates the rental of garden plots from various sources, including homeowners, community gardens, farms, schools, churches, and businesses. It aims to promote local food production, environmental sustainability, community engagement, and provide a passive income opportunity for landowners.

name: Urban Cultivator
summary: Urban Cultivator designs and manufactures fully automated indoor garden appliances for growing fresh herbs, vegetables, and microgreens year-round. Their mission is to provide easy access to healthy, sustainable produce for homes and restaurants. The company offers solutions for both residential and commercial use, emphasizing convenience, nutrition, and flavor.

name: AGROWISE LTD
summary: AGROWISE LTD is a company founded in 2004 that specializes in providing integrated solutions for agricultural greenhouses. They manufacture, erect, supply, and install greenhouse equipment and automation systems. Additionally, they offer consulting services for irrigation and fertilization programs in hydroponic systems, leveraging their own factory and storage facilities equipped with modern machinery.

name: BluKhet Private Limited
summary: BluKhet Private Limited is an agri-tech startup focused on transforming wastelands into productive agricultural areas using hydroponic farming techniques. They offer a comprehensive solution for designing, constructing, operating, and generating revenue from hydroponic farms, emphasizing water efficiency, reduced chemical usage, and automated systems. The company also provides hydroponic animal feed solutions, positioning itself as an innovator in sustainable and efficient agriculture.

name: AgricUltra Advancements Inc.
summary: AgricUltra Advancements Inc. specializes in optimizing indoor farm production through advanced multi-layer grow platforms, inter-canopy management, and specialized LED lighting, including deep UVB+A. They leverage Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling to minimize energy inputs and prevent costly facility design errors. The company focuses on a "Plant First™" philosophy, integrating photobiology expertise to enhance crop quality, resilience, and pest/mold control.

name: Kryzen Biotech Pvt. Ltd.
summary: Kryzen Biotech is a leading Indian manufacturer specializing in protected cultivation and controlled environment agriculture (CEA) solutions. They offer a range of products including polytunnels, nethouses, and hydroponic systems, alongside services like rural and urban farming technology, crop research, and farm training. The company aims to build profitable farms by providing innovative farming technologies and comprehensive knowledge to maximize crop production with limited resources.

name: 未来農業プロジェクト (Mirai Nogyo Project)
summary: The Mirai Nogyo Project aims to revolutionize agriculture by focusing on 'functional vegetables' and sustainable soil cultivation. They seek to create a system where 100 consumers support one farmer, allowing farmers to concentrate on producing high-quality, nutritious vegetables. The project also offers agricultural machinery rental services to reduce barriers for new farmers and promotes advanced cultivation techniques for challenging climates.

name: いちごカンパニー株式会社
summary: Ichigo Company Inc. is developing a new form of agriculture by revolutionizing production and distribution systems, focusing on creating innovative plant factories. They aim to produce high-quality strawberries year-round using LED-lit, closed-system plant factories, making cultivation manageable even without agricultural experience. The company also offers consulting services based on their plant factory development and operational expertise, seeking to solve food issues and labor shortages in agriculture.

name: (주)인성테크
summary: Insung Tech is a company specializing in the development and installation of plant factory systems, container farms, portable indoor gardens, and built-in indoor vegetable gardens. They offer innovative solutions for urban farming and controlled environment agriculture, aiming to create new possibilities in food production. Their product range includes systems like Vegedia and Wallfarm, catering to various indoor cultivation needs.

name: Greenbugs Agtech Pte. Ltd.
summary: Greenbugs Agtech Pte. Ltd. is an indoor farming company specializing in the cultivation and supply of microgreens, salad mixes, and sweet basil to cafes and restaurants. They also operate a farm-to-table cafe offering healthy meals, coffee, and waffles, emphasizing nutritious and flavorful dishes. The company is committed to transparency, offering farm tours and educational experiences about indoor farming and hydroponics, and also produces edible flowers and exotic kombucha juices.

name: Floe di Jessica Brenna
summary: Floe is an organic agricultural company and laboratory that produces and sells a variety of products including fresh produce, cosmetics, preserves, flours, legumes, and candles. They emphasize organic farming practices and offer their products through an online shop. The company also provides contract farming services and maintains a newsletter for customer updates.

name: GreenTokri Farms Pvt. Ltd.
summary: GreenTokri is an e-commerce platform specializing in farm-fresh produce, including hydroponic salads, vegetables, herbs, spices, and homemade delicacies. They emphasize sustainable and eco-friendly practices, delivering directly to consumers. The company also offers unique experiences like farm tours and camping, positioning itself as a provider of fresh, natural, and locally sourced food products and lifestyle experiences.

name: Società Agricola Emon Agri S.r.l.
summary: Società Agricola Emon Agri S.r.l. was an organic agricultural company focused on cultivating and selling healthy and tasty produce directly from the field to the table. They operated greenhouses and offered seasonal products, including recipes. The company announced its closure after 11 years of operation, ceasing its direct sales point.

name: Ackerglück Hamburg
summary: Ackerglück Hamburg is a market garden in Hamburg, Germany, specializing in the cultivation and sale of fresh, organic vegetables. They offer a seasonal vegetable subscription box service for individuals and restaurants, emphasizing resource-efficient, hand-tended farming on a small scale. The company aims to provide high-quality, regional produce while contributing to the preservation of green spaces in Hamburg.

name: AckerCompany GmbH
summary: AckerCompany GmbH focuses on promoting appreciation for nature and food by developing sustainable concepts for communal vegetable cultivation. They offer unique vegetable-growing experiences for neighborhoods, companies, and care facilities, integrating people of all ages and backgrounds. Their mission is to create a more sustainable world through hands-on gardening projects and knowledge sharing, supported by over 500 experts across Germany.

name: Stadtrandacker gGmbH
summary: Stadtrandacker gGmbH is an urban farming initiative focused on growing vegetables in city soils. They offer a vegetable subscription service and community gardening plots, promoting local food production and community engagement. The organization aims to make fresh produce accessible within urban environments.

name: Grow Zone Scandinavia
summary: Grow Zone Scandinavia is an e-commerce platform specializing in hydroponics, LED grow lights, microgreens, and related gardening equipment. Founded by Ian Hunter, the company aims to promote home-grown produce and year-round indoor cultivation. They offer a range of products and resources to support growers of all levels, emphasizing the benefits of fresh, self-produced food.

name: Jirifarm
summary: Jirifarm is an e-commerce platform specializing in hydroponic and aquaponic farming supplies. They offer a wide range of products including grow media, seeds, Dutch buckets, grow tents, and complete hydroponic kits (DFT and NFT). The company aims to provide essential tools and resources for individuals and businesses looking to engage in sustainable agriculture and urban farming.

name: Albard'Eira
summary: Albard'Eira is a company focused on certified organic agricultural production, specializing in vegetables and strawberries. They offer home delivery of weekly organic produce baskets and provide agricultural consulting services. The company also engages in project dissemination and offers training workshops, supported by the FEADER program for rural development.

name: Supragarden® SHOP
summary: Supragarden® offers hydroponic green wall systems and components for easy vertical gardening at home or in commercial spaces. They provide complete kits, including grow modules, water tanks, nutrients, and grow lights, designed for both food plants and decorative greenery. The company ships its products globally and also offers installation and rental services in specific regions.

name: Urban Farming
summary: This content discusses the rise of urban farming as a sustainable solution for cities facing growing populations and food security challenges. It defines urban farming, outlines its benefits including environmental sustainability, enhanced food security, community engagement, and economic opportunities, and touches upon the challenges and future prospects of this practice. The overall message highlights urban farming's potential to create more livable and resilient cities.

name: Hortisul
summary: Hortisul is a company specializing in hydroponic cultivation systems, offering products such as hydroponic growing channels, fertilizers, strawberry growing slabs, smart gardens, and greenhouses. They aim to provide innovative solutions for modern agriculture, catering to both commercial growers and potentially home users. The company is based in Ijuí/RS, Brazil, and emphasizes quality materials like virgin PVC in their products.

name: Poliflor Engineering s.r.l
summary: Poliflor is a leading company in architectural and urban greening, specializing in innovative systems for vertical gardens and green roofs. They offer bespoke design and installation services, collaborating with landscape architects and designers to provide cutting-edge solutions for both interior and exterior spaces. Their offerings include patented systems like Flexiverde® Vydro for vertical gardens and Completa® for extensive green roofs, alongside comprehensive technical assistance.

name: АО "СП "ЗАРЯ"
summary: АО "СП "ЗАРЯ" is a leading greenhouse farm in the Russian Federation, established in 1982. The company specializes in growing ecologically clean cucumbers and tomatoes using innovative technologies, including biological pest control and bee/bumblebee pollination. They focus on high-quality produce with excellent taste, cultivated in conditions that exclude harmful substances. The company also operates a significant retail network for its products.

name: Bio Gemüsehof Hörz
summary: Bio Gemüsehof Hörz is a regional organic farm and delivery service operating in the Filder region and surrounding areas. They specialize in growing over 80 types of vegetables on approximately 20 hectares according to Bioland guidelines and offer a wide range of organic products including fruits, vegetables, baked goods, dairy, and more through their online shop and delivery service. The company emphasizes regionality, seasonality, and sustainability in its operations, providing fresh produce directly to consumers' homes or offices.

name: 恵葉&菜 健康野菜 (Keihanna Kenko Yasai)
summary: 恵葉&菜 (Keihanna) specializes in developing and commercializing high-quality premium vegetables and fruits through advanced cultivation technology. They offer integrated solutions for plant factories, including technology transfer, plant design, manufacturing, installation, automation, and quality analysis. Their focus is on producing high-antioxidant, low-nitrate leafy greens and high-sugar fruits like melons, strawberries, and tomatoes, aiming to contribute to food security and promote healthy eating.

name: Urban Farming
summary: This content discusses the rise of urban farming as a sustainable solution for cities facing growing populations and food security challenges. It defines urban farming, outlines its benefits including environmental sustainability, enhanced food security, community engagement, and economic opportunities, and touches upon the challenges and future prospects of this practice. The overall message highlights urban farming's potential to create more livable and resilient cities.

name: Neon Greens
summary: Neon Greens is a restaurant that operates as a working farm, specializing in hyper-local, hydroponically grown greens and herbs. They aim to provide fresh, nutritious produce year-round, independent of climate, and craft these ingredients into seasonal meals. The company emphasizes quality, community connection, and sustainable food systems, offering a solution to traditional produce supply chain issues.

name: 寿光信达农业发展有限公司
summary: Shouguang Xinda Agricultural Development Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of soilless cultivation, aquaponics, and plant factories. Their business encompasses soilless cultivation, integrated water and fertilizer management, R&D of full-element fertilizers, IoT smart agriculture, and agricultural technology promotion. The company focuses on innovation, providing high-quality products and services for agricultural transformation and upgrading, with a commitment to consumer interests.

name: Perks Microgreens
summary: Perks Microgreens is a commercial vertical farm located in the Cowichan Valley, specializing in growing and supplying a wide selection of microgreens, herbs, and edible flowers. They serve local restaurants, hotels, caterers, and residents with harvested-to-order produce, emphasizing sustainability through organic seeds and eco-friendly packaging. The company highlights the high nutritional value of microgreens and their culinary applications.

name: Obsthof
summary: Obsthof is a family-run farm located near Mainz, Germany, specializing in the cultivation of sun-ripened fruits and fresh asparagus. They offer a seasonal variety of produce from their own cultivation, emphasizing high quality and local sourcing. The farm operates as a multi-generational business, committed to sustainability, biodiversity, and direct sales to consumers through their own stands and a click & collect service.

name: Le Pic-Vert
summary: Le Pic-Vert is a family-run organic farm that produces a wide variety of fruits, vegetables, herbs, and flowers year-round. Founded in 2008 by Jelle and Joline, the farm emphasizes sustainable practices, including agroforestry and zero-phyto policies, and is certified organic. They offer their produce through an on-site farm shop, a bio-basket delivery service, and supply local businesses and restaurants.

name: 广东奥玛农业科技有限公司
summary: Guangdong Aoma Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. is a smart agriculture research institution focused on providing integrated smart agriculture solutions. Their services include smart agriculture planning, modern agricultural IoT management systems, artificial spectrum research and development, and seedling cultivation. They specialize in plant factory customization, offering various containerized plant factory solutions for different needs like leafy greens, forage, strawberries, education, and tourism.

name: Danvan A/S
summary: Danvan A/S is a Danish company specializing in innovative climate and water management solutions for the horticulture industry. They design, manufacture, and service products such as fertilizer mixers, valves, and automated gutter systems, aiming to create optimal growing environments for plants. The company positions itself as a full-service provider, offering customized solutions and expert advice to growers worldwide.

name: 山西蓝藤嘉源种植基地
summary: Shanxi Lanteng Jiayuan Planting Base specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of plant walls and micro-gardens. They offer solutions for various spaces, including homes and commercial properties, emphasizing features like light weight, year-round greenery, and easy maintenance. The company also sells plants and related products through its online store.

name: La Ferme du Torry
summary: La Ferme du Torry is a farm that offers fresh produce through subscription baskets and direct sales at markets. They provide options for home delivery and also sell products online. The farm emphasizes its commitment to organic practices, as indicated by its bio number.

name: TTA-ISO
summary: TTA-ISO provides high-tech automation solutions for the horticulture and food industries, focusing on empowering growers worldwide. They develop cutting-edge automation, software, and integrated systems to enhance productivity, improve yields, and drive sustainable progress. Their solutions address challenges such as labor shortages, increasing demands, and competitiveness across sectors like ornamentals, bulbs, cut flowers, food, and forestry.

name: Bio-Warenbörse
summary: The Bio-Warenbörse is an online marketplace facilitating the exchange of organic agricultural products and related items. It connects organic producers and processors, allowing them to post advertisements and search for specific goods such as feed, consumer goods, and agricultural equipment. The platform is free to use and aims to support the organic farming community.

name: Gärtnerhof Steinat GbR
summary: Gärtnerhof Steinat is a family-run, biologically-dynamic vegetable farm established in 1980, holding Demeter certification since 1982. They specialize in growing and distributing organic produce, adhering to strict guidelines that prohibit synthetic fertilizers, pesticides, and GMOs. The farm offers a delivery service, including an "Abokiste" (subscription box), and emphasizes social and environmental sustainability in its operations.

name: ECO Finance Group s.r.o.
summary: ECO Finance Group is a family holding company focused on sustainable development across agriculture, energy, real estate, and investments. They utilize precision agriculture, hydroponic farming, and renewable energy sources like wind and solar to minimize environmental impact and ensure energy independence. The company aims to improve the quality of life for current and future generations through responsible business practices and revitalizing brownfield sites.

name: HIKARI Food Farming & Trading L.L.C.
summary: HIKARI Food Farming & Trading L.L.C. is a company based in the UAE that specializes in hydroponic vegetable farming using Japanese technology. Their mission is to expand the availability of pesticide-free vegetables year-round, aiming to establish a new agricultural industry in the UAE. They offer fresh, nutritious, and pesticide-free vegetables.

name: 上蔬源 (Shang Shu Yuan)
summary: Shang Shu Yuan (上蔬源) provides smart plant growth solutions, enabling users to grow flowers and vegetables at home for safe, traceable consumption. Their technology aims to create urban forest-like environments, promoting a green lifestyle and well-being. The company offers smart home farms, plant seedlings, nutrient solutions, and accessories, catering to both individual consumers and commercial applications.

name: Les Serres de Mitry
summary: Les Serres de Mitry is a company that produces and sells flowers, vegetable plants, and seasonal vegetables, all cultivated by hand and with a focus on organic and local practices. They emphasize enriching the soil through composting and manual weeding. The company also offers landscaping services and provides updates through news articles and a newsletter.

name: Biolandhof Bodemer
summary: Biolandhof Bodemer is a diverse organic farm operating under strict Bioland association guidelines. The farm engages in cattle fattening (Angus beef), crop cultivation (grains, potatoes, clover-grass), pumpkin farming, and maintains extensive orchards. They also offer firewood sales, operate a contract business for services like mowing and winter maintenance, and have a photovoltaic system. The farm emphasizes a closed-loop, sustainable agricultural system, avoiding mineral fertilizers and promoting biodiversity.

name: TRAITAGRI CENTRE
summary: TRAITAGRI CENTRE specializes in providing alternative agricultural products and services for market gardening and horticulture. They offer solutions focused on environmental respect, aiming to maintain yields and quality through biological and physical rebalancing of water, soil, and plants. Their offerings include disinfection services, pest control, greenhouse cleaning, and sales of greenhouse films, positioning them as an alternative to conventional fertilizers and synthetic treatments.

name: Gmües Mattli
summary: Gmües Mattli is a small-scale, organic vegetable farm located in Kastanienbaum, Switzerland, operated by Sebastian & Cristina Ineichen Colantuoni since 2017. They adhere to Bio-Suisse guidelines and are a 'Vollknospebetrieb' (full bud operation), focusing on diverse seasonal cultivation. Their produce is available through an on-site farm shop, a weekly market, subscription vegetable boxes ('GmüesAbo'), and direct supply to select restaurants and stores in the Lucerne region.

name: АП ООО «АГРОСЕРВИС-6»
summary: АП ООО «АГРОСЕРВИС-6» is a company that cultivates cultivated mushrooms using Dutch technology in specially equipped chambers. They focus on automated processes with manual harvesting, emphasizing training for their mushroom pickers. The company also operates within the 'Zapadny' market complex, offering a variety of goods.

name: 樫山農園 (Kashiyama Farm)
summary: Kashiyama Farm is an agricultural enterprise focused on creating new forms of farming adapted to changing times. They integrate smart agriculture techniques, scientific know-how, and data management to efficiently produce crops like tomatoes, rice, shiitake mushrooms, komatsuna, and wheat. The company also engages in direct-to-consumer sales through their online shop and has expanded its operations internationally, aiming to connect traditional Japanese agriculture with future generations through technology, ideas, and passion.

name: VertiDesign
summary: VertiDesign specializes in vertical plant furniture, transforming spaces with innovative green solutions. They offer concepts like vertical plant walls, plant columns, and modular vertical gardening systems, aiming to redefine urban environments with nature. Their solutions focus on space-saving, air purification, and aesthetic appeal, promoting sustainable urban living and food production.

name: Westhof Bio-Gemüse GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Westhof Bio-Gemüse is a family-owned company specializing in the cultivation, processing, and distribution of organic vegetables. They offer fresh, frozen, and vacuum-packed organic produce, emphasizing a closed-loop system that integrates farming with renewable energy generation. Their operations span over 1,000 hectares of farmland and include large-scale greenhouses, a dedicated organic freezing facility, and research into sustainable agricultural technologies.

name: Lovingreens
summary: Lovingreens is a sustainable urban farm in Amsterdam specializing in vertical farming and organic microgreens. They also offer indoor and outdoor urban garden design solutions, focusing on sustainable practices and maximizing green space in urban environments. The company aims to provide high-quality microgreens and diversify its offerings with edible flowers and mushrooms, while minimizing its environmental footprint.

name: The Green Edge International Pty Ltd.
summary: The Green Edge is an Australian company focused on enhancing organic food grain productivity through advanced agricultural solutions. They offer plant nutrients, soil conditioners, robotic farming and testing equipment, vertical gardening, digital irrigation systems, and industrial lab facilities. Their product line includes humate-based soil reclamations and water-soluble fertilizers designed to reduce chemical reliance, regenerate soil, and improve plant vitality.

name: Bachguterhof
summary: Bachguterhof is a family-run farm that has been operating for over 35 years, focusing on diversity, ecology, and sustainability. They cultivate over 90 types of organic vegetables and fruits on approximately 2 hectares, selling directly to the local community through their farm shop and a weekly subscription box. The farm also includes a small apiary and offers two holiday apartments, emphasizing a 'farm to table' approach with regional, organic, and fair products.

name: Biolandhof Frölich
summary: Biolandhof Frölich is a family-run farm dedicated to sustainable and ecological agriculture, operating under strict Bioland guidelines since 2008. They engage in crop farming, raise Hereford cattle and sheep, and maintain diverse fruit orchards. The farm emphasizes a closed-loop system, producing high-quality food from field to table in harmony with nature, and sells products through an on-site and online farm shop.

name: 寿光市耕元农业科技有限公司
summary: Shouguang Gengyuan Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise based in Shouguang, China, specializing in soilless cultivation materials, design, and construction. They offer integrated solutions for greenhouse engineering, aquaponics systems, ecological restaurants, and park planning, including agricultural IoT and plant factories. The company aims to be a leading supplier of modern agricultural facilities and solutions, with numerous demonstration parks and successful projects in the region.

name: Teclion (Shandong) Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Teclion (Shandong) Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, and manufacturing of intelligent agricultural equipment and facilities. They provide professional agricultural automation control systems, planting systems, plant factories, container planting, and water-saving irrigation equipment, offering integrated solutions for modern agriculture. The company focuses on technological innovation and sustainable development in smart agriculture.

name: Les Maraîchers de l'Auberdière
summary: Les Maraîchers de l'Auberdière is a certified organic market garden farm located in Margon, France. They specialize in producing and selling seasonal vegetables, mushrooms, edible flowers, and honey. The farm emphasizes sustainable practices inspired by living soil farming and permaculture, aiming to provide healthy, local food. They offer online ordering for click-and-collect and also sell at local farmers' markets.

name: Farmshelf
summary: Farmshelf offered hydroponic indoor garden systems designed for home and business use, enabling users to grow leafy greens and herbs year-round. Their product featured automated lighting, water, and nutrient delivery, supported by a subscription service for seed pods and nutrients. The company aimed to provide fresher, more nutritious, and sustainably grown produce by reducing food miles and eliminating plastic packaging.

name: Hazelfield Farm
summary: Hazelfield Farm is a farm specializing in organic and sustainable farming practices, primarily focusing on growing flowers and operating a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) program. They offer wedding floral services in Ohio and Kentucky, alongside a CSA for general consumers and workplaces. The farm also sells products through an online store and at local farmers' markets.

name: Reppe Søndre
summary: Reppe Søndre is a family-run farm located in Trondheim, Norway, focused on engaging the local community in food production through sustainable, urban agriculture. The farm cultivates grains for flour production, offers event venue rentals, and provides mini-storage units. It also hosts various community projects including a CSA (Reppe Andelslandbruk), a school garden program, and an integration project (Dype Røtter) that operates a cafe and vegetable sales, aiming to preserve local farming knowledge and promote Norwegian agriculture.

name: Certhon
summary: Certhon specializes in designing and building high-tech greenhouses and indoor farming solutions worldwide. They offer turnkey greenhouse systems, indoor farming setups, and robotic harvesting solutions aimed at increasing yield, quality, and sustainability in food production. Their integrated Certhon Control System (CCS) optimizes technical installations for energy efficiency, serving growers, investors, and researchers.

name: Poljoprivredna zadruga "Agrofood" sa p.o. Konjević Polje
summary: Poljoprivredna zadruga "Agrofood" is an agricultural cooperative focused on producing high-quality seedlings and organic food. They operate greenhouses and open fields to grow vegetables and fruits, emphasizing pesticide-free production. The cooperative also engages in retail and wholesale distribution of its products, aiming to provide healthy food to citizens.

name: Ben's Farm
summary: Ben's Farm is an organic farm located in Tirosh, Israel, specializing in the cultivation and sale of fresh produce. They offer a wide variety of fruits, vegetables, herbs, and mushrooms, all grown on their farm. The website functions as an e-commerce platform where customers can browse products, add them to a shopping cart, and proceed to payment, indicating a direct-to-consumer sales model.

name: WeGrowOrganic B.V.
summary: WeGrowOrganic B.V. is a Dutch company founded by two organic farmers, specializing in the cultivation, sorting, processing, and packaging of a wide range of organic produce, including potatoes, onions, beetroot, and carrots. They manage the entire supply chain from their farm in Zeewolde to a European network of buyers, ensuring quality and availability. Their mission is to grow healthy, reliable products in collaboration with nature.

name: Rolling Hills Greenhouse
summary: Rolling Hills Greenhouse is a hydroponic farm specializing in locally grown, fresh salads and herbs. They utilize nutrient-balanced water systems indoors to cultivate produce year-round without preservatives or chemicals, ensuring non-GMO products. Their produce is delivered weekly to local grocery stores, emphasizing freshness and a clean ingredient list for consumers.

name: Surna
summary: Surna is a company specializing in facility design and equipment for indoor and controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities. They offer a comprehensive range of products including HVAC systems, climate controls, water treatment solutions, LED lighting, and air purification, alongside services like architectural and engineering design, installation, and maintenance. With over 16 years of experience, Surna aims to help commercial growers optimize their cultivation facilities for increased yields and profitability.

name: La ferme de Keruzerh
summary: La Ferme de Keruzerh is an organic farm focused on producing vegetables, raising livestock, and cultivating fruit trees using manual agriculture without synthetic products or heavy machinery. They emphasize biodiversity, soil health through no-till farming, and operate within the "Demain en main" ecovillage. The farm offers direct sales and a "Drive Fermier" service for customers to pick up their orders.

name: Greenup Design
summary: Greenup Design is an e-commerce company specializing in vertical garden systems and related accessories. They offer a range of products including modular panels, planters, irrigation systems, and kits designed for both home and professional use. The company focuses on providing solutions for urban gardening and green spaces, emphasizing ease of use and aesthetic appeal.

name: BioLand Agrarprodukte AG
summary: BioLand Agrarprodukte AG is a Swiss company focused on organic farming, specializing in the production and sale of organic vegetables. They offer a vegetable subscription box service, operate a farm shop, and provide event services including venue rental and special dinners. The company emphasizes sustainable practices, adhering to the Bio Suisse label since 1995, and aims to contribute to a healthy environment for future generations.

name: Unser Laden
summary: Unser Laden is a retail operation specializing in the cultivation and sale of a wide variety of self-grown vegetables. They focus on energy-efficient, seasonal cultivation, offering approximately 60 different vegetable cultures, with a strong emphasis on quality, taste, and disease resistance. The business operates a physical store with set opening hours and also sells at markets, and is currently seeking staff for market and store operations.

name: City-Farmer.ru
summary: City-Farmer.ru is a portal dedicated to urban farming and progressive plant cultivation. It provides news, knowledge base articles, and guides on various aspects of city farming, including hydroponics, microgreens, equipment, and plant care. The portal also features community discussions, expert interviews, and startup ideas within the agritech sector.

name: URBANIZE, LLC
summary: Urbanize, LLC is a company dedicated to providing year-round, fresh, and locally grown produce, including basil, microgreens, and herbs, to local grocery stores and restaurants. They utilize state-of-the-art indoor hydroponic and LED lighting technologies for efficient and sustainable operations. Their mission is to deliver high-quality products while fostering a green lifestyle and supporting the local community.

name: Gipmans Young Plants
summary: Gipmans Young Plants is a family-owned company established in 1972, specializing in the cultivation of high-quality young plants for professional vegetable growers and herbs for European customers. They focus on quality, efficiency, and sustainable production processes, including organic cultivation where possible. Their business strategy is built on three pillars: Vital People, Vital Planet, and Vital Plants, aiming for a circular, cost-efficient, and vital future in food production.

name: AgriNovix Agricultural Technology Co.
summary: AgriNovix is a Chinese company specializing in agricultural greenhouse solutions, including design, material supply, construction, and training. They offer a range of greenhouse types, soilless cultivation systems, eco-tourism farm setups, and agricultural equipment like drones and seeders. With over 25 years of experience, AgriNovix aims to provide high-quality, affordable, and integrated solutions for modern agriculture, serving clients globally.

name: Ferriplastic srl
summary: Ferriplastic srl is an Italian company specializing in precision agriculture, irrigation systems, and vertical farming solutions. They supply and install equipment for modern farming techniques, including advanced indoor production systems. The company also offers hardware and services related to gardening and general hardware, emphasizing reliability and quality in their projects.

name: Colina Farms
summary: Colina Farms is an organic farm that grows and sells fresh, seasonal vegetables. They offer various box sizes for weekly delivery and emphasize chemical-free cultivation methods, using bio-fertilizers and manual labor. The farm also invites customers for picnics and volunteer days, promoting a connection with nature and healthy living.

name: Waldgarten Everode
summary: Waldgarten Everode is a vegetable farming operation with direct sales through weekly markets, farm-gate sales, and a delivery service. They cultivate a wide variety of vegetables in open fields and greenhouses, offering seasonal produce, young plants, herbs, and honey. The business also features a flower-picking field and emphasizes organic farming practices, holding a bio-certification.

name: 2445 Organics
summary: 2445 Organics offers the SuperGrow System, an indoor organic growing technology designed to extend growing seasons and provide year-round food production. Their soil-based system allows for growing various produce, reducing environmental impact, and promoting food accessibility. The company also provides business opportunities through distributorships and dealer programs, enabling individuals to sell their technology and promote sustainable food growth.

name: КлубникаПро (KlubnikaPro)
summary: KlubnikaPro is a company that provides comprehensive solutions for strawberry cultivation, particularly for urban farming. They offer an online store with essential supplies like seeds, LED lighting, irrigation systems, shelving, and substrates. Additionally, they provide educational resources, including a course called "Strawberry Hack," consultations, and a farm calculator to assist clients in setting up and managing their strawberry farms. Their mission is to make strawberry cultivation accessible and efficient for everyone.

name: ООО "Современные Системы Выращивания"
summary: ООО "Современные Системы Выращивания" specializes in the automation of hydroponic plant cultivation through its OverGrower system. They offer integrated solutions including automated nutrient delivery systems (GrowerMix), hydroponic installations (CityFarmer, GrowPillar), LED grow lights (LuxaVita), and related consumables. The company targets both commercial agricultural projects and educational initiatives, aiming to provide efficient and remote-controlled growing environments.

name: TLT Automation bv
summary: TLT Automation bv specializes in innovative cultivation systems for mushroom farms worldwide, aiming to foster growth while respecting people and the environment. They offer solutions to enhance mushroom farming operations, contributing to the global expansion of this agricultural sector. The company's mission is to facilitate the growth of mushroom businesses through their technological expertise.

name: Natürlich aus Broldes Garten
summary: Natürlich aus Broldes Garten is an organic farm and garden center specializing in ecological vegetable cultivation and natural foods. They offer a range of services including certified EM (Effective Microorganisms) consulting and nutritional advice. The business also provides a "Frischekiste" (fresh produce box) service and operates a natural food store with an unpackaged goods section.

name: MiHuertoenTresCantos
summary: MiHuertoenTresCantos offers individuals the opportunity to cultivate their own 100% organic produce in plots located near Madrid. They provide plots of various sizes, access to well water, drip irrigation, natural fertilizers, and gardening tools. The service also includes amenities like parking, restrooms, changing rooms, and a rest area, aiming to provide a relaxing experience for users.

name: Dagan Agricultural Automation
summary: Dagan Agricultural Automation is a company with over 40 years of experience specializing in providing comprehensive agricultural solutions. They offer turnkey projects, advanced agricultural systems like greenhouses, AgriSolar, and aquaculture, as well as services including planning, consultation, feasibility studies, and ongoing maintenance. Dagan focuses on integrating technology, innovation, and sustainability to ensure effective and profitable results for governments, research institutions, companies, and private farmers worldwide.

name: Total Grow Control (TGC)
summary: Total Grow Control (TGC) specializes in developing custom-tailored precision agriculture systems for indoor vertical farming and industrial-scale operations. They offer automated control systems, smart irrigation, water treatment, and nutrient delivery solutions designed to maximize yield, crop quality, and efficiency. Their proprietary cloud-based systems enable remote monitoring and precise adjustment of environmental conditions, streamlining operations for growers.

name: Zephyr Organics
summary: Zephyr Organics is a third-generation family-owned farm specializing in certified organic vegetables, fruits, and herbs. They operate on over 100 acres, focusing on sustainable farming practices and soil health. Their produce is available through an on-farm market, local farmers' markets, direct delivery via Mama Earth Organics, and wholesale to other CSAs and grocery stores.

name: CambridgeHOK
summary: CambridgeHOK is a specialist company focused on the design, research, construction, commissioning, and support of vertical farming, glasshouses, and energy solutions. They offer innovative technologies and services to help clients achieve specific goals, improve energy efficiency, and enhance food production environments. The company serves various sectors including horticulture, energy, and construction, aiming to deliver projects on time and within budget.

name: Chalsys LLP
summary: Chalsys is a 17-year-old advisory and direct investment firm headquartered in London, England, with a branch in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded by Sonia Lo, the firm focuses on sustainability and has developed and funded ESG opportunities globally, with a recent emphasis on food and agriculture supply chains. They have significant operating experience in vertical farming and greenhouse growing, serving clients across the food and agriculture value chain.

name: Office for Micro Climate Cultivation (OMC°C)
summary: Office for Micro Climate Cultivation (OMC°C) specializes in vertical greening systems, particularly their VERD° product. This system uses fast-growing annual climbing plants on lightweight structures to create large-scale green spaces in urban areas. The modules provide shade, improve microclimates, bind CO2, and are designed for seasonal cultivation with harvested biomass returned to the economic cycle. They offer this as a service, focusing on sustainability and minimal environmental impact.

name: Cycloponics
summary: Cycloponics transforms underground parking lots in cities into sustainable urban farms and business incubators. They cultivate organic mushrooms and other produce, offering ultra-local food options while creating jobs and revitalizing underutilized urban spaces. The company also provides consulting services for installing similar urban farms in underground structures.

name: Jamboz
summary: Jamboz is a family-run farm located in Kutnohorsko, Czech Republic, cultivating vegetables, herbs, and fruits on 50 hectares using natural methods. They emphasize sustainable farming practices, avoiding unnecessary pesticides and caring for the landscape and living creatures. The farm offers regional delivery of 'bedýnky' (produce boxes) and ships nationwide via their e-shop, also participating in farmer's markets.

name: De Tuinen van de Hagert
summary: De Tuinen van de Hagert is a biological vegetable farm located near Nijmegen, Netherlands. It cultivates vegetables, edible flowers, small fruits, and herbs on a small scale. The farm operates as a learning and work environment for individuals with a distance to the labor market, including those with mild disabilities, providing expert guidance. Its produce is sold to local restaurants, individuals, and a village shop.

name: Aponix GmbH
summary: Aponix provides modular components for setting up urban farming grow spaces, enabling hyperlocal plant production in 3D. They offer solutions like Vertical Barrels and Living Wall Systems for both soilless and substrate-based cultivation, designed for efficiency and versatility in urban environments. Their products are robust, made in Germany, and cater to prosumer and production needs for edible and ornamental plants.

name: Bioland-Gärtnerei Thomas Brands
summary: Bioland-Gärtnerei Thomas Brands is a regional organic vegetable farm located near Schloss Moyland, established in 1997. The farm specializes in the seasonal production of organic vegetables under glass for regional wholesale and retail markets, focusing on quality with minimal heating energy. They also engage in own young plant propagation and employ local students for training in ecological horticulture. Products are sold through wholesale, retail, and a weekly market stall.

name: VMS Malaysia Sdn Bhd
summary: VMS Malaysia Sdn Bhd is a company focused on vermiculture, gardening, and farm products, including supplying plants, soil, fertilizers, and pesticides for landscaping. They also offer fresh and frozen free-range chicken and premium seafood products. Additionally, the company provides IT infrastructure services, event management, and training workshops, operating through various online platforms and physical retail points.

name: BN SERRES
summary: BN SERRES specializes in the design and manufacturing of greenhouses for horticulture and vegetable farming, as well as protective roofing for animal husbandry or material storage. With 40 years of experience, they focus on high-tech structures and efficient ventilation systems. The company operates its own production workshops, design office, and employs a significant number of installers and sales partners across Europe.

name: EcoGrowing Unipessoal, Lda
summary: EcoGrowing is an e-commerce company specializing in organic seeds, microgreens, and sustainable cultivation systems like vermicomposting and the MyPot system. They offer a wide range of products including seeds, substrates, grow kits, and accessories, alongside educational resources such as workshops and tutorials. The company aims to promote healthier eating habits and environmental consciousness by empowering individuals to grow their own food.

name: Hydrotab Srls
summary: Hydrotab Srls specializes in containerized hydroponic systems for vertical farming, enabling year-round cultivation in controlled environments. Their modular systems are designed for various crops, including fresh grass for livestock, and emphasize pesticide-free production with high yields and superior organoleptic properties. The systems utilize photovoltaic energy and significantly reduce water consumption, offering an efficient and sustainable agricultural solution.

name: Organic Farm & Greenhouse
summary: This is an organic farm and greenhouse established in 1949, specializing in certified organic produce and greenhouse products. They offer CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) subscriptions for fresh vegetables and also sell bedding plants and hanging baskets. The farm emphasizes local, healthy products and sustainable practices.

name: Le Jardin des Roys
summary: Le Jardin des Roys is a French market gardening company specializing in the production and sale of high-quality mini-vegetables. They emphasize manual cultivation, soil health, and organic practices to deliver fresh, aesthetically pleasing produce to both professional chefs and individual consumers. The company offers online sales with home delivery or collection at designated points, focusing on freshness and taste as key selling points.

name: Bio-Gärtnerei Familie Klages
summary: Bio-Gärtnerei Familie Klages is an ecologically operating family business established in 1992, cultivating over 50 types of vegetables on approximately 16 hectares. They utilize greenhouses for young plant propagation, herbs, and winter crops, with a focus on sustainable practices like plant-based nitrogen fertilizers and eco-electricity. The company sells its certified organic products through regional markets and its own farm shop, adhering to strict EU organic regulations and Bioland and ABCERT certifications.

name: Quellwiesenhof - Eckhardt & Platzdasch GbR
summary: Quellwiesenhof is a family-run organic farm and mill that cultivates grains such as emmer, spelt, oats, buckwheat, rye, and wheat. They process these grains into flour and flakes, which are sold directly to consumers through their farm shop. The farm emphasizes biodiversity as a key principle for sustainable agriculture and also engages in energy generation.

name: La ferme du Donjon
summary: La ferme du Donjon is a farm that cultivates and sells organic, seasonal vegetables directly to consumers. They emphasize sustainable farming practices, respecting the seasons and prioritizing short supply chains with zero pesticides. The farm is open for sales on Wednesdays and Fridays, offering locally grown produce.

name: VeriFarms
summary: VeriFarms offers the Minifarm, a 5-tier, fully automated hydroponic system designed for year-round indoor produce cultivation. This system utilizes Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) and intelligent controls for LED grow lights and water circulation, enabling users to grow various greens and herbs in small spaces without soil, harmful chemicals, or pesticides. The product is marketed for both personal and business use, aiming to revolutionize home and small-scale food production.

name: EZ GRO Garden
summary: EZ GRO Garden specializes in vertical container gardening systems, offering complete, self-watering kits designed for ease of use and efficiency. Their products, including Quad Pots and various garden systems, enable users to grow more produce in less space and time, utilizing hydroponic technology. The company emphasizes sustainability by using recycled materials in their manufacturing.

name: Buttercrunch Farm
summary: Buttercrunch Farm is an aquaponics farm located in the Vail Valley, specializing in year-round leafy green production within a 3,000 sqft greenhouse. They offer a no-contact delivery service for online orders, emphasizing fresh, organic food. The farm was founded by a couple with backgrounds in culinary and entrepreneurship, driven by a passion for healthy eating.

name: Daunfarm
summary: Daunfarm is a farm that emphasizes organic and sustainable practices, offering a variety of fresh produce including vegetables, fruits, and dairy. They highlight their commitment to chemical-free products and healthy living, operating since 1985. The farm also appears to be involved in advanced agricultural techniques such as nutrient film technique and propagation systems.

name: Agri Island s.r.l.
summary: Agri Island designs and builds innovative industrial smart farms for agriculture 4.0, utilizing aquaponics and sustainable business models. Their high-tech facilities aim to produce food efficiently with minimal resource usage, focusing on circular economy principles and environmental respect. The company also conducts research to improve cultivation systems and produces food from its own smart farms.

name: eevigardens
summary: eevigardens is an e-commerce store specializing in premium, space-efficient vertical gardening systems for home use. Their products aim to provide fresh food and ambient light year-round, emphasizing sustainability and quality. The company offers a rich collection of seeds and features human-centric lighting in its indoor gardening ecosystems, with a focus on a "Sustainable Lifestyle Redesigned" and a "FOOD RE-DESIGNED" concept.

name: EcoTal (אקוטל)
summary: EcoTal is an Israeli organization promoting urban and hydroponic farming, aiming to integrate these practices into city living. They offer lectures, events, workshops, and sell products that enable a natural and healthy lifestyle. The company focuses on hydroponics and sprout cultivation, providing both in-person and online courses, as well as a retail shop for home growers.

name: Lighthouse Gardens
summary: Lighthouse Gardens is a certified organic greenhouse and market garden grower specializing in high-quality plants and produce. They offer a variety of edibles and over 50 varieties of succulents, suitable for gifts and home decor. The company operates an online store and a farm club, serving customers seeking fresh, organically grown products.

name: Homefarm
summary: Homefarm provides smart, automated indoor gardening systems for homes and businesses, enabling year-round cultivation of pesticide-free crops. They offer various models, from compact home units to commercial-scale solutions, supported by a mobile app and a 'Farming as a Service' model for commercial clients. The company aims to make indoor food farming accessible and successful for everyone.

name: Les Saveurs du Ried
summary: Les Saveurs du Ried is a family farm specializing in organic market gardening, operating for nearly 30 years. They offer a variety of organic vegetables, fruits, and processed products made on-site. The farm emphasizes sustainable production practices and biodiversity preservation, selling directly through their farm shop, online store, and various local markets and points of sale.

name: Young Urban Farmers
summary: Young Urban Farmers (YUF) specializes in creating edible gardens for residential, commercial, and indoor spaces. They offer customized garden solutions, including raised beds and self-watering containers, along with heirloom seeds, garden setup, maintenance services, and coaching. YUF aims to make urban farming accessible and enjoyable for individuals and businesses, providing fresh produce year-round.

name: 小猎人智慧农场
summary: Xiao Lieren Smart Farm is an agricultural operation focused on producing and selling organic produce, including corn and sweet potatoes. The farm emphasizes organic farming practices and offers its products directly to consumers, as indicated by its online sales and promotional content. It appears to be a direct-to-consumer farm business.

name: C-Grow B.V.
summary: C-Grow B.V. specializes in turn-key solutions for high-tech indoor farming and modern greenhouse horticulture. Leveraging 50 years of experience, they provide integrated systems for lighting, climate control, water management, and air treatment, enabling optimal plant growth year-round. Their mission is to bring technology and nature together, creating customized environments for diverse crops and ensuring efficient, sustainable, and reproducible cultivation.

name: inGreen Kelčany s.r.o.
summary: inGreen Kelčany s.r.o. is an innovative agricultural company specializing in aquaponics and microgreens production. They utilize a closed-loop aquaponic system, where fish waste fertilizes plants and plants purify water for fish, enabling year-round, pesticide-free, and fertilizer-free cultivation. The company offers a variety of microgreens, herbs, and vegetables, alongside African catfish, and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and environmental sustainability.

name: シンコムアグリテック (SynCom Agritech)
summary: SynCom Agritech is an organic farming startup focused on designing and distributing profitable and sustainable organic agriculture. They connect demand, products, and locations to create sustainable businesses. Their case studies include developing organic cotton in India and transforming tea fields into lemon orchards in Shizuoka, Japan, while also generating carbon credits.

name: The Urban Food
summary: The Urban Food is a company focused on urban agriculture and sustainable food systems. They aim to provide fresh, locally-sourced produce through innovative farming techniques. Their mission is to enhance food security and promote environmental responsibility within urban environments.

name: Ramsay Agriculture
summary: Ramsay Agriculture is an agricultural enterprise focused on growing and supplying fresh leafy greens, baby greens, and microgreens to local communities in Jamestown, New York. They utilize hydroponic cultivation for optimal freshness and employ renewable energy methods in their waste management to generate power and reduce emissions. The company aims to provide locally grown, high-quality produce with a longer shelf life.

name: Zilt en Zoet
summary: Zilt en Zoet is an experimental farm focused on cultivating vegetables, herbs, and flowers with a strong emphasis on ecological farming practices. They offer weekly vegetable packages directly from the field, promoting biodiversity, soil health, and sustainable methods like rainwater reuse and minimal plastic packaging. The organization aims to provide the best of the season at a fair price, fostering a connection between consumers and local, seasonal produce.

name: Me Sabe a Grou
summary: Me Sabe a Grou offers indoor and outdoor hydroponic cultivation systems designed for home use, enabling individuals to grow fresh vegetables without pesticides. Their product line includes various "GROU" units, pre-grown "GROU Plants" (eliminating the need for seed germination), and related accessories and supplies. The company emphasizes ease of use, sustainability, and the health benefits of home-grown produce, targeting consumers looking to save money and improve their diet.

name: Oishii
summary: Oishii is an innovative agricultural technology company specializing in the indoor cultivation of premium berries and tomatoes. They utilize advanced vertical farming techniques to grow produce year-round, focusing on sustainability and superior taste. Their products, such as the Omakase Berry and Rubī Tomato, are distributed through partnerships with major retailers and are recognized for their quality and Non-GMO Project Verified status.

name: Adaptable Gardens
summary: Adaptable Gardens is an e-commerce company specializing in portable, vertical gardening solutions made from recycled materials, designed to empower individuals to grow their own food regardless of space limitations. The company's mission is to promote self-sufficiency and gardening as therapy, offering Australian and New Zealand-made products. They cater to diverse living situations, including renters, by providing adaptable and space-saving gardening kits.

name: Società Agricola Bortolan
summary: Società Agricola Bortolan is an agricultural company established in 1984, focused on potato cultivation and other crops across approximately 194 hectares. The company emphasizes sustainable practices, minimizing chemical use, preserving natural areas, and reducing CO2 emissions with modern machinery. They operate their own retail outlet to offer high-quality products at competitive prices directly to consumers, reinvesting annually in technology and cultivation techniques.

name: Urban Funghi
summary: Urban Funghi is a company focused on locally producing mushrooms in urban environments. They utilize controlled indoor growing environments and an organic straw-based substrate to ensure fresh, chemical-free products. The company aims to reduce carbon footprints, engage with local communities through waste utilization and partnerships, and provide healthy, locally sourced food.

name: SmartGrow
summary: SmartGrow provides a precision information system to support farmers in making optimal decisions for crop cultivation. Their offerings include the SmartGrow system, focusing on hemp cultivation and irrigation systems, along with consulting services. The company aims to enhance crop yields through data-driven insights.

name: Lübecker Küchengarten
summary: The Lübecker Küchengarten is a non-profit social vegetable farm focused on sustainable and future-oriented organic gardening. It educates people of all ages in biodiversity-rich, nature-oriented, and biological gardening methods. The farm is supported by active participation, donations, and a vegetable box subscription service, promoting regionality and community.

name: HCH Haskins Cove Holdings, LLC
summary: Haskins Cove Holdings is an investment management company founded in 2008, specializing in gourmet food, restaurants, farming, and agricultural robotics. They focus on investing in unique companies and providing active involvement from their investment team and management advisors. Their portfolio includes an online retailer of Italian gourmet products, a high-quality Italian grocer, and a developer of agricultural robotics for small farms.

name: BC贷(中国区)官方网站 / Teclion(shandong)Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Teclion (Shandong) Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd, operating as BC贷(中国区)官方网站, is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, and manufacturing of intelligent agricultural equipment and facilities. They provide professional agricultural automation control systems, planting systems, plant factories, container planting, dehumidification/humidification, HVAC, and water-saving irrigation equipment. The company aims to offer comprehensive solutions for the agricultural planting sector, focusing on technological innovation and sustainable modern agriculture.

name: Gardyn
summary: Gardyn is a company that offers advanced indoor hydroponic gardening systems, allowing users to grow a variety of plants, including vegetables, herbs, and fruits, in their homes. Their systems utilize patented Hybriponics™ technology, automated lighting, and watering, managed by a virtual gardener named Kelby, to simplify the growing process. Gardyn emphasizes sustainability, reduced water usage, and pesticide-free produce, positioning itself as a provider of fresh, healthy food accessible to everyone.

name: Hidroponika
summary: Hidroponika is an online platform offering a variety of hydroponic systems and related products for home and commercial use. They provide guidance on choosing the right hydroponic setup based on user needs, experience level, and desired crops, including leafy greens, salad vegetables, and fruits. The website also features an online store for purchasing these systems and offers design services for custom hydroponic gardens.

name: AGRIWALANT SS
summary: AGRIWALANT SS is an agricultural company founded in 1999, specializing in the cultivation of fruits and vegetables such as fennel, radicchio, lettuce, chicory, potatoes, and cauliflower. Operating on approximately 70 hectares of land in the Piana del Fucino region, the company supplies major retail chains and serves markets in central-northern and central-southern Italy. They emphasize integrated agriculture, quality standards, and environmental compliance.

name: Mechanisch Schoon
summary: Mechanisch Schoon is a dynamic contracting company specializing in organic farming, with over 15 years of experience in the sector. They offer a 'total package' for organic livestock farmers, focusing on specialized organic cultivation and mechanical weed control. Their services include plowing, seedbed preparation, sowing, and mechanical weed control, utilizing light, specialized machinery to minimize soil impact.

name: Re Della Inc.
summary: Re Della Inc. is a company that grows, packs, and distributes high-quality fruits and vegetables, specializing in hydroponically grown produce from Mexico. They are committed to excellence, innovation, and sustainability, offering premium Beefsteak Tomatoes, Greenhouse Bell Peppers, Red Finger Hot Peppers, and Persian Mini Cucumbers. Their mission is to make exquisite Mexican produce accessible globally while adhering to eco-friendly farming practices and cutting-edge technology.

name: P. van Osch Groenteproducties B.V.
