summary: P. van Osch Groenteproducties is a Dutch company specializing in the cultivation, harvesting, processing, and packaging of fresh vegetables and lettuce varieties. They serve B2B clients with locally grown, day-fresh produce, exclusively sold through the ZON growers' association. The company emphasizes innovation, continuous improvement, and local production, also cultivating lily bulbs.

name: Westranell Horticultural Solutions Pty Ltd
summary: Westranell Horticultural Solutions is an Australian company specializing in vegetable breeding and distribution. Established in 2002, it began by distributing vegetable seeds from overseas companies into the Australian market, initially focusing on Pak Choi for baby leaf growers. The company has since expanded its product range to include various vegetables and is actively involved in breeding non-GMO vegetables suitable for vertical farming and developing new honeydew melon varieties.

name: AmHydro
summary: AmHydro provides sustainable hydroponic solutions to empower local farming businesses globally. They offer products and guidance for growing leafy greens, vine crops, and other produce, aiming to facilitate the launch of community-based food production. The company focuses on designing systems and offering support for commercial and small-scale hydroponic ventures.

name: Future Fresh Farms
summary: Future Fresh Farms develops and sells next-generation modular aquaponics systems designed to address challenges in sustainable food production. Their offerings include the Farmtainer and Farmplex systems for integrated fish and plant cultivation, as well as MicroRevive, a soil conditioner derived from fish waste. The company aims to maximize nutrition, minimize environmental impact, and regenerate soil health through innovative, scalable, and efficient farming technologies.

name: Biohof am Hollerberg Agrar GbR
summary: Biohof am Hollerberg is an organic farm operating under the Bioland association guidelines in the Donnersbergkreis region of Germany. The farm cultivates approximately 75 hectares, focusing on crop farming with an 8-year crop rotation and also raising livestock including sheep, goats, and laying hens. They emphasize circular economy principles, landscape maintenance, biodiversity, and direct sales through an on-site farm shop.

name: Minigarden Việt Nam
summary: Minigarden Vietnam specializes in providing European-designed vertical garden systems, primarily from Portugal, for urban environments in Vietnam. They offer modular solutions for both green walls and vertical vegetable gardens, emphasizing ease of installation, automated irrigation, and long-term durability. The company also supplies related products such as fertilizers, seeds, and lighting, and provides installation and maintenance services.

name: Biosem
summary: Biosem is a small, family-run organic farm in the canton of Neuchâtel, Switzerland, specializing in the production and selection of hardy seeds for vegetables, herbs, flowers, and green manure. They also cultivate various crops like potatoes, onions, and dahlias, and offer a self-service farm shop with fresh produce, processed goods, and gardening supplies. Biosem also runs a demonstration garden and offers courses on plant multiplication and seed cultivation, supported by a non-profit association.

name: NÃM mushroom
summary: NÃM mushroom is an urban farming company focused on sustainable and regenerative agriculture, specifically growing gourmet mushrooms from waste materials like coffee grounds. They operate a hyper-local model, aiming to feed cities from within by upcycling waste in partnership with companies like Delta Cafés. The company also offers mushroom grow kits for home use and emphasizes its commitment to environmental and social impact as a Certified B Corporation.

name: Hugo Wolf AG (duroplant®)
summary: Hugo Wolf AG, operating under the brand duroplant®, specializes in the design and manufacturing of high-quality planters and irrigation systems for green spaces. They offer custom solutions for vertical greening, public spaces, terraces, and interiors, emphasizing Swiss-made craftsmanship and technical expertise. The company provides comprehensive services from initial consultation and engineering to installation and ongoing support, aiming to ensure successful greening projects.

name: 株式会社ソルティエラ (Soltiera Co., Ltd.)
summary: 株式会社ソルティエラ (Soltiera Co., Ltd.) is a Japanese company focused on contributing to local communities through safe and secure food. They operate a self-owned organic farm using aquaponics to grow fresh vegetables, which are supplied daily to their retail outlets and restaurants. The company also sells organic produce, health foods, and specialized cleaning water, and operates several wine bars and casual dining establishments.

name: Buckeye Fresh
summary: Buckeye Fresh is a vertical farming company based in Medina, Ohio, specializing in the production of fresh, healthy, and delicious greens. Utilizing state-of-the-art controlled indoor growing facilities, they employ hydroponic systems, LED lighting, and sustainable practices, using 98% less water than traditional farms and eliminating the need for pesticides and herbicides. Their local, year-round production ensures ultra-fresh produce with a traceable farm-to-table supply chain, positioning them as a provider of high-quality, locally grown vegetables.

name: Bluehouse Greenhouse
summary: Bluehouse Greenhouse is a company focused on revolutionizing agriculture through sustainable practices. They offer solutions in sustainable agriculture and energy, aiming to transform the industry. The company operates with a mission to promote environmentally conscious farming methods.

name: Agrosys Vertriebs GmbH
summary: Agrosys Vertriebs GmbH is a small Swiss company dedicated to plant strengthening management. Their primary goal is to enable pesticide-free agricultural production by offering personalized consulting and solutions for both conventional and organic farming. They focus on providing expert advice and product recommendations to support sustainable agricultural practices.

name: Grateful Greens
summary: Grateful Greens is an indoor farming company that utilizes sustainable, low-impact technology, including solar power and rainwater harvesting, to grow nutrient-rich organic vegetables. They focus on strengthening local food systems by providing fresh, tasty produce year-round, starting with Sunflower Greens. Their mission is to change the world by offering a new, healthier way to produce food and nourish communities.

name: ООО АБС
summary: ООО АБС is a company specializing in the production and distribution of agricultural supplies, particularly for hydroponic and vertical farming systems. Their product catalog includes salad lines, pots, cassettes, substrates like peat and mineral wool, and bio-preparations. They cater to modern agricultural needs, offering solutions for efficient plant cultivation.

name: De Zonnegaard
summary: De Zonnegaard is a biological-dynamic farm that cultivates vegetables and fruits with a focus on taste and soil health. They offer a farm shop, vegetable and fruit subscriptions, and sell at local markets. The farm emphasizes sustainable practices, including crop rotation, green manure, and certified organic fertilization, to maintain fertile soil for future generations.

name: Twój Świat - Ogrody wertykalne
summary: Twój Świat specializes in the design and implementation of vertical gardens and green walls, promoting the integration of nature into urban environments. They are the exclusive distributor of Florafelt modules in Poland and Eastern Europe and also produce their own Vertical Planter system. The company offers training and support, aiming to educate the public and expand its network of partners both domestically and internationally.

name: Biohospodářství Kokonín
summary: Biohospodářství Kokonín is a certified organic farm located in Kokonín, Czech Republic, focusing on growing cereals, fodder crops, vegetables, and oilseeds. They also operate an orchard and a vineyard, selling produce directly from their farm. The organization emphasizes environmental sustainability through various eco-friendly practices, including renewable energy, waste reduction, and nature conservation efforts, alongside offering environmentally conscious IT services.

name: Народные семена
summary: Народные семена is an e-commerce platform specializing in microgreens, hydroponic systems, seeds, substrates, fertilizers, and related equipment. They offer educational resources, including a "Microgreen School" and marathons, to teach customers about growing microgreens for personal use or business. The company also provides delivery services and operates online stores in Belarus and Kazakhstan.

name: Pure Hydroponic Lettuce
summary: Pure Hydroponic Lettuce is a company that specializes in growing and distributing lettuce using hydroponic methods. They offer various lettuce varieties grown in greenhouses year-round, emphasizing freshness, sustainability, and environmental benefits such as reduced water usage and no agricultural runoff. Their products are grown locally and delivered quickly to grocery stores, ensuring a longer shelf life for consumers.

name: FarmModules.tech s.r.o.
summary: FarmModules.tech s.r.o. specializes in developing and implementing advanced aquaponics systems. They offer solutions ranging from home-use aquaponic towers to intelligent monitoring systems and full-scale commercial aquaponic farms. Their mission is to enable year-round organic cultivation with minimal maintenance and high yields, leveraging technology for efficient food production.

name: Futureconnect
summary: Futureconnect operates livfarm, an urban farming network that grows eco-friendly, pesticide-free vegetables using smart farming solutions. They emphasize a new paradigm of freshness by delivering produce from farms located close to consumers, including in-store farms that harvest directly for orders. Their mission is to provide exceptionally fresh produce through innovative urban agriculture.

name: Wüga GmbH
summary: Wüga GmbH is a company specializing in hydroponic cultivation of multicolor salads, emphasizing freshness, regional sourcing, and sustainability. They operate an urban farming project on a rooftop in Landau, utilizing 5x less water than traditional agriculture, renewable energy, and avoiding pesticides. Their mission is to provide high-quality, vitamin-rich salads through innovative and environmentally conscious farming methods.

name: Hoortech
summary: Hoortech is an e-commerce company focused on cultivating health and well-being through home gardening solutions. They offer products like smart gardens, microgreens, and mushroom growing kits, emphasizing healthy, pesticide-free food production with a focus on design, practicality, and sustainability. Their mission is to bring quality of life to individuals who wish to grow their own food at home, regardless of space or time constraints.

name: Coyote Hill Farm
summary: Coyote Hill Farm is an organic farm that grows and sells vegetables, fruits, and flowers. They operate a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) program with a limited membership and also sell produce at local farmers' markets. The farm emphasizes sustainable practices, being solar-powered, and offers eggs from their hens.

name: 농업회사법인 닥터애그㈜ (Dr. AG Co., Ltd.)
summary: Dr. AG Co., Ltd. is a leading automated mushroom production company in South Korea, operating as a smart farm frontier. They leverage advanced smart farm systems and automation to manage the entire agricultural process, from cultivation to sales. The company focuses on data-driven innovation to maximize agricultural efficiency and deliver fresh produce, with significant annual output and a growing international presence.

name: La Ferme du Torry
summary: La Ferme du Torry is a farm that offers fresh produce through subscription baskets and direct sales at markets. They provide options for home delivery and also sell products online. The farm emphasizes its commitment to organic practices, as indicated by its bio number.

name: LohmannsHof
summary: LohmannsHof is an organic farm located in the Aller-Weser-Dreieck region, practicing biodynamic agriculture since 1985. The farm focuses on field vegetables, potatoes, and has an integrated nursery for fruit vegetables, seed propagation, and plant breeding. It also cultivates herbs, raises sheep, chickens, and bees, and operates a bakery with direct sales through a farm shop and markets. The farm is committed to creating a diverse 'future field' through agroforestry and is open to educational visits and apprenticeships.

name: Evogro Ltd
summary: Evogro provides automated hydroponic plant growing systems for professional chefs and bartenders in the hospitality sector. Their internet-connected cabinets, coupled with support services and consumables, enable year-round cultivation of fresh salad leaves, microgreens, and herbs. The company emphasizes sustainability, reduced food miles, and pesticide-free produce, making advanced horticultural technology accessible for businesses seeking high-quality, on-demand ingredients.

name: San Leone Azienda Agricola Biologica
summary: San Leone Azienda Agricola Biologica is an organic agricultural company rooted in a passion for natural products and rural traditions. The company focuses on capturing the spirit of dedication to agricultural and rural heritage. It operates as a direct sales point and showroom for its products.

name: Goldkauter Hof
summary: Goldkauter Hof is a mixed farm specializing in crop cultivation, viticulture, potato farming, and chicken husbandry, with a focus on direct sales of regional products. They also offer contract farming services for soil cultivation, sowing, fertilization, plant protection, and logistics. The farm is actively seeking to lease or purchase additional farmland to expand its operations.

name: JAPAN PLANT FACTORY ASSOCIATION
summary: The Japan Plant Factory Association (JPFA) is dedicated to promoting the research, development, and widespread adoption of plant factory technology. They facilitate knowledge sharing through various activities including research support, business and technical assistance, surveys, international symposiums, and educational programs. The association aims to foster a network for professionals and stakeholders involved in sustainable agriculture and plant factory innovation.

name: Swift River Farm
summary: Swift River Farm is a certified organic vegetable and seed farm located in Idaho, dedicated to building a sustainable and equitable regional food system. They offer a variety of garlic, culinary vegetables, and seeds, emphasizing community partnerships and accessible pricing models. The farm aims to empower its community through shared resources and knowledge, fostering a more just and diverse food economy.

name: Deli Plant
summary: Deli Plant cultivates nutrient-rich herbs year-round in urban indoor facilities, free from pesticides. Their operation utilizes AI and smart technology to optimize production, employing energy-efficient LED lighting and significantly reducing water consumption compared to traditional farming. The company focuses on sustainability through reduced transportation and eco-friendly packaging, ensuring food safety throughout their process.

name: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN THỦY CANH MIỀN NAM
summary: Thủy Canh Miền Nam is a company specializing in hydroponic farming solutions. They offer a range of hydroponic growing systems for balconies and rooftops, along with accessories, cultivation supplies, and nutrient solutions. The company also provides technical knowledge and support for various hydroponic cultivation techniques, aiming to make urban farming accessible and efficient.

name: 北京中农绿谷芽苗菜研究院 (Beijing Zhongnong Lugu Sprout Research Institute)
summary: Beijing Zhongnong Lugu Sprout Research Institute is a specialized research institution focused on the production, sales, seed supply, and training for sprout vegetables. They have developed innovative, low-light, soilless cultivation methods for large-scale sprout production, serving major hotels, supermarkets, and wholesale markets in Beijing and surrounding areas. Their seeds and equipment are also distributed internationally, and they aim to establish China's leading sprout brand.

name: Smala Farming
summary: Smala Farming is an urban agriculture project based in Anderlecht, Brussels, focused on cultivating vegetables using sustainable and agroecological practices. They offer a direct-to-consumer model through basket subscriptions and an on-site market, emphasizing fresh, healthy, and flavorful produce. The project also engages the community through volunteer opportunities and aims to promote a localized and sustainable food system.

name: VertiPlant
summary: VertiPlant specializes in vertical gardening solutions, offering a fully self-sufficient system with integrated watering and liquid nutrient supply. Their innovative RVS Greenwalls are designed to optimize plant development, creating lush and colorful green spaces. They aim to bring greenery back into gardens and spaces where it has diminished due to space constraints, focusing on creativity and ease of maintenance.

name: 그린플러스 (Greenplus)
summary: Greenplus is a South Korean company specializing in smart farm solutions, leveraging eco-friendly aluminum for greenhouse construction. They offer a range of green business sectors including smart farms, plant factories, aluminum products, rainwater gutters, renewable energy (solar power), and urban landscaping. The company aims to be a leading green enterprise focused on environmental and human well-being, with a history of establishing overseas subsidiaries and securing significant smart farm contracts globally.

name: Lucky Dog Farm
summary: Lucky Dog Farm is an organic farm that provides fresh food directly from its fields to consumers. They emphasize simplicity, freshness, and organic practices for the benefit of all. The farm operates under the legal entity Lucky Dog Organic LLC.

name: キーストーンテクノロジー (Keystone Technology)
summary: Keystone Technology is a company specializing in advanced cultivation solutions, particularly focusing on LED lighting technology for plant factories. They offer "Eco-Boost LED Solutions" designed to increase crop yield and reduce energy consumption. Additionally, they provide "Accompanying Consulting" services that integrate LED lighting, plant physiology, product development, and brand strategy to support clients from technology to commercialization. Their mission is to contribute to society through light technology, aiming to be a pivotal "keystone" connecting technology and society.

name: Brogärde trädgård
summary: Brogärde trädgård is an organic farm offering weekly CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) subscriptions for fresh, biodynamic vegetables during the harvest season. They focus on providing subscribers with seasonal produce and also offer internships. The farm is preparing for the 2025 growing season.

name: High Ridge Hydroponics
summary: High Ridge Hydroponics is a company specializing in the cultivation and sale of hydroponically grown salad greens. Established in 2023, they focus on providing local, sustainable, and fresh produce directly from their farm to consumers' kitchens. The company offers a direct-to-consumer model, emphasizing quality and freshness in their speciality food offerings.

name: Fulusco
summary: Fulusco is a consultancy firm specializing in water management and agro-ecosystems, with a particular focus on the Chinese market. They offer expertise in sustainable ecosystems, including high-tech vertical farming and advanced greenhouse cultivation techniques. Their services aim to optimize food production and resource management through modern technologies and energy-efficient practices.

name: TheCircle Sarl
summary: TheCircle Sarl is a sustainable and competitive agricultural company that produces high-quality food using an innovative aquaponic vertical farming system. By integrating fish farming with plant cultivation, they achieve significant water savings and reduced environmental impact. The company offers a range of products including fresh salads, herbs, pestos, oils, and salts, and serves over 200 restaurants nationwide.

name: Phormium NV
summary: Phormium NV is a company specializing in premium agrotextiles, offering climate screens, ground covers, and nets designed for durability and technical performance. Their products are developed through extensive research to meet the specific needs of growers across various agricultural sectors. Phormium aims to provide growth-oriented solutions backed by global expertise, focusing on sustainability and future-proofing agricultural practices.

name: The Urban Cultivation Store
summary: The Urban Cultivation Store appears to be an online retailer specializing in horticultural and agricultural products. Their offerings include Dutch lighting innovations, climate control systems, nursery and seedling systems, plant factory solutions, dehumidifiers, vegetable seeds, and urban cultivation supplies. The website also features news and contact information, suggesting a focus on providing tools and knowledge for modern farming and cultivation practices.

name: 三鷹オーガニック農園 (Mitaka Organic Farm)
summary: Mitaka Organic Farm is an organic farm located between Mitaka and Chofu cities in Tokyo, specializing in pesticide-free and organic vegetables. They cultivate crops like sweet potatoes, corn, watermelon, cucumbers, soybeans, wheat, and buckwheat, and operate a large soba noodle field. The farm offers various services including agricultural classes, direct vegetable sales, event hosting, space rentals, workshops, and a members-only farm restaurant. They also engage with volunteer groups for agricultural experience.

name: Vitensa Home
summary: Vitensa is an organization rooted in natural cultivation, specializing in organic greenhouse vegetables such as cherry tomatoes, vine tomatoes, and cucumbers. They focus on sustainable practices, using natural crop protection and full soil cultivation to produce high-quality, characterful produce for the European retail market. Vitensa aims to provide 'feelgood vegetables' that are both delicious and ethically produced, emphasizing a healthy and sustainable approach to agriculture.

name: Idrohub Impresa Sociale S.R.L.
summary: Idrohub is an innovative social enterprise focused on sustainable agriculture through vertical hydroponic farming. They cultivate produce using advanced technology that significantly reduces water and soil consumption, aiming to regenerate urban spaces and promote local, km0 food production. The company also offers educational programs and services related to hydroponic system design and installation, contributing to environmental preservation and community development.

name: ООО «Вертимастер»
summary: Vertimaster is a workshop specializing in vertical greening, focusing on the installation of stationary green walls made of live plants. They offer a comprehensive service from initial consultation and site assessment to installation of the base structure, irrigation systems, and plant arrangement. The company also provides warranty maintenance for its projects, aiming to bring nature into urban spaces.

name: Farmacy HK Ltd.
summary: Farmacy is a green smart-living tech company focused on impact, driving the 'New Green Normal Movement' with its decentralized, data-driven farm technologies. They build smart mobile farms in urban locations like supermarkets, restaurants, and schools, enabling partners to grow produce onsite via a cloud-based system. Farmacy aims to promote healthy lifestyles with fresh, nutritious food while significantly reducing food waste, carbon emissions, and water consumption in agriculture.

name: Botman Hydroponics B.V.
summary: Botman Hydroponics B.V. specializes in developing and supplying advanced hydroponic growing systems, including propagation trays, floating rafts, and aeration systems, for efficient cultivation of leafy greens and herbs. Their solutions focus on maximizing yield with minimal investment, emphasizing sustainability through reduced water and pesticide usage. The company leverages over a decade of research to offer integrated systems for controlled environment agriculture, aiming to advance the future of food production.

name: Azienda Agricola Molino
summary: Azienda Agricola Molino is a family-run farm in Vinovo, Italy, that has been producing seasonal fruits and vegetables for over 50 years using sustainable methods and integrated pest management. They emphasize bringing healthy, high-quality produce from their land to the consumer's table, offering direct sales at their farm and at local markets. The company combines tradition with technology to ensure the best products while minimizing environmental impact.

name: 농업회사법인 닥터애그㈜ (Dr. AG Co., Ltd.)
summary: Dr. AG Co., Ltd. is a leading automated mushroom production company in South Korea, operating as a smart farm frontier. They leverage advanced smart farm systems and automation to manage the entire agricultural process, from cultivation to sales. The company focuses on data-driven innovation to maximize agricultural efficiency and deliver fresh produce, with significant annual output and a growing international presence.

name: Mattawoman Creek Farms
summary: Mattawoman Creek Farms was an organic farming operation that ran from 2005 to 2025. The farm served several thousand customers and employed over 130 individuals during its operational period. The owners express gratitude to their supporters and wish everyone a healthy future.

name: Obst-Paradies Kleinwort
summary: Obst-Paradies Kleinwort is a family-run business, now in its third generation, that began in 1901. Originally involved in livestock and arable farming, it transitioned to fruit cultivation and direct sales in 1948, later introducing self-picking and integrated farming practices. The business now operates a farm café and participates in weekly markets, though self-picking and the farm shop have recently ceased operations. They focus on direct sales of their produce and hospitality services.

name: Walnut Creek Farm Texas
summary: Walnut Creek Farm Texas is an agricultural company that manages the entire process of produce cultivation and distribution, from seed to table. They specialize in year-round aquaponic farming of various vegetables and fruits, utilizing sustainable, pesticide-free methods. The company also offers processing and custom packaging solutions for wholesale clients, ensuring fresh, safe, and locally grown produce is delivered ready for use.

name: Organic Aqua Fresh
summary: Organic Aqua Fresh specializes in sustainable indoor vertical and horizontal farming of leafy greens and herbs, grown year-round without pesticides or chemicals. They focus on improving taste, texture, and shelf life, delivering fresh produce within hours to South Florida. Their 1-acre facility aims to significantly impact the food system by reducing chemical use, fuel consumption, and carbon emissions associated with traditional agriculture and long-distance shipping.

name: Weerd Pompoenen
summary: Weerd Pompoenen is a biological agricultural company based in Lelystad, the Netherlands, specializing in the cultivation of pumpkins, potatoes, carrots, and other vegetables on 175 hectares. The company also processes and packages pumpkins and sweet potatoes for distribution to supermarkets, utilizing three modern processing lines. Founded in 2001, it has a long-standing commitment to organic farming practices, with the land being organically managed since 1984.

name: 台灣農神植物工廠有限公司 (TAIWAN SATURNALIA PLANT FACTORY LTD.)
summary: Taiwan Saturnalia Plant Factory Ltd. is a company specializing in the supply of consumable materials for hydroponic vegetable cultivation and aquaponics systems. They offer online shopping for these materials, including those for ice plant cultivation, and operate a physical store. The company focuses on providing resources for home and commercial hydroponic farming.

name: Le Potager de Jérôme-San
summary: Le Potager de Jérôme-San is a farm practicing living soil agriculture, focusing on organic and sustainable methods to produce flavorful vegetables. They emphasize direct sales within the local community, minimizing environmental impact by avoiding synthetic chemicals and reducing soil disturbance. The farm offers vegetable baskets and direct sales, with seasonal availability.

name: Biohof Heimenhaus
summary: Biohof Heimenhaus is a modern, ecological, and versatile organic farm offering a variety of products including vegetables, meat, and dairy. They provide a vegetable subscription service, a Q-klub for premium dairy and meat products, and also offer event catering. The farm emphasizes direct sales through a ramp sale and home delivery service for its products.

name: XPONICS
summary: XPONICS specializes in advanced cultivation techniques, including aquaponics, hydroponics, and aeroponics, to grow vegetables and flowers. They aim to create healthy environments for producing nutritious food and green spaces for offices, shops, and homes. Their methods focus on environmental sustainability and water conservation, enabling plants to absorb nutrients efficiently for higher yields.

name: Aquaponik 2.0
summary: This company specializes in the planning, construction, and commissioning of commercial aquaponics production facilities. They offer customized aquaponics solutions, considering factors like size, location, climate, economic viability, and sustainability. The company provides turnkey solutions and ongoing consulting services, focusing on green innovation in agriculture.

name: Garden Spot Int. sp. z o.o.
summary: Garden Spot Int. specializes in creating innovative vertical garden systems, known as Pixel Garden, and offers comprehensive green solutions for both businesses and homes. Their product range includes living walls, vertical gardens for balconies and apartments, water walls, lawn grids, exclusive planters, and acoustic green boxes. The company also provides rental services for green walls and fountains for events and trade fairs, aiming to enhance spaces with greenery and improve well-being.

name: vitec vegetable factory
summary: Vitec Vegetable Factory, part of the Lester Group, utilizes IoT and big data technologies in its advanced plant factories to cultivate vegetables. They offer stable quality and pricing year-round, independent of weather conditions. Their controlled environment allows for pesticide-free, soil-less cultivation, reducing processing needs and ensuring food safety. The company can also develop custom products for major food service chains, supermarkets, and convenience stores.

name: Prickenhof
summary: Prickenhof is a family-owned farm that produces high-quality organic food in accordance with strict Bioland guidelines. They raise dairy cows for milk and meat, and source pork and poultry from regional organic farms. The farm operates its own farm shop (Hofladen) and butchery (Metzgerei), offering fresh meat, sausages, and a variety of organic products. They also provide a local delivery service for their products.

name: Nordamark
summary: Nordamark is a leading European provider of hydroponic watering systems and supplies for microgreen production. They offer a comprehensive range of products including microgreen seeds (conventional and organic), grow media, packaging, and complete growing systems. The company aims to facilitate efficient and automated microgreen cultivation for both hobbyists and commercial growers, positioning itself as a key player in the urban farming and sustainable agriculture sectors.

name: Kleibeek
summary: Kleibeek is a farm shop and webshop offering organic vegetable and fruit packages, with a focus on biodiversity. They provide winter and summer subscriptions, trial subscriptions, and gift vouchers. The company also organizes events like a light walk and has projects focused on food and connection.

name: Grow Bristol CIC
summary: Grow Bristol is an urban farming enterprise focused on producing fresh, local, and sustainable food year-round using innovative methods like aquaponics. They aim to educate the community, promote enterprise, and develop employment opportunities through 'smart urban farming'. Their vision is to contribute to a healthier, happier, and more sustainable city by addressing challenges in food production, energy efficiency, and environmental impact.

name: Bachfeldhof Schweinhammer KG
summary: Bachfeldhof Schweinhammer KG is a farm that specializes in growing and selling a variety of fruits, including apples, pears, cherries, apricots, nectarines, peaches, Saskatoon berries, and plums. They also raise laying hens and offer direct-to-consumer sales (AbHof), delivery services, and supply to the gastronomy sector. The farm emphasizes its self-sufficiency in electricity production.

name: Narpavi Agritech
summary: Narpavi Agritech is an agritech business company focused on supporting crop cultivation through smart technology, enabling users to grow crops anywhere, any season, and with reduced water and space requirements. They offer a comprehensive, customizable package from farming initiation to yield sales, promoting hydroponic and soilless farming practices. Their mission is to make agriculture more sustainable and increase food production to meet future demands, aiming to provide healthy, toxic-free food globally.

name: グリーン・グリーン株式会社 (Green Green Co., Ltd.)
summary: Green Green Co., Ltd. specializes in hydroponic farming, offering consulting services, system implementation, and custom fertilizer creation. They also develop and sell original hydroponic and gardening products under their GG brand and operate an online store, "Eco Guerrilla," for hydroponic supplies. The company aims to support new farmers and improve existing hydroponic operations, emphasizing quality and innovation in their offerings.

name: Royal Hills Farm
summary: Royal Hills Farm is a local urban farm based in Oakland, CA, specializing in fresh microgreens and garden-grown vegetables. They utilize indoor controlled environments and outdoor raised beds to provide consistent, high-quality harvests year-round. The farm also offers a book on urban microgreen cultivation and direct-to-consumer sales through subscriptions and one-time orders.

name: The Root Zone Ltd.
summary: The Root Zone is a specialist hydroponics consultancy company with over 25 years of experience, focusing on urban greening and agriculture. They offer hydroponics consultancy, installation services for urban greening projects, and are vendors of industry-leading agricultural substrates like Fytocell. The company aims to solve complex challenges in hydroponics and has developed advanced monitoring systems for vertical gardens and urban greening.

name: Alexander Ranch, Inc.
summary: Alexander Ranch is a family farm that cultivates premium hydroponic greenhouse-grown lettuce, herbs, and organic microgreens. They are committed to sustainable farming practices to provide naturally healthy produce. The company focuses on cultivating, nourishing, and sustaining high-quality produce for consumers.

name: IDROVA
summary: IDROVA is an innovative startup that designs and installs advanced agricultural systems for both domestic and industrial cultivation. They specialize in creating soil-less, water-efficient farming solutions that utilize 100% natural nutrients and eliminate the need for pesticides or GMOs. IDROVA offers turnkey projects, including modular greenhouses and industrial farms, aiming to revolutionize agriculture with sustainable and high-yield practices.

name: Bioboerderij Goedinge
summary: Bioboerderij Goedinge is an organic farm located in Zuid-West Gent, operating on the principles of Community Shared Agriculture (CSA). They offer customers the opportunity to buy a harvest share at the beginning of the season, allowing them to harvest vegetables themselves or pick up a pre-made package throughout the year. The farm emphasizes responsible agriculture, respecting nature, people, and society, and delivers produce fossil-free via bicycle cart or boat to local pickup points. They also collaborate with De Moester vzw to provide employment for individuals facing psychological or social vulnerabilities.

name: Verdureira Agro Indústria S.A
summary: Verdureira Agro Indústria S.A is a Brazilian company specializing in the production and distribution of fresh salads and vegetables. They emphasize rapid delivery, aiming to get products from harvest to business shelves within 24 hours. The company utilizes advanced technologies like hydroponics and modified atmosphere packaging to ensure product quality, freshness, and extended shelf life, positioning itself as an innovative supplier in the food industry.

name: Booysen's Tunnel Farm
summary: Booysen's Tunnel Farm is a small-scale farming operation specializing in high-quality fresh produce using hydroponic and traditional methods. Beyond its own production, the farm offers consultation services for greenhouse and tunnel farming, custom business plans, turnkey setup solutions, and mentorship for new farmers. Its mission is to become a large-scale supplier of fresh produce while building networks and uplifting the community through sustainable farming practices and knowledge sharing.

name: BUONATERRA S.P.A.
summary: BUONATERRA S.P.A., operating under the brand "Terra&Vita", is an Italian company specializing in the production and distribution of fresh, ready-to-eat food products. They manage the entire production chain, from cultivation in vertical farms and greenhouses to processing and in-store merchandising, ensuring high quality and freshness. Their product range includes salads, soups, ready meals, fruit juices, and cereal mixes, all produced with advanced technology and a focus on sustainability.

name: Eden Grow Systems
summary: Eden Grow Systems is a Houston-based company that utilizes NASA-developed aeroponic technology to create modular grow towers for cultivating fruits and vegetables with minimal water and no soil. Founded in 2017, the company aims to bring space-age agricultural solutions to Earth, addressing food deserts and promoting sustainable agriculture. Their systems offer accelerated growth and are designed for scalability from residential to commercial applications, with future innovations including self-sustaining life-support systems.

name: La Ferme des Possibles
summary: La Ferme des Possibles is a cooperative that supports individuals facing social exclusion and disabilities by integrating them into a local, sustainable, and inclusive food system. They operate urban farms, offer catering services, and provide corporate event planning, all while focusing on ecological agriculture and community well-being. Their mission is to transform needs into resources, fostering employment and sustainable territories.

name: 叶菜侠（山东）农业科技有限公司 (LEAFYMAN®️ Shandong Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: LEAFYMAN focuses on the research and development of standardized production processes for leafy vegetables, integrating crop production techniques with advanced facilities to create comprehensive production equipment systems. They offer solutions for greenhouse hydroponics, plant factories, horticultural automation, and specialized materials, aiming to create healthy growing environments for various crops and support industrialized production. The company provides automated DFT hydroponic solutions for year-round, low-labor leafy vegetable supply in urban areas.

name: Mällby Lantgård
summary: Mällby Lantgård is a small, family-run organic farm located in Hjälteby, Sweden, specializing in egg production and the cultivation of organic asparagus and vegetables. They integrate their poultry into their crop rotation, using chicken manure to fertilize vegetable crops and then sowing new pasture for the chickens. The farm also features a small on-site bakery producing gluten-free baked goods, primarily using buckwheat, and offers its products through a webshop.

name: Podere Volere
summary: Podere Volere is an agricultural company located in Este, Italy, dedicated to growing genuine and sustainable products. They emphasize a combination of agronomic science and a deep respect for nature, focusing on family values, biodiversity, and continuous learning. The company offers weekly produce boxes, direct sales, and local delivery, aiming to connect consumers with the natural cycle of food production.

name: Airlux Technologies
summary: Airlux Technologies is an innovative company specializing in assimilation lighting and climate control systems for horticulture. With over 15 years of global expertise, they provide tailored, R&D-driven solutions including LED lighting, climate control systems, sensors, and controllers. Their mission is to optimize growing conditions, enhance crop quality, maximize yields, and reduce costs for vertical farming, indoor farming, and greenhouse operations.

name: BeGreen
summary: BeGreen operates a network of urban farms that produce hydroponic vegetables year-round in controlled environments, free from pesticides. Their high-tech, sustainable model significantly increases production while drastically reducing water consumption and transportation emissions. BeGreen supplies fresh produce to restaurants and offers educational experiences and 'pick-and-take' visits, promoting sustainability and healthy eating.

name: Urban Farming Technology BV
summary: Urban Farming Technology BV specializes in the development of monitoring and control systems for indoor and outdoor farming. They offer R&D services with extensive experience, manufacturing of electronic devices through partners, and private label solutions for product development and manufacturing. The company aims to provide comprehensive technological solutions for the urban farming sector.

name: VerdeVertical
summary: VerdeVertical is a Berlin-based company specializing in vertical greening solutions for facades and interiors. They offer planning, installation, and maintenance services for vertical gardens, green walls, and facade greening systems across Germany. The company also provides rental options for events and integrates corporate logos into green installations, leveraging 10 years of experience in the field.

name: Kubed Root
summary: Kubed Root is an indoor co-farming space in Buffalo, NY, offering flexible greenhouse rentals for year-round cultivation of produce. They provide individual 6ft x 8ft 'Kubes' equipped with LED lighting, water, and soil, along with shared amenities like tools, a coworking space, and community events. The company aims to foster urban farming and sustainability by making indoor growing accessible to individuals and teams.

name: Horta de Fanares
summary: Horta de Fanares is a local producer specializing in microgreens, emphasizing sustainable and vertical farming practices. They offer fresh, locally grown microvegetables produced naturally without fertilizers, aiming to provide nutritious food while minimizing water waste and maximizing space efficiency. The company focuses on direct sales to consumers, promoting a connection between the producer and the local community.

name: A Regola d'Orto S.S. Società Agricola
summary: A Regola d'Orto is an agricultural company based in Monteviale, Italy, specializing in the production and direct-to-consumer delivery of fresh produce, including vegetables, fruits, honey, and eggs. They emphasize generational passion for agriculture and the importance of local, seasonal products. The company offers various pre-selected and customizable produce boxes, with home delivery options and a focus on customer convenience and product quality.

name: Ott Gemüse AG
summary: Ott Gemüse AG is a family-run business in its fourth generation, specializing in the production of fresh vegetables and salads. Located in the Unterthurgau region of Switzerland, they utilize good soil and Rhine water for sustainable farming. The company emphasizes local and climate-friendly energy production, including a large photovoltaic system and a CO2-free heating system for their greenhouses. They offer a wide variety of produce, directly processed and packaged on-site for consumers.

name: Biolandgärtnerei Erdfrüchte
summary: Biolandgärtnerei Erdfrüchte is a market garden operating for 40 years under Bioland guidelines, cultivating over 30 types of vegetables on approximately 3 hectares of open land and 2000 sqm of greenhouse space. They focus on organic farming practices, including organic fertilization, green manuring, and crop rotation, to ensure healthy produce. The company sells directly from their farm shop and at a local market.

name: BF Agricola S.r.l. Società Agricola
summary: BF Agricola is an agricultural company engaged in farming and livestock activities, with a focus on transforming its own products. They offer both conventional and organic produce, including medicinal plants, fruits, and vegetables, cultivated using eco-sustainable methods. The company emphasizes its agricultural supply chain and aims to be more than just a farm.

name: Golden Russet Farm
summary: Golden Russet Farm is a certified organic farm and greenhouse operation located in Shoreham, VT. They specialize in growing and selling vegetable and flower plants, cut flowers for events, and produce sold through their farmstand and local co-ops. The farm also offers a CSA program, providing fresh produce to its members.

name: Xardinova Coruña SLU
summary: Xardinova specializes in gardening, urban farming, and pool maintenance, offering a wide range of products and machinery for lawn and garden care, as well as technical solutions for irrigation systems and pool purification. They are official distributors for leading brands like Outils Wolf, Stihl, and Honda, and provide expert post-sales service and technical support through their specialized workshops. Their mission is to ensure customers can fully enjoy their gardens and pools with quality products and expert advice.

name: Suministros Agroebro
summary: Suministros Agroebro is a company with over 30 years of experience providing agricultural supplies and services. They specialize in precision agriculture, offering solutions like satellite and drone imagery, optimized water usage, and variable rate seeding/fertilization. The company also supports ecological farming practices and offers online sales of agricultural products.

name: Certhon
summary: Certhon specializes in designing and building high-tech greenhouses and indoor farming solutions worldwide. They offer turnkey greenhouse systems, indoor farming setups, and robotic harvesting solutions aimed at increasing yield, quality, and sustainability in food production. Their integrated Certhon Control System (CCS) optimizes technical installations for energy efficiency, serving growers, investors, and researchers.

name: 株式会社アグリ王 (Agri-Oh Co., Ltd.)
summary: 株式会社アグリ王 (Agri-Oh Co., Ltd.) specializes in the development, implementation, and operation of LED plant factories. Their mission is to create a safe and secure food future, foster a society where individuals with disabilities can thrive, and cultivate new food cultures. They offer comprehensive support from initial consultation to post-installation follow-up for LED plant factory adoption.

name: Sinterra
summary: Sinterra specializes in developing innovative solutions for substrate-free hydroponic cultivation. Their products aim to simplify hydroponics for a wide range of users, from home growers to large-scale farms, emphasizing ease of use and sustainability. The company offers flexible alternatives to traditional grow plugs and plant pots, promoting healthy root development and resource efficiency.

name: Crotoni
summary: Crotoni is a family-owned business established in 2001, specializing in the cultivation of vegetables in open ground with a focus on quality, sustainability, and reliability. They grow a variety of vegetables, including lettuce alternatives and other produce, with a commitment to respecting the soil and environment through innovative and sustainable farming methods. The company serves both the fresh market and the food processing industry, ensuring freshness, continuity, and adherence to high standards.

name: Cocotte Émoi
summary: Cocotte Émoi is a family-run organic farm located in Saint-Sauveur, France, specializing in the production and direct sale of beef, veal, and pork. They emphasize sustainable, local, and short-circuit commerce, offering high-quality, traceable organic meat products. Customers can purchase products through their online store with home delivery or farm pickup options, as well as at local markets.

name: Growgreen Limited
summary: Growgreen Limited, operating under the brand ASPARA®, specializes in hydroponic smart growers for home, educational, and societal use. Their products combine technology with indoor gardening, offering automated systems for growing fresh produce year-round. The company focuses on innovation, user-friendly design, and promoting green living through accessible gardening solutions.

name: AZIENDA AGRICOLA VIVAISTICA RICCA SEBASTIANO
summary: Azienda Agricola Vivaisitica Ricca Sebastiano is an agricultural company specializing in the production of high-quality grafted, conventional, and organic vegetable plants. Established in 1985, they focus on innovation and continuous research to improve their nursery production processes. The company offers a variety of products including seedlings in different cell sizes, grafted plants, and special substrates, with a recent expansion into certified organic vegetable seedling production.

name: Tomatopiu srl
summary: Tomatopiu srl designs and manufactures the "Tomato+" indoor greenhouse, a revolutionary, fully automatic system for growing high-quality vegetable sprouts, herbs, and salads year-round. Targeting restaurants and chefs, it emphasizes healthy, nutrient-rich produce with a low environmental impact, utilizing biodegradable pods and innovative technology. The company also offers related software and accessories, positioning itself as a provider of fresh, locally grown ingredients for the culinary industry.

name: Martini Società Agricola S.S.
summary: Martini Società Agricola S.S. is a biological agricultural company focused on the breeding and direct sale of meats. The company manages over 100 hectares of pastures, woods, and cereal/forage crops, primarily in Galeata and Civitella di Romagna. They emphasize quality and authenticity in their products, with a direct sales point and an online shop. The company has also received European Community funding for young farmer initiatives and farm investments.

name: Brota
summary: Brota is a Brazilian startup that designs and sells intelligent indoor gardening systems and decorative pots. Their products, such as the Brota Box and various smart planters, aim to make it easy for consumers to grow herbs, vegetables, and even cat grass at home with minimal effort. The company also offers plant nutrients, replacement capsules, and educational content through its blog, positioning itself as a provider of accessible urban gardening solutions.

name: Stienen Bedrijfselektronica B.V. (formerly Microfan)
summary: Stienen Bedrijfselektronica B.V., formerly known as Microfan, provides comprehensive farm automation solutions for poultry, pig, and cattle farming. The company offers cloud portals, climate computers, and other integrated systems to optimize livestock operations. With over 45 years of experience and a presence in more than 40 countries, Stienen focuses on delivering reliable service and advanced technology to modern livestock farmers.

name: Società agricola La Campagnola s.s. società benefit
summary: Società agricola La Campagnola is an agricultural company that cultivates and sells its own organic produce, including vegetables, fruits, berries, and herbs. They also offer seedlings, flowers, and aromatic plants directly to consumers. The company operates as a 'società benefit,' indicating a commitment to social and environmental impact alongside profit. They emphasize direct sales from their Udine location with prior reservation and appointment.

name: Blokgarden
summary: Blokgarden specializes in creating participatory community gardens and diverse green spaces that enhance both nature and human well-being. They implement tangible actions for companies and cities to achieve sustainability goals, increase urban biodiversity, and support resident and employee welfare. Their services include urban farming solutions, indoor hydroponics for restaurants, office gardens, and Green Care initiatives for care homes and schools.

name: Caspersch Hof Naturkost GbR
summary: Caspersch Hof is a farm focused on organic agriculture, raising livestock, and growing seasonal produce. They offer a variety of products including grains, potatoes, flax, and fresh vegetables from their fields and greenhouses. The farm also operates a farm shop and a subscription box service (Abokiste), emphasizing a circular economy and sustainable practices for both people and nature.

name: Oishii
summary: Oishii is an innovative agricultural technology company specializing in the indoor cultivation of premium berries and tomatoes. They utilize advanced vertical farming techniques to grow produce year-round, focusing on sustainability and superior taste. Their products, such as the Omakase Berry and Rubī Tomato, are distributed through partnerships with major retailers and are recognized for their quality and Non-GMO Project Verified status.

name: SCEA DU CHAILLOUE
summary: SCEA DU CHAILLOUE is a family-run farm located in Saint-Mard-de-Réno, France, operating since 1943. They specialize in organic farming, producing a variety of goods including grains, hemp products, flours, pastas, juices, and animal feed. Additionally, they raise Blonde d'Aquitaine cattle for direct sales of beef and veal, offering fresh meat and prepared meals, and also sell products from partner farms. The company ships products nationwide and offers home delivery in specific sectors.

name: ТОВ “ПрофПолив”
summary: ПрофПолив, founded in 2016 and part of EFT GROUP, specializes in designing and installing high-quality automated drip irrigation systems for organic fruit and berry farms. They utilize global best practices and high standards to deliver innovative, professional, and profitable solutions. The company focuses on providing turnkey projects that enhance business revenue and growth for their clients.

name: OZPONICS
summary: OZPONICS is an Australian business specializing in hydroponic systems and products, making hydroponic gardening accessible to all Australians. They offer hydroponic kits, planters, and towers, emphasizing the sustainability and efficiency of growing food with significantly less water and space compared to traditional agriculture. Their mission aligns with contributing to global food security by enabling food production in areas with limited agricultural resources.

name: Primalof
summary: Primalof is a company specializing in the cultivation of witloof (chicory) using hydroponic and dark-growing techniques. They focus on high-quality production through automation, robotization, and sustainable practices, including on-site electricity generation and rainwater harvesting. The company aims to deliver premium witloof for various culinary uses and is actively seeking motivated employees.

name: Pete's Greens
summary: Pete's Greens is a certified organic, four-season vegetable farm located in Craftsbury, Vermont. They focus on growing and distributing organic produce year-round, believing that local food consumption leads to healthier communities. The farm offers weekly CSA shares, sells produce to restaurants and retailers, and operates a farmstand, all while emphasizing sustainable practices and increasing local food access.

name: Wallgarden
summary: Wallgarden designs and manufactures DIY-friendly vertical garden systems, including the 'Wallgarden' and 'Multi-Hang' modules. They emphasize quality, affordability, and ease of installation, offering a system that allows for better plant growth, including herbs and vegetables. The company proudly manufactures in Australia and provides a 10-year warranty on its products.

name: STADTRANDACKER
summary: STADTRANDACKER is an urban gardening community focused on growing vegetables on city soil. They offer a CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) model with subscription options for their produce, including new options without mandatory labor. The organization aims to connect people with local food production within the city of Zurich.

name: Rusty Plough Farm Rondout Valley Organics
summary: Rusty Plough Farm, formerly a provider of organic vegetables since 1996, has retired its business operations as of 2022. They previously sold produce at the Kingston Farmers' Market and through New Paltz Health & Nutrition. Rondout Valley Organics, a related online marketplace created in 2006, also ceased operations, connecting local producers with consumers. The farm now functions as a family garden, with some fields utilized by neighboring farmers.

name: HollandBioProducts
summary: HollandBioProducts offers sustainable agtech solutions for indoor farming, focusing on 100% biodegradable and compostable products like pre-seeded mats made from jute fibers and patented Bio-Flakes. Their solutions aim to increase yield, profitability, and food security by enabling year-round fresh produce production in controlled environment agriculture (CEA) systems. The company emphasizes environmental responsibility, contributing to clean water, responsible consumption, and climate action through innovative vertical farming applications.

name: ООО "ГРЯДКАРЯДОМ"
summary: ERP "Грядка Рядом" (Gryadka Ryadom) is a company that develops software for automating and optimizing city farming processes, particularly hydroponic and aeroponic systems. Their platform offers features like a marketplace connecting producers and restaurants, planting planning tools, daily checklists, demand/supply mapping, and agronomist consultations. They aim to make advanced farming technologies accessible to smaller farms and provide consumers with fresh, locally grown produce.

name: もりた農園 (Morita Nouen)
summary: Morita Nouen is a farm dedicated to growing safe and delicious vegetables using organic fertilizers and pesticide-free methods. They focus on delivering fresh, nutrient-rich produce harvested on the day of shipment. The farm also operates a restaurant, "農家食堂 わがや (Noka Shokudo Wagaya)", which serves dishes made with their own vegetables and local rice, promoting local consumption. They also offer agricultural consulting services for aspiring farmers.

name: 一般社団法人ジャパンハイドロポニックス
summary: Japan Hydroponics General Incorporated Association is dedicated to establishing safe, secure, and stable indoor hydroponic vegetable cultivation using new technologies. They specialize in the cultivation and sale of 'sprout garlic' and provide comprehensive management support for hydroponic farming businesses. The organization focuses on research for safe, secure, and stable indoor agriculture based on technological verification.

name: Kalliergo Farming
summary: Kalliergo Farming specializes in advanced, small-scale farming techniques to produce large amounts of produce. They offer innovative solutions including GeoTowers, affordable greenhouses, and climate-controlled containerized farming. The company also provides 3D modeling services and has been recognized internationally for its agricultural advancements.

name: VertiCrop
summary: VertiCrop introduces a proprietary growing method for urban environments, recognized by TIME Magazine as a top invention. This patent-pending technology significantly increases food production yield while drastically reducing water consumption compared to traditional farming. It utilizes a suspended tray conveyor system with controlled light and nutrient delivery to grow leafy greens naturally, eliminating the need for pesticides and herbicides.

name: KS.EP株式会社
summary: KS.EP株式会社 is a company focused on creating future plant factories, aiming to inspire visitors with the wonders of plants and science. They develop innovative solutions for plant cultivation, including next-generation greenhouses and specialized equipment. Their mission is to contribute to humanity's future development and hope by creating energy-efficient, advanced plant cultivation systems.

name: MORGENTAU Biogemüse GmbH
summary: Morgentau Gärten offers urban dwellers the opportunity to grow their own organic vegetables in city gardens. They provide prepared fields, organic seeds and plants, gardening tools, water access, and expert guidance. The service guarantees a harvest success and aims to make organic vegetable cultivation accessible to people without land ownership.

name: Urban Gartneren AS
summary: Urban Gartneren AS is a Norwegian company specializing in the production of high-quality, environmentally friendly green produce, including microgreens and salads. They utilize advanced vertical hydroponic farming technology with LED lighting and recirculating water systems to minimize energy and water consumption and eliminate the need for pesticides. The company aims to provide fresh, locally sourced food with minimal environmental impact and also offers complete hydroponic systems and training to aspiring growers.

name: Neighbor's Farm (ネイバーズファーム)
summary: Neighbor's Farm is an urban farm located in Hino City, Tokyo, dedicated to growing and selling fresh, delicious vegetables and fruits. They specialize in flavorful tomatoes, seasonal vegetables, and blueberries, aiming to connect farms and dining tables at a close, community-oriented distance. The farm also operates an online shop and participates in events, with their produce being featured in local restaurants and media.

name: АО "СП "ЗАРЯ"
summary: АО "СП "ЗАРЯ" is a leading greenhouse farm in the Russian Federation, established in 1982. The company specializes in growing ecologically clean cucumbers and tomatoes using innovative technologies, including biological pest control and bee/bumblebee pollination. They focus on high-quality produce with excellent taste, cultivated in conditions that exclude harmful substances. The company also operates a significant retail network for its products.

name: KPC Online
summary: KPC Online specializes in expert consultation and sales for greenyGARDEN HOME and greenyWATER products from greeny+. They offer advice on hydroponic and aeroponic systems for home gardening, focusing on self-sufficiency and fresh produce. The company also provides support for ordering, payment, financing, and post-purchase assistance, aiming for a greener future.

name: Obsthof Marben
summary: Obsthof Marben is a third-generation family business specializing in the cultivation and sale of apples, other fruits, and vegetables. They also grow and sell a wide variety of bedding and balcony plants. The farm emphasizes local, sustainable, and fresh produce, offering direct sales from their farm and at local markets. Their offerings include various apple varieties, seasonal fruits and vegetables, and apple juice made from their own apples.

name: Biolandhof Meyer-Toms
summary: Biolandhof Meyer-Toms is a family-run organic farm that has been operating under Bioland guidelines for 30 years. They cultivate vegetables on their land and operate a farm shop offering their own produce alongside a wide range of natural food products. The farm also engages in various community and ecological initiatives, including educational programs and partnerships.

name: ErnteZeit
summary: ErnteZeit offers a unique gardening experience where customers can rent a garden bed for a season to grow their own vegetables, herbs, and flowers. The service provides the initial planting, and customers are then invited to cultivate their plots, fostering a connection with nature and fresh produce. It promotes a hobbyist gardening lifestyle, encouraging outdoor activity and community interaction.

name: Gemüsebau Bucher
summary: Gemüsebau Bucher is a family-run business that cultivates and markets vegetables and potatoes year-round. They operate under the protected brand "Bucher's Feine" for their quality potatoes and are GLOBAL G.A.P. certified. The company focuses on direct sales from the producer, offering products through their farm shop and automated vending machines.

name: Kuntilerhof
summary: Kuntilerhof is a family-run farm dedicated to biointensive agriculture, cultivating fresh, seasonal vegetables and fruits. They offer weekly vegetable boxes and hand-made flower creations, emphasizing sustainability, CO2-neutral delivery, and direct customer relationships. The farm aims to contribute to a healthier planet and provides nutrient-rich food directly from their fields.

name: Gemüse Käser AG
summary: Gemüse Käser AG is a family-run business specializing in the cultivation and distribution of over 35 varieties of fresh vegetables and salads. They focus on ecological and sustainable farming practices, integrating modern technology with traditional values. The company serves a diverse customer base, from local greengrocers to large retailers, emphasizing reliability and quality.

name: Green Automation Group
summary: Green Automation Group designs, develops, manufactures, and markets fully automated hydroponic growing systems for commercial leafy greens production. Their sustainable systems enable greenhouse growers globally to achieve high plant density, record yields, and quick ROI. The company aims to make fresh, safe, sustainable, and locally grown leafy greens the norm through advanced technological solutions.

name: Cooperativa Agricola Agricopecetto
summary: Agricopecetto is an agricultural cooperative based in Pecetto Torinese, specializing in the cultivation and direct sale of certified organic fruits, vegetables, and cherries. They operate a retail store offering a wide range of local products, including processed goods, honey, wines, meats, dairy, and baked items. The cooperative also engages in contract processing of fruits and vegetables and promotes social agriculture projects.

name: TropAgri
summary: TropAgri is an agricultural solutions provider offering expertise and services to enhance agricultural projects. They specialize in custom agricultural solutions, including greenhouse construction, agricultural consulting, landscaping, and rental of agricultural machinery. TropAgri aims to support farmers, market gardeners, horticulturists, and agricultural project leaders in creating efficient and sustainable farming operations.

name: Teclion (Shandong) Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Teclion (Shandong) Agricultural Science And Technology Co., Ltd is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and manufacturing of intelligent agricultural equipment and facilities. The company focuses on providing professional agricultural automation control systems, planting systems, plant factories, container planting, dehumidification and humidification, HVAC, and water-saving irrigation equipment. They aim to offer comprehensive solutions for agricultural planting and are committed to promoting the sustainable development of smart modern agriculture through technological innovation.

name: HydroInvent SRL
summary: HydroInvent SRL specializes in the design, realization, and supply of professional hydroponic and aeroponic systems, as well as advanced indoor farming technologies. Since 2012, the company has served individuals, agricultural businesses, research centers, and startups with customized solutions ranging from small design installations to large industrial farms. They offer comprehensive services including personalized design, equipment supply, custom construction, and ongoing technical support, focusing on innovation and sustainability in agriculture.

name: Enza Zaden
summary: Enza Zaden is a global seed company specializing in the breeding, production, and marketing of vegetable seeds. They offer a wide range of vegetable varieties for various crops, focusing on innovation, quality, and sustainability. The company serves professional growers worldwide, providing them with high-performance seeds to optimize their cultivation and yield.

name: (주)흥농원예자재
summary: (주)흥농원예자재 is a company specializing in smart farm solutions and horticultural materials. They offer smart farm hydroponic cultivation systems, greenhouse construction, environmental control systems, and agricultural heating equipment. The company also provides various agricultural materials and has a track record of domestic and international installations, including exports to Japan and the US.

name: La Fattoria Il Pettirosso
summary: La Fattoria Il Pettirosso, established in 2011, produces and sells organic and biodynamic fruits and vegetables. They offer fresh produce directly from the farm, at local markets, and through home delivery services. The farm also provides educational and recreational activities for children and offers support to individuals with special needs.

name: Plantaform
summary: Plantaform offers advanced indoor gardening systems that enable users to grow fresh, nutrient-rich produce year-round with minimal effort. Their smart gardens utilize fogponics technology and app control to optimize plant growth for herbs, vegetables, and edible flowers. The company aims to make healthy, sustainable food accessible to everyone, positioning itself as a leader in home gardening appliances.

name: Europrogress srl
summary: Europrogress is a leading company in the production and commercialization of greenhouses, warehouses, and related technologies for protected cultivation. Established in 1986, the company offers customized solutions from design to installation, including post-sales assistance, serving agricultural businesses, cooperatives, and development entities. They also provide solutions for garden centers, storage, shading, agrivoltaics, and sports facilities.

name: Nature Coast Aquaponics Systems
summary: Nature Coast Aquaponics Systems focuses on making sustainable farming simple through aquaponics. The company provides systems and likely related services to enable individuals and businesses to engage in environmentally friendly food production. Their mission appears to be promoting accessible and sustainable agricultural practices.

name: SAS Vitaprim
summary: SAS Vitaprim is an organization of producers with generations of experience in vegetable cultivation, specializing in open-field, plastic-covered, and glass greenhouse farming. They have recently rebranded from SAS LES 3 MOULINS-VITAPRIM to SAS VITAPRIM. The company focuses on quality and has multiple loading points across different regions in France.

name: CphFarmHouse
summary: CphFarmHouse is a company specializing in the production of delicious, organic microgreens using sustainable indoor farming techniques. They leverage CEA technology, combining principles of greenhouse and vertical farming to ensure consistent quality year-round. Their production is 100% organic, free from pesticides and fertilizers, and utilizes green energy and minimal water, focusing on environmental impact reduction.

name: PAV & BIO SAVEURS
summary: PAV SA and Bio Saveurs Sàrl are complementary family-run businesses specializing in organic farming and the preparation of ready-to-use vegetables. Bio Saveurs cultivates approximately 80 hectares of organic produce, while PAV SA focuses on transforming these vegetables into convenient, ready-to-eat products, including utilizing produce that might otherwise be wasted due to size or shape. This integrated approach ensures efficient use of resources and provides consumers with high-quality, accessible organic vegetable products.

name: The Urban Worm CIC
summary: The Urban Worm CIC is a social enterprise dedicated to promoting worm farming as a sustainable solution for organic waste management. They offer products, workshops, and services to households, businesses, and communities, transforming kitchen waste into nutrient-rich fertilizer. Their mission is to inspire widespread adoption of low-cost, low-tech worm farming techniques.

name: Giona Srl
summary: Giona Srl specializes in automation and control solutions for irrigation systems, offering consulting, sales of a wide range of products, and high-level technical assistance. Founded on the vision of Carlo Boati, the company leverages its team's extensive experience and reliable products to become a reference point for clients. They provide solutions for various needs, including frost protection, vertical gardens, and greenhouse climate control, serving agricultural and residential sectors.

name: Father Earth Organic Farm
summary: Father Earth Organic Farm is a small family farm located in Lafayette, Colorado, specializing in locally grown, organic vegetables, fruits, and herbs. They offer a CSA program and a farm stand, with a focus on non-GMO produce, including hydroponically grown tomatoes and peppers. The farm also engages in consulting services related to organic farming practices.

name: Hof Margarethental
summary: Hof Margarethental is a family-run farm in Goldelund, Germany, transitioning to organic farming practices. They cultivate grains, potatoes, and vegetables, and raise livestock including pigs, sheep, ducks, and chickens. The farm also offers a vacation rental and boarding for horses, promoting a farm-stay experience. Additionally, they operate a community-supported agriculture (CSA) program called 'Erntegarten' and plan to open a farm shop to sell surplus produce and pork.

name: Certhon
summary: Certhon specializes in designing and building high-tech greenhouses and indoor farming solutions worldwide. They offer turnkey greenhouse systems, indoor farming setups, and robotic harvesting solutions aimed at increasing yield, quality, and sustainability in food production. Their integrated Certhon Control System (CCS) optimizes technical installations for energy efficiency, serving growers, investors, and researchers.

name: Biorfarm S.r.l.
summary: Biorfarm is an Italian company that connects consumers directly with small-scale organic farmers through a digital platform. It facilitates the adoption of trees, vineyards, beehives, and fields, allowing users to monitor cultivation and receive harvests directly. The company also operates an online marketplace (Biormarket) for purchasing organic products, aiming to support sustainable agriculture and preserve traditional farming practices.

name: Gemüsehof Weßling
summary: Gemüsehof Weßling is a family-run organic vegetable farm, operating for four generations. They specialize in organic cultivation and sell their produce through their own farm shop and various weekly markets. The farm also supplies kindergartens and schools, and serves as a demonstration farm for organic farming practices.

name: Cerro Punta
summary: Cerro Punta is an e-commerce platform specializing in the sale of fresh produce, flowers, coffee, and other related products. They emphasize good practices and hydroponic farming methods, offering a variety of fruits, vegetables, plants, and flowers. The company also provides tours and operates a coffee shop, aiming to connect consumers with quality agricultural products.

name: Wüga GmbH
summary: Wüga GmbH is a company specializing in hydroponic cultivation of multicolor salads, emphasizing freshness, regional sourcing, and sustainability. They operate an urban farming project on a rooftop in Landau, utilizing 5x less water than traditional agriculture, renewable energy, and avoiding pesticides. Their mission is to provide high-quality, vitamin-rich salads through innovative and environmentally conscious farming methods.

name: Vihannestila Känkänen Oy
summary: Vihannestila Känkänen Oy is a family-owned company founded in 2008, with roots in a farm established in 1948. The company specializes in the preparation and marketing of vegetables, as well as growing and selling vegetables, seedlings, herbs, and summer flowers in greenhouses. Customer satisfaction is their top priority as they focus on developing and expanding their business.

name: Biosporos
summary: Biosporos is a company focused on organic agriculture, offering seeds, fertilizers, and arts. They emphasize "a seed full of life" and have launched a new online shop. Additionally, they are developing nursery technology with automation for plant nurseries.

name: ActivePots Private Limited
summary: ActivePots Private Limited provides technology-enabled micro farming solutions for urban households, aiming to simplify traditional farming challenges. Their products, ActivePots, are intelligent, automated micro farming pots designed for balconies, rooftops, and backyards, enabling families to grow their own organic produce. The company focuses on making urban farming accessible, cost-effective, and a family activity, contributing to food security and environmental sustainability.

name: X TRIMMER LLC
summary: X TRIMMER LLC offers innovative solutions for the cannabis cultivation industry, including CO2 trimmers, vertical farming racks, and specialized LED lighting. They provide trimming services and machine rentals, aiming to increase crop yields and resource efficiency for farms. The company also offers a free 30lb trimming service to new clients.

name: Hapi Hydro
summary: Hapi Hydro specializes in the design and manufacture of custom hydroponic systems for commercial, medical, and hobby growers. They offer modular RDWC systems and parts, catering to various growing needs. The company operates with wholesale and direct-to-public sales, with stockists throughout Victoria.

name: Vext
summary: Vext is a company that designs and sells advanced indoor gardening systems, primarily the Vext 2.0 model. Their products utilize fog-growing technology, automation, and app control to enable users to effortlessly grow fresh greens and herbs year-round at home. Vext aims to solve common issues like produce spoilage and the difficulty of home gardening, offering a sustainable and convenient solution for fresh food.

name: Hirzel Farms
summary: Hirzel Farms is a family-owned agricultural business with nearly a century of experience in organic and sustainable farming. They specialize in crop production, offering certified organic corn, soybeans, grains, and sunflowers. Additionally, Hirzel Farms provides services such as custom seed cleaning, food-grade processing, and compost production from waste materials, aiming to preserve land for future generations and foster community partnerships.

name: InstaGreen
summary: InstaGreen provides sustainable urban farming solutions, specializing in microgreen cultivation systems and training for both professional farmers and home growers. Their mission is to enable local cultivation of fresh, healthy food while promoting environmental sustainability. They offer growing systems, biodegradable materials, and educational courses, aiming to make urban farming accessible and efficient.

name: CambridgeHOK
summary: CambridgeHOK is a specialist company focused on the design, research, construction, commissioning, and support of vertical farming, glasshouses, and energy solutions.
