They offer innovative technologies and services to help clients achieve specific goals, improve energy efficiency, and enhance food production environments. The company serves various sectors including horticulture, energy, and construction, aiming to deliver projects on time and within budget.

name: Springworks Farm
summary: Springworks Farm is a company operating the largest aquaponic greenhouse in New England, located in Lisbon, Maine. They specialize in growing 100% organic, pesticide-free lettuce year-round using an ecosystem approach. Their mission is to create local jobs, reduce food miles, and provide high-quality, great-tasting greens to their community.

name: Gut Fahrenbach eGbR
summary: Gut Fahrenbach is a Bioland-certified family farm with eight employees, specializing in organic farming on approximately 250 hectares. They focus on arable crops for food grains and oilseeds, agroforestry with nut trees, and pasture-raised Aberdeen Angus cattle, including their own processing and direct marketing via a farm shop and delivery service. The farm was recognized for its achievements in processing and marketing organic meat within regional cycles and its high ethical standards in animal husbandry.

name: Malaia's Microgreens
summary: Malaia's Microgreens is an indoor vertical farm in Southern California specializing in the year-round cultivation of over 25 varieties of microgreens, edible flowers, and specialty herbs. They supply fine dining establishments, including Michelin-star restaurants, and are committed to sustainable urban agriculture. The company holds high food safety certifications and has received grants to expand its operations.

name: (주)그린월 (Green Wall Co., Ltd.)
summary: (주)그린월 (Green Wall Co., Ltd.) is a company specializing in smart farm technology, particularly focusing on wall greening and plant factories. They develop and supply innovative functional planters called 'Tide Pot,' which allow for individual control of water levels and drainage. The company aims to expand into the AI smart farm market globally and contribute to domestic technological advancements in the sector.

name: Impilo Projects
summary: Impilo Projects specializes in aeroponic and NFT (Nutrient Film Technique) hydroponic systems, positioning itself as a leader in future farming technologies. The company offers a range of products including custom living walls, nutrient solutions, and various sizes of NFT and aeroponic growing systems. They are actively involved in research and development, collaborating with institutions like the University of Pretoria, to advance sustainable and efficient food production methods.

name: The Severn Project CIC
summary: The Severn Project CIC is an urban farming initiative based in Bristol that produces high-quality salad leaves and herbs. Beyond food production, the organization is dedicated to social impact by providing training, education, and employment opportunities for individuals facing barriers to the workplace. They operate using organic principles and supply local restaurants, shops, and distributors.

name: Westhof Bio-Gemüse GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Westhof Bio-Gemüse is a family-owned company specializing in the cultivation, processing, and distribution of organic vegetables. They offer fresh, frozen, and vacuum-packed organic produce, emphasizing a closed-loop system that integrates farming with renewable energy generation. Their operations span over 1,000 hectares of farmland and include large-scale greenhouses, a dedicated organic freezing facility, and research into sustainable agricultural technologies.

name: Bioland-Hof Familie Heckler
summary: Bioland-Hof Familie Heckler is a farm that offers a variety of products and services, including organic potatoes, eggs, and meat from their own livestock (pigs and chickens). They also operate a 24/7 farm shop ('Häusle') and are involved in regenerative agriculture, biogas production, and photovoltaics. The farm emphasizes sustainable practices and direct sales to consumers.

name: GIOVI SRL
summary: GIOVI SRL is an Italian startup focused on the research and development of ecocompatible hydroponic cultivation technologies for salads and other vegetables. The company aims to optimize production processes, efficiently use resources, and protect the environment through innovative methods in greenhouses and vertical farms. Their multidisciplinary approach involves agronomy, biology, engineering, renewable energy, and sustainable packaging, with a dedicated research center simulating vertical farm environments.

name: Re-Nuble, Inc.
summary: Re-Nuble, Inc. is a climate technology company specializing in sustainable agriculture solutions. They utilize their proprietary organic cycling science™ technology to transform waste streams into agricultural inputs, offering peat-free grow media like ReNu Terra Mats and organic hydroponic nutrients. Their mission is to help both home gardeners and commercial farms grow more sustainably and affordably, optimizing farm performance while minimizing environmental impact.

name: Compton Farms USA
summary: Compton Farms USA is an agricultural enterprise focused on producing and distributing specialty whole organic fruits and vegetables. They aim to supply local grocers and underserved communities in Southern California with high-quality produce. Additionally, the company seeks to educate communities on self-sustainable micro-farming and hydroponic/aquaponic systems.

name: Oxygena™
summary: Oxygena™ specializes in the design and manufacturing of revolutionary, modular, and demountable plant cultivation containers called Oxygena™ pots. These pots utilize an advanced aeration system that promotes optimal root growth through natural 'air pruning,' preventing root circling and leading to denser root structures. This technology results in increased crop yields, improved nutrient absorption, and more resilient plants, positioning Oxygena™ as an innovator in smart agriculture solutions.

name: Alvonto
summary: Alvonto is a company focused on effective, high-tech vegetable cultivation, emphasizing sustainability and a people-centric approach. They utilize advanced technologies like combined heat and power (CHP) units and are exploring waste heat for greenhouse warming, aiming for gas-free operations. Alvonto is part of Coöperatie Growers United U.A., which handles sales and marketing.

name: Cultinova
summary: Cultinova provides monitoring, control, and data management solutions for plants and the environment, supporting growers, researchers, and environmental technologists. Their modular CultinovaEDGE™ platform is designed for applications in greenhouses, vertical farms, urban green infrastructure, and open-field agriculture. The company aims to improve plant health and crop yield through advanced environmental sensing and control technologies.

name: SMARTFARMDIY
summary: SMARTFARMDIY provides smart farm solutions and technologies for modern agriculture, focusing on reducing costs and increasing income. They offer services and products for indoor and outdoor farming, including greenhouses, automated irrigation, and IoT-based systems. Their mission is to enhance crop productivity and efficiency through precision agriculture and digital solutions, making advanced farming accessible to farmers.

name: 河南乐果农业科技有限公司
summary: Henan Leguo Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd., established in 1990, specializes in the research, development, production, OEM, and project cooperation of hydroponic solutions. They offer a comprehensive range of hydroponic systems and greenhouse solutions for various crops, aiming to provide efficient and flexible cultivation methods for both home and commercial use. The company positions itself as an expert in hydroponic soilless cultivation, emphasizing their technical expertise and industry experience.

name: Urban Cultivator
summary: Urban Cultivator is a pioneer in the on-site farming industry, providing chefs and home cooks with systems to grow fresh ingredients on-site. The company focuses on sustainability, higher quality produce, and empowering culinary professionals with ultra-local, fresh ingredients. Following the acquisition of VaVersa B.V., Urban Cultivator aims to enhance its offerings and continue its vision of innovative and sustainable food solutions.

name: Kwekerij de Noordhoek
summary: Kwekerij de Noordhoek is a family-run business located in Kapelle, Zeeland, specializing in the organic cultivation of cucumbers, peppers, and tomatoes. The company emphasizes sustainable farming practices and provides information about its operations, organic methods, and certifications on its website. They are involved in the direct sale of their produce.

name: Alvelia s.r.o.
summary: Alvelia s.r.o. specializes in providing comprehensive services for controlled cultivation environments, including greenhouses and foil tunnels. They offer training, foreign internships, excursions, technical materials, turnkey construction, supplier recommendations, joint ventures, and management assistance. Their mission is to guide clients towards efficient and high-quality cultivation processes through expert knowledge and practical experience.

name: Association l’ID
summary: Association l’ID is a non-profit organization focused on professional integration through organic market gardening in Caupenne, Landes. They train and support individuals in organic farming techniques, producing organic plants and seasonal vegetables. The association also offers agricultural services to farmers and aims to guide its participants towards employment or further training.

name: Vitalfarm
summary: Vitalfarm is a BIO-vegetable rental plot facility that allows customers to rent plots for growing and harvesting their own vegetables. The farm cultivates approximately 15 different vegetable types, providing customers with the space to also grow additional plants. While the farm handles field preparation and subsequent cultivation, it will not be renting out plots in 2025. The operation focuses on organic farming practices and community engagement in agriculture.

name: Fancyleaf
summary: Fancyleaf is a family-owned and operated hydroponic farm, established in 1990, specializing in premium hydroponic products. It is a major supplier of Fancy Lettuce to Australia's largest supermarket chain and has expanded into growing other crops for farm gate trade. The company is also involved in consultancy and has developed innovative hydroponic growing channels with international sales.

name: MicroHabitat
summary: MicroHabitat is the world's largest urban farming network, transforming underutilized urban spaces into productive ecosystems. They offer installation and maintenance services for outdoor and indoor farms, including garden care, harvesting, and full production management. The company also provides educational activities and facilitates local harvest distribution, contributing to community engagement and sustainability.

name: Quinta do Arneiro
summary: Quinta do Arneiro is an organic farm that has been operating since 2009, offering fresh produce directly from their farm, kitchen, and bakery. They provide customizable and pre-set organic produce baskets, delivered directly to customers. The farm also features a restaurant and hosts workshops, emphasizing a commitment to organic certification and local sourcing.

name: FILCLAIR
summary: FILCLAIR is a global leader in the design and construction of flexible-covered greenhouses, with over 5000 hectares built worldwide since 1963. They specialize in turnkey agronomic projects, offering technical expertise and sustainable solutions for food production. The company emphasizes operational excellence, teamwork, cooperation, and innovation in its approach to agriculture and environmental stewardship.

name: Diemelhof Wülmersen
summary: Diemelhof Wülmersen is a Bioland-certified farm specializing in organic vegetable and arable farming, as well as raising geese, ducks, and chickens. They highlight their fresh Christmas geese and Peking ducks, available for pre-order, and mention the use of an autonomous, solar-powered field robot called Farmdroid. The farm is located in Trendelburg, Germany.

name: Karshamra Mat & Trädgård
summary: Karshamra Mat & Trädgård is a restaurant and organic vegetable farm located in Grödige, Botkyrka, Sweden. It focuses on a sustainable relationship between cultivation and food, offering services like cultivation assignments, processing, and consultations. The business also provides catering, events, collaborative projects, knowledge exchange, courses, and education, aiming to integrate gastronomy and horticulture.

name: Le Jardin des Sables
summary: Le Jardin des Sables is a bio-organic farm located in Couffé, France, specializing in seasonal vegetables and fruits. They emphasize direct sales and short supply chains, offering a 'Click & Collect' service for online orders. The farm also sells local organic grocery products and is committed to sustainable, peasant agriculture, working with local producers and AMAPs.

name: VerdeGreens
summary: VerdeGreens is an urban hydroponic farm that provides local, organically grown, seasonal produce directly to consumers. They emphasize pesticide-free cultivation methods and offer home delivery and farm pickup options. The company also sells farmboxes containing produce and add-ons from local producers, aiming to bring the farmers market experience to customers' homes.

name: Biologische kwekerij & winkel Zuidbos
summary: Biologische kwekerij & winkel Zuidbos is a Skal-certified organic farm and shop located in Noordgouwe, Netherlands. They cultivate a variety of fruits and vegetables on their own land, emphasizing nature and biodiversity. The business offers fresh produce through its on-site shop, a subscription service for vegetable packages, wholesale to traders, and online ordering via their website. Their mission is to provide local, organic, and seasonal products connected to the landscape.

name: Growgreen Limited
summary: Growgreen Limited, operating under the brand ASPARA®, specializes in hydroponic smart growers for home, educational, and societal use. Their products combine technology with indoor gardening, offering automated systems for growing fresh produce year-round. The company focuses on innovation, user-friendly design, and promoting green living through accessible gardening solutions.

name: Gotham Greens
summary: Gotham Greens is a company focused on urban agriculture, growing and producing fresh greens and plant-based dips. They aim to revitalize communities and innovate for a sustainable future by reimagining urban landscapes for farming. Their mission involves bringing fresh produce to tables through innovative farming methods and local production.

name: Santo Broto
summary: Santo Broto is a company specializing in urban organic cultivation of edible sprouts, offering kits and subscription services for home growing. They provide support, exclusive recipes, and guidance for a healthier, chemical-free diet. Their mission is to deliver freshness, flavor, and nutrition through practical and sustainable urban agriculture.

name: 라이네쎄 (Reinasse)
summary: 라이네쎄 (Reinasse) is a company specializing in interior landscaping, flower cafes, and urban agriculture support. They offer products like 'Rich Soil,' a unique soil that doesn't rot without drainage holes, and services including plant rentals and indoor gardening. The company also provides urban farming education, focusing on rooftop gardens, local food, and experiential learning.

name: Gärtnerei Schmid
summary: Gärtnerei Schmid is a biological vegetable farming operation located near Glonn, Bavaria. They cultivate 2.3 hectares of open field and 800m² of unheated foil houses, focusing on a diverse range of organic vegetables and a flower field. The farm emphasizes direct customer contact through its farm shop and subscription box service, ensuring fresh, high-quality produce with minimal packaging and no intermediaries.

name: micro orti.com
summary: Micro orti.com offers intelligent vertical hydroponic gardens for growing microgreens indoors. Their automated systems provide light and water, delivering fresh, healthy, and sustainable superfoods weekly. The company focuses on integrating urban horticulture into living spaces, providing nutrient-rich, design-forward solutions for home cultivation.

name: Seldom Home Farm
summary: Seldom Home Farm is a family-owned farm located in Urbana, Illinois, specializing in growing over 125 varieties of organic herbs and vegetables. With six generations of farming experience, they focus on sustainable practices, avoiding synthetic fertilizers and pesticides to produce nutrient-rich food. The farm offers wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer sales, including CSA memberships, farmer's markets, home delivery, and online ordering.

name: Terra Verum
summary: Terra Verum is an organization focused on promoting sustainable and organic farming practices, translating to 'True to the Earth'. They offer consulting services in 'Earth Care', crop lifecycle management, and product distribution, alongside producing and selling premium organic mangoes and other fruits. The company also engages in research and development for educational apps, clean energy, and water management, aiming to foster eco-friendly prosumers and community-driven food security.

name: Impattozero srl
summary: Impattozero srl, operating as Agricoltura 2.0, specializes in advanced aquaponic and hydroponic farming systems. They offer engineering, consulting, and training services to establish profitable, sustainable, and chemical-free agricultural operations. Their solutions focus on optimizing costs, maximizing yields, and promoting environmental responsibility through innovative technologies like vertical farming and nutrient film techniques.

name: Van Der Hoeven
summary: Van Der Hoeven is a Brazilian company specializing in the design and manufacturing of agricultural greenhouses and related structures. They offer innovative solutions for maximizing agricultural productivity, including various types of greenhouses like Poly Venlo, Poly House, and retractable roof systems. The company focuses on providing quality and safety for agricultural production, particularly for seedling nurseries and clonal gardens.

name: アトラス株式会社
summary: Atlas Corporation is an innovative company focused on developing advanced agricultural technologies, including a unique "Four-Dimensional Farming" method and an automated plant cultivation robot called "Robo Farm." They aim to create a new era of agriculture through technological advancement, offering solutions for efficient and automated plant cultivation. The company also provides information on its manufacturing processes and corporate details.

name: 株式会社Ａ＆Ｒネットワーク
summary: A&R Network Inc. aims to create prosperous agriculture and comfortable living environments. The company operates an Agri division handling agricultural materials and facility horticulture equipment, a Renovation division for housing, a Consulting division for agricultural and housing sectors, an IT Solutions division offering web services and IT support for farmers, and a Housing Environment division selling microbubble generators. Their mission emphasizes human connection, safety, health, and economic efficiency in developing future agriculture and living spaces.

name: Gospodarstwo Filipczyk
summary: Gospodarstwo Filipczyk is a family-run farm established in 1967, specializing in the production of healthy food using traditional and natural methods with minimal environmental impact. They cultivate over 20 hectares of land, growing vegetables, root crops, and green manure crops. The company engages in both retail and wholesale sales, with physical stores and nationwide shipping, and also complements its offerings with products from partner farms.

name: MONT POTAGER BIO
summary: MONT POTAGER BIO is a market garden farm located in Rontalon, specializing in the production and direct sale of organic fruits and vegetables. They are committed to environmentally friendly agriculture, using natural fertilizers and pest control methods. The farm offers a variety of fresh produce, preserves, and "farm basket" options, and also acts as a supplier for local businesses.

name: 농업법인 주식회사 그린 (GRIIN Co., Ltd.)
summary: GRIIN Co., Ltd. is an agricultural corporation focused on modernizing farming through smart indoor agriculture and collaborative farming models. They utilize IoT automation for efficient crop cultivation, offer facility installation, crop management, sales support, and maintenance services. The company aims to support farmers, foster agricultural innovation, and connect producers with large food companies and distribution networks, positioning itself as a key player in sustainable and technologically advanced agriculture.

name: Natuurlijk Klein Dongen
summary: Natuurlijk Klein Dongen is a family-run business that combines organic farming with retail, event hosting, and educational activities. They cultivate tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers in greenhouses, alongside a vegetable garden and a food forest, selling their produce in their own organic shop. The company also offers workshops, tours, and venue rentals, emphasizing sustainable agriculture and knowledge sharing.

name: Hydrolore
summary: Hydrolore is a company that provides innovative hydroponic solutions for home cultivation, enabling individuals to grow their own chemical-free vegetables and greens. They offer end-to-end services including custom POD design, crop selection guidance, training, assembly, and ongoing maintenance. Their technology, Inert Material Hydroponic Technology (IMHT), uses minimal water and space, promoting sustainable living and a connection with nature.

name: NC Tarım Ltd. Şti.
summary: NC Tarım Ltd. Şti. is a leading Turkish company specializing in soilless agriculture systems, particularly for strawberry and banana cultivation. They offer innovative solutions like movable and multi-tiered systems designed to increase yield while reducing water and fertilizer usage. The company emphasizes research, development, and the use of modern technology, aiming for environmentally friendly and sustainable agricultural practices.

name: Biohof Meiwes
summary: Biohof Meiwes is a farm and organic food retailer operating since 1998, specializing in the cultivation of over 50 varieties of vegetables, fruits, and herbs, as well as eggs from their own chickens. They offer a wide range of organic products through their farm shop, weekly markets, and an online delivery service. The company emphasizes sustainable and transparent organic farming practices, aiming to provide high-quality, seasonal produce to its customers.

name: 株式会社グリーンズプラント中越
summary: Greens Plant Chueh is a company specializing in the production and sale of leafy vegetables such as baby leaves, watercress, and lettuce. They operate two hydroponic facilities totaling 7,200 square meters, utilizing a solar-assisted system to ensure a stable supply of produce year-round. The company also provides recipes and company information on its website.

name: Crate to Plate
summary: Crate to Plate is a company that grows and sells fresh greens using state-of-the-art hydroponic technology in purpose-built containers. They focus on providing locally grown, high-quality produce with enhanced taste and nutrient value, utilizing 95% less water than traditional farming. Their innovative approach allows for year-round harvests and delivery within 24 hours of picking, minimizing food waste and transportation footprints.

name: Netar AgriTech
summary: Netar AgriTech specializes in providing comprehensive greenhouse technologies and solutions for modern agriculture. Their offerings include smart greenhouse components, automated irrigation and fertilization systems, and climate control solutions, catering to both soil-based and soilless farming methods. The company aims to bring smart approaches to the agricultural sector, enabling efficient and adaptable farming practices regardless of external environmental conditions.

name: The Salad Table
summary: The Salad Table is a company that designs and sells hydroponic growing systems, primarily their "Salad Table" products, along with accessories like nutrients and seeds. They aim to make growing fresh produce accessible and simple for consumers, emphasizing cost savings and year-round availability. The company also provides educational content on hydroponics and home gardening through their blog and website.

name: Biologische Tuinderij "De Twee Linden"
summary: Biologische Tuinderij "De Twee Linden" is a small-scale organic farm cultivating vegetables and fruits on nearly 2 hectares, with approximately 1000m2 of tunnel greenhouses. Since 1992, they have been growing over 40 types of vegetables without synthetic pesticides, using natural fertilizers and compost. The farm offers seasonal vegetable and fruit subscription boxes, delivered weekly, and also operates a farm shop selling organic produce, juices, and syrups. They emphasize working in harmony with nature, incorporating elements like ponds, flowers, and hedges into their farming practices.

name: Danvan A/S
summary: Danvan A/S is a Danish company specializing in innovative climate and water management solutions for the horticulture industry. They design, manufacture, and service products such as fertilizer mixers, valves, and automated gutter systems, aiming to create optimal growing environments for plants. The company positions itself as a full-service provider, offering customized solutions and expert advice to growers worldwide.

name: Gardyn
summary: Gardyn is a company that offers smart indoor gardening systems designed to make growing fresh produce at home effortless. Their automated hydroponic systems, powered by AI assistant 'Kelby', manage light and water, allowing users to grow over 100 varieties of plants year-round. Gardyn aims to reconnect people with their food, promote healthy living, and contribute to sustainability by reducing food waste and the need for grocery store produce.

name: Blue Moon Acres
summary: Blue Moon Acres is a family-run, certified organic farm specializing in microgreens, specialty salad greens, edible flowers, vegetables, and freshly-husked rice. They focus on regenerative agriculture and offer restaurant-quality produce through direct sales, delivery, and farm pick-up. The farm also provides recipes and information about its products and farming practices.

name: CMW Horticulture
summary: CMW Horticulture is a UK-based supplier specializing in horticultural technology and turnkey solutions for the horticultural industry. Since 2021, as part of Bosman Van Zaal, they offer integrated systems for glasshouses, vertical farms, and garden centers, covering climate, water, logistics, and control technologies. They focus on delivering future-proof, tailored solutions for commercial production and retail environments, emphasizing long-term partnerships and reliable service.

name: 有限会社 正八 (Shohachi Co., Ltd.)
summary: 有限会社 正八 (Shohachi Co., Ltd.) is an agricultural corporation primarily engaged in B2B transactions, producing vegetables, seedlings, and feed. Their main activities include producing wholesale pot seedlings for home centers, cultivating processing vegetables for stable year-round supply across various regions, and challenging the domestic production of feed corn, which is heavily reliant on imports. They focus on healthy seedlings, easy-to-process vegetables, and non-GMO feed.

name: South Florida Urban Farm
summary: South Florida Urban Farm is a modern indoor hydroponic facility specializing in the year-round cultivation of high-quality, nutrient-dense leafy greens and microgreens. They utilize an advanced, sustainable hydroponic system that eliminates the need for harmful chemicals and conserves water. The company offers a variety of pesticide-free produce, including microgreens, lettuces, herbs, and Swiss chard, positioning itself as a provider of fresh, environmentally friendly produce.

name: Vehro Oy
summary: Vehro Oy is a Finnish company founded in April 2022 that develops and manufactures 3D-printed cultivation systems. Their products aim to make local food production easier for everyone, regardless of gardening experience. The company is expanding its product range rapidly and operates primarily online.

name: IGWorks
summary: IGWorks is a company specializing in indoor gardening systems, offering products like the iHarvest® and uHarvest® indoor gardens, along with grow lights and accessories. Their mission is to enable consumers to grow fresh produce year-round, emphasizing ease of use, affordability, and product durability. They position themselves as a trustworthy brand in the home hydroponics market.

name: True Garden
summary: True Garden is a company that specializes in providing seedlings and gardening supplies, including aeroponic, aquaponic, and hydroponic systems. They offer a wide variety of plant seedlings such as herbs, greens, fruits, and flowers, alongside seed packets, ebooks, and accessories. The company also provides educational resources like classes and events, catering to both residential and commercial customers, and has an international presence.

name: De la fourche à la fourchette
summary: De la fourche à la fourchette is an urban organic market garden farm that produces organic vegetables, fruits, mushrooms, and cut flowers. They offer a 'farm to fork' experience through their pick-your-own service, an organic grocery store with bulk options, and a farm drive service for pre-ordered baskets and products. Their mission is to provide healthy, local food while creating a welcoming space for biodiversity and community.

name: Gärtnerei Neuland
summary: Gärtnerei Neuland is a Bioland-certified organic farm specializing in the cultivation and sale of fruits and vegetables. They operate a weekly market stall and are exploring options like a subscription box (Abokiste) and self-service sales (SB-Verkauf) for future offerings. The farm is committed to organic practices, as indicated by its Bioland certification.

name: Farmperfect, LLC
summary: Farmperfect, LLC is a consulting firm based in Redwood Valley, California, that assists farms in transitioning to organic practices and improving direct-to-consumer sales channels. They leverage agricultural experience and data analysis to identify opportunities for improvement, share best practices among clients, and explore new crop possibilities. Their services aim to optimize production, build sustainable enterprises, and increase farm profitability through strategies like farmers' markets and online ordering.

name: 株式会社ベジタブルテック (Vegetabletech Inc.)
summary: Vegetabletech Inc. operates advanced plant factories to produce "freshness-lasting vegetables" such as frill lettuce, green leaf, and sunny lettuce. They focus on providing safe, stable, and high-quality produce year-round, addressing industry needs for reduced food waste, consistent supply, and simplified preparation. The company emphasizes stringent food safety and quality control, offering a reliable supply chain for food processing plants, restaurants, and retailers.

name: 언니네텃밭 여성농민생산자협동조합
summary: Unninne Tteopbat is a women farmers' producer cooperative that operates an online marketplace for agricultural products. They focus on ecological farming, seasonal produce, heirloom seeds, and collaborative production. The cooperative aims to supply diverse and stable agricultural products to consumers through the collective efforts of its members.

name: Novarbo Oy
summary: Novarbo Oy is a Finnish company specializing in professional greenhouse cultivation solutions. They offer high-quality growing media, including innovative Mosswool, and organic fertilizers for both conventional and organic farming. Novarbo also provides greenhouse technology such as vertical farming systems and energy-efficient climate control solutions like heat recovery (LTO) and heat reuse systems. As part of the Biolan Group, they aim to create greener growth for their professional clients.

name: TIESSEI
summary: TIESSEI specializes in the design and installation of greenhouses and internal technological systems for protected cultivation. They offer expertise in various systems including climate control, fertigation, hydroponics, aeroponics, and vertical farming solutions. The company provides comprehensive services from initial design and installation to maintenance and automation, aiming to give clients full control over their agricultural operations.

name: Bio-Eichwaldhof
summary: Bio-Eichwaldhof is a farm located in Nürensdorf, Switzerland, that offers a variety of organic products and services. They specialize in direct sales of organic beef and seasonal organic vegetable boxes through a subscription service. The farm also engages in mother cow farming, crop cultivation, and fodder production, with a focus on biodiversity and sustainable practices.

name: SEF
summary: SEF is a vertically integrated greenhouse builder specializing in complete greenhouse solutions. They offer custom design, steel manufacturing, project management, and post-completion support. Their mission is to empower sustainable food systems by building innovative, high-performance greenhouses, driving client success through expertise and efficiency.

name: Urban Garden Boston
summary: Urban Garden Boston is a Certified B Corporation focused on transforming underutilized spaces into biodiverse, sustainable, and productive landscapes. They provide access to organic, locally-grown food and promote self-sufficiency through community involvement. The company offers services including food services, community maintenance, workshops, consulting, and residential garden packages, aiming to balance financial success with social responsibility.

name: 日栄インテック株式会社 アグリテック事業部 (Clean Farm)
summary: Clean Farm, operated by Nichiei Intecc Co., Ltd.'s Agritect Division, specializes in plant factory business, vegetable sales, and edible flower production. They offer plant factory systems, interior plant shelves, and cultivation kits, alongside a variety of vegetables, edible flowers, and herbs. The company also provides installation services for plant factories and showcases customer adoption cases.

name: Living Towers Florida Keys
summary: Living Towers Florida Keys specializes in vertical gardening systems, particularly the Tower Garden, for growing fruits, vegetables, and herbs year-round. They offer Tower Garden systems, seedlings, growing supplies, and consulting services for both home and commercial use. Their mission is to make healthy, nutrient-dense food accessible and to educate people on sustainable food growing methods.

name: GeoGreens
summary: GeoGreens is an indoor hydroponics farm based in Hamilton, NJ, specializing in growing fresh, local, and specialty produce year-round for the Tristate area. They focus on pesticide-free, water-saving, and 100% indoor-grown methods, aiming for a zero-waste operation. Their mission includes serving food-insecure areas and food deserts, supplying local restaurants, supermarkets, food banks, and institutions.

name: Sown in Surrey
summary: Sown in Surrey is a company that grows sustainable, environmentally friendly micro herbs and microgreens using hydroponic technology in a state-of-the-art vertical farm. They supply these living products to local restaurants, pubs, hotels, and wholesalers, with nationwide delivery available. They also offer a "letterbox kit" for home cooks and plan to release grow-your-own kits. Their products are highlighted for their health benefits, being packed with antioxidants and nutrients.

name: AGRITECH SERVICE
summary: AGRITECH SERVICE is an organization dedicated to supporting farmers in improving their farm's profitability and sustainability. They offer expert advice, innovative solutions derived from experimentation, and training in plant production strategies. With over 30 years of experience, they are committed to providing independent, relevant counsel to agricultural professionals, focusing on optimizing cultural practices for better technico-economic performance.

name: Pottery Designs
summary: Pottery Designs is a vertically integrated company specializing in the production and sale of high-quality plant containers and living wall systems. They offer a wide range of products, including ergonomic workspace solutions and natural material pots, catering to both consumers and wholesalers. The company emphasizes providing excellent value by manufacturing its own products and distributing them directly.

name: Eagle Creek Farms
summary: Eagle Creek Farms is a certified organic farm specializing in the production of vegetables, flowers, and seed potatoes. They offer a variety of services including U-pick gardens, farm store sales, and a unique organic vegetable fundraiser program for schools and groups. The farm also provides weekly food box deliveries and operates an online store for seed potatoes, focusing on soil health and sustainable farming practices.

name: МАЛОЕ ИННОВАЦИОННОЕ ПРЕДПРИЯТИЕ "ЗЕЛЁНЫЙ ЭЛЕМЕНТ"
summary: Green Element is a small innovative enterprise focused on integrating scientific advancements in ecology and healthy nutrition. The company produces enriched salads, supplies hydroponic systems, and develops bioactive food and feed additives, as well as plant growth stimulants. They leverage advanced technologies like hydroponics and nanotechnology, collaborating with scientific institutions to bring green technologies to life.

name: Our Homestead
summary: Our Homestead is a family-run hydroponic farm established in 2014, located near Myakka State Park in Florida. They specialize in growing high-quality, crisp hydroponic vegetables and greens without synthetic pesticides or GMOs, harvested 24-48 hours before purchase. The farm offers direct online sales, a subscription greens box, and participates in local farmers markets, also selling products from local vendors.

name: TTA-ISO
summary: TTA-ISO provides high-tech automation solutions for the horticulture and food industries, focusing on empowering growers worldwide. They develop cutting-edge automation, software, and integrated systems to enhance productivity, improve yields, and drive sustainable progress. Their solutions address challenges such as labor shortages, increasing demands, and competitiveness across sectors like ornamentals, bulbs, cut flowers, food, and forestry.

name: Certhon
summary: Certhon specializes in designing and building high-tech greenhouses and indoor farming solutions worldwide. They offer turnkey greenhouse systems, indoor farming setups, and robotic harvesting solutions aimed at increasing yield, quality, and sustainability in food production. Their integrated Certhon Control System (CCS) optimizes technical installations for energy efficiency, serving growers, investors, and researchers.

name: Urban Farming
summary: This content discusses the rise of urban farming as a sustainable solution for cities facing growing populations and food security challenges. It defines urban farming, outlines its benefits including environmental sustainability, enhanced food security, community engagement, and economic opportunities, and touches upon the challenges and future prospects of this practice. The overall message highlights urban farming's potential to create more livable and resilient cities.

name: Hidrovista Unipessoal Lda.
summary: Hidrovista offers modern hydroponic solutions for sustainable and efficient food cultivation. They specialize in developing accessible hydroponic systems for both home use and commercial production, promoting healthier food with increased productivity. Their offerings include domestic kits, commercial NFT systems, specialized nutrients, and installation consultancy.

name: Handelskwekerij Van Rossum
summary: Handelskwekerij Van Rossum is a specialist in growing and packaging chicory, producing approximately 1.5 million kg annually. They operate a modern logistics center for cooling, sorting, treating, and packaging horticultural and arable products, offering year-round supply tailored to customer specifications. The company is a member of Coöperatie Tolpoort Vegetables U.A.

name: Talborne Organics (Pty) Ltd.
summary: Talborne Organics (Pty) Ltd. is a company specializing in the production and distribution of organic fertilizers and solutions for various growing needs. They cater to farmers, growers, golf courses, landscapers, and urban farmers, aiming to improve soil health and yield success. The company emphasizes organic and sustainable practices in agriculture and horticulture.

name: ООО «УК «РОСТ»
summary: ООО «УК «РОСТ» is a holding company that operates a network of greenhouse complexes across Russia, specializing in the year-round cultivation of vegetables such as tomatoes, cucumbers, and lettuce. The company emphasizes modern, automated technologies, natural pest control methods, and sustainable practices, including energy generation and water recycling. Their mission is to provide high-quality, fresh produce to consumers through an efficient distribution network.

name: Himmelreichhof
summary: Himmelreichhof is a family-run organic farm in its 5th generation, operating as a Bioland farm since 1984. It combines sustainable agriculture with culinary experiences and educational activities. The farm offers fresh organic produce through a vegetable subscription box and a farm shop, hosts enjoyable events like 'Ackerdinner' and 'Sommerküche', and provides an experiential farm setting for children and schools, including workshops with natural materials.

name: La Bourrache
summary: La Bourrache is an ASBL (non-profit association) and CISP (social integration training center) focused on organic market gardening and the maintenance of parks and gardens. They offer professional and introductory training in these fields, sell organic produce through a CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) basket system and an online shop, and provide landscaping services. The organization emphasizes ecological practices and short distribution circuits.

name: KC Farm School
summary: KC Farm School is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to connecting individuals of all ages, ancestries, and abilities to land, soil, food, community, and opportunity through hands-on, on-farm experiences and vocational education. They offer programs like farm tours, volunteer opportunities, and educational initiatives, aiming to foster growth and community connection. The organization also engages in produce sales, CSA programs, and farmers market participation.

name: OroVerde Società Agricola Srl
summary: OroVerde Società Agricola Srl is an innovative startup focused on agricultural production and agri-cosmetics. They cultivate various products including basil, hemp, microgreens, and mushrooms (cardoncelli). The company also offers educational programs related to agriculture and hydroponics, indicating a diverse approach to the agricultural sector.

name: CityCrop
summary: CityCrop offers a smart indoor farming system that enables users to grow fresh produce at home using hydroponics and a mobile app. Their super-automatic growing machines are designed for ease of use, requiring minimal effort and no green thumb, while promoting sustainable practices like reduced water usage and pesticide-free cultivation. The company provides a variety of seeds and devices, supported by an app that guides users from planting to harvesting.

name: London Grow
summary: London Grow is a UK-based retailer specializing in products for urban farming, vertical farming, hydroponics, and controlled environment agriculture. They offer a wide range of items including grow kits, LED and HPS grow lights, plant nutrients, hydroponic systems, grow media, and grow tents. The company aims to provide top-quality products and excellent customer service, positioning itself as a fast-growing retailer in its niche market.

name: Gärtnerhof Röllingsen
summary: Gärtnerhof Röllingsen is a farm focused on organic and biodynamic agriculture, specializing in vegetable cultivation. They offer a subscription box service for fresh produce, direct sales at their farm, and a presence at local weekly markets. The farm also engages in educational activities and has published a cookbook featuring their produce.

name: The Organic Family Farm
summary: The Organic Family Farm (TOFF) is a family-run farm dedicated to growing fresh, local produce year-round using aquaponics. This method leverages the symbiotic relationship between fish, microbes, and plants in an oxygen-rich water environment, allowing for cultivation within greenhouses. TOFF aims to provide locally grown products to its community.

name: Panier Bio des 3 Vallons
summary: Panier Bio des 3 Vallons is an association that connects consumers directly with local organic farmers and processors. They offer weekly deliveries of fresh organic fruits and vegetables, seasonal processed products, and additional items like eggs and bread through subscriptions. The organization focuses on promoting proximity contract farming and supporting organic agriculture within the "3 Vallons" region and surrounding areas, with distribution points across the region.

name: Living Jungle Hydroponics
summary: Living Jungle Hydroponics is an Australian company specializing in hydroponic systems and supplies. They offer a range of products designed for both commercial and home growers, focusing on sustainable and efficient indoor gardening solutions. The company aims to provide high-quality equipment and expertise to facilitate successful hydroponic cultivation.

name: Naturim
summary: Naturim provides consulting services for organic arable farming and vegetable cultivation. The company offers business management support, focusing on decision-making during the growing season and advising on sustainable farming practices like no-till farming (Ploegloos) and controlled traffic farming (Rijpaden). They also assist with the transition to organic farming and offer business economic and strategic planning, with the farmer's goals and ambitions at the center.

name: Voges Gemüse
summary: Voges Gemüse is a family-run agricultural business founded in 1920, now in its third generation. Located in Ronnenberg, near Hannover, the company specializes in the production and direct marketing of fresh vegetables. They also offer services leveraging their modern machinery and fleet, emphasizing sustainability through their own photovoltaic system and reduced use of pesticides. The business is actively managed by the family, with the fourth generation already involved.

name: Les jardins Épicés
summary: Les jardins Épicés is a diversified market garden farm established in 2013, specializing in local, organic vegetables and herbs with a focus on Latin American flavors. They operate on a Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) model, offering weekly and bi-weekly vegetable baskets to subscribers. The farm is located in L'Île-Bizard, Quebec, and also features a self-service farm stand.

name: RAUTALAN TILA
summary: Rautalan Tila is an organic farm located in Parhalahti, Finland, specializing in beef production, grain cultivation, and machinery contracting. The farm also engages in forestry and offers land construction services, including the sale of soil, sand, and crushed materials. They provide various tractor-based services and sell preserved organic meat products, with a notification service for fresh organic meat availability.

name: Organic Monk
summary: Organic Monk is a company specializing in the sale and management of sustainably managed organic farmlands. They encourage investment in agricultural land, offering curated plots, farm management services, and opportunities for financial returns and wealth preservation. The company aims to connect clients with nature through a unique living and investment experience, emphasizing organic practices and community.

name: CultiPro
summary: CultiPro provides advanced multi-layer drying and LED growing solutions for crop farmers, including vegetable growers, fruit growers, plant nurseries, tissue culture labs, and medicinal plant growers. Their research-based technology focuses on creating optimal climate conditions and utilizing patented laminar airflow techniques for higher yields, improved crop quality, and energy efficiency. They offer comprehensive support and a range of products like grow rooms, LED trolleys, and drying systems.

name: Mikrofarm Gräfelfing
summary: Mikrofarm Gräfelfing is a regenerative micro-farm located in Munich-Gräfelfing, cultivating a diverse range of untreated vegetables, mushrooms, and cut flowers on a small plot of land. They operate on a solidarity agriculture model, offering a weekly vegetable subscription and also selling products through a farm shop and online orders. The farm emphasizes seasonal, regional, and sustainable practices, aligning with the Slow Flowers movement for their floral offerings.

name: A Roda dea Sega di Berti Antonio
summary: A Roda dea Sega is an organic farm located in Luparense, operating for over 20 years on approximately 7 hectares. The farm specializes in producing organic vegetables, seasonal fruits, and grains, adhering to biodynamic farming principles. They utilize natural fertilization methods like worm humus, composting, and cover crops, strictly avoiding synthetic chemicals and GMOs to promote soil fertility and sustainable agriculture.

name: Lost Weekend Farms
summary: Lost Weekend Farms is a semi-urban farm located near Nashville, Tennessee, specializing in growing and selling a variety of produce including microgreens, hardy greens, and fresh herbs. They emphasize seasonal eating, biodiversity, and environmental health, offering products through an online store, CSA program ('The Good Life Box'), and local farmers' markets. The farm also features artisanal cheeses and unique spice blends.

name: EarthBox México, S.A.P.I de C.V.
summary: EarthBox México is a company specializing in urban gardening solutions, offering a range of products including eco-friendly containers, organic substrates, seedlings, fertilizers, and organic repellents. They also provide comprehensive services such as integral consulting, maintenance, design, installation, and training workshops. The company aims to promote sustainable urban agriculture through its products and services, catering to individuals, businesses, and social projects.

name: 上海宣通能源科技有限公司
summary: Shanghai Xuantong Energy Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in providing comprehensive solutions for intelligent equipment in facility agriculture. They offer customized greenhouse facilities, active water equipment, integrated water and fertilizer irrigation systems, and cultivation systems. The company focuses on improving crop yield and quality through innovative technologies like active water and digital agriculture, aiming to enhance the added value of agricultural products.

name: Orto Urbano
summary: Orto Urbano is a company specializing in the cultivation and sale of microgreens. They focus on sustainable, vegan, and natural farming practices, utilizing indoor cultivation to minimize environmental impact. Their products are fresh, nutritious, and aimed at enhancing culinary dishes, with a direct-to-consumer delivery service and retail partnerships.

name: HollandBioProducts
summary: HollandBioProducts offers sustainable agtech solutions for indoor farming, focusing on 100% biodegradable and compostable products like pre-seeded mats made from jute fibers and patented Bio-Flakes. Their solutions aim to increase yield, profitability, and food security by enabling year-round fresh produce production in controlled environment agriculture (CEA) systems. The company emphasizes environmental responsibility, contributing to clean water, responsible consumption, and climate action through innovative vertical farming applications.

name: Willow Wisp Organic Farm
summary: Willow Wisp Organic Farm is a 25-acre certified organic farm located along the Delaware River, specializing in the cultivation of vegetables, herbs, and organic cut flowers. They emphasize sustainable farming practices, focusing on soil health, biodiversity, and community contribution. The farm sells its produce and flowers at various farmers' markets and offers wholesale inquiries, with special orders available for weddings and events.

name: Organic Farming Works LLC
summary: Organic Farming Works LLC is a consulting business founded by Atina and Martin Diffley, dedicated to educating farmers and consumers about organic farming practices. They offer consulting services and workshops, and also promote Atina Diffley's memoir "Turn Here Sweet Corn" which details their experiences in organic agriculture and entrepreneurship. The company emphasizes sustainable and renewable farming methods, focusing on soil health and the interconnectedness of farm ecosystems.

name: Certhon
summary: Certhon specializes in designing and building high-tech greenhouses and indoor farming solutions worldwide. They offer turnkey greenhouse systems, indoor farming setups, and robotic harvesting solutions aimed at increasing yield, quality, and sustainability in food production. Their integrated Certhon Control System (CCS) optimizes technical installations for energy efficiency, serving growers, investors, and researchers.

name: Le Jardin Ouroboros
summary: Le Jardin Ouroboros is an organic market gardening farm located between Ernée and Gorron, France. They cultivate a variety of fruits and vegetables, emphasizing sustainable practices, respect for the environment, and biodiversity. Products are available for direct sale at the farm and through an online shop, offering local, high-quality, healthy, and seasonal certified organic produce.

name: Fräulein Lenz
summary: Fräulein Lenz is a German organic farm that provides fresh vegetable boxes and operates a weekly market day. The farm emphasizes high-quality, ecological work and is undergoing a transition, rebranding as 'Frau Lenz'. They supply local restaurants and resorts with their produce, highlighting a commitment to sustainable agriculture and local partnerships.

name: Orto 2.0
summary: Orto 2.0 is an agricultural cooperative that allows users to choose and manage their own crops through an app, from cultivation to delivery. They aim to provide healthy, fresh produce by connecting farms directly to consumers' tables within hours. The service focuses on a 'smart farmer' concept, enabling individuals to oversee their produce remotely and receive harvests at home.

name: AmHydro
summary: AmHydro provides sustainable hydroponic solutions to empower local farming businesses globally. They offer products and guidance for growing leafy greens, vine crops, and other produce, aiming to facilitate the launch of community-based food production. The company focuses on designing systems and offering support for commercial and small-scale hydroponic ventures.

name: Cyber Hydroponics
summary: Cyber Hydroponics is a consultancy specializing in commercial hydroponic, organic, and permaculture farming. They offer services including farm establishment consultation, technology implementation for monitoring and growth, infrastructure upgrades, custom nutrient formulations, and farm automation. With a background in marine biology, they also focus on R&D in artificial growing systems and aquaculture, aiming to optimize farm operations and increase yields for various crops.

name: Gipmans Young Plants
summary: Gipmans Young Plants is a family-owned company established in 1972, specializing in the cultivation of high-quality young plants for professional vegetable growers and herbs for European customers. They focus on quality, efficiency, and sustainable production processes, including organic cultivation where possible. Their business strategy is built on three pillars: Vital People, Vital Planet, and Vital Plants, aiming for a circular, cost-efficient, and vital future in food production.

name: Alvonto
summary: Alvonto is a company focused on effective, high-tech vegetable cultivation, emphasizing sustainability and a people-centric approach. They utilize advanced technologies like combined heat and power (CHP) units and are exploring waste heat for greenhouse warming, aiming for gas-free operations. Alvonto is part of Coöperatie Growers United U.A., which handles sales and marketing.

name: Loregar
summary: Loregar is an agricultural company specializing in the organic production of almonds and tomatoes, with its own registered brand 'Tomate de Falces. Maia'. They focus on delivering high-quality products while prioritizing environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and ecological awareness. The company also engages in knowledge sharing and community collaboration, offering farm visits and donating produce.

name: 농업회사법인 닥터애그㈜ (Dr. AG Co., Ltd.)
summary: Dr. AG Co., Ltd. is a leading automated mushroom production company in South Korea, operating as a smart farm frontier. They leverage advanced smart farm systems and automation to manage the entire agricultural process, from cultivation to sales. The company focuses on data-driven innovation to maximize agricultural efficiency and deliver fresh produce, with significant annual output and a growing international presence.

name: Mama Farms
summary: Mama Farms is an upcoming agricultural venture focused on producing high-quality organic fruits, vegetables, herbs, and edible flowers. Utilizing aeroponic technology, the farm aims for rapid harvesting cycles of 21-28 days. The company emphasizes providing consumers with nutritious and sustainably grown produce, with a website launch planned for August 2023.

name: Verde Co., Ltd.
summary: Verde Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and sale of artificial soil, Verde Knight. They propose and provide a new style of organic, pesticide-free plant factories that utilize soil (Verde Knight) instead of traditional hydroponics. The company is committed to promoting sustainable agriculture and innovative plant cultivation methods.

name: Sierra Valley Farms
summary: Sierra Valley Farms is a 65-acre certified organic farm and nursery located in the Sierra Valley, California, at an elevation of 5,000 feet. Established in 1990 as a native plant nursery and expanding to organic produce in 1999, the farm cultivates a variety of cool-season vegetables, fruits, microgreens, herbs, and hops. They also produce value-added condiments and operate an on-farm farmers market, restaurant CSAs, and host farm dining events, serving the Reno/Tahoe area.

name: Eudrop S.r.l.
summary: Eudrop S.r.l. specializes in revolutionizing traditional agriculture through innovative hydroponic and aquaponic cultivation systems. They offer complete, turnkey solutions for industrial hydroponic farming, aquaponic systems integrating fish and plants, and educational greenhouses for schools. Their mission is to promote sustainable agriculture by reducing water and fertilizer usage, eliminating pesticides, and enabling efficient food production regardless of natural resources or weather conditions.

name: Le Piante S.S. di Tapparello Vittorio & C.
summary: Le Piante S.S. di Tapparello Vittorio & C. is an agricultural company with three generations of experience in the horticultural sector. They specialize in creating various types of gardens, including alternative, water, and rock gardens, as well as vertical gardens and floral arrangements in pots and planters. The company emphasizes sustainability and energy saving in its operations and offers an educational farm experience.

name: Vert d'Iris
summary: Vert d'Iris is an eco-intensive agroforestry market gardening cooperative that cultivates organic fruits, vegetables, herbs, and edible flowers across two bio-certified plots in Anderlecht. They focus on short supply chains, exceptional taste quality through on-demand harvesting, and promoting biodiversity and soil health. The cooperative also engages in educational activities, composting initiatives, and aims to contribute to the greening of Brussels.

name: Citrii Software
summary: Citrii specializes in farm management solutions and digital platforms designed to optimize agricultural processes, improve efficiency, and drive sustainable growth. Their offerings include FarmNode for real-time farm monitoring and PackSys for streamlining packhouse operations. By leveraging data-driven intelligence and innovation, Citrii aims to enhance productivity and profitability for businesses in the agricultural sector.

name: Suzunari Inc.
summary: Suzunari Inc. is a group of companies focused on agricultural production and distribution, specializing in vegetables such as edamame, lettuce varieties, broccoli, spinach, cilantro, and garlic. They operate multiple farm and logistics subsidiaries, including Mos Farm Suzunari, Suzunari Oigawa, and STM Express, and also have an online shop and a "Suzunari Kitchen" for food-related services. The company emphasizes quality and is actively recruiting new team members.

name: Rosenta, Inc.
summary: Rosenta is a technology company providing smart farming software specifically designed for the floral industry. Their platform modernizes and automates floral operations, offering tools for order management, production visibility, accurate inventory tracking, and data-driven insights. The company aims to simplify farm management for growers, enabling them to increase productivity and reduce costs through a cloud-based, user-friendly system.

name: Family Farmers Inc
summary: Family Farmers Inc. offers an all-in-one marketing and e-commerce platform designed specifically for family farmers to connect with local customers. The platform provides features for CSA management, flexible subscriptions, wholesale options, sell-by-weight capabilities, broadcast notifications, customer group management, and various online and offline payment methods. It aims to help farmers streamline their sales, manage orders efficiently, and build customer loyalty through features like store credits and loyalty points, facilitating both local pickups and home delivery.

name: Ecoponic Agri Tech LLP
summary: Ecoponic Agri Tech LLP is an online retailer specializing in farm-fresh produce, including leafy greens, exotic fruits, mushrooms, and microgreens. They emphasize direct sourcing from their own farms or trusted growers, aiming to deliver high-quality, fresh food with no middlemen. The company offers same-day and next-day delivery services and provides subscription options.

name: TLC Custom Farming
summary: TLC Custom Farming is a family-owned, full-service custom farming company specializing in growing and harvesting high-quality leafy greens for the value-added produce industry. They offer organic and conventional varieties, including spinach, arugula, and various lettuces and kales. The company also provides logistics services, including transport and cooling, to ensure affordable fresh produce and aims to supply the market year-round from their growing locations in Arizona and California.

name: Vertical Growing Systems LLC
summary: Vertical Growing Systems (VGS) is an Austin, TX-based manufacturing company that specializes in creating sustainable green wall products. Their vision is to provide simple, cost-effective, and resource-conserving modules for wider adoption of living walls. VGS combines horticultural and manufacturing expertise to develop easy-to-produce and maintain systems, tested for various environmental conditions, including edible plant panels for small-scale food production.

name: SunnyGirl Farm
summary: SunnyGirl Farm is a farm that grows a variety of vegetables and industrial hemp using natural, sustainable methods. They offer fresh produce, including lettuce, tomatoes, peppers, and more, as well as handcrafted CBD products like salve and tincture. The farm aims to provide healthy and nutritious food and products to its community, operating on a smaller scale since relocating.

name: 有限会社 花咲農園
summary: Hanasaka Nouen (花咲農園) is a farm that cultivates and sells rice, vegetables, fruits, and processed food products. They emphasize maintaining stable prices for their rice and offer services like gift wrapping with 'nori' (decorative paper). The company operates an e-commerce website for direct sales and provides information on their farming practices and products.

name: 中科创康 (Zhongke Chuangkang)
summary: Zhongke Chuangkang, also known as Chuangkang Facility Agriculture Technology Co., Ltd., specializes in developing and marketing miniature home plant factories. These systems allow urban dwellers to grow organic vegetables indoors, providing a source of fresh produce and improving indoor air quality. The company integrates research, production, sales, and service, aiming to create a large-scale urban ecological agriculture service platform.

name: Green Concepts
summary: Green Concepts is an urban farming company focused on reducing food travel by growing nutritious food locally. They specialize in visualizing, planning, designing, and executing projects in greenhouses, landscaping, and hydroponic cultivation. With three decades of experience in pomology, olericulture, and ornamental culture, they offer customized cultivation solutions, green houses, irrigation accessories, hydroponic kits, solar driers, and bio-fertilizers, aiming to bring nature to homes.

name: SkyTech Engineering
summary: SkyTech Engineering specializes in creating and implementing sustainable solutions for environmental conservation. They offer a range of products including SkyGrow Vertical Gardens, WavePlus Geo Bags, Geo tubes, and various horticultural solutions. The company aims to integrate environmental benefits with practical applications through their innovative concepts.

name: Harvest Today
summary: Harvest Today provides an engineered solution for indoor growing called the Harvest Wall, designed to simplify local food production. Their system enables communities to grow fresh produce year-round in a controlled environment using significantly less water and no pesticides. The company aims to increase accessibility to fresh food, reduce food insecurity, and promote sustainable, local agriculture.

name: Westhof Bio-Gemüse GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Westhof Bio-Gemüse is a family-owned company specializing in the cultivation, processing, and distribution of organic vegetables. summary: SVMAC Ingeniería Sistemas y Vehículos S.L. is a technology-based company specializing in precision agriculture and the development of unmanned vehicles and industrial systems. The company also provides homologation services for its products and is a member of the Industria 4.0 Program and the Asturias Business Association for Defense Industry Development.

name: Fmec Group
summary: Fmec Group provides integrated software solutions for agribusinesses, focusing on efficient data recording and cloud-based decision-making. Their offerings include crop management software (Fmec Over-Watch), business management ERP (Fmec Symphony), and an IoT platform for device connectivity (Fmec Garnet IoT). Designed by farmers for farmers, their solutions aim to increase productivity, environmental sustainability, and profitability.

name: 昆山阳翎机器人科技有限公司
summary: Kunshan Yangling Robot Technology Co., Ltd. is an agricultural data service enterprise founded by overseas returnees. The company focuses on the independent research and development of integrated hardware and software, utilizing drones and onboard sensors for data collection. It employs artificial intelligence algorithms for data integration, mining, and analysis, providing results to clients for decision-making across agriculture, environmental protection, geological exploration, and public utility management. The company has a strategic partnership with Zhejiang University Innovation Technology Research Institute to promote agricultural data analysis in smart agriculture.

name: Satyukt Analytics Private Limited
summary: Satyukt Analytics Private Limited is a global Ag-tech company that aims to revolutionize farming practices through satellite-derived data, AI, and machine learning. Their products like Sat4Agri, Sat2Farm, and Sat4Risk leverage advanced technologies to address large-area agricultural challenges and promote sustainable practices worldwide.

name: FarmSense
summary: FarmSense provides an automated, AI-powered insect monitoring platform for agriculture, utilizing patented FlightSensor technology to deliver real-time pest detection and classification. Their solution aims to reduce labor, minimize pesticide use, and combat insecticide resistance by offering growers actionable data for timely treatment decisions. The company focuses on revolutionizing pest control in farming through advanced sensor technology and intelligent analytics.

name: AgroData
summary: AgroData is an innovative Brazilian company specializing in geotechnology and geomatics solutions for the agricultural sector. They import, commercialize, and develop premium products and services, including expert consulting, professional training, and technical support. AgroData aims to provide intelligent solutions to agricultural challenges, leveraging partnerships with leading technology providers.

name: ГК Агроштурман
summary: ГК Агроштурман provides digital solutions for agricultural enterprises, specializing in equipment and services for precision farming. Their offerings include autosteer systems, GPS/GLONASS receivers, RTK modems, base stations, and monitoring software. The company focuses on optimizing agricultural production processes through advanced technology, aiming to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve yields while minimizing environmental impact. They have over 15 years of implementation experience and a broad dealer network across Russia.

name: AkkerAnalyse
summary: AkkerAnalyse is a certified company specializing in agricultural analysis using RPAS (drones) and GPS automation. They provide crucial crop information, including soil and crop variables, growth analysis, nitrogen levels, yield predictions, and stress detection, to help optimize farm profitability. Their services involve creating flight plans, conducting drone scans with advanced multispectral cameras, and generating actionable reports and GPS-compatible task maps for precision agriculture.

name: Sevra Suisse AG
summary: Sevra Suisse AG is a company focused on providing innovative and sustainable solutions for the future of agriculture. They offer advanced technological products and services aimed at improving efficiency and sustainability for farmers. Their offerings include personalized solutions, expert advice, and reliable, high-quality equipment, positioning them as a partner for modern agricultural practices.

name: Nutrien Soluções Agrícolas Ltda.
summary: Nutrien is an agricultural solutions company that provides products and services to rural producers. The company offers a range of solutions including agricultural inputs, digital agriculture tools, and financial services through its "Cartão Nutrien". It operates through "Centros de Experiências" and has been expanding its reach through acquisitions, aiming to support the growth and development of the agricultural sector.

name: ハイパーアグリ株式会社 (HyperAgri, Inc.)
summary: HyperAgri, Inc. is a company focused on smart agriculture solutions, developing and promoting technologies like 'Field Meister' to address issues such as lodging and taste in rice cultivation. They actively participate in industry forums, collaborate with government agencies and private companies, and have received certifications for their innovative agricultural practices. Their mission appears to be advancing agricultural efficiency and quality through technology.

name: ISAGRI
summary: ISAGRI is a European leader in agricultural software, providing management solutions and innovative technologies for farmers and agribusiness companies since 1983. They offer specialized software for field management, crop recording, livestock management, and vineyard/winery operations, aiming to improve profitability, performance, and compliance with legislation. With a global presence through subsidiaries and dealers, ISAGRI supports customers in mastering their data and optimizing their agricultural operations.

name: Charrua Agrícola
summary: Charrua Agrícola is a company that has been providing technology solutions to rural producers for over 34 years. They are committed to sustainable development, promoting practices that contribute to low carbon emissions and ecosystem health, particularly in the Cerrado region of Brazil.

name: Gearbox
summary: Gearbox is a high-tech, data-driven software partner for the agri, food, and flower sectors. They develop digital employees using their modular GearCore platform, which integrates Vision, AI, and Motion software. Their solutions enable real-time measurement, assessment, and digitization of produce for phenotyping, quality inspection, sorting, and harvesting assistance, aiming to reduce labor costs and improve product quality through data-driven insights and cloud reporting.

name: greenhive GmbH
summary: Greenhive GmbH develops and manufactures semi-automated ground drones for agricultural plant protection, specifically designed for steep terrain and vineyards. Their product, the "Spritzengel," aims to reduce risks for farmers by providing a safer, more efficient, and environmentally friendly alternative to traditional spraying methods. The company focuses on innovation, leveraging technology to minimize soil compaction and optimize the application of plant protection agents.

name: Prairie Queen Ag, LLC
summary: Prairie Queen Ag, LLC is an agricultural services company that began as a Pioneer Seed dealership in 2016. The company also provides digital services and drone sales and service, catering to the diverse needs of modern farmers.

summary: Nutrien is an agricultural solutions company that provides products and services to rural producers. name: GAtec
summary: GAtec is a technology company specializing in integrated management software solutions for the agribusiness sector. name: FJ Dynamics
summary: FJ Dynamics, operated by Northern Innovation Inc., specializes in smart steering systems for agricultural machinery, notably the FJD AT2 auto-steer system. Their solutions aim to enhance agricultural efficiency, reduce operational costs, and increase crop yields, also extending to applications in the construction industry.

name: AI-Genix
summary: AI-Genix is a company focused on redefining crop protection through innovative technologies and durable products. The company aims to provide advanced agricultural solutions to enhance crop yield and health.

name: Rolnictwo Precyzyjne Andrzej Przeperski
summary: Rolnictwo Precyzyjne Andrzej Przeperski specializes in precision agriculture solutions for farms, offering consulting, implementation services, and a range of advanced equipment. name: T3RRA
summary: T3RRA provides terrain management solutions through advanced software for agriculture and earthworks. name: Canopée Dronautique inc.
summary: Canopée Dronautique inc. provides advanced aerial services, including remote sensing, 3D modeling, soil measurement, and integrated pest management, primarily for the agriculture and environmental management sectors. name: GeoMeter
summary: GeoMeter specializes in developing and selling GPS devices for accurate area measurement and field management, primarily for agricultural use. name: AGROSMART DRONES
summary: AGROSMART DRONES is a company specializing in intelligent agricultural spraying solutions using drones. name: Topcon
summary: Topcon is a global company that designs, manufactures, and distributes precision measurement and positioning equipment. summary: Innov.GPS is a company specializing in GPS solutions for the agricultural sector, offering products such as guidance bars, auto-guidance systems, section control, and RTK signal receivers. summary: Pollo Precisão is an agricultural company specializing in precision agriculture and digital farming solutions. summary: Thorsen-Teknik A/S specializes in precision agriculture solutions, offering auto-steering and implement control systems for agricultural machinery. summary: Buz Agro is an agricultural technology company with over 10 years of experience, focused on delivering innovative solutions for planting and spraying to enhance efficiency and sustainability in agribusiness. summary: Datum is a company that provides innovative technology solutions for agriculture, measurement systems, meteorology, and GIS & Remote Sensing. summary: Fitovision revolutionizes agriculture with technology and versatility, offering solutions for crop management, pest control, and sales management. summary: SCHAVINSKI PD&I is a startup focused on developing innovative solutions for the agribusiness sector. name: Spray Center Electronics
summary: Spray Center Electronics (SCE) is a family-owned business specializing in precision agriculture, lawn and garden, and de-icing applications. name: Altınöz Tarım Makineleri Ltd. Şti.

name: Novanta Inc.
summary: Novanta is a global technology partner specializing in precision motion, laser, and vision-based technologies for the medical and advanced manufacturing industries. They provide integrated solutions and deep application expertise to OEMs worldwide, enabling innovation in demanding applications. Novanta focuses on system-level thinking to deliver mission-critical solutions that help customers solve complex challenges and achieve market differentiation.

name: Solfranc Tecnologías SL
summary: Solfranc Tecnologías SL, founded in 2005, provides technology and knowledge for the sustainable development of agriculture and environmental control. They offer personalized equipment, sensors, and services, analyzing user needs to provide tailored solutions. The company focuses on innovation, customer satisfaction, and environmental respect, aiming to improve production processes and profitability.

name: Ньютехагро (Newtechagro)
summary: Newtechagro is a supplier of modern, high-tech agricultural equipment and navigation systems for precision farming in Russia. summary: Teralytic provides advanced soil quality data collection through a single probe equipped with 26 sensors. summary: Elio Tecnologia is an agricultural technology company specializing in the collection and processing of geo-referenced images. Their services aim to increase agricultural productivity, reduce costs, and minimize environmental impact by delivering actionable insights to farmers.

summary: MR Uelzen-Isenhagen e.V. is an agricultural service provider offering a range of services to its members, including billing services, operational assistance, and purchasing advantages. summary: ООО “Фолворт Консультант” is an official dealer of Pessl Instruments, specializing in smart agro-management solutions. name: ALVO Consultoria
summary: ALVO Consultoria is a company with 10 years of experience specializing in application technology for agricultural inputs, including phytosanitary, nutritional, and biological products, as well as solid corrective applications.
