The company partners with chemical, biological, and nutritional companies, and provides consulting services to large groups in the sugarcane, forestry, export fruit, and seed sectors, aiming to transmit knowledge through theory and practice.

name: Fixposition AG
summary: Fixposition AG is a Swiss startup specializing in precise global positioning solutions for autonomous systems. The company aims to simplify autonomous navigation by enhancing reliability and expanding the availability of accurate positioning.

name: Treberhandel
summary: Treberhandel has been distributing high-quality brewer's spent grain from Cologne breweries for over forty years. Their product is easily ensiled, well-absorbed by livestock, and offers a valuable protein source that is more beneficial for the digestive tract than alternatives like soy meal. It is also a GMO-free alternative, making it suitable for organic farming operations.

name: Lebensfuttermittel
summary: Lebensfuttermittel offers a wide range of animal feed products for various animals including chickens, sheep, rabbits, and wild animals. They emphasize regional cultivation and careful processing of their feed. The company also sells fresh eggs directly from their farm, highlighting their commitment to animal welfare and quality nutrition.

name: KENT WORLDWIDE
summary: KENT WORLDWIDE is a family-owned company founded in 1927, specializing in ag-based ingredients and consumer brands. They are known for their expertise in marketing and manufacturing, transforming science into solutions for food, beverage, agriculture, and pet products. The company focuses on innovation, sustainability, and building long-term relationships, aiming to help a growing world do more.

name: 담원인터내셔널 (Damwon International)
summary: Damwon International is a food ingredient distribution company established in 2016, specializing in importing various raw materials from around the world. They handle dairy products, imported raw materials, basic raw materials, finished products, feed ingredients, and offer OEM consulting services for functional foods. The company is also the exclusive importer and distributor of Ausnutria's goat milk protein powder and the importer and seller of Cabrita infant formula.

name: SL Alimentos
summary: SL Alimentos is a company focused on human nutrition, specializing in the industrialization of whole grains such as oats and rice, and extruded products. They also offer services in co-manufacturing for clients and have expanded into plant-based proteins, including meat analogue products. Positioned as one of the largest whole grain mills in Latin America, they cater to the baby food industry and new market demands for clean label products.

name: Birdstone Consulting LLC
summary: Birdstone is a company dedicated to the sustainable development and success of the pet food industry. They offer a range of solutions including technical business consulting, production of specialty and custom ingredients, and co-packing services. Their offerings are designed to be safe, sustainable, and functional, aiming to innovate within the pet food sector.

name: TOFUTOWN
summary: TOFUTOWN is a traditional organic manufacturer specializing in vegan food products, including spreads, tofu, seitan, and convenience meals. Founded in 1981 as a 'Tofu Kollektiv', it evolved into a GmbH and is now part of the international Vegan Food Group. The company emphasizes high-quality, organic, vegan, and sustainable ingredients, aiming to provide delicious food without animal products.

name: Nấm Tươi Cười
summary: Nấm Tươi Cười is a company specializing in the production and distribution of vegetarian and vegan food products. Their offerings include ready-to-eat meals, frozen foods, and processed vegetarian items, emphasizing natural ingredients and the absence of artificial additives. The company also provides services such as technology transfer, recipe development, and OEM manufacturing for vegetarian food products, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the growing plant-based food market.

name: Intercity Packers
summary: Intercity Packers is a Canadian company that has been producing, sourcing, and delivering premium quality meat and seafood products since 1972. They serve top restaurants, retailers, and healthcare establishments across Canada. The company emphasizes a consultative approach with customers, focusing on sustainable practices and community well-being.

name: Griyum
summary: Griyum is a company that produces and sells cricket flour, a highly nutritious and environmentally sustainable protein source. Their product is designed to be easily integrated into various food applications, including bakery, snacks, and meat alternatives. Griyum aims to promote the adoption of insect-based proteins to combat climate change and provide healthier food options.

name: Aveno
summary: Aveno is a certified organic, Kosher, non-GMO, and gluten-free food processing and co-packing manufacturer specializing in the plant-based food industry. They focus on using high-quality ingredients for their scalable production, distributing products nationwide. The company positions itself as a boutique manufacturer within the rapidly growing plant-based sector.

name: Donini Integratori Alimentari S.r.l.
summary: Donini Integratori Alimentari S.r.l. is an Italian company specializing in the development, production, and packaging of food supplements on a contract basis (conto terzi). They offer a full-service approach, guiding clients from formulation to final packaging, with a focus on market trends, personalized formulations, and quality raw materials. The company also holds organic production certification, emphasizing well-being and environmental respect.

name: Unicum Trade Botanicals (UTB)
summary: Unicum Trade Botanicals (UTB) is a company specializing in the development and production of private label nutritional supplements, food, and premixes for human and veterinary use. With nearly 40 years of experience, they offer flexible, customized manufacturing solutions, handling everything from formulation and raw material sourcing to packaging and logistics. UTB holds certifications such as ISO22000:2018, FCA, and BIO, emphasizing quality and sustainability in their complex production processes.

name: Bluebonnet
summary: Bluebonnet is a company that manufactures and supplies animal feed and supplements, with a primary focus on equine nutrition. They emphasize science-backed formulas, safety, and transparency in their ingredients, offering products for horses, poultry, and livestock. The company also provides nutrition consultations and educational resources to empower animal owners.

name: Focus Trading Pvt Limited
summary: Focus Trading Pvt Limited is a company that has been providing sustainable and ethical products and solutions to the animal nutrition industry for over 15 years. They focus on delivering operational excellence through their offerings, aiming to support their clients' success in the animal feed sector. The company emphasizes its long-standing presence and commitment to responsible business practices.

name: Primient
summary: Primient is a leading producer of food and industrial products derived from renewable plant-based sources, primarily corn. Leveraging scientific expertise in corn wet milling and technical applications, they provide high-quality ingredients and solutions for industries including food, beverage, paper, packaging, personal care, apparel, and animal nutrition. The company emphasizes sustainability throughout its value chain and is committed to enriching lives through plant-based solutions.

name: Hubbard Feeds
summary: Hubbard Feeds is a company specializing in animal nutrition, providing research-based feed products and support services for various livestock and companion animals. As part of the Alltech family, they focus on improving animal health, productivity, and profitability for producers through innovative feed formulations and expert consultation. Their mission is to help people raise healthy animals while promoting sustainable agriculture.

name: Farm Dairy
summary: Farm Dairy is a leading private label partner specializing in dairy and plant-based dairy alternatives. They focus on innovation, sustainability, and customer-oriented solutions, delivering high-quality products to millions of households. The company emphasizes customization and partnership to meet unique market needs and seize opportunities in the dynamic food sector.

name: EXTRAKTA STRAUSS GmbH
summary: Extrakta Strauss GmbH is a German company specializing in additives and ingredients for the food industry. Their core competencies include coating (microencapsulation), grinding, extraction, and spice blending. They offer standard products, custom ingredient solutions, and contract manufacturing for various food sectors, including confectionery, baked goods, meat, fish, and vegan/vegetarian alternatives. The company emphasizes its decades of expertise, innovative product concepts, specialized process technology, and quality-oriented production.

name: Rangen Group
summary: Rangen Group is a company focused on innovative nutrition for various industries including aquaculture, livestock, lifestyle, and pet sectors. They offer premium feed, forage products, and tailored solutions that promote productivity, animal health, and sustainable growth. The company also provides specialized services in material handling, premixing, and bottling, leveraging industry expertise to optimize operational efficiency.

name: Naedts
summary: Naedts is a family-owned company with over twenty years of experience in the purchase and sale of animal feed, specializing in brewer's spent grain and press pulp. They supply high-quality, safe, and GMP-certified moist compound feeds, which are by-products of the food industry. The company emphasizes profitability, lower costs, and customer satisfaction, offering its own transport service for flexible and sharp deliveries.

name: Rumix Prosoya
summary: Rumix Prosoya is a family-owned company with over 30 years of experience in producing 100% vegan, BIO-ecological, and gluten-free food products. They specialize in plant-based alternatives made from soy, hemp, and lupine, including beverages, tofu, vegan cheeses, spreads, and ready meals. The company emphasizes high-quality ingredients, rigorous quality control, and continuous improvement to satisfy consumer demand for healthy and sustainable food options.

name: Nuzest USA Incorporated
summary: Nuzest is a company that develops and sells daily nutritional products designed to improve health and well-being. Their product line includes plant-based proteins, multi-nutrients, and specialized formulas for kids, gut health, and everyday wellness. Nuzest emphasizes science-backed, natural ingredients and aims to provide convenient, effective solutions for consumers seeking to transform their health.

name: Senson
summary: Senson is a company specializing in the production and supply of sustainable, plant-based ingredients for the food and beverage industry. They focus on Nordic ingredients, utilizing locally grown cereals and pulses, and offer a range of extracts including gluten-free liquid malt extracts, cocoa replacements, and enzymes like beta-amylase. Their mission is to be a leading provider of sustainable ingredient solutions, emphasizing innovation and clean label applications.

name: Tastell Import and Export Limited (Anhui)
summary: Tastell Import and Export Limited (Anhui) is a professional Asian food supplier established in 2017, specializing in natural, healthy, and high-quality food products. They offer a range of organic pastas made from ingredients like edamame, soybean, black bean, buckwheat, and millet, emphasizing non-GMO, additive-free, and gluten-free options. The company is certified with ISO quality management and utilizes an ERP foreign trade management system, backed by a team with extensive export experience.

name: J.R. Short Milling Company
summary: J.R. Short Milling Company is a global leader in the production of custom-created snack pellets, specializing in gluten-free, non-GMO, organic, and kosher options. With over 30 years of extrusion technology experience, they provide grain-based extruded intermediates to customers worldwide. The company emphasizes quality, customer focus, flexibility, and innovation in its product development and manufacturing processes.

name: 8th Avenue Food & Provisions
summary: 8th Avenue Food & Provisions is a leading manufacturer and distributor of nut butters, specializing in private label, co-manufacturing, and foodservice solutions. They offer a wide range of conventional and organic peanut and tree nut butters, with versatile packaging and processing capabilities. The company emphasizes customer-centricity, quality, and safety, serving retail, foodservice, industrial, and e-commerce channels globally.

name: Naturtrade Hungary Kft.
summary: Naturtrade Hungary Kft. is a food manufacturer specializing in innovative, gluten-free, and 100% plant-based products. With a heritage of flour production spanning four generations, the company develops and produces a range of items including instant soups, pasta, flours, and flour mixes. They also offer private label services and contract manufacturing, aiming to make gluten-free and plant-based eating more enjoyable and accessible.

name: Bahama Burger
summary: Bahama Burger offers the "Planet's Cleanest & Best Alternative to Meat™," featuring the Bahama Burger made with Risofu®, a rice-based plant-based meat alternative. Their products are soy-free, gluten-free, non-GMO, vegan, free of the top 9 allergens, and 100% plant-based. They focus on providing a healthy, sustainable, and flavorful option for consumers and food service providers, emphasizing natural ingredients over lab-engineered replication.

name: БОБАЛ
summary: БОБАЛ (BOBAL) provides sustainable and innovative solutions for industries, manufacturers, and end-users, aiming for a better life. As a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technologists, and culinary experts, they partner with international leaders to help local and regional producers achieve better taste and results in the production of affordable food, beverages, and pharmaceuticals. They also have distribution centers and their own transport across Bulgaria.

name: Haltáp Kft.
summary: Haltáp Kft. is a Hungarian company with over 40 years of experience in the manufacturing, distribution, and development of animal feed. Established in 1977, the company specializes in producing high-quality fish feed from fry to adult stages, as well as dog and cat food. They also offer contract manufacturing services, catering to unique client needs with modern production facilities and a strong focus on quality assurance, including HACCP compliance.

name: ПРОБИОКОРМ
summary: ПРОБИОКОРМ specializes in the production of feed additives through chemical and microbiological synthesis. The company offers effective technological functional products designed to improve performance and positively impact client operations. They focus on continuous development and growth within their sector.

name: Van Koolen
summary: Van Koolen is a family business specializing in the production of innovative plant-based food products derived from mushrooms, vegetables, and vegetable proteins. They focus on taste, recognizable ingredients, and transparency, managing the entire process from growing their own ingredients to delivering the final product. The company emphasizes sustainability, contributing to a lower CO2 footprint compared to meat production.

name: La Mandorle
summary: La Mandorle is a French company specializing in organic, plant-based nutrition, with over 35 years of innovation. They offer a range of products including almond milk, plant-based powders, and cereals, catering to various life stages from babies to seniors, as well as athletes. Their mission is to provide healthy, nutritious, and sustainable plant-based food options that are free from lactose, gluten, and soy.

name: Surlean Foods
summary: Surlean Foods is a family-owned custom food manufacturer established in 1979, specializing in providing "back of house" solutions and assured product supply for leading restaurant chains. They focus on strategic sourcing, culinary research and development, and supply chain optimization to help clients increase menu profitability. Their product offerings include sauces, soups, sides, and proteins.

name: Grönaverde GmbH
summary: Grönaverde GmbH is a specialist in plant-based raw materials, focusing on proteins, flours, nuts, and dried fruits. They act as a partner for sourcing, sales, and consulting in this sector. Additionally, the company offers private label services for filling mixtures of proteins, nuts, and dried fruits.

name: Phyto Ingredients
summary: Phyto Ingredients is a supplier of organic powder ingredients and blends, offering bulk quantities to businesses. They provide value-added services including formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and organic certification through their 'turnkey' solutions. The company is committed to sustainability, with its operations being Carbon Neutral and offering a Phyto Carbon Bank service for carbon offsetting.

name: 由美生機有限公司
summary: 由美生機有限公司 is a company that specializes in providing organic, plant-based, and sustainable food ingredients to corporate clients. They believe in the future trend of plant-based food and aim to help businesses create products that benefit both people and the planet. Their product offerings include items like organic quinoa crisp, spirulina powder, and broccoli sprout powder.

name: ふる里食効研究所 (Furusato Shokko Laboratory)
summary: Furusato Shokko Laboratory specializes in developing and supplying functional raw materials derived from domestic Japanese ingredients. They focus on plant-based, organic, fermented, and upcycled materials, offering solutions for health and beauty products, supplements, and pet food. The company also provides comprehensive support for product development, from raw material sourcing and development to quality testing, regulatory support, and sales assistance.

name: KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH
summary: KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH is a company specializing in the development of bespoke stabilising and emulsifying solutions for the food industry. They offer a wide range of ingredients and solutions for dairy, dairy alternatives, plant-based meat and fish, savory products, and bakery items. KaTech focuses on innovation, quality, and providing tailored support to food manufacturers and brands.

name: wheat. pray. love.
summary: Wheat. pray. love. is an Amsterdam-based company specializing in the production and distribution of seitan, a vegan meat substitute made from wheat gluten. Their mission is to simplify plant-based cooking and promote enjoyment of vegan food for a better world. They offer a range of seitan products for both individual consumers and businesses in the hospitality sector, and also operate a food truck called Bamboozled Foodtuktuk.

name: Gluten Free Co-Pak Inc.
summary: Gluten Free Co-Pak Inc. is a full-service commercial private label manufacturer specializing in dedicated gluten-free co-packing. They offer Kosher Parve certified services, focusing on quality and discretion for their clients' product lines. The company positions itself as a reliable partner for businesses seeking to produce private label gluten-free food products.

name: PiLeJe Industrie
summary: PiLeJe Industrie is a manufacturer specializing in the development and production of nutraceuticals and dietary supplements for private labels. They focus on plant-based innovation, micronutrition, probiotics, and industrial excellence to deliver high-quality solutions. The company positions itself as a full-service partner for businesses in the food supplement industry, emphasizing quality and safety in their manufacturing processes.

name: Asian Group
summary: Asian Group is a global food and pet food manufacturer committed to quality, safety, social responsibility, and environmental sustainability. The company focuses on preserving and adding value to various food products, including wet pet food, frozen food, aqua feed, tuna, and dry feed. Their mission is to build strength in every business and increase growth potential, aiming for excellence through efficiency, experience, and expertise.

name: EuroProsper
summary: EuroProsper is a supplier established in 2009, specializing in agricultural commodities such as sunflower kernels, pumpkin seeds, coriander, chickpeas, millet, walnuts, and vegan proteins. They source products directly from producers to ensure quality and competitive pricing. The company serves wholesalers, processors, and packers globally, emphasizing reliable transactions and customer satisfaction.

name: Awakened Foods
summary: Awakened Foods is a company focused on producing and distributing healthier snack options that are better for consumers and the planet. They offer a range of products catering to various dietary needs and restrictions, emphasizing natural ingredients and nutritional value. Additionally, their 'Awakened Foods Crafters' division provides contract manufacturing services for other brands and retailers, specializing in 'free-from' and high-nutrition snacks.

name: W&G Brinkhorst
summary: W&G Brinkhorst is a specialist supplier of high-quality meat, poultry, game, and vegetarian products for the professional kitchen, serving sectors like hospitality, healthcare, and meal services. They offer a wide assortment with flexible customization options, focusing on taste, quality, and tailored solutions. The company emphasizes innovation, inspiration, and collaborative partnerships with chefs.

name: Menon Renewable Products, Inc.
summary: Menon Renewable Products, Inc. develops and manufactures MrFeed®, a patented functional animal feed ingredient derived from agricultural raw materials using their proprietary CelTherm™ technology. This innovative product aims to replace unsustainable ingredients like fish meal and soy meal, while also reducing the need for antibiotics. MrFeed® is designed to improve animal health, growth, and digestibility across various species including shrimp, finfish, poultry, and swine, promoting sustainable practices in animal agriculture.

name: American Bean L.L.C.
summary: American Bean L.L.C. specializes in creating nutritious, plant-based food products, primarily falafel, designed for K-12 school menus. Their offerings are USDA-compliant, allergen-free, and aim to provide delicious, vegetarian meal options for students. The company focuses on simplifying the process of providing healthy and appealing meals for educational institutions.

name: Nove Alpi srl
summary: Nove Alpi is an Italian manufacturing company founded in 1955, specializing in gluten-free, sugar-free, and low-protein bakery products for individuals with specific dietary needs. They operate as both a co-packer and produce their own brands, Agluten and Aminò. The company emphasizes innovation, quality assurance with an internal lab, and holds numerous certifications including FSSC 22000 and Ministry of Health approval.

name: Aura Pea
summary: Aura Pea is a company specializing in plant-based food products that are fully cooked, ready-to-eat, and designed for quick preparation. They focus on creating delicious, healthy, and consistent meatless alternatives using a 100% Clean Label Promise, avoiding fillers and prioritizing flavor. Their versatile products are suitable for various culinary applications, aiming to delight both long-term vegans and those new to plant-based eating.

name: Crown Foods Ltd
summary: Crown Foods Ltd is a family-run business with 47 years of experience in creating and supplying a wide range of food products. They specialize in sourcing and producing tailored solutions for meat, chicken, and fish, including gluten-free and meat-free options, catering to diverse clients like schools, supermarkets, care homes, and caterers. The company emphasizes meeting market needs with trusted, sustainable products and aims to build strong customer relationships.

name: Louis Dreyfus Company
summary: Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC) is a global agricultural merchant and processor that plays a vital role in nourishing the world's population. The company responsibly sources, transforms, and delivers agricultural goods across the world, evolving from a commodities merchant to mastering more of the food, feed, fiber, and ingredients value chain. LDC is committed to fair and sustainable value creation for current and future generations, focusing on high-quality, responsibly sourced products and sustainable practices.

name: Nuzest USA Incorporated
summary: Nuzest is a company that develops and sells daily nutritional products designed to improve health and well-being. Their product line includes plant-based proteins, multi-nutrients, and specialized formulas for kids, gut health, and everyday wellness. Nuzest emphasizes science-backed, natural ingredients and aims to provide convenient, effective solutions for consumers seeking to transform their health.

name: COMFOSA (Comercial Forrajera de Lagos, S.A. de C.V.)
summary: COMFOSA specializes in the production of high-quality balanced animal feed for poultry, pigs, and cattle. They emphasize using certified ingredients, providing professional nutritional advice, and optimizing costs to offer competitive market prices. The company serves a wide region with its products and is committed to innovation and customer service.

name: FTM S.L.
summary: FTM S.L. is a company with over 50 years of experience in providing ingredients and solutions for the food industry, specializing in breading, marinades, spices, dehydrated vegetables, and nuts. They focus on combining tradition with innovation, offering both classic and vegan product ranges. FTM S.L. aims to provide high-quality products at competitive prices while offering expert advice and developing new product solutions for their clients.

name: SEAH International
summary: SEAH International is a company specializing in sourcing and supplying high-quality ingredients for various industries, including food and nutrition. They offer a range of ingredients derived from marine and vegetal origins, focusing on taste, functionality, nutrition, and protection solutions like microencapsulation. The company emphasizes quality, traceability, and service, and is committed to natural sourcing and innovation.

name: Devansoy
summary: Devansoy is a leading producer of plant-based food ingredients, specializing in oat and soy liquids and powders. With over 30 years of experience, the company partners with brands to design, develop, and commercialize products for consumers, focusing on taste, texture, and sustainability. They offer a range of sourcing options including organic, non-GMO, and gluten-free, and are committed to environmental stewardship through practices like reducing food miles and water consumption.

name: UNIVO
summary: UNIVO, a subsidiary of TRANSLAIT, specializes in producing PROTOFIT, a reconstituted feed made from dairy by-products for calf fattening. Established in 1985, UNIVO partners with farmers to ensure consistent quality and quantity in meat production. The company emphasizes animal welfare and aims to innovate in animal health, including reducing antibiotic use, in collaboration with veterinary experts and faculties.

name: XFE Products
summary: XFE Products is a marketing division of XF Enterprises, Inc., specializing in the animal agriculture industry. They identify and source unique feed ingredients globally, offering premium proteins, energy ingredients, functional minerals, pre/probiotics, and enzymes. Their expertise in animal nutrition, veterinary medicine, and husbandry aims to provide cost savings and improved animal performance for livestock producers nationwide.

name: B2 Ingredientes
summary: B2 Ingredientes is a company focused on providing innovative food ingredients and specialties to the market. They aim to be leaders in this sector by following key food trends and forming strong partnerships. The company offers a range of products including plant-based ingredients, proteins, sweeteners, and amino acids, alongside consulting services for businesses in the ingredient and agribusiness sectors.

name: Ecoloplant Levante, S.L.
summary: Ecoloplant Levante, S.L. is a company specializing in third-party manufacturing and the supply of eco and conventional raw materials for the agri-food industry. They offer packaging, grinding, and white label services, alongside import and export solutions. Their product range includes superfoods, proteins, seeds, grains, sugars, dehydrated fruits, nuts, flours, butters, flakes, rice, legumes, vegetables, and puffed cereals, catering to businesses from startups to larger enterprises.

name: RIP Foods™
summary: RIP™ Chicken is a plant-based chicken alternative that aims to replicate the authentic taste and texture of chicken without using any animal products. The company focuses on sustainability, seeking to minimize the environmental impact of food production by using less water and generating fewer greenhouse gas emissions compared to traditional chicken. RIP Foods is dedicated to innovation in the plant-based meat market, with plans to develop beef and pork alternatives.

name: Bobeldijk
summary: Bobeldijk is a Dutch company specializing in the production and packaging of plant-based (vegetarian and vegan) convenience products for retail and foodservice. They focus on private label concepts and product development, aiming to create delicious products without animal ingredients. The company transitioned entirely to plant-based production in 2020 and emphasizes sustainability in its operations.

name: DELTA Tierernährung GmbH
summary: DELTA Tierernährung GmbH is an internationally operating company specializing in animal nutrition, producing mineral and supplementary feed, as well as premixes for various animal species. They focus on the targeted use of vitamins, trace elements, additives, minerals, and herbs to balance nutritional deficiencies. The company offers contract manufacturing services and trades in raw materials, emphasizing a strong consulting aspect across all its business areas.

name: ABS FOOD S.r.l.
summary: ABS FOOD is an Italian company with over 25 years of experience in the food industry, specializing in the research and development of natural, plant-based ingredients. They offer tailor-made solutions and collaborate with food companies to create new recipes that align with market trends and consumer demands. Their focus is on innovation, sustainability, and multiculturalism, providing a wide range of ingredients and expert consultancy.

name: ООО «ФУДСИСТЕМС»
summary: ООО «ФУДСИСТЕМС» is an official distributor and supplier of "INGREDION" products for children's, healthy, and functional nutrition. The company also specializes in developing concepts and technologies for product stabilization and texturization. With over fifteen years of experience in food hydrocolloids, they offer a range of ingredients including modified starches, prebiotics, plant proteins, and sweeteners.

name: COPRESA Comercial de Productos Recuperados, S.A.
summary: COPRESA Comercial de Productos Recuperados, S.A. is a company focused on providing energy and proteins for animal feed, with products including pet food, compound feeds, biodiesel, and fertilizers. They emphasize quality and logistics in their operations. The company also engages in sustainability initiatives, calculating its carbon footprint and participating in regional development projects.

name: Solutex
summary: Solutex is a leading global manufacturer of omega-3 ingredients derived from fish and algae. They specialize in highly concentrated EPA and DHA fatty acids, including Specialized Pro-resolving Mediators (SPMs), and offer customizable solutions for the dietary supplement, medical nutrition, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic industries. The company emphasizes sustainable innovation, pioneering green chemistry, and advanced biolipid processing technologies to ensure high quality and purity in their products.

name: Crème de la crème
summary: Crème de la crème is a food company specializing in plant-based products such as butters, Mac 'N Cheeze, and pestos. They emphasize the use of plant-based ingredients and botanical flavors, aiming to offer delicious and high-quality alternatives. The company also provides co-packing services and distributes its products across Canada and the United States.

name: Il CashewFicio
summary: Il CashewFicio is an Italian company specializing in the production of high-quality plant-based alternatives, particularly focusing on cashew-based products. They aim to provide consumers with delicious and satisfying food experiences that mimic traditional dairy and meat products. The company has received awards for its innovative products, positioning itself as a leader in the plant-based food market.

name: SoyKing Limited
summary: SoyKing Limited is a UK-based company established in 2007, specializing in providing soy-based food ingredients to a global market. They offer a range of soy derivatives, including TVP and soy isolate, and emphasize advanced manufacturing, affordability, and the use of non-GMO soybeans. The company also provides NPD (New Product Development) services and support to its clients.

name: Chacabuco
summary: Chacabuco is a company with over 100 years of experience in producing quality food for people and pets. They specialize in gluten-free flour blends, pre-mixes with seeds and legumes, and ultra-premium pet food. The company is committed to sustainability, utilizing renewable energy, donating food to food banks, and recycling packaging. They also emphasize safe food production and environmental responsibility.

name: Herpan Nutrição Animal
summary: Herpan Nutrição Animal is a Brazilian company specializing in animal nutrition, offering a range of products including mineral supplements, protein supplements, and feed (rações). They focus on providing technologically advanced, high-quality nutritional solutions tailored to different stages of livestock, aiming to improve productivity, animal health, and profitability for rural producers. With 20 years of experience, Herpan emphasizes technical assistance and personalized service, positioning itself as a trusted partner in the agricultural sector.

name: Jimini's
summary: Jimini's is a company specializing in the production and sale of edible insect-based food products. Their product line includes mealworms, grasshoppers, crickets, protein snacks, protein bars, granolas, crackers, pasta, and insect burgers. The company emphasizes sustainability, high protein content, and French manufacturing, positioning itself as an innovative provider of alternative food sources.

name: Hangzhou Natur Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Natur Foods Co., Ltd. is a company specializing in the production and supply of a wide range of organic food ingredients. They offer products such as organic algae, inulin, plant proteins, sweeteners, spices, yeast, fruit and vegetable powders, extracts, mushroom powders, plant oils, lecithin, and feed ingredients. The company emphasizes organic cultivation, quality control, and sustainability, serving various industries including food and beverage, bakery, confectionery, and nutrition.

name: Edgy Foods
summary: Edgy Foods is a supplier of plant-based raw materials for the food industry, serving both industrial clients and the foodservice sector. They offer a range of products including various types of peas and lentils, with options for organic sourcing. The company aims to provide ingredients to food wholesalers and manufacturers, facilitating their integration into the supply chain.

name: Silk
summary: Silk is a brand that produces and markets a variety of plant-based dairy alternatives, including beverages, creamers, and yogurt alternatives. Their products are made from ingredients like almonds, oats, and soy, offering options that are dairy-free and often lower in sugar than traditional dairy products. Silk focuses on providing plant-powered nutrition for consumers seeking healthier and more sustainable food choices.

name: GDAŃSKIE BIURO HANDLOWE
summary: Gdańskie Biuro Handlowe (GBH) is a company specializing in the supply of professional raw materials for animal production and high-quality raw materials for feed production. They offer products such as extraction meal, high-protein expeller, cereal processing products, and fishmeal. GBH collaborates with leading suppliers, inspection, and transport companies to provide optimal solutions for feed mills, livestock farms, and commercial entities, emphasizing quality and safety, evidenced by their GMP+ certification.

name: Nourish Kitchen Foods
summary: Nourish Kitchen Foods is a custom food manufacturer specializing in chef-driven recipes for emerging restaurant chains and expanding grocers. They produce a variety of items including sauces, dips, spreads, soups, stews, and deli salads, catering to clients seeking custom food solutions without high minimums or long lead times. The company emphasizes its agility and capability to produce a wide range of food products.

name: 厦门克里森农业科技有限公司
summary: Xiamen Creciente Agritech Co., Ltd. (克里森) was established in March 2015, focusing on the future of agriculture with a global vision. The company imports advanced European technology and forms strategic partnerships with leading European companies like Norway's Borregaard, Skretting, and Belgium's Nutrimix. They integrate domestic resources and collaborate with Chinese universities for applied research, production, and promotion. Their mission is to support antibiotic-free feed, safe farming, precise nutrition, and cost-efficiency, creating value for customers and promoting the healthy development of China's feed and aquaculture industries.

name: FZ Organic Food
summary: FZ Organic Food is a company specializing in the production and distribution of organic food products, including Asian meal bases, chips, snacks, natural foods, and pantry staples like coconut oil and agave syrup. They also offer private label services for their products. The company emphasizes passion for organic farming, respect for nature, and traditional recipes, with a focus on sustainability and meeting the rising demand for meat substitutes.

name: FeedVit., Ltd.
summary: FeedVit is a professional manufacturer and supplier of animal nutrition and feed additives, drawing on knowledge and experience from the Netherlands. The company offers a range of products including premixes, pet group items, and raw materials, aiming to provide high-quality and stable supplies. They emphasize innovation, responsibility, and continuous improvement in their technical and professional solutions for the animal feed sector.

name: SimpliiGood
summary: SimpliiGood is an innovative food technology company that produces plant-based meat and fish analogs using microalgae, specifically spirulina. Their products are designed to mimic the taste, texture, and nutritional profile of animal-derived foods while being sustainable, pollutant-free, and non-GMO. The company leverages proprietary technology for minimal processing and aims to provide a climate-positive food source.

name: Vilofoss BeNeLux
summary: Vilofoss BeNeLux is a company specializing in animal nutrition, providing farmers with high-quality mineral supplements, liquid supplements, milk powders, and hygiene products for various livestock species. They offer expert advice and innovative solutions to support the healthy development of farming businesses. The company also focuses on sustainability and aims to help farmers achieve their environmental goals while contributing to global food security.

name: Slaats Dierenvoeders B.V.
summary: Slaats Dierenvoeders B.V. is a traditional milling company founded in 1900, specializing in animal feed. Originally focused on livestock feed, it shifted to small animal feed in 1980. The company sources natural grains and seeds globally to produce optimal feed for various animal species, with a particular specialization in bird seeds. They also act as a wholesaler for pet specialty stores, ensuring healthy animals through high-quality nutrition and supplements.

name: Novita Nutrition
summary: Novita Nutrition is an animal nutrition company specializing in the production of high-quality feed ingredients. Their product line includes NovaMeal®, a premium bypass protein for dairy cattle, and NovaOil®, a versatile vegetable oil used in animal feed and for renewable fuel production. The company focuses on innovation, manufacturing, and utilizing research to bring advanced feed products to market.

name: Bayou Best Foods
summary: Bayou Best Foods produces and markets plant-based shrimp alternatives designed to mimic the taste, texture, and performance of conventional seafood. Their products are vegan, shellfish-free, allergen-friendly, and made with clean ingredients, targeting the growing demand for sustainable seafood options in the foodservice industry. The company aims to address global food industry and environmental challenges while supporting economic growth.

name: Harmless Food Co
summary: Harmless Food Co is a New Zealand-based company established in 2017, specializing in the production and distribution of 100% plant-based and vegan-friendly food products. Their product range includes meals, meats, pies, pizzas, and cheese, all aimed at being affordable. The company offers nationwide shipping within New Zealand and also supplies its products to selected grocery stores.

name: Atargatis – natuurlijk voor dieren
summary: Atargatis is a Dutch retailer specializing in organic animal feed, natural supplements, and sustainable pasture management products. They offer a range of organic feeds for horses, chickens, goats, and sheep, alongside bio-based grass seeds and fertilizers. Their mission is to promote animal vitality through pure, high-quality, and sustainably sourced products.

name: Mathilda's
summary: Mathilda's is a plant-based food company offering a range of products including frozen meals, sauces, and cake mixes, with a focus on nutrient density and allergen-free options. The company also operates a retail store and sells vegan supplies. Mathilda's aims to promote health and wellbeing through delicious and accessible plant-based eating, stemming from the founder's personal journey of overcoming illness.

name: Continental Milkose India Ltd
summary: Continental Milkose India Ltd is a family-owned business with over 20 years of experience in producing high-quality food products. They specialize in malt products, food ingredients, and nutritional formulations, offering both ready formulations and private label services. The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies like spray drying and vacuum band drying, emphasizing product quality, safety, and client specifications.

name: Hill Foods, Inc.
summary: Hill Foods, Inc. is a company specializing in organic ingredients for plant-based meals, offering products like Ortiva Rice Syrup and Pisiva Yellow Pea Fiber and Protein. They provide these ingredients for various applications including baked goods, beverages, infant formulas, and meat alternatives. The company also offers detailed formulas and recipes to assist clients in creating their own branded healthy and nutritious dishes.

name: BIOZONA INDIA PVT LTD
summary: Biozona India Private Limited is a manufacturer and global supplier specializing in innovative feed additive solutions for animal nutrition. They produce high-quality probiotics in-house to enhance animal health, gut function, and productivity in poultry, aquaculture, and cattle. Their mission is to provide science-driven, sustainable solutions that improve feed efficiency and profitability for feed millers, integrators, and farmers.

name: NUFOER
summary: NUFOER is a family-owned company specializing in the development, manufacture, and commercialization of additives for animal nutrition. They focus on creating solutions tailored to market demands, ensuring animal health and well-being across various species including poultry, swine, bovine, ovine, caprine, horses, and aquaculture. The company aims to build a global family of clients by addressing their problems and sharing their successes.

name: EXTRUDO BEČICE s.r.o.
summary: Extrudo Bečice s.r.o. is a Czech company specializing in the production and distribution of extruded food products. Their diverse product range includes protein granulates, ready-to-eat meals, protein flours, extrudates, crispbreads, crispy sticks, biscuits, and various flour types, with a focus on plant-based and organic options. The company also offers cereal porridges, breadcrumbs, and coating mixtures, catering to both retail and B2B markets.

name: Reino das Aves
summary: Reino das Aves is a company that manufactures and sells high-quality food for birds and rodents. Their products are made with carefully selected raw materials and balanced formulas to ensure the well-being of animals. The company aims to be a partner for breeders by providing products that enhance the quality of life for pets, available through specialized stores and an online shop.

name: Mirakle Foods
summary: Mirakle Foods offers artisanal, handcrafted vegan meat substitute patties called Mirakle Burger. Unlike industrial meat substitutes, their product is made with fresh, natural ingredients and is free of preservatives. The company aims to provide a healthy, delicious, and whole plant-based alternative for consumers seeking meat-free options.

name: Möhrengrün
summary: Möhrengrün is a German company specializing in plant-based food products, particularly a versatile vegetarian 'Hack-Allerlei' (minced meat alternative). Their mission is to provide delicious, easy-to-prepare, and sustainable food options that contribute to a climate-friendly diet without compromising on taste. The company emphasizes quality, sustainability, and local production, offering their products for both retail and B2B customers.

name: Marin Living Foods
summary: Marin Living Foods is a company that produces and sells plant-based, non-dairy beverages, primarily almond milk with various flavors like cocoa, cinnamon, and maca. They focus on using premium ingredients and crafting their products in small batches. The company operates an e-commerce store offering direct-to-consumer sales with free shipping on qualifying orders within the US.

name: Qponics Limited
summary: Qponics is an agritech company focused on developing a drought-proof marine bioproducts industry. They utilize advanced technologies to farm marine microalgae, producing high-value nutraceuticals like Omega-3 oils (EPA) and high-protein food supplements. Their mission is to address the global protein deficit and accelerate the transition to sustainable agriculture.

name: Deliciou
summary: Deliciou is a company specializing in plant-based seasonings and meat alternatives, aiming to make plant-based cooking easy and delicious. They offer a range of seasonings, including popular flavors like Bacon and Nacho Cheese, as well as crumbled plant meat products. The company emphasizes natural, GMO-free ingredients and provides a 100-day trial for their products, positioning themselves as a leading brand in the plant-based food sector.

name: Bemtat Organik Ürünler
summary: Bemtat Organik Ürünler is a Turkish company specializing in the production and sale of organic food products. Their offerings include organic flours, vegan pastas, practical organic meals, and professional-use products, alongside private label services. The company emphasizes organic farming practices to protect environmental and human health, leveraging 83 years of experience in the food industry.

name: BioKing AS
summary: BioKing AS is a supplier of food products with beneficial properties, focusing on organic, plant-based, vegan, and gluten-free options. Many of their products are certified organic (Debio or EU Organic) and cater to health-conscious consumers by being sugar-free, palm oil-free, and low in salt. They emphasize sustainability, ethical sourcing, and high-quality raw materials, marketing their products to the foodservice industry, grocery stores, and health food shops.

name: Complete Solution for Poultry Inc.
summary: Complete Solution for Poultry Inc. (CSP) provides science-based solutions and all-natural feed additives for feed manufacturers and animal producers worldwide. Established in 2004, CSP offers comprehensive consulting services including technical support, quality assurance through laboratory testing, manufacturing of premixes and blends, and distribution logistics. They also offer a product portfolio of proprietary feed additives like Natura Betaine and Naturazyme®.

name: SDA
summary: SDA is a company that supplies natural specialty ingredients, singles, blends, flours, and custom solutions to customers worldwide. Leveraging 35 years of farming and production experience, they offer a "seed-to-ship" process, transforming raw materials into tailored products. SDA serves industries such as food, plant-based alternatives, and feed, focusing on quality, sustainability, and customer-specific needs.

name: FG La Pasta (Pty) Limited
summary: FG La Pasta is a South African convenience food manufacturer established in 1975, specializing in Italian-inspired pasta products, frozen foods, and bakery items. The company focuses on producing high-quality, preservative-free convenience foods for local and international markets, including private label, food services, and catering industries. Their mission is to innovate and develop wholesome products at competitive prices, aiming to be the leading convenience food manufacturer on the African continent.

name: Trans Feed Futuro Lab Sp. z o.o. S.K.A.
summary: Trans Feed Futuro Lab Sp. z o.o. S.K.A. is a Polish company specializing in the production and distribution of safe, non-invasive supplements and feed additives for livestock. Their product range includes specialized preparations for cattle, such as those for udder and hoof care, and support for metabolic conditions like ketosis and acidosis. They also offer vitamin and mineral supplements for poultry (profivet) and pigeons (flyvet), focusing on animal health and performance enhancement. The company emphasizes quality, holding a GMP+ certification and ensuring its products are GMO-free.

name: Cellana, Inc.
summary: Cellana, Inc. is an algae biotechnology company formed by the merger of Cellana and PhytoSmart. The company aims to build a sustainable and scalable algae-based nutrition platform, producing ingredients like Omega-3s and plant-based proteins. It combines Cellana's large-scale outdoor production technology with PhytoSmart's revenue-generating, indoor whole-cell algae platform, targeting markets from pet nutrition to human supplements and industrial applications.

name: Flowfood AS
summary: Flowfood AS is a leading producer of innovative plant-based food products, offering tailored solutions for private label retail, foodservice, and industrial clients. They specialize in ready-to-eat and single-frozen alternative protein products, emphasizing sustainable food production. The company aims to help consumers make more sustainable food choices through their diverse product portfolio.

name: Beauvallet
summary: Beauvallet is a company specializing in the meat industry, with a history dating back to 1860. They offer a wide range of meat products and solutions tailored for various markets including table service restaurants, street food, artisanal butcher shops, large retailers, and industrial food manufacturers. The company emphasizes innovation, sustainability, and a global commercial presence to meet customer needs.

name: L.F.B. BIOSINT Srl
summary: L.F.B. BIOSINT Srl is a family-owned company specializing in the development, production, and commercialization of complementary feeds and premixes for all animal species. With over 40 years of experience, they combine high-quality raw materials with research and development to create customized formulations. Their product range includes complementary feeds, premixes, raw materials, litter mixtures, and biogas plant mixtures, all produced with a focus on respecting nature.

name: Barfections
summary: Barfections is a company specializing in the manufacturing of nutritious and flavorful bars designed to support an active lifestyle. They offer bar manufacturing, recipe development, and packaging assistance, catering to both Fortune 500 companies and emerging brands. Their mission is to provide high-quality, transparently produced food products while fostering innovation and exceeding customer expectations.

name: Bioefekt Sp. z o.o.
summary: Bioefekt Sp. z o.o. is a Polish company specializing in the development and production of innovative solutions for animal nutrition, plant nutrition, and specialized industrial applications. Their product range includes molasses, specialized feeds, fertilizers, substrates, and functional ingredients like prebiotics and natural colorants. The company emphasizes natural solutions and proprietary technologies, often collaborating with academic institutions on research and development projects.

name: Ceralia
summary: Ceralia is a company specializing in the production and packaging of organic and natural food products. They offer a wide range of products including pure grain products, gluten-free options, cereals, legumes, and baking ingredients. Additionally, Ceralia provides custom packaging solutions like pillow bags, gusset bags, and folding boxes, along with services such as contract mixing, co-packing, and private label manufacturing. Their focus is on utilizing high-tech processes and quality assurance to transform client ideas into market-ready products.

name: Wytwórnia pasz Barbara
summary: Wytwórnia pasz Barbara is a Polish company specializing in the production of high-quality feed mixtures for farm animals, including poultry, pigs, and rabbits. They utilize modern technology and carefully selected raw materials to produce full-ration, supplementary, and medicinal feeds. The company also engages in grain procurement and conducts laboratory research to ensure product quality, aiming to provide competitive pricing while maintaining high standards.

name: Blenditup™
summary: Blenditup™ is an e-commerce company specializing in plant-based, nutrient-dense food products. Their offerings include organic vegan protein powders, spice blends, and vegan honey alternatives, all designed to enhance flavor and nutrition in everyday meals and smoothies. The company emphasizes clean ingredients, sustainability, and empowering customers to achieve a healthier lifestyle.

name: Milbank Mills, Inc. (Silver Moon Feeds)
summary: Milbank Mills, Inc., operating under the brand Silver Moon Feeds, is a family and employee-owned company established in 1867. They specialize in manufacturing and distributing a wide range of animal feeds, including non-GMO options, for various livestock, poultry, exotic animals, and pets. The company emphasizes personalized service, quality products, affordable pricing, and custom feed solutions, serving agriculture in Missouri, Iowa, and Kansas.

name: SCEA ARC EN CIEL
summary: SCEA ARC EN CIEL is a family farm located in Marigny-le-Châtel, France, specializing in the cultivation and direct sale of farm products, primarily grains and seed mixes for animal feed. The farm emphasizes traditional farming methods, quality, transparency, and local sourcing, offering products without GMOs or additives. They also provide a 24/7 self-service grain dispenser and personalized advice from the farmer, Michel.

name: Jan Zandbergen Group
summary: Jan Zandbergen Group is an international partner specializing in meat and meat alternatives, serving the retail, foodservice, and industrial markets. They act as an importer, supplier, producer, and packager of various meat products, as well as a developer of plant-based alternatives. The company aims to be a preferred partner by providing innovative solutions and adding value to the market.

name: Vilofoss BeNeLux
summary: Vilofoss BeNeLux is a company specializing in animal nutrition, providing farmers with high-quality mineral supplements, liquid supplements, milk powders, and hygiene products for various livestock species. They offer expert advice and innovative solutions to support the healthy development of farming businesses. The company also focuses on sustainability and aims to help farmers achieve their environmental goals while contributing to global food security.

name: KENT WORLDWIDE
summary: KENT WORLDWIDE is a family-owned company founded in 1927, specializing in ag-based ingredients and consumer brands. They are known for their expertise in marketing and manufacturing, transforming science into solutions for food, beverage, agriculture, and pet products. The company focuses on innovation, sustainability, and building long-term relationships, aiming to help a growing world do more.

name: New Wave Foods
summary: New Wave Foods is a company focused on developing and commercializing plant-based seafood alternatives. They aim to provide sustainable and delicious options that mimic the taste and texture of traditional seafood, addressing environmental concerns associated with overfishing and aquaculture. Their mission is to revolutionize the seafood industry with innovative, plant-based products.

name: Chunk™
summary: Chunk is a plant-based meat alternative designed to mimic the taste, texture, and versatility of beef. It can be prepared using various cooking methods like searing, grilling, and stewing, making it a direct substitute for beef in numerous recipes. The product emphasizes a clean ingredient list with 8 recognizable, natural components, offering high protein, iron, and B12.

name: Nutreza S.R.L.
summary: Nutreza S.R.L. is an innovative company focused on animal nutrition and supplementation, specializing in native microorganisms to enhance animal productivity. They offer a range of probiotic, prebiotic, and inoculant products, alongside equipment like feeders and fermentation units for intensive livestock farming. The company also provides consulting, training, licensing, and research and development services, aiming to advance animal agriculture through scientific solutions.

name: La Campana
summary: La Campana provides functional and tailor-made solutions for the meat industry, offering all-in-one formulas and specific adaptations with traditional aroma and flavor. As part of Budenheim since 2018, they leverage tradition and innovation, utilizing a semi-industrial R&D plant with advanced manufacturing technology. Their offerings extend to Life Science (Nutrition, Pharma, Savory Solutions, Baking) and Material Science (Polymers, Building & Construction, Ceramics, Metal Treatment, Custom Manufacturing), alongside new business platforms and a strong focus on sustainability.

name: ネクストワンジャパン (Next One Japan)
summary: Next One Japan specializes in food OEM services, offering high-quality product development from small lots to meet diverse customer needs. They provide a wide range of food products including pasta sauces, soups, meat products, seafood, Chinese dishes, dressings, baked goods, and fully cooked meals for various institutions. The company emphasizes its strong development capabilities and commitment to customer satisfaction in the food manufacturing sector.

name: Culivega
summary: Culivega specializes in developing and producing culinary plant-based meal components for the professional food market, creating restaurant-level dishes with meat, fish, and dairy alternatives. Their mission is to make plant-based foods more attractive sensorially and commercially, enabling a seamless shift from animal-based to animal-free protein. They offer convenient, time-saving, and labor-efficient products for the food service, ready-meal, and white label markets.

name: Ants Innovate
summary: Ants Innovate is a company focused on commercializing innovative functional ingredients and tools to create tasty, affordable hybrid meat cuts for the mass market. They aim to provide a complete meat-eating experience for everyone through technologies that enhance flavor, texture, and cost-effectiveness. Their mission involves developing clean-label, non-GMO, and pathogen-free products.

name: Farmers & Chefs (formerly Aloba)
summary: Farmers & Chefs, formerly known as Aloba, is a company specializing in plant-based food alternatives. They offer a range of products including sauces, spice blends, and frozen items like plant-based mince, burgers, and balls. The company focuses on providing delicious, nutritious, and sustainable options to make it easy for consumers to incorporate plant-based meals into their diets. Their mission is to encourage small dietary changes for a greater impact.

name: ES Aqua Holding
summary: ES Aqua Holding is a company specializing in the production and distribution of various types of animal feed, including fish feed, ornamental fish feed, small animal feed, and poultry feed. They offer a range of specialized fish feeds for different life stages and species, such as trout, carp, salmon, and tilapia. The company also provides high-performance and health-focused feed options.

name: PROEXA S.A.
summary: PROEXA S.A. is a company specializing in healthy food production and maquila (contract manufacturing) services. They offer a range of food products including rice pasta, pre-baked pizza and bread, instant soups, vegan yogurt, and rice semolina. Their services encompass grinding, mixing, extrusion, spray drying, hydrolysis, and packaging, catering to both their own brands and private label development.

name: ITALSOLEmangimi (F.lli Menis srl)
summary: ITALSOLEmangimi, operated by F.lli Menis srl, is a family tradition company specializing in the production and sale of high-quality animal feed. They offer simple, complete, and complementary feeds for poultry, cattle, and swine, as well as processed cereals and related products. The company emphasizes animal physiology, modern nutritional science, and customer satisfaction through tailored formulations and localized services, aiming for balanced livestock nutrition and environmental sustainability.

name: Gluvana Gluten Free Foods, LLC.
summary: Gluvana Gluten Free Foods, LLC. is a company specializing in the production and sale of gluten-free, nut-free, soy-free, and dairy-free flour blends. Their mission is to provide high-quality, delicious, and healthy alternatives for consumers, professionals, and manufacturers. The company emphasizes the nutritional benefits of their plant-based ingredients, such as high fiber and protein content, and offers versatile blends suitable for various culinary applications.

name: Công ty TNHH Thái Việt Long
summary: Thái Việt Long Co., Ltd. specializes in providing optimal solutions for the industrial animal feed production, business, and quality management sectors. They offer a range of products including premixes, additives, and specialized equipment, alongside services like nutritional consulting and formula software. The company aims to support clients in enhancing production and quality within the animal feed industry.

name: Bionly Kft.
summary: Bionly Kft. is a Hungarian company established in late 2015, specializing in the production and distribution of organic extruded food products. Their primary focus is on processing organic millet, but they also produce extrudates from organic corn and rice, including flavored varieties. The company operates in Northern Hungary, aiming to create jobs and contribute to regional development, and serves both domestic and international markets. They emphasize product development, meeting market demands, and maintaining allergen-free production environments, supported by an ISO quality assurance system.

name: Rule Breaker Snacks
summary: Rule Breaker Snacks is a company that produces and sells allergen-free, vegan, and gluten-free cookies and brownies. Their products are free from the top 11 allergens, including peanuts, tree nuts, eggs, dairy, soy, sesame, coconut, mustard, fish, shellfish, and wheat/gluten. The company offers a variety of products such as singles, bites, juniors, and limited edition flavors, with a mission to make delicious snacks accessible to everyone.

name: Heritage Feed
summary: Heritage Feed is a company that produces and sells premium, non-GMO animal feed formulated for pasture-raised livestock. They offer a range of specialized feeds for poultry, swine, dairy, and sheep/goats, emphasizing healthy ingredients without fillers or soy. The company was founded by farmers seeking high-quality, affordable feed options and now serves small to medium-sized production farms.

name: Ahimsa Vege Health Food
summary: Ahimsa is a compassionate brand established in 1986, specializing in a diverse range of plant-based food products including ready-to-eat meals, frozen plant-based meats and seafood, sauces, condiments, and snacks. The company emphasizes ethical production, certified quality, and sustainability, utilizing solar energy and innovative practices. Ahimsa aims to deliver delicious and compassionate food choices to customers globally.

name: Tutt'Altro
summary: Tutt'Altro is an Italian company specializing in the production and sale of 100% organic, plant-based food products. Their offerings include a range of legume and wheat-based protein alternatives designed to mimic traditional meat products, such as mince, burgers, sausages, and roasts. The company emphasizes quality ingredients and aims to provide delicious, versatile options for a plant-based diet, catering to both vegans and those looking to reduce meat consumption.

name: Tribe 9 Foods
summary: Tribe 9 Foods is a food manufacturing company specializing in producing natural, healthful products, including pasta styles and nut butter & bar ingredients. They offer manufacturing partnerships, private labeling, and food service solutions, leveraging their entrepreneurial innovation and customer-first approach. The company is committed to sustainability and improving lives through food, operating as a B Corporation.

name: Panghea SPA
summary: Panghea is an Italian company specializing in the production and supply of innovative and sustainable protein-based nutritional solutions for the animal feed market. They focus on high-quality raw materials, including guar meal and camelina sativa, emphasizing GMO-free and ecologically responsible crop production. The company is committed to social and environmental improvements, aiming to provide optimal nutritional value while adhering to strict quality and safety controls.

name: KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH
summary: KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH is a company specializing in the development of bespoke stabilising and emulsifying solutions for the food industry. They offer a wide range of ingredients and solutions for dairy, dairy alternatives, plant-based meat and fish, savory products, and bakery items. KaTech focuses on innovation, quality, and providing tailored support to food manufacturers and brands.

name: Bartleby's Food
summary: Bartleby's Food is a company specializing in the production and sale of seitan, a plant-based protein derived from wheat gluten. They offer various seitan products like nuggets and cutlets, emphasizing their high protein content, allergen-free nature, and lower environmental impact compared to animal agriculture. The company operates on an exclusive drop system for online sales and also supplies wholesale to retailers and restaurants.

name: HOD-ROL Paweł Wróblewski
summary: HOD-ROL is a company established in 1999 that specializes in providing a comprehensive range of services and products for animal husbandry. They offer feed analysis, nutritional plan development, and supply high-quality, GMO-free feeds and supplements for various livestock including cattle, pigs, poultry, horses, sheep, goats, fish, rabbits, and domestic pets. The company focuses on enhancing herd productivity, health, and feeding economics, serving clients of all herd sizes with professional advice and support.

name: Viñals Gourmet
summary: Viñals Gourmet (VG) is a company focused on providing unique gastronomic solutions, positioning itself as a key partner for its clients. They emphasize continuous improvement, honesty, hard work, and efficiency. Their core values include transparency, quality, sustainability, social and animal respect, and traceability from origin to distribution. VG also pioneers the introduction of plant-based meat alternatives.

name: DAVA Foods
summary: DAVA Foods is a food company that processes and distributes a variety of food products, including eggs, fermented legumes, and protein chips. They cater to both retail and professional markets, emphasizing quality, local sourcing, and sustainability. The company collaborates closely with farmers to ensure high-quality raw materials for their processed goods.

name: CRICKET ONE
summary: Cricket One is a company that farms crickets and processes them into high-quality, sustainable protein ingredients for food, pet food, beverages, and cosmetics. They operate on a farm-to-fork model with an advanced manufacturing system and strict quality standards, aiming to make crickets a part of the daily diet globally. Their mission is to provide scalable and affordable cricket protein to address malnutrition and promote community development and sustainability.

name: Granum Animal Nutrition
summary: Granum Animal Nutrition, operating since 1990, specializes in animal feed production, emphasizing productivity for livestock. They offer a range of products, including private label options, and are recommended by professional breeders. The company also operates a corporate store and focuses on quality in its offerings.

name: COPIC
summary: COPIC is a company founded in 1985, specializing in animal nutrition and premixes, offering innovative formulations and nutritional services for the agri-food industry and livestock production (pigs, ruminants, poultry). They utilize modern technology and rigorous analysis methods to ensure high-quality processes and products, also providing laboratory and agricultural services. Their mission is customer satisfaction through quality products and affordable prices.

name: Fitwell (Functional Ingredient Technologies Sdn Bhd)
summary: Fitwell is a leading OEM food manufacturer in Malaysia specializing in health food and beverage production. With over 20 years of experience, they offer end-to-end solutions including custom formulation, raw material sourcing, regulatory advice, and high-speed automated manufacturing. They focus on plant-based products, functional ingredients, and meal replacements, holding certifications like JAKIM Halal, GMP, HACCP, and MESTI to ensure quality and compliance for both local and international markets.

name: Vilomix
summary: Vilomix is a company specializing in animal nutrition, providing customized vitamin and mineral solutions, innovative feed additives, and consultancy services to farmers and the feed industry. They offer a range of products including premixes, concentrates, milk replacers, and hygiene products, aiming to enable sustainable animal production with good returns. The company focuses on meeting the nutritional needs of various animal types such as ruminants, swine, poultry, aquaculture, and horses.

name: Arizona Sunland Foods, INC.
summary: Arizona Sunland Foods is a family-owned custom food manufacturer established in 1983, specializing in frozen breaded proteins, vegetables, value-added labor projects, sauces, and salad dressings. They serve restaurant chains, distributors, casinos, institutions, and deli counters with proprietary and private label products. The company focuses on providing portion-controlled, high-quality food items to help customers improve quality control and lower food costs.

name: Nayaa Ingredients
summary: Nayaa Ingredients is a company specializing in the development and supply of high-quality food ingredients and additives. They offer a diverse range of products, including plant-based alternatives, animal proteins, encapsulated ingredients, and natural marinades and preservatives. The company focuses on providing tailored technical, sensory, and nutritional solutions to meet specific client needs across various markets such as food, pharmaceutical, technical, and animal feed.

name: Plant Based Foods, Inc.
summary: Plant Based Foods, Inc. offers a line of innovative, delicious, and sustainable plant-based foods targeting health-conscious consumers. Their product offerings include plant-based seafood alternatives and a product called CAVI-ART. The company emphasizes the versatility, sustainability, and variety of its offerings.

name: FRoSTA Foodservice GmbH
summary: FRoSTA Foodservice GmbH is a subsidiary of FRoSTA AG, specializing in frozen food solutions for the foodservice industry. They offer a wide range of convenience products, including plant-based alternatives, fish dishes, and vegetable patties, designed for quick and easy preparation in professional kitchens. Their focus is on high-quality ingredients, minimal additives, and user-friendly products for sectors like restaurants, canteens, and hospitals.

name: Nonfood
summary: Nonfood is a company focused on developing and marketing algae-based food products, positioning algae as a sustainable and highly nutritious alternative to traditional food sources. Their product line includes the Nonbar, a ready-to-eat nutrition bar, and Nongredient, a versatile golden chlorella powder for home cooking. The company aims to revolutionize the food chain by leveraging algae's efficiency in converting sunlight, water, and CO2 into essential nutrients, thereby promoting environmental sustainability and reducing reliance on land-intensive agriculture.

name: No Bones Beach Club
summary: No Bones Beach Club is a 100% female-owned and operated vegan food company that specializes in plant-based cauliflower wings. Originally founded as a restaurant, the company has pivoted to offer food service solutions for restaurants, delis, grocery stores, and offices. Their products are designed to be easy to prepare, catering to both food service professionals and retail consumers seeking convenient, delicious, and allergen-free plant-based options.

name: Modesto Milling Inc.
summary: Modesto Milling Inc. is a company specializing in the production and sale of certified organic animal feed for various species including poultry, livestock, pets, and horses. They emphasize non-GMO ingredients and utilize beneficial herbs and essential oils in their formulations. The company also offers supplements and minerals, and provides feed in various sizes from bags to bulk truckloads, with custom mixes available. They have been a pioneer in organic feed production since 1998, focusing on customer satisfaction and animal health.

name: Nourish Ingredients Pty Ltd.
summary: Nourish Ingredients is a deep tech company specializing in animal-free fats and precision fermentation. They develop innovative lipid-based ingredients, Tastilux® and Creamilux®, to enhance the taste, texture, and functionality of plant-based and hybrid food products. Their mission is to create delicious, healthier, and more sustainable food options by combining advanced science with natural lipids, positioning themselves as leaders in the alternative food ingredients market.

name: Cia do Sal
summary: Cia do Sal is a Brazilian company with twenty years of experience in producing mineral supplements, proteinated feeds, concentrates, and rations for the livestock industry. They offer both standard product lines and customized formulations aimed at optimizing cattle profitability. The company emphasizes punctuality, quality, partnership, and sustainability in its operations and maintains a strong commitment to social responsibility through community support and donations.

name: Kelstar Store
summary: Kelstar Store is an e-commerce business specializing in premium, plant-based food products. They offer artisan, small-batch vegan-friendly items, including a plant-based honey alternative and dry mixes for burgers and sausages. The company aims to provide delicious and convenient plant-based options for a wide range of consumers.

name: Global Organics
summary: Global Organics is a supplier of certified organic, sustainable, non-GMO, and quality food and beverage ingredients to manufacturers and wholesalers globally, operating since 1992. The company focuses on offering high-quality ingredients at fair prices, providing outstanding customer support, and building collaborative relationships based on trust and integrity. They partner with producers who meet stringent social and environmental standards, aiming to positively impact food supply and environmental health through organic agriculture.

name: CÔNG TY TNHH THƯƠNG MẠI VÀ DỊCH VỤ IVAR VIỆT NAM
summary: IVAR Vietnam is a company specializing in the import, export, distribution, and production of organic and healthy food products. They aim to provide high-quality, certified organic products from international and Vietnamese brands to consumers, focusing on a convenient and healthy lifestyle. The company also operates a modern distribution system and offers attractive policies for its agents and collaborators.

name: KOKIRIKI | Plant Based Food
summary: KOKIRIKI is a French company specializing in 100% plant-based food alternatives, offering a wide range of products that mimic beef, fish, poultry, and charcuterie. Their mission is to make plant-based eating accessible to everyone through superior taste, strict quality standards, and affordable pricing, facilitated by their own manufacturing facility and team. The company emphasizes the environmental and nutritional necessity of plant-based diets.

name: Vegital
summary: Vegital is a company specializing in the sale of home appliances for making plant-based drinks, such as almond milk, soy milk, and oat milk. They offer a range of devices like the Vegital Silky, Smile, and Rainbow series, alongside fermenting machines, frothers, and ice cream makers. The company also provides related ingredients, accessories, and recipes, aiming to make a dairy-free lifestyle accessible and convenient for households.

name: Sunny Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunny Foods Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in food ingredient processing. They offer services ranging from sourcing raw food materials to processing, sterilization, and packaging, aiming to provide ideal products and services that meet diverse customer needs. Their capabilities include drying, grinding, roasting, spray drying, and producing ingredients for products like green juices and plant-based foods, with a focus on contract manufacturing and OEM production.

name: 黑龙江省恒源食品股份有限公司 (Heilongjiang Hengyuan Food Co., Ltd.)
summary: Heilongjiang Hengyuan Food Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and operates four modern production bases. The company specializes in the R&D, customization, and processing of whole grain products, including grain powders, granules, and bars, as well as plant-based meat and functional rice products.
