They are known for their 'Whole Grain Essence - Four-Dimensional Nutrition Technology' and operate one of the world's advanced smart grain factories, serving a global market with over 50 export countries.

name: OmnisOva Pty Ltd.
summary: OmnisOva is dedicated to revolutionizing food safety by developing ovomucoid (OVM) free eggs using advanced technologies. Their mission is to create safer food options and new dietary choices for individuals with egg allergies globally. By adhering to high safety and quality standards, OmnisOva aims to make egg products worry-free for allergen sufferers.

name: Boi Verde Ind e Comercio de Farinha de Carne e Osso LTDA
summary: Boi Verde Ind e Comercio de Farinha de Carne e Osso LTDA is a Brazilian company founded in November 2008, specializing in the production and supply of ingredients for animal nutrition. They serve the poultry, swine, aquaculture, and pet food sectors. The company emphasizes continuous industrial modernization and rigorous quality control for both raw materials and finished products, ensuring compliance with Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture standards.

name: LA TROJA
summary: LA TROJA is a company specializing in plant-based food products derived from legumes. They offer native and precooked legume flours, gluten-free extrusions, and selected grains, emphasizing healthy, natural, and delicious options. Their products are rich in proteins, fibers, and vitamins, contributing to a healthy diet and are marketed to various industries.

name: Arravis Kft.
summary: Arravis Kft. is a Hungarian-owned company established in 2005, specializing in the distribution of feed additives and supplements for animal husbandry, feed manufacturers, and veterinarians. Their product range includes enzymes, carotenoids, salmonella control agents, preservatives, and plant extracts, with a focus on natural solutions that reduce the need for pharmaceuticals and chemicals. The company also provides expert consulting services in areas such as animal health, nutrition, and farm management, aiming to support sustainable production systems.

name: Intercity Packers
summary: Intercity Packers is a Canadian company that has been producing, sourcing, and delivering premium quality meat and seafood products since 1972. They serve top restaurants, retailers, and healthcare establishments across Canada. The company emphasizes a consultative approach with customers, focusing on sustainable practices and community well-being.

name: Barvecue
summary: Barvecue is a company specializing in plant-based meat alternatives, offering products like Pulled BVQ, Carnitas, and Rotisserie Chicken. They focus on providing delicious and sustainable food options, with recipes and store locators available on their website. The company operates through an e-commerce platform powered by Shopify.

name: EWROL Sp. z o.o.
summary: EWROL Sp. z o.o. is a company specializing in nutritional consulting for all types of farm animals and distributing high-quality feed components and industrial feed mixes for cattle, pigs, and poultry. Established in 2006, the company focuses on providing comprehensive solutions for livestock farms, developing custom feed recipes, and offering expert support through training and consultations. They also oversee the production of protein-energy components using advanced technologies.

name: Kapuvit Kraftfutterwerk GmbH&Co.KG
summary: Kapuvit Kraftfutterwerk specializes in the production, development, and distribution of animal feed, including milk replacers, pre-starters, mineral feeds, and specialized formulations for pigs and cattle. They emphasize quality management, product safety, and offer flexible solutions and custom blends to meet specific animal needs. The company aims to be a competent and reliable partner in animal nutrition.

name: Cano-ela
summary: Cano-ela is a food technology company that specializes in processing oil-rich seeds, like canola, to create a new generation of plant-based ingredients. Their innovative, mild processing methods unlock the full potential of seeds, transforming them into healthy, functional, and sustainable components such as oils, proteins, and fibers. By utilizing 100% of the seed and avoiding harsh chemicals, Cano-ela aims to remove refined ingredients from the food supply chain, offering food companies cleaner labels and reduced environmental impact.

name: American River Ag
summary: American River Ag specializes in cultivating and processing high-quality ingredients for the livestock and pet food industries. They focus on using 100% upcycled ingredients, employing proprietary processing, drying, mixing, and pelletizing capabilities. The company offers farm-direct sourcing and warehousing services, aiming to be an industry leader in sustainable ingredient solutions.

name: Ambrosia Sciences Pte Ltd
summary: Ambrosia Sciences is a cultured meat startup focused on developing sustainable and ethical protein alternatives for the future of food. They utilize innovative biotechnology, including a single-step stem cell differentiation process, to produce cultured meat with a reduced environmental impact compared to traditional agriculture. The company aims to revolutionize the food industry by offering healthier, more ethical, and environmentally responsible food production solutions.

name: 베지푸드 (VEGEFOOD)
summary: 베지푸드 is a 26-year-old company specializing in vegan and vegetarian food products. They offer a wide range of plant-based alternatives to meat, including soy and wheat-based products, as well as vegan snacks, sauces, and meal kits. The company also provides recipes and information on veganism, aiming to promote a plant-based lifestyle through its diverse product offerings and online resources.

name: Primavika Sp. z o.o.
summary: Primavika is a creator of healthy, plant-based food products, aiming to simplify healthy eating and positively impact the world. Their product range includes ready-to-eat meals, world cuisine dishes, vegetable pastes, nut butters, and organic and gluten-free options. The company emphasizes natural ingredients, sustainable sourcing, and high production standards, holding various certifications for quality and safety.

name: Veganic OÜ
summary: Veganic OÜ is an Estonian-based creator of plant-based foods, focusing on pure ingredients, high nutritional value, and delicious flavors without artificial additives. They offer a range of products including meat cuts, ready meals, deli meats, pâté, and dumplings, emphasizing a healthy lifestyle and clean eating. The company also provides cooperation opportunities for retail, private label, food service, and bulk supply.

name: POLAMEDICA sp. z o.o.
summary: POLAMEDICA sp. z o.o. is a Polish company established in 2010, specializing in the production and packaging of dietary supplements and food products. They offer comprehensive services including product design, formulation development, and packaging selection, aiming to create new brands for their clients. The company emphasizes using natural ingredients and scientific knowledge in their product development and continuously invests in expanding its manufacturing capabilities.

name: Tucker Milling, LLC
summary: Tucker Milling is a family-owned and operated full-service mill specializing in superior animal nutrition. They produce high-quality animal feeds using carefully sourced ingredients and the latest research, with an in-house Ph.D. nutritionist on staff. The company offers specialized feed additives like probiotics, yeast culture, bioavailable minerals, and essential oils, and also provides logistics services through TM Freight.

name: Industrija Mesa TOPOLA DOO
summary: Industrija Mesa TOPOLA DOO is a meat processing company that emphasizes high-quality products made from domestic raw materials, following a 'farm to table' process. They offer a diverse range of products including pates, meat spreads, ready meals, pet food, semi-durable and durable sausages, and smoked products. The company is committed to modern trends, producing allergen-free and gluten-free options, and has received recognition for its quality, such as the 'Best from Vojvodina' and 'Serbian Quality' marks.

name: RNK Agro & Chemicals Pvt. Ltd.
summary: RNK Agro & Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is a leading Indian manufacturer and supplier of animal nutrition products, specializing in poultry, cattle, fish, and shrimp feed. They operate a state-of-the-art manufacturing plant in Hyderabad, adhering to international quality standards and GMP practices. The company emphasizes nutritionally balanced, economical products made from high-quality raw materials, with a notable focus on antibiotic-free aqua products.

name: Vege Wholesale
summary: Vege Wholesale is an online retailer specializing in a wide variety of vegetarian and vegan food products, including meat alternatives, poultry, seafood, and non-frozen items. They also offer personal protective equipment and gift cards. The company emphasizes fast online order fulfillment, shipping via UPS within 24 hours, and accepts all major credit cards.

name: Triple-M-Farms
summary: Triple-M-Farms specializes in customer formula feed manufacturing, providing tailored nutrition programs and feed formulas for livestock. They focus on delivering quality feed and excellent customer support, aiming for better farming results. The company also offers pre-pay and early payment discounts, and is associated with the '97 Milk' initiative supporting dairy farmers.

name: イフジ産業株式会社 (Ifuji Sangyo Co., Ltd.)
summary: Ifuji Sangyo Co., Ltd. is a company specializing in egg processing and related products, operating under the concept of 'Tamago Tech' (Egg Tech). Their core business involves processing approximately 1.3 billion eggs annually into liquid eggs, which serve as a 'semiconductor of food' for various food manufacturers. They also have a seasoning business and an organic e-commerce platform, aiming to support Japan's food infrastructure with sustainable supply chains.

name: M.T.A. s.r.l.
summary: M.T.A. s.r.l. specializes in providing customized ingredient solutions and technical support for the meat processing industry. They offer a range of products including flavorings, functional blends, and semi-finished products for cooked and cured meats, focusing on allergen-free, GMO-free, and clean label formulations. The company leverages its pilot plant and laboratory facilities for research and development to meet specific client needs and market trends, ensuring high-quality, traceable raw materials and efficient logistics.

name: ТОВ ТЕКРО
summary: TEKRO is a company specializing in the production, distribution, marketing, and consulting for animal feed and care for both domestic and agricultural animals. Founded in 1991, it has grown to become a leading producer of animal feed products in Eastern Europe, with a strong focus on premixes, supplements, and specialized feed programs. The company also distributes products from international partners and offers comprehensive consulting services to its clients.

name: Marin Foods Specialties, Inc.
summary: Marin Foods Specialties, Inc. is a food manufacturing company established in 1974, specializing in natural food products. They offer private label services including contract baking, energy bar manufacturing, and contract packaging for various items like cookies, bars, bites, and trail mixes. The company emphasizes quality, holding certifications for USDA Organic, Gluten-free, and Non-GMO products, and is committed to social responsibility and environmental sustainability through initiatives like solar power.

name: KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH
summary: KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH is a company specializing in the development of bespoke stabilising and emulsifying solutions for the food industry. They offer a wide range of ingredients and solutions for dairy, dairy alternatives, plant-based meat and fish, savory products, and bakery items. KaTech focuses on innovation, quality, and providing tailored support to food manufacturers and brands.

name: Goshen Alimentos
summary: Goshen Alimentos is a food company specializing in a variety of plant-based protein products, including sausages, burgers, tofu, and sliced meats, as well as bread and savory snacks. They emphasize harmony and respect for life in their mission, offering nutritious options suitable for vegans and vegetarians. The company also provides recipes and information on product storage and ingredients.

name: Apogee Foods
summary: Apogee Foods is a natural foods manufacturing partner specializing in gluten-free, SQF, and Kosher certified products. They offer a comprehensive suite of services including recipe development, QA testing, nutritional analysis, commercialization, logistics, procurement, and demand planning. Their facility is equipped to produce a variety of snacks, bars, extruded products, bakery items, and chocolate-enrobed products, aiming to help quality-conscious brands bring their natural food products from concept to market.

name: Harvest Food Products
summary: Harvest Food Products is a food manufacturer specializing in high-quality appetizers and entrees for food service, retail, and private label markets. They focus on innovation, quality ingredients, and catering to niche consumer markets such as ethnic foods, gluten-free, and organic options. The company offers co-packing services and supplies products for deli, hot bar, grab'n'go, and freezer case applications.

name: Fuel For Fire
summary: Fuel For Fire is a company that produces and sells plant-based protein and original flavor food products, primarily in the form of purees. They offer a subscription service for regular deliveries and also sell through Amazon. Their mission appears to focus on providing healthy, smart snacking options for children and communities.

name: 株式会社アスリックス (ASLIX INC.)
summary: ASLIX INC. was established in 2001 as a computer software development company and later expanded into organic farming with "Hifumi Farm" in 2010. The company holds a patent for antioxidant dried vegetable and fruit powders derived from their organically grown produce. They utilize these patented powders to manufacture unique products such as cookies, juices, and supplements, emphasizing a commitment to sustainable agriculture and the well-being of all life.

name: CEDAN Rações
summary: CEDAN Rações is a company that manufactures and distributes high-quality animal feed for dogs, cats, and birds, as well as nutritional supplements for various livestock. They emphasize advanced technology and selected raw materials to ensure healthy and vital animal nutrition. The company also engages in content creation related to pet care and health through its blog.

name: Witpol
summary: Witpol is a Polish company specializing in the production of plant-based beverages, breakfast products, and dry snacks. Their product line includes a variety of plant-based drinks made from grains, nuts, soy, and coconut, as well as cereal chips, rice wafers, and protein cookies. The company emphasizes natural ingredients, simple compositions, and high quality, aiming to provide healthy and tasty options for consumers seeking alternatives to traditional dairy and snack products.

name: Gempol Sp. z o.o.
summary: Gempol Sp. z o.o. is a manufacturer specializing in high-quality animal feed additives under the brand Animal Glow®. They offer products designed to support the health, development, and vitality of various animal groups, including livestock and pets. The company emphasizes competitive pricing, high-quality ingredients, and adherence to European quality, safety, and environmental standards, supported by certifications like Non-GMO and HACCP.

name: SunOpta
summary: SunOpta is a company that provides customized supply chain solutions and innovation for brands, retailers, and foodservice providers. They specialize in a broad portfolio of beverages, broths, and better-for-you snacks, including plant-based options and fruit-based products. SunOpta also offers co-manufacturing, private label services, and ingredient sourcing, focusing on organic and non-GMO verified products.

name: Novades Ambition
summary: Novades Ambition specializes in creating custom ingredient solutions from raw materials that have lost their original purpose. They transform these into high-quality, competitively priced products through flexibility, creativity, and advanced mixing capabilities. The company serves various markets including pet food, aquafeed, and animal feed, focusing on adding value for both suppliers and customers.

name: Stalk & Spade
summary: Stalk & Spade was a restaurant chain focused on providing familiar plant-based food options. The company announced its closure effective November 1, 2023, citing the unpredictable landscape of the plant-based meat and dairy alternatives industry. They aimed to offer delicious and accessible vegan alternatives to traditional favorites.

name: Eco Rescue
summary: Eco Rescue is a company focused on providing high-quality, sustainable animal feed, including alternative protein sources like black soldier fly larvae, to pets and livestock. Their mission is to promote animal health and environmental stewardship by transforming food waste into valuable feed products. They offer a range of premium, organic, and natural feed options, positioning themselves as an innovative solution in the animal nutrition market.

name: Bump Plant-Enhanced Meat
summary: Bump Plant-Enhanced Meat is a company focused on producing plant-based meat alternatives. While their current product lineup is unavailable, they are preparing to launch new products next year. The company aims to create "meat made to make a difference" and engages with customers through a mailing list for updates, discounts, recipes, and information on pop-up events.

name: MF Feed CORPORATION
summary: MF Feed CORPORATION is a feed manufacturer that produces and sells mixed feed, compound feed, and premix products primarily for dairy cows. Their mission is to connect producers and consumers through product development, aiming to contribute to the advancement of the dairy industry and benefit consumers. The company focuses on customer-centric business activities and offers private blend products tailored to specific client needs.

name: OVARGADO S.A.
summary: OVARGADO S.A. is a company with over 30 years of experience in the animal feed industry, specializing in the production of healthy and balanced animal food for all land animals. They offer feed in various forms, including farinated, pellets, extruded, and multi-particles, and commercialize both their own registered brands and Private Label products. Their mission is to produce and sell quality food at competitive prices, aiming to be recognized for innovation and meeting customer expectations.

name: Boermarke
summary: Boermarke is an innovative partner specializing in plant-based dairy alternatives, offering a range of products including plant-based cheese, yogurt, and ice cream. With 35 years of experience, the company has evolved from artisanal ice cream production to a knowledge partner in the plant-based sector. They focus on taste, health, and sustainability, serving retail, foodservice, and industry markets with both private label and their own brand, VAIRY.

name: Gardein
summary: Gardein is a brand specializing in plant-based meat alternatives, offering a wide range of frozen and refrigerated products designed to mimic the taste and texture of traditional meat. Their mission is to make plant-based eating accessible and enjoyable for everyone. They are a prominent player in the growing plant-based food market.

name: 8th Avenue Food & Provisions
summary: 8th Avenue Food & Provisions is a leading manufacturer and distributor of nut butters, specializing in private label, co-manufacturing, and foodservice solutions. They offer a wide range of conventional and organic peanut and tree nut butters, with versatile packaging and processing capabilities. The company emphasizes customer-centricity, quality, and safety, serving retail, foodservice, industrial, and e-commerce channels globally.

name: Hummami
summary: Hummami produces a vegan protein derived from cultivated edible mushroom mycelium, flavored with natural ingredients. It offers a high protein and fiber content, essential amino acids, and a fibrous, juicy texture, positioning itself as a sustainable and versatile alternative to traditional proteins. The company emphasizes its circular economy approach, using agricultural waste as a substrate for cultivation.

name: Stony Brook US Grown Seeds and Seed Oils
summary: Stony Brook US Grown Seeds and Seed Oils is an artisan food producer specializing in roasting seeds and pressing oils in-house at their New York facility. They offer a range of products including pepitas seed snacks, culinary seed oils, and seed protein powders, all made from locally sourced, US-grown ingredients. The company emphasizes small-batch production, zero-waste practices, and provides vegan, nut-free, and gluten-free options.

name: My Agrinutrition
summary: My Agrinutrition is a manufacturing company specializing in nutritional animal feed additives and supplements for livestock and aquaculture. With over 15 years of research-oriented experience, they provide scientifically formulated, eco-friendly products aimed at improving food quality and animal nutrition. The company emphasizes quality, affordability, and customer-centric solutions, positioning itself as a caring manufacturer in the animal feed industry.

name: PROFEED® NUTRICION ANIMAL
summary: PROFEED® NUTRICION ANIMAL specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of custom mineral premixes for ruminants, focusing on cattle for meat, milk, and reproduction. They also provide expert animal nutrition consulting services. The company emphasizes tailored solutions based on specific farm conditions, water quality, and animal welfare, aiming for high production and economic returns for their clients.

name: Polpetteria Italiana
summary: Polpetteria Italiana is an artisanal producer of meatballs for restaurants, offering beef, plant-based, and frozen lines. They emphasize handmade quality, small-batch production, and consistent results, aiming to provide a homemade taste with reliable quality. The company also offers digital HACCP solutions for restaurants through their Fridge app, focusing on technology and services for the food service industry.

name: Villafrati Alimentos Eireli
summary: Villafrati Alimentos Eireli is a food industry company providing solutions and support to restaurants, food services, corporate catering, hospitals, supermarkets, and dark kitchens. They specialize in developing creative solutions for cost reduction, process improvement, delivery punctuality, and product standardization. The company also offers product outsourcing, including Halal, Kosher, and Vegan certified items, and assists chefs and buyers in optimizing operations through ingredient suggestions, new product development, menu creation, and process review.

name: Value Food GmbH
summary: Value Food is a vegan and clean label food distributor that connects innovative startups and established brands with the retail and foodservice markets. They focus on providing healthier and more sustainable food choices without compromising on taste. The company acts as a distributor, offering product innovation, logistical consolidation, and market access for brands, while enabling businesses to make better purchasing decisions.

name: 邢老汉豆业 (Xing Laohan Bean Products)
summary: HBS Hongbao Platform, formerly Daqing Xing Laohan Bean Products, was established in 2000 and is a leading enterprise specializing in the production, sales, and research of water tofu, dried tofu, and other bean products. Operating from a facility over 1000 square meters with more than 35 employees, the company utilizes modern production lines and pure, green soybeans as raw materials. They are recognized as the largest bean product producer in Daqing.

name: Pflanzliche Lebensmittelfabrik GmbH
summary: Pflanzliche Lebensmittelfabrik GmbH (PLF) is a production partner and service provider specializing in the development and manufacturing of plant-based food products. Their core focus areas include vegan liquid egg alternatives, spreads, and sweet spoonable products. They cater to retail, industrial clients, and brand manufacturers, offering expertise in product development, production technology, and sourcing of raw materials.

name: ООО "Бартон Маркетинг"
summary: ООО "Бартон Маркетинг" acts as a unified marketing representation for three European pet food manufacturers. They specialize in contract manufacturing and direct supply of pet food products under clients' private labels (СТМ). Their offerings include over 1000 dry and wet food recipes, veterinary diets, snacks, and treats, catering to various quality and price points.

name: Frosty Foods
summary: Frosty Foods is a premier supplier specializing in frozen food and artisanal specialty meats. They emphasize quality through locally sourced, organically raised livestock and small-batch production using traditional techniques. Their mission is to provide customers with exceptional, preservative-free frozen food products.

name: SUGIHARA INDUSTRIAL CO.,LTD
summary: Sugihara Industrial Co., Ltd. is a specialized trading company with 100 years of history, focusing on soybeans and beans. They offer a wide range of products including beans, sugars, feed, and fertilizers, and provide product development support for low-carbohydrate, gluten-free, low-GI, and vegan foods. The company emphasizes direct overseas sourcing for cost-effectiveness and maintains strict quality control with ISO9001 certification.

name: Corel Lifecare
summary: Corel Lifecare applies precision biosciences to aquaculture farming, offering science-led biological solutions that enhance growth, survival, and system balance. Their products aim to reduce guesswork and increase predictability for farmers, moving beyond traditional manufacturing to provide reliable, on-pond results. The company also offers contract manufacturing and white-labeling services through its 'Build Your Brand' vertical.

name: LA TROJA
summary: LA TROJA is a company specializing in plant-based food products derived from legumes. They offer native and precooked legume flours, gluten-free extrusions, and selected grains, emphasizing healthy, natural, and delicious options. Their products are rich in proteins, fibers, and vitamins, contributing to a healthy diet and are marketed to various industries.

name: Ada Valley
summary: Ada Valley specializes in producing high-quality, center-of-the-plate meat products for healthcare and restaurant settings. They offer a range of beef, poultry, and pork options, emphasizing low sodium, allergen-free, and consistent quality. The company is committed to providing choice meats and foods, catering to specific dietary needs like dysphagia and 'no antibiotics ever' preferences.

name: Balance Me NZ
summary: Balance Me NZ is a food production company specializing in plant-based products for the food service industry. They offer business-friendly, plant-based solutions like sausageless rolls and chickpea tofu, designed to help cafes and restaurants easily incorporate inclusive menu options. Their mission is to provide delicious, convenient plant-based meals for customers with dietary requirements.

name: Festa Food Company
summary: Festa Food Company is a premium frozen food manufacturer with over 30 years of experience, specializing in producing meals for specialized diets and precise nutrition at scale. They offer flexible manufacturing for private label, co-packing, and medically tailored meals, serving sectors like schools, military, healthcare, retail, and foodservice. Their mission is to provide clean label, nutritionally dense frozen meals with a focus on quality and meeting exact specifications.

name: Seed Oil Company
summary: Seed Oil Company is an e-commerce business specializing in organic, non-GMO, cold-pressed seed oils and plant-based nutrition products. They offer a range of products derived from pumpkin seeds, including protein powder and various grades of pumpkin seed oil, as well as omega-3 supplements for humans, pets, and livestock. The company emphasizes natural processing methods and provides educational content through blogs and recipes.

name: ProFood Zrt.
summary: ProFood Zrt. is a Hungarian company specializing in the development and production of high-quality food ingredients and solutions. Their product range includes spice blends, flavorings, marinades, breading systems, liquid smoke, sauces, and decorative spices, catering to various dietary needs like vegan, allergen-free, clean label, and halal. The company emphasizes innovation, research and development, and offers educational programs through its Profood Akadémia.

name: SunOpta
summary: SunOpta is a company that provides customized supply chain solutions and innovation for brands, retailers, and foodservice providers. They specialize in a broad portfolio of beverages, broths, and better-for-you snacks, including plant-based options and fruit-based products. SunOpta also offers co-manufacturing, private label services, and ingredient sourcing, focusing on organic and non-GMO verified products.

name: 南京周子未来食品科技有限公司
summary: Nanjing Zhouzi Future Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a company focused on developing and producing cultivated meat, also known as cell-cultured meat. They aim to provide a sustainable, ethical, and efficient alternative to traditional meat production, addressing growing global meat demand while mitigating environmental impact and animal welfare concerns. Their product offerings include various forms of cell-cultured pork and a range of cell lines for research and development.

name: U-Relish
summary: U-Relish offers an artisan, small-batch line of vegan and gluten-free meals for slow-cooking, primarily using beans, peas, lentils, and grains. The business was acquired in 2022 and now sells products at local farmers' markets, special events, and online, focusing on convenient and nutritious meal solutions. They aim to provide easy-to-prepare, healthy meals adaptable to various tastes.

name: Norfolk Foods
summary: Norfolk Foods is a privately owned Australian family company specializing in contract manufacturing of value-added meat products and plant-based alternatives. They offer services in product development, quality assurance, and cater to various markets. Located in Melbourne, they operate from a substantial production facility.

name: Nutriservice
summary: Nutriservice is a company with over 30 years of experience, specializing in animal nutrition and toll manufacturing (maquila) services for food and feed. They offer tailored solutions for various animal divisions including pigs, aquaculture, poultry, and pets, emphasizing intelligent, responsible, and customized nutrition. The company operates with a focus on quality, innovation, and trust, serving producers with specific needs.

name: Ibérica Feeding Stuff
summary: Ibérica Feeding Stuff is a manufacturer of high-quality animal feed, established in 2013. They produce a wide range of over 160 feed products for companion animals, intensive and extensive livestock, poultry, and rural species, using national raw materials and expert technical development. Their mission is to provide nutritious, safe, and fresh products that support animal well-being and professional profitability, offering customized formulations and specialized technical advice.

name: Hubbard Feeds
summary: Hubbard Feeds is a company specializing in animal nutrition, providing research-based feed products and support services for various livestock and companion animals. As part of the Alltech family, they focus on improving animal health, productivity, and profitability for producers through innovative feed formulations and expert consultation. Their mission is to help people raise healthy animals while promoting sustainable agriculture.

name: Handtmann Global
summary: Handtmann Global is a company that develops intelligent technologies to optimize food production processes. They offer modular solutions for various food applications including meat and sausage, bakery, pet food, ready meals, alternative proteins, dairy, and seafood. Their services encompass machine solutions, line solutions, individual solutions, refurbished machines, digital solutions, and partner solutions, all aimed at advancing innovation and quality in food processing.

name: King's Gourmet Foods
summary: King's Gourmet Foods is a food manufacturing company specializing in high-quality, artisanal ingredients and finished products such as pesto sauces, garlic, ginger, and onions. They emphasize fresh, farm-sourced produce, prepared using traditional methods with modern innovation, and adhere to strict quality controls including being preservative-free, artificial color/flavor-free, glass-free, and allergen-free. The company serves both retail and food service markets, offering custom solutions and private label services, and distributes products across the West Coast, British Columbia, East Coast, and Mid West.

name: Soyana
summary: Soyana is a Syrian manufacturing company founded in 2007, specializing in high-performance animal feed additives and premixes for poultry, ruminants, and fish. They operate an innovative, automated plant producing VIMEX® premixes and full-fat soybean ingredients. Their mission is to enhance animal health, optimize productivity, and support efficient nutrition through science-driven solutions.

name: Building Brands Together
summary: This company specializes in co-manufacturing and private label production for food brands, focusing on cookies, crackers, savory snacks, grains, gluten-free pasta, mac 'n cheese, and baby food. They operate a certified plant-based, gluten-free, and peanut-free facility with advanced extrusion and packaging technology. Their mission is to build brands through trust and collaboration, adapting to the needs of both startups and established retailers.

name: OMNI
summary: OMNI is a brand specializing in plant-based food products, offering a range of alternatives to meat and seafood. Their product line includes plant-based burgers, seafood fillets, crab-style cakes, tuna, pork mince, and luncheon meat, alongside plant-based fried rice options. The company aims to provide sustainable and delicious food choices, catering to a growing market for alternative proteins.

name: Le Petit Menez Céréales Fermières
summary: Le Petit Menez is a family-run business specializing in the production and sale of animal feed. They offer a wide range of products including raw materials, feed for poultry, herbivores, equines, goats, sheep, rabbits, pigs, and pets like dogs and cats. The company emphasizes artisanal production, guarantees OGM-free products, and practices sustainable agriculture, supporting local beekeepers. They cater to both individuals and small-scale farms.

name: 苏州禾能生物科技有限公司
summary: Suzhou Hneng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a biotechnology company focused on cellular agriculture, specializing in the innovative processing of soybeans. They have developed proprietary technology to remove undesirable flavors and gas-producing factors from soybeans, creating a plant-based milk powder with a rich, appealing taste. The company aims to leverage agricultural modernization and biotechnology to create sustainable food systems, connecting various ecological levels from soil to human health.

name: Terrium
summary: Terrium is a Chilean food manufacturing company specializing in gluten-free and vegan products. They focus on adding value to local ingredients, particularly through collaborations with farmers in La Araucanía. Their product line includes a variety of food items such as meat replacements, flour mixes, plant-based beverages, cookies, and ready-to-eat meals, all produced with a focus on sustainability and reduced environmental impact, positioning them as a B Corp.

name: POLI.COM Srl
summary: POLI.COM Srl is an Italian company with over 40 years of experience specializing in the production of plant-based food products. They focus on creating natural, tasty, and sustainable items such as plant-based drinks, spreads, and almond paste. The company also offers semi-finished products and private label services for the food and beverage industry, emphasizing innovation and Italian craftsmanship.

name: Yumgo
summary: Yumgo is a company specializing in the production and sale of 100% plant-based egg alternatives. Their product line includes 'Entier' (whole egg replacement), 'Blanc' (egg white replacement for meringues), and 'Jaune' (egg yolk replacement for richness and color). These products are designed to be allergen-free, easy to use, and suitable for various culinary applications, catering to both home cooks and professional chefs seeking vegan and sustainable options.

name: Pasquier Vgt’Al.
summary: Pasquier Vgt’al is an independent company specializing in animal nutrition, plant production, and cereal trading. They offer services such as feed manufacturing, custom formulation, animal health and dietetics consulting, and advice on crop production, including forage and large crops. The company focuses on providing sustainable solutions for agriculture, including the valorization of plant proteins and contributing to the "agriculture of tomorrow."

name: Organo Fertilizers (india) Private Limited
summary: Organo Fertilizers (india) Private Limited is a company that recycles poultry and animal by-products into valuable products such as poultry meal, chicken fat, and organic fertilizers. They operate clean and efficient conversion plants, transforming raw materials into nutrient-rich feed ingredients and soil enhancers. The company emphasizes its contribution to preserving natural resources through this recycling process and is committed to providing responsive and fast service to all its customers.

name: Belstra Milling Company
summary: Belstra Milling Company is a family-owned agriculture enterprise founded in 1954, specializing in the production of high-quality nutritional feeds and vitamin mixes for a wide range of animals, from large-scale dairies to backyard flocks and pets. The company operates multiple divisions, including BMC Transport for feed delivery, Belstra Group Farms for swine farm support, and Belstra Farm & Garden for homesteading supplies. Driven by values of integrity, quality, and service, Belstra Milling focuses on innovation and collaboration with nutritionists to enhance animal health and performance.

name: Nutreatlife
summary: Nutreatlife is a company that handcrafts custom food premixes using traditional methods like sprouting, sun-drying, slow roasting, and stone grinding. They offer personalized blends for various dietary needs, including baby cereals, women's health, diabetic care, and fitness. The company emphasizes eco-friendly practices with zero food wastage and has created over 14,000 custom food stories.

name: AGROZACCA ALIMENTOS LTDA
summary: AGROZACCA ALIMENTOS LTDA is an animal nutrition company founded in 1999, specializing in the manufacturing of high-quality animal feed, concentrates, and supplements. Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, the company serves the southern Brazilian markets and is committed to ethical principles and product quality. They offer a diverse product line for various animal species and also provide opportunities for resellers.

name: SIMFOPES FOOD PROCESSING PRIVATE LIMITED
summary: SIMFOPES FOOD is a leading manufacturer and exporter of healthy food products, specializing in contract manufacturing, private labeling, and product development for ready-to-cook items. With over 20 years of experience, they focus on high-quality ingredients, sustainability, and simplifying cooking processes for both domestic and commercial kitchens. The company is committed to rural employment and women empowerment, aiming to be a one-stop solution provider in the food industry.

name: MOMETA
summary: MOMETA, founded by Melanie Tag-Schindler, is a specialized retailer of high-quality animal feed, including dry food, B.A.R.F. (Biologically Appropriate Raw Food), and feed for livestock. The company emphasizes animal welfare through species-appropriate nutrition and supports regional agriculture by providing non-GMO feed to local farmers. MOMETA offers a delivery service within a 50 km radius and operates by appointment, prioritizing customer service and expert advice.

name: Good Stock Foods
summary: Good Stock Foods is an Edmonton-based, family-owned company specializing in healthy, plant-based frozen meals and dairy-free cheese products. Founded by a Red-Seal Chef, the company focuses on creating delicious, home-style food from scratch without cooking oils, refined sugar, or highly processed ingredients. They offer a wide variety of frozen meals, plant-based cheeses, and pantry items, serving both direct consumers and a growing wholesale market.

name: International Food Srl
summary: International Food Srl specializes in the creation of safe and high-quality plant-based products. They focus on sourcing excellent raw materials from sustainable agriculture, ensuring a short supply chain. The company utilizes an exclusive whole-grain extraction method without intermediate refining or flours, prioritizing both taste and health in their organic offerings. With a history dating back to 1977 and continuous investment in research, they are positioned as an ideal partner for developing custom plant-based food solutions.

name: Unicum Trade Botanicals (UTB)
summary: Unicum Trade Botanicals (UTB) is a company specializing in the development and production of private label nutritional supplements, food, and premixes for human and veterinary use. With nearly 40 years of experience, they offer flexible, customized manufacturing solutions, handling everything from formulation and raw material sourcing to packaging and logistics. UTB holds certifications such as ISO22000:2018, FCA, and BIO, emphasizing quality and sustainability in their complex production processes.

name: Cooper Farms Inc.
summary: Cooper Farms is a family-owned company with over 85 years of experience in producing quality private-label food products, including deli meats, sliced meats, turkey burgers, commodity meats, and eggs. They also produce pet food ingredients and emphasize animal care, food safety, and community involvement. The company focuses on building strong relationships with its customers and employees, fostering a culture of doing the right thing.

name: Mid-South Feeds, Inc.
summary: Mid-South Feeds is a company that produces and distributes premium animal feed for a variety of species including pets, equine, cattle, gamecock, gamebird, poultry, swine, and goats. They focus on providing nutritionally balanced, science-backed formulas made with quality ingredients to support animal health, growth, and performance. The company also offers specialty feeds and ingredients, and operates a dealer and distributor network.

name: Meridian Feed Mill
summary: Meridian Feed Mill, also known as Dynamite Specialty Products, is a company that purveys specialty products and secret formulas for animal feed. They offer a range of products categorized by animal type, including horse and cattle, poultry, swine, sheep, llamas, goats, and small animals. The company also provides custom processing services and has a history section on its website.

name: Mrs. Murry's Naturals
summary: Mrs. Murry's Naturals is a food company dedicated to providing high-quality food options for everyone, regardless of dietary restrictions or allergies. They offer a range of products including cakes, cookies, pies, and frozen meals, with a focus on scratch-made ingredients. The company operates through direct sales, farmers' markets, and partnerships with local businesses like Cleo's Bodega & Café.

name: Intercity Packers
summary: Intercity Packers is a Canadian company that has been producing, sourcing, and delivering premium quality meat and seafood products since 1972. They serve top restaurants, retailers, and healthcare establishments across Canada. The company emphasizes a consultative approach with customers, focusing on sustainable practices and community well-being.

name: Pilarica
summary: Pilarica is a company with over 100 years of experience specializing in the development of functional ingredient blends for the industrial and food service channels. They offer customized solutions, including complete blends, functional bases, and raw materials, catering to sectors like meat, snacks, vegan products, and food service. Pilarica focuses on innovation, allowing clients to modify products by introducing new ingredients, removing allergens, reducing additives, and altering flavors, colors, and formats.

name: Revi Food bv
summary: Revi Food bv is a company specializing in the production of high-quality food products, particularly known for its artisanal croquettes made from grey shrimp, cheese, and other ingredients. They also offer a range of soups, spreads, salads, and plant-based alternatives. Their mission is to craft taste inspired by customer preferences, focusing on quality ingredients and ease of use for professional kitchens.

name: Pasquier Vgt’Al.
summary: Pasquier Vgt’al is an independent company specializing in animal nutrition, plant production, and cereal trading. They offer services such as feed manufacturing, custom formulation, animal health and dietetics consulting, and advice on crop production, including forage and large crops. The company focuses on providing sustainable solutions for agriculture, including the valorization of plant proteins and contributing to the "agriculture of tomorrow."

name: Neat Feeding S.r.l.
summary: Neat Feeding S.r.l. is a company specializing in animal nutrition, founded in 2013. They produce and sell sustainable animal feed and premixes, offering both ready-to-use solutions and custom formulations in liquid or powder form. The company serves farmers and resellers, aiming to improve the efficiency and well-being of livestock farms, and also provides contract manufacturing services.

name: Imposter Food
summary: Imposter Food is a company that produces and sells plant-based, dairy-free, and soy-free food products, including mozzarella sticks, jalapeño bites, mozzarella shreds, and cream cheese. They operate a dedicated 100% plant-based facility in Troy, NY, and focus on offering alternatives to traditional dairy products. The company also offers a newsletter subscription for updates.

name: Eiger Holdings (Private) Ltd.
summary: Eiger Holdings is an inspired food solutions provider that offers a diverse portfolio of high-quality food products for both the foodservice and retail sectors. They specialize in innovative ingredients, plant-based alternatives like I-BIND, and processed food components such as coated fries and casings. The company acts as a representative for international food brands, focusing on innovation, agility, and value creation for businesses and consumers.

name: Vemiwa
summary: Vemiwa is a full-service provider specializing in high-quality plant-based food products. They cater to the foodservice industry, offering a range of meat substitutes and creative vegan dishes. Additionally, Vemiwa provides white-label and contract manufacturing services, assisting clients in developing, producing, packaging, and marketing their own plant-based food products. Their mission is to create delicious plant-based foods that consumers can enjoy with a clear conscience.

name: Crème de la crème
summary: Crème de la crème is a food company specializing in plant-based products such as butters, Mac 'N Cheeze, and pestos. They emphasize the use of plant-based ingredients and botanical flavors, aiming to offer delicious and high-quality alternatives. The company also provides co-packing services and distributes its products across Canada and the United States.

name: Coco Earth
summary: Coco Earth is an Australian-owned company specializing in natural and organic health and wellness products. They offer a range of items including almond protein powder, ready-to-eat meals, and specialty oils and flours, with a vision to promote healthy and sustainable lifestyles. While their online store is closed, their products are available through major Australian retailers like Coles and Woolworths.

name: 8th Avenue Food & Provisions
summary: 8th Avenue Food & Provisions is a leading manufacturer and distributor of nut butters, specializing in private label, co-manufacturing, and foodservice solutions. They offer a wide range of conventional and organic peanut and tree nut butters, with versatile packaging and processing capabilities. The company emphasizes customer-centricity, quality, and safety, serving retail, foodservice, industrial, and e-commerce channels globally.

name: Chelten House Products, LLC
summary: Chelten House is a food production company with generations of culinary expertise, specializing in private label, food service, and co-manufacturing solutions. They collaborate with clients to develop and produce a wide range of food products, including salad dressings, pasta sauces, salsas, and more. The company emphasizes quality ingredients, culinary innovation, and building partnerships to help clients differentiate themselves in the market.

name: ООО «ЭкоФактор»
summary: ЭкоФактор is an innovative company based in Koltsovo, Russia, that develops and produces the "Algalat" feed complex. This complex is designed to improve the survival rate and productivity of livestock and poultry without the use of antibiotics or GMOs. It is a synbiotic product composed of live cultures of microalgae Chlorella vulgaris and lactic acid bacteria, along with organic and mineral fillers, offering detoxification, antioxidant, and sorbent properties.

name: Van Koolen
summary: Van Koolen is a family business specializing in the production of innovative plant-based food products derived from mushrooms, vegetables, and vegetable proteins. They focus on taste, recognizable ingredients, and transparency, managing the entire process from growing their own ingredients to delivering the final product. The company emphasizes sustainability, contributing to a lower CO2 footprint compared to meat production.

name: Taylor Gleason Enterprises
summary: Taylor Gleason Enterprises (TGE) is a private label food manufacturer and co-packing facility specializing in allergen-free products. They offer services including dry blending, private label food manufacturing, and food packaging for various product types and formats. TGE emphasizes its SQF Certified, gluten-free, and Top 14 Allergen-free facility to ensure the safety and quality of products for health-conscious consumers.

name: Bluebonnet
summary: Bluebonnet is a company that manufactures and supplies animal feed and supplements, with a primary focus on equine nutrition. They emphasize science-backed formulas, safety, and transparency in their ingredients, offering products for horses, poultry, and livestock. The company also provides nutrition consultations and educational resources to empower animal owners.

name: (주)팡세 (Pensées Inc.)
summary: (주)팡세 (Pensées Inc.) is a company focused on producing cultivated meat through advanced 3D bioprinting technology. Their mission is to contribute to a sustainable world where delicious meat can be enjoyed without compromising the environment. They aim to offer a new, sustainable alternative to traditional meat production.

name: MFiber Inc.
summary: MFiber Inc. is a company that produces and supplies a natural fiber ingredient derived from Miscanthus grass for the pet food industry. Their product, MFiber, is promoted as a healthy, cost-effective, and sustainable alternative to traditional fiber sources in pet food formulations. The company emphasizes its vertically integrated system, from farming to processing, and its commitment to non-GMO, grain-free, and gluten-free ingredients.

name: Arizona Algae Products, LLC
summary: Arizona Algae Products, LLC is an innovative biotechnology company specializing in the sustainable production of animal-free omega-3 oils and protein powders derived from microalgae. Utilizing proprietary production technologies and a controlled environment, the company offers high-quality, non-GMO, and allergen-free ingredients for the food, dietary supplement, and wellness industries. Their mission is to provide environmentally friendly solutions for a healthier society by avoiding overfishing and promoting sustainable alternatives.

name: Groupe Berkem
summary: Groupe Berkem is a French producer of 100% natural organic plant-based oils and proteins, specializing in textured vegetable proteins (TVP) derived from locally sourced soybeans. They offer solutions for human nutrition, animal feed, and industrial applications, leveraging expertise in plant extraction and extrusion processes. The company emphasizes sustainable sourcing and high-quality, organic products.

name: Intercity Packers
summary: Intercity Packers is a Canadian company that has been producing, sourcing, and delivering premium quality meat and seafood products since 1972. They serve top restaurants, retailers, and healthcare establishments across Canada. The company emphasizes a consultative approach with customers, focusing on sustainable practices and community well-being.

name: Bluebonnet
summary: Bluebonnet is a company that manufactures and supplies animal feed and supplements, with a primary focus on equine nutrition. They emphasize science-backed formulas, safety, and transparency in their ingredients, offering products for horses, poultry, and livestock. The company also provides nutrition consultations and educational resources to empower animal owners.

name: Pancho's Vegan Foods
summary: Pancho's Vegan Foods specializes in creating innovative and delicious vegan meat alternatives, including popular options like asada, pastor, chorizo, carnitas, chicken, nacho cheese, and sour cream. Originally a restaurant founded in 2016, the company now focuses on providing unique, customer-tested products to elevate restaurant and catering services. They offer comprehensive support, including menu reviews, development, staff training, and marketing materials, to help businesses expand their offerings with high-quality plant-based options.

name: KENT WORLDWIDE
summary: KENT WORLDWIDE is a family-owned company founded in 1927, specializing in ag-based ingredients and consumer brands. They are known for their expertise in marketing and manufacturing, transforming science into solutions for food, beverage, agriculture, and pet products. The company focuses on innovation, sustainability, and building long-term relationships, aiming to help a growing world do more.

name: ТОВ ТЕКРО
summary: TEKRO is a company specializing in the production, distribution, marketing, and consulting for animal feed and care for both domestic and agricultural animals. Founded in 1991, it has grown to become a leading producer of animal feed products in Eastern Europe, with a strong focus on premixes, supplements, and specialized feed programs. The company also distributes products from international partners and offers comprehensive consulting services to its clients.

name: FZ Organic Food
summary: FZ Organic Food is a company specializing in the production and distribution of organic food products, including Asian meal bases, chips, snacks, natural foods, and pantry staples like coconut oil and agave syrup. They also offer private label services for their products. The company emphasizes passion for organic farming, respect for nature, and traditional recipes, with a focus on sustainability and meeting the rising demand for meat substitutes.

name: 广州素兴贸易有限公司 (Guangzhou Suxing Trading Co., Ltd.)
summary: Guangzhou Suxing Trading Co., Ltd. is a trading company established in 2013, specializing in the wholesale, retail, and franchise distribution of plant-based meat products and vegetarian food items. They offer a wide range of imitation meat products, including frozen and ambient options, as well as vegetarian seasonings, catering to both businesses and individual consumers. The company operates with a philosophy of integrity and social contribution, aiming to provide high-quality, affordable vegetarian products.

name: Down to Cook, Inc.
summary: Down to Cook, Inc. produces and markets Adda Veggie, a plant-based food product designed as a versatile ingredient for various culinary applications. Their offerings include blends like Original, Chipotle Adobo, and Indian Masala, primarily targeting the foodservice industry, especially K-12 school nutrition programs. The company focuses on providing clean-label, allergen-free, and whole-vegetable-rooted options to create appealing vegetarian meals.

name: Essantis (formerly Unigrain)
summary: Essantis, formerly Unigrain, is a passionate producer of Australian-grown plant-based food and beverage ingredients. With over 40 years of experience, the company specializes in oat cereal products, oat milk base, animal nutrition, and various pulse-derived ingredients like proteins, starches, and flours. They are committed to innovation, quality, integrity, and genuine relationships, aiming to empower a plant-based future.

name: Meatless
summary: Meatless is a company specializing in the production of plant-based textured ingredients for the food industry, particularly for vegetarian and vegan products. They offer a range of textured flakes derived from rice, fava beans, and mycoprotein, designed to enhance texture, mouthfeel, and stability in meat and fish alternatives. Meatless operates as a brand of BENEO, leveraging BENEO's raw material expertise and its own technology to provide versatile plant-based solutions.

name: 升福生物科技有限公司
summary: Sheng Fu Bio-Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, and production of fermented feed for aquaculture and livestock. Established in 2003, the company focuses on high-quality, fully fermented feed, utilizing original probiotic strains to enhance animal growth, improve feed conversion rates, boost immunity, and purify water in aquaculture. They also offer customized feed formulations to meet specific client needs, aiming to create superior agricultural products and increase competitiveness for farmers.

name: Alver BV
summary: Alver BV is a company specializing in sustainable, clean-label microalgae-based ingredients, developing Golden and Diamond Chlorella® for plant-based food products. They utilize proprietary fermentation technology for cost-effective, scalable, and eco-friendly production in Maastricht, NL. Their mission is to transform the food system with nutritious, sustainable, and functional ingredients, offering natural protein solutions to meet the growing demand for plant-based alternatives.

name: For Foodies GmbH
summary: For Foodies GmbH is a company specializing in the creation and sale of plant-based, gluten-free sauces, dips, and spreads. Founded by Oli Rick, the company emphasizes high-quality ingredients, artisanal craftsmanship, and sustainable practices. Their products are available in retail markets and supplied to cafes and restaurants, aiming to enhance culinary experiences with unique flavors.

name: Rebellyous Foods
summary: Rebellyous Foods is a company that produces plant-based chicken alternatives, including tenders, popcorn chicken, and nuggets. Their mission is to create delicious, affordable, and sustainable meat alternatives using advanced manufacturing technology. They aim to provide consumers with options that are better for both people and the planet.

name: Prime Roots Meats
summary: Prime Roots Meats offers clean-label deli meats and bacon with no preservatives or artificial ingredients, focusing on a meatier texture and bolder flavor. They emphasize transparency in their ingredients and aim to provide a healthier alternative to traditional processed meats. The company also targets the foodservice industry and promotes its products through various channels including a blog and social media.

name: Culture Fresh Foods, Inc.
summary: Culture Fresh Foods, Inc. is a plant-based dairy alternative production facility specializing in non-dairy spoonables, spreadables, and drinkables. They offer private label manufacturing, contract packing (co-packing), and cold storage/3PL services. The company operates an SQF Level II certified facility and works with major retailers and national brands, positioning itself as a quality-driven producer in the food and beverage industry.

name: Beyond Animal
summary: Beyond Animal is a professional network and online platform dedicated to the animal-free industry. It connects investors with vegan businesses for capital raising, helps investors find ethical investment opportunities, and facilitates networking and business development among vegan entrepreneurs. The platform also hosts a job board for ethical businesses and aims to accelerate the transition to an economy free of animal exploitation through technology-driven services.

name: ЭКОРМ
summary: ЭКОРМ specializes in supplying equipment for processing animal by-products, slaughter waste, and deceased animals. Their patented dry extrusion technology transforms waste into high-nutrient, sterile feed for various livestock and poultry. The company emphasizes the environmental friendliness and economic viability of its solutions, with a rapid return on investment for equipment purchasers.

name: Ibérica Feeding Stuff
summary: Ibérica Feeding Stuff is a manufacturer of high-quality animal feed, established in 2013. They produce a wide range of over 160 feed products for companion animals, intensive and extensive livestock, poultry, and rural species, using national raw materials and expert technical development. Their mission is to provide nutritious, safe, and fresh products that support animal well-being and professional profitability, offering customized formulations and specialized technical advice.

name: Mazzoleni S.p.A.
summary: Mazzoleni S.p.A. is an Italian company specializing in the production and sale of technologically advanced products for animal nutrition. They offer a comprehensive range of components and ingredients for the animal feed industry, as well as complete solutions for retailers, including private label options. Their mission is to improve the well-being and performance of breeding animals through innovative nutritional, management, and technological solutions.

name: Renewal Processing, Inc.
summary: Renewal Processing is a family-owned business specializing in the food by-product industry, transforming waste into high-quality feed ingredients through a renewal process. They aim to reduce landfill waste while providing valuable services to customers, vendors, and the community. The company emphasizes customized handling, certificates of destruction, and a commitment to being "green" and cost-effective.

name: TOFUTOWN
summary: TOFUTOWN is a traditional organic manufacturer specializing in vegan food products, including spreads, tofu, seitan, and convenience meals. Founded in 1981 as a "Tofu Kollektiv," it evolved into a GmbH and is now part of the international Vegan Food Group. The company emphasizes high-quality, organic, vegan, and sustainable ingredients, aiming to provide delicious food without animal products.

name: Edgy Foods
summary: Edgy Foods is a supplier of plant-based raw materials for the food industry, serving both industrial clients and the foodservice sector. They offer a range of products including various types of peas and lentils, with options for organic sourcing. The company aims to provide ingredients to food wholesalers and manufacturers, facilitating their integration into the supply chain.

name: Natural By Nature
summary: Natural By Nature is a company specializing in the production of high-quality organic, grass-based dairy products and organic oats. They offer private labeling and co-packing services, focusing on sustainable farming practices and direct communication with clients. The company positions itself as a nimble partner for businesses seeking premium dairy and oat ingredients.

name: Pattern Pet
summary: Pattern Pet is a manufacturer and distributor of pet food and related products with over 18 years of experience. They offer a wide range of products for aquatic animals, pets, and poultry, emphasizing quality through continuous research and development, modern manufacturing processes, and efficient logistics. The company aims to provide high-quality products that meet international standards and customer needs.

name: Astrid's Fine Foods
summary: Astrid's Fine Foods is a company specializing in connecting buyers and sellers of natural, organic, and environmentally sound food products. They focus on sourcing high-quality ingredients from trusted suppliers and makers, serving both consumers and top chefs in the region. The company emphasizes providing fresh, quality products and fostering relationships within the food industry.

name: Nummies, LLC
summary: Nummies Bakery is a family-owned and operated contract manufacturing facility specializing in gluten-free, dairy-free, peanut-free, and soy-free baked goods. They produce a variety of items including bread, cookies, muffins, cupcakes, and pizza crusts. The company is certified by GFCO, OK Kosher, and SQF Level II, ensuring high standards for products suitable for individuals with dietary restrictions and general consumers.

name: Frisian Egg
summary: Frisian Egg is a company specializing in egg products, with a focus on egg powder and fluid egg products. The company highlights its history, product range, packaging capabilities, and plant locations. Their core business revolves around processing and distributing egg-based food ingredients.

name: Tasco
summary: Tasco is an innovative company that produces a natural, marine-plant based prebiotic ingredient, Tasco®, for premium animal feed and pet food formulations. Their product supports animal health and well-being, contributing to the efficiency and profitability of animal production. They offer expert support to help clients create performance-driven formulations.

name: Serfco
summary: Serfco is a family-owned business specializing in the production and distribution of natural, high-quality animal feeds. Their products are free from antibiotics, hormones, and growth stimulants, catering to a wide range of animals including livestock, poultry, pets, and game. The company emphasizes animal health and environmental care, and also offers distributorship opportunities.

name: Rangen Group
summary: Rangen Group is a company focused on innovative nutrition for various industries including aquaculture, livestock, lifestyle, and pet sectors. They offer premium feed, forage products, and tailored solutions that promote productivity, animal health, and sustainable growth. The company also provides specialized services in material handling, premixing, and bottling, leveraging industry expertise to optimize operational efficiency.
